papers.title: Strain-Tunable Spin Relaxation in Germanium from First Principles
papers.abstract: Germanium is a leading platform for semiconductor spin qubits and spintronics. Yet its electron and hole spin dynamics remain understood primarily through phenomenological models. Here, we predict electronic transport and spin relaxation in bulk Ge entirely from first principles, combining hybrid-functional band structures with fully relativistic electron-phonon ($e$-ph) interactions. Without empirical parameters, we predict carrier mobilities, velocity-field curves, and electron and hole spin relaxation times in close agreement with experiments over 100$-$400 K. By resolving spin-flip scattering by valley and phonon mode, we identify the microscopic mechanisms governing spin relaxation and show that spin and momentum relaxation, although both mediated by $e$-ph scattering, are controlled by distinct processes. We further show that compressive biaxial strain enhances the hole spin lifetime by up to two orders of magnitude at 5% strain, through strain-induced valence-band splitting and suppressed spin mixing. This mechanism is directly relevant to Ge-on-Si devices, where strain provides a practical route to engineering long-lived hole spins for quantum technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“from first principles”（第一性原理计算）、“hybrid-functional band structures”（杂化泛函能带）、“fully relativistic electron-phonon interactions”（全相对论电子-声子相互作用），属于第一性原理计算研究。；研究对象：体相锗（bulk Ge）中的电子与空穴输运性质及自旋弛豫动力学，具体包括载流子迁移率、速度-电场曲线、电子与空穴自旋弛豫时间，以及双轴压应变对空穴自旋寿命的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在不引入任何经验参数的情况下，第一性原理计算可定量重现100–400 K范围内锗的迁移率、速度-电场曲线及电子/空穴自旋弛豫时间；自旋弛豫与动量弛豫虽均由电子-声子散射介导，但受不同微观过程控制。此外，5%双轴压应变通过价带劈裂抑制自旋混合，可将空穴自旋寿命提升约两个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在不引入任何经验参数的情况下，第一性原理计算可定量重现100–400 K范围内锗的迁移率、速度-电场曲线及电子/空穴自旋弛豫时间；自旋弛豫与动量弛豫虽均由电子-声子散射介导，但受不同微观过程控制。此外，5%双轴压应变通过价带劈裂抑制自旋混合，可将空穴自旋寿命提升约两个数量级。；创新点：首次完全从第一性原理（无经验参数）统一预测锗的电子与空穴输运及自旋弛豫性质，并揭示自旋弛豫与动量弛豫由不同散射过程控制；同时提出应变工程（双轴压应变）作为提升Ge-on-Si器件中空穴自旋寿命的实用途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用杂化泛函（hybrid-functional）计算锗的电子能带结构，结合全相对论电子-声子相互作用（fully relativistic e-ph interactions）进行第一性原理输运与自旋弛豫计算。具体方法包括：基于第一性原理计算载流子迁移率、速度-电场曲线、自旋弛豫时间，并按能谷和声子模式分解自旋翻转散射以识别微观机制。

papers.title: Microwave-Induced Optomagnetism in High-Temperature Superconductors
papers.abstract: We report the first experimental observation of a steady-state, microwave-driven inverse Faraday effect in a high-temperature superconductor. Circularly polarized microwave radiation generates a helicity-dependent response in an epitaxial $\mathrm{YBa_2Cu_3O_{7-δ}}$ film, detected using homodyne Hall transport. The optomagnetic response emerges exclusively below $T_c$, vanishes in the normal state, and exhibits no power-dependent counterpart under linearly polarized excitation. The effective optomagnetic conversion reaches $1.75\,\mathrm{T}/(\mathrm{W\,cm^{-2}})$, surpassing optical benchmarks by several orders of magnitude. At higher microwave powers, the signal collapses when the self-generated field exceeds $B_{c1}$, marking the onset of a vortex phase-slip regime, and subsequently re-emerges at mode-locked vortex-washboard harmonics. These results establish steady-state microwave optomagnetism as a route to contactless, non-inductive magnetic control and nonequilibrium vortex spectroscopy in superconducting quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“first experimental observation”，并描述了具体的实验测量手段（homodyne Hall transport）。；研究对象：高温超导体外延薄膜 YBa₂Cu₃O₇₋δ（YBCO），具体研究其超导态下由圆偏振微波驱动的逆法拉第效应（稳态微波光磁效应）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高温超导体YBCO薄膜中首次实验观测到稳态微波驱动的逆法拉第效应：圆偏振微波在超导态下产生依赖于手性的光磁响应，有效光磁转换效率高达1.75 T/(W·cm⁻²)，远超光学波段基准；在高功率下信号因自生场超过Bc1而塌缩，随后在涡旋洗板谐波处重新出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高温超导体YBCO薄膜中首次实验观测到稳态微波驱动的逆法拉第效应：圆偏振微波在超导态下产生依赖于手性的光磁响应，有效光磁转换效率高达1.75 T/(W·cm⁻²)，远超光学波段基准；在高功率下信号因自生场超过Bc1而塌缩，随后在涡旋洗板谐波处重新出现。；创新点：首次在高温超导体中实现稳态（非瞬态）微波频段的逆法拉第效应，将光磁效应从光学频段拓展至微波频段，并展示其作为无接触、非感应式磁调控手段以及非平衡涡旋谱学工具的潜力。摘要未突出说明与已有微波-超导相互作用研究的其他对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：外延YBCO薄膜的制备、圆偏振微波辐照、同相（homodyne）霍尔输运测量以检测手性依赖响应；通过改变微波功率和偏振状态（圆偏振 vs 线偏振）进行对照实验；通过温度变化（低于/高于Tc）区分超导态与正常态响应。

papers.title: Static-Field Shielding of Bosonic Molecules: Evaporation to Degeneracy and Self-Bound Droplets
papers.abstract: The strong, tunable dipolar interactions of ultracold molecules make them a powerful platform for quantum many-body physics, but reaching degeneracy by evaporative cooling requires suppressing inelastic collisions. Microwave collisional shielding has enabled the preparation of degenerate Fermi gases and Bose-Einstein condensates of polar molecules, whereas static electric field shielding has been limited to fermionic species, which are less prone to inelastic loss. We demonstrate static-field Förster shielding of bosonic $^{23}$Na$^{87}$Rb molecules, suppressing two-body loss by up to four orders of magnitude. Within a bound-state-free electric-field window, three-body loss is also strongly suppressed, enabling efficient evaporation. Evaporating with an efficiency of 2.09(9), we increase the phase-space density of the gas by two orders of magnitude, reaching degeneracy with 7200(1000) molecules. We observe self-bound droplets at the end of evaporation over a wide range of field strengths, emerging from either degenerate or non-degenerate parent gases. We perform Path Integral Monte Carlo simulations, which suggest that the observed droplets are filamentary in nature, and find good agreement with the experimentally observed droplet formation temperatures. Our results establish Förster shielding as a single-field route to prepare degenerate gases and self-bound droplets of bosonic polar molecules.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述实验演示（“We demonstrate”）、实验观测（“We observe”）及实验数据（“efficiency of 2.09(9)”），并辅以数值模拟（Path Integral Monte Carlo simulations）作为理论支持，属于实验为主、计算为辅的混合类型。；研究对象：超冷极性分子气体——玻色性 $^{23}$Na$^{87}$Rb 分子，具体研究其蒸发冷却至量子简并的过程，以及自束缚液滴（self-bound droplets）的形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过静电场Förster屏蔽，将玻色性NaRb分子的两体非弹性损失抑制了四个数量级，并在无束缚态电场窗口内同时抑制三体损失，实现了高效蒸发冷却，使气体达到量子简并（7200个分子），并在蒸发末端观测到自束缚液滴。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过静电场Förster屏蔽，将玻色性NaRb分子的两体非弹性损失抑制了四个数量级，并在无束缚态电场窗口内同时抑制三体损失，实现了高效蒸发冷却，使气体达到量子简并（7200个分子），并在蒸发末端观测到自束缚液滴。；创新点：首次将静电场Förster屏蔽应用于玻色性极性分子（此前仅用于费米子），实现了玻色分子气体的量子简并；同时发现该屏蔽方案可在单一电场下同时制备简并气体和自束缚液滴，为玻色极性分子的量子多体研究提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用静电场Förster屏蔽技术进行碰撞保护，结合蒸发冷却手段提升相空间密度；数值上采用路径积分蒙特卡洛（Path Integral Monte Carlo, PIMC）模拟，用于分析液滴形态（丝状结构）及形成温度。

papers.title: Overcoming critical slowing down in frustrated spin systems by learned multiscale sampling
papers.abstract: Cluster algorithms, such as the Swendsen--Wang and Wolff methods, are among the most successful MCMC methods for mitigating critical slowing down in statistical systems. These constructive cluster algorithms, however, fail in the presence of even extremely weak frustration. Here, we sidestep this fundamental limitation by learning rather than constructing the relevant clusters. Specifically, we use the wavelet conditional renormalization group (WCRG) sampling method to learn the probability distribution of collective fluctuations of a frustrated two-dimensional soft-spin model. Configurations are then generated recursively from coarse to fine scales by sampling conditional wavelet distributions. The WCRG method reproduces the main statistical properties of the system across different phases, including the local-field distribution and the structure factor. At an Ising-like critical point, the conditional dynamics remains decorrelated within $\mathcal{O}(1)$ sweeps at each scale, yielding an overall sampling complexity of $\mathcal{O}(\log_2 L)$, thus making WCRG much more efficient than standard local MCMC methods. These results show that learned multiscale sampling can overcome critical slowing down in frustrated systems for which conventional cluster algorithms fail. By assessing the sampling accuracy of different observables, we also clarify the main tradeoff of the WCRG method: the accuracy of the fast sampling scheme depends on the expressiveness of the energy-based model used to estimate the wavelet conditional distributions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：MCMC方法、采样方法、能量模型、数值模拟。；研究对象：二维软自旋阻挫模型（frustrated two-dimensional soft-spin model），重点关注其临界点附近的临界慢化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过学习的多尺度采样方法（WCRG）可以在阻挫自旋体系中克服临界慢化，在Ising类临界点处每尺度条件动力学在O(1)次扫描内即去相关，整体采样复杂度为O(log₂L)，远优于标准局域MCMC方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过学习的多尺度采样方法（WCRG）可以在阻挫自旋体系中克服临界慢化，在Ising类临界点处每尺度条件动力学在O(1)次扫描内即去相关，整体采样复杂度为O(log₂L)，远优于标准局域MCMC方法。；创新点：传统构造性簇算法（如Swendsen-Wang和Wolff）在存在极弱阻挫时即失效，本文通过“学习”而非“构造”相关簇来绕过这一根本限制，首次展示了学习型多尺度采样可在传统簇算法失效的阻挫体系中克服临界慢化。同时明确了WCRG方法的主要权衡：快速采样方案的精度取决于用于估计小波条件分布的能量模型的表达能力。
papers.method_zh: 使用小波条件重正化群（WCRG）采样方法，通过能量模型学习集体涨落的概率分布，然后从粗到细递归地采样条件小波分布来生成构型。对比对象为Swendsen-Wang和Wolff等传统簇算法及标准局域MCMC方法。

papers.title: Device characterization of Si$/$SiGe double quantum dots using exchange oscillations in Earth's magnetic field
papers.abstract: Exchange-based semiconductor qubits encompass a broad family of encodings constructed from singlet- and triplet-like spin states, several of which are compatible with operation at zero applied magnetic field. Their reliable operation requires characterization of environmental noise, residual idle interactions, and exchange-dependent decay, but this characterization often relies on multi-axis control calibration or deliberately engineered magnetic-field gradients. A simpler zero-applied-field diagnostic is particularly valuable for hybrid semiconductor-superconductor systems, in which magnetic fields can degrade superconducting components. Here, we use the intrinsic magnetic-field gradient produced by residual nuclear spins in isotopically enriched Si/SiGe to implement exchange oscillations between two quantum dots as a characterization tool without a micromagnet, dynamic nuclear polarization, or prior multi-axis calibration. Using Carr-Purcell-Meiboom-Gill exchange sequences, we extend the singlet coherence from $T_2^*=1.17\pm0.02~μ$s to $T_2^{\mathrm{CPMG}}=74.8\pm1.8~μ$s with $N=70$ refocusing pulses. The oscillation phase resolves residual exchange in the tens-of-kilohertz regime and enables it to be mapped across the $(1,1)$ charge cell. These results establish intrinsic-gradient exchange oscillations as a simple, more relevant zero-field diagnostic for exchange-only and related semiconductor qubit encodings that is amenable to rapid, high-throughput device characterization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体的器件测量（交换振荡、相干时间测量）和脉冲序列（CPMG），属于实验研究。；研究对象：Si/SiGe 双量子点体系，具体为基于单重态-三重态自旋编码的交换型半导体量子比特，在零外加磁场下利用残余核自旋产生的内禀磁场梯度实现交换振荡。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用同位素富集 Si/SiGe 中残余核自旋产生的内禀磁场梯度，无需微磁体或动态核极化即可实现双量子点间的交换振荡，并以此作为器件表征工具。通过 CPMG 交换序列将单重态相干时间从 T2* = 1.17 ± 0.02 μs 延长至 T2^CPMG = 74.8 ± 1.8 μs（N = 70 重聚焦脉冲），振荡相位可分辨数十 kHz 量级的残余交换耦合，并能在 (1,1) 电荷胞内进行映射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用同位素富集 Si/SiGe 中残余核自旋产生的内禀磁场梯度，无需微磁体或动态核极化即可实现双量子点间的交换振荡，并以此作为器件表征工具。通过 CPMG 交换序列将单重态相干时间从 T2* = 1.17 ± 0.02 μs 延长至 T2^CPMG = 74.8 ± 1.8 μs（N = 70 重聚焦脉冲），振荡相位可分辨数十 kHz 量级的残余交换耦合，并能在 (1,1) 电荷胞内进行映射。；创新点：提出一种无需微磁体、无需动态核极化、无需预先多轴校准的零磁场诊断方案，利用内禀核自旋梯度实现交换振荡，作为交换型量子比特（特别是混合半导体-超导体体系）的快速、高通量器件表征工具。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用 Si/SiGe 双量子点器件，在零外加磁场下利用残余核自旋梯度驱动交换振荡；使用 Carr-Purcell-Meiboom-Gill（CPMG）交换脉冲序列测量并延长相干时间；通过振荡相位提取残余交换耦合强度及其空间分布。摘要未提及具体材料生长方法（如分子束外延）或详细测量装置。

papers.title: Orbital and Spin Edelstein Effects in KTaO$_3$(110) Two-Dimensional Electron Gases
papers.abstract: The orbital Edelstein effect converts an electric field into a non-equilibrium orbital polarization, opening new opportunities for orbitronics. Although signatures of the orbital Edelstein effect have been reported, its microscopic mechanisms and quantitative validation remain underexplored. Here, by directly linking the atomic structure of KTaO$_3$(110) two-dimensional electron gases to both their calculated and measured electronic band dispersions, we predict and provide experimental evidence for an orbital Edelstein effect that largely counterbalances its spin counterpart. Scanning transmission electron microscopy and electron energy-loss spectroscopy resolve the interfacial atomic configuration, which is used as input for density-functional calculations. Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy then confirms the resulting band structure, which is fitted by a tight-binding model enabling computation of the spin and orbital Edelstein responses. Harmonic magnetotransport indicates that a $\sim$20 \% contribution from the orbital Edelstein response is necessary to describe the magnitude and anisotropy of the effect. Our results establish KTaO$_3$(110) as a model platform for orbitronics and demonstrate a pathway to generate and harness orbital polarization in quantum oxide systems while also offering new insights into pairing mechanisms in their superconducting state.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“scanning transmission electron microscopy”“angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy”“harmonic magnetotransport”等实验手段，以及“density-functional calculations”“tight-binding model”等计算方法。；研究对象：KTaO₃(110) 二维电子气（2DEG）中的轨道Edelstein效应与自旋Edelstein效应，以及二者之间的竞争关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在KTaO₃(110)二维电子气中，轨道Edelstein效应显著存在，且其响应在很大程度上抵消了自旋Edelstein效应；实验表明约20%的磁输运响应来自轨道Edelstein贡献，才能解释效应的幅度和各向异性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在KTaO₃(110)二维电子气中，轨道Edelstein效应显著存在，且其响应在很大程度上抵消了自旋Edelstein效应；实验表明约20%的磁输运响应来自轨道Edelstein贡献，才能解释效应的幅度和各向异性。；创新点：首次将KTaO₃(110)的原子级界面结构直接与计算和实测能带关联，定量预测并实验证实了轨道Edelstein效应对自旋Edelstein效应的大幅抵消，确立了KTaO₃(110)作为轨道电子学（orbitronics）模型平台的地位，并为超导配对机制提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）和电子能量损失谱（EELS）确定界面原子构型；密度泛函理论（DFT）计算电子结构；角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）验证能带；紧束缚模型拟合能带并计算自旋/轨道Edelstein响应；谐波磁输运测量验证轨道贡献比例。

papers.title: A MOF-reinforced self-foaming sponge for mechanically robust triboelectric membranes with improved resistance to humidity
papers.abstract: Porous triboelectric materials offer significant potential for enhancing the performance of triboelectric nanogenerators, yet their practical application is limited by structural instability and humidity-induced performance degradation. In this work, a bio-derived, sustainable polyamide containing disulfide linkages was developed to enable spontaneous formation of a porous dielectric without external templating. Hydrophilic MOF fillers comprising HKUST-1 crystals are incorporated within the porous matrix to reinforce the membrane structure and regulate moisture effects. Mechanical characterization demonstrates that HKUST-1 suppresses pore collapse and improves structural robustness under repeated deformation, while analysis of stress-strain behaviour reveals the critical role of pore stability in achieving stable triboelectric output. In addition, HKUST-1 mitigates humidity-induced charge dissipation by confining water molecules within its framework, giving enhanced triboelectric output stability and reduced performance degradation under increasing relative humidity compared to the neat porous system. This work demonstrates a strategy that integrates self-foamed porous structures, sustainable polymer design, and functional filler reinforcement to engineer mechanically robust and environmentally stable triboelectric systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“Mechanical characterization”“analysis of stress-strain behaviour”等实验表征手段。；研究对象：一种含二硫键的生物基可持续聚酰胺自发泡多孔介电材料，并掺入亲水性MOF填料HKUST-1晶体，用于摩擦电纳米发电机（TENG）的摩擦电膜。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: HKUST-1填料可抑制多孔结构坍塌、增强膜在反复形变下的结构鲁棒性，并通过将水分子限制在其框架内减轻湿度引起的电荷耗散，从而在提高相对湿度下相比纯多孔体系获得更稳定的摩擦电输出和更小的性能衰减。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：HKUST-1填料可抑制多孔结构坍塌、增强膜在反复形变下的结构鲁棒性，并通过将水分子限制在其框架内减轻湿度引起的电荷耗散，从而在提高相对湿度下相比纯多孔体系获得更稳定的摩擦电输出和更小的性能衰减。；创新点：将自发生成多孔结构（无需外部模板）、可持续聚合物设计（含二硫键的生物基聚酰胺）与功能性填料（HKUST-1）增强相结合，同时解决多孔摩擦电材料的结构不稳定性和湿度性能退化问题。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段，仅提及机械表征（mechanical characterization）和应力-应变行为分析（stress-strain behaviour analysis）。未提及具体仪器或计算方法。

papers.title: Intercoupling of Segregation and Rheology in Spatially Developing Granular Chute Flows
papers.abstract: We investigate the flow and segregation of binary granular mixtures with density differences down a long chute using a continuum framework that couples a particle-force-based segregation model with an inertial-number-based local rheology. The steady-state momentum and convection-diffusion-segregation equations are solved simultaneously, explicitly accounting for the two-way coupling between segregation and flow. Predicted concentration and velocity fields at different streamwise locations are validated against representative DEM simulations. The validated model is then used to examine the influence of density ratio, mixture composition, and chute inclination on segregation over a wide range of conditions. The chute length required to achieve fully developed segregation is quantified and compared with the development length for monodisperse granular flow. At low density ratios and/or low inclinations, segregation develops over much longer distances than the velocity field. In contrast, at higher inclinations and larger density contrasts, the two length scales become comparable, demonstrating that neglecting flow development can significantly underestimate segregation evolution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“continuum framework”（连续介质框架）、“solved simultaneously”（联立求解方程）、“validated against representative DEM simulations”（与DEM模拟对比验证），属于基于模型求解与数值模拟验证的理论计算研究。；研究对象：具有密度差异的二元颗粒混合物在长溜槽（chute）中的流动与分离（segregation）耦合现象，具体涉及颗粒流的空间发展过程（spatially developing granular chute flows）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低密度比和/或低倾角条件下，分离（segregation）达到完全发展所需的溜槽长度远大于速度场的发展长度；而在高倾角和大密度差条件下，两者长度尺度相当，表明忽略流动发展效应会显著低估分离演化过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低密度比和/或低倾角条件下，分离（segregation）达到完全发展所需的溜槽长度远大于速度场的发展长度；而在高倾角和大密度差条件下，两者长度尺度相当，表明忽略流动发展效应会显著低估分离演化过程。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用连续介质框架，将基于颗粒力的分离模型（particle-force-based segregation model）与基于惯性数的局部流变学（inertial-number-based local rheology）耦合；联立求解稳态动量方程和对流-扩散-分离方程（convection-diffusion-segregation equations），显式考虑分离与流动的双向耦合；预测结果与代表性DEM（离散元法）模拟进行对比验证。

papers.title: Particle-Mediated Tuning of Defect Stability in Lamellar Block Copolymer Systems
papers.abstract: We study how colloidal inclusions modify the formation energy of dislocation pairs in lamellar block copolymer systems. Using a hybrid particle/Ginzburg--Landau model, we calculate defect formation energies by comparing defect-free and defect-containing states with and without embedded colloids. Finite-size scaling is used to obtain formation energies in the thermodynamic limit. The effect of colloid insertion depends strongly on particle sizes and surface patterning. Homogeneous particles increasingly stabilize dislocation pairs with increasing particle sizes. Particles larger than one lamellar domain preferentially occupy the dislocation cores, where they replace strained polymer rather than deforming defect-free lamellae. The magnitude of this stabilization depends on surface affinity. Balanced Janus particles instead increase the formation energy, because their competing surface preferences cannot be satisfied simultaneously near the curved core. Varying the patch ratio interpolates between these limits. Surface patterning has little effect for particles smaller than one lamellar domain but changes the formation energy by several tens of $k_BT$ for larger particles. These results provide quantitative guidelines for controlling topological defect stability in lamellar block copolymer systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“hybrid particle/Ginzburg--Landau model”进行数值计算，并采用“finite-size scaling”分析，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：层状嵌段共聚物（lamellar block copolymer）体系中的位错对（dislocation pairs），以及胶体颗粒（colloidal inclusions）对其形成能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 胶体颗粒的尺寸和表面图案（patterning）可显著调控层状嵌段共聚物中位错对的稳定性：均质颗粒随尺寸增大逐渐稳定位错对，而平衡型Janus颗粒则增大位错对形成能；表面图案对大于一个层状畴的颗粒影响显著（改变形成能达数十k_BT），对小颗粒几乎无影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：胶体颗粒的尺寸和表面图案（patterning）可显著调控层状嵌段共聚物中位错对的稳定性：均质颗粒随尺寸增大逐渐稳定位错对，而平衡型Janus颗粒则增大位错对形成能；表面图案对大于一个层状畴的颗粒影响显著（改变形成能达数十k_BT），对小颗粒几乎无影响。；创新点：定量揭示了胶体颗粒尺寸和表面图案（包括Janus颗粒的补丁比例）对层状嵌段共聚物中拓扑缺陷稳定性的调控规律，为通过颗粒设计控制缺陷形成能提供了定量指导。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用混合粒子/Ginzburg–Landau模型（hybrid particle/Ginzburg–Landau model），通过比较含/不含缺陷及含/不含胶体颗粒的状态来计算缺陷形成能，并利用有限尺寸标度（finite-size scaling）外推热力学极限下的形成能。

papers.title: Interfacial Spin-to-Charge Conversion in Sputtered MoTe2 Heterostructures Probed by Spin Pumping and Spin-Torque Ferromagnetic Resonance
papers.abstract: Transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) and their Weyl semimetal phases, such as MoTe$_2$, have attracted significant attention for spin-orbit torque applications due to their efficient charge-to-spin conversion. However, whether this conversion originates predominantly from the bulk or the interface remains unclear. Here, we investigate spin-charge interconversion in MoTe$_2$ using spin-pumping and spin-torque ferromagnetic resonance (SP-FMR and ST-FMR). Thickness-dependent measurements reveal large spin-to-charge conversion and spin-torque efficiencies that are essentially independent of MoTe$_2$ thickness, indicating that the conversion is predominantly governed by the Rashba-Edelstein effect at the Py/MoTe$_2$ interface rather than by bulk spin transport. This behavior contrasts with the characteristic thickness dependence observed in Pt heterostructures and is further supported by bidirectional SP-FMR and interface-separation measurements. Our results highlight the dominant role of the Py/MoTe$_2$ interface in enabling efficient spin-charge conversion and spin-orbit torques in TMD-based spintronic devices. These findings highlight the potential of sputtered MoTe$_2$/Py heterostructures for low-power spintronic applications, including magnetic memory and logic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“spin-pumping and spin-torque ferromagnetic resonance (SP-FMR and ST-FMR)”等实验测量手段，以及“thickness-dependent measurements”等实验表征方式。；研究对象：溅射生长的MoTe₂（过渡金属二硫族化物/外尔半金属相）与坡莫合金（Py）构成的异质结，具体研究其界面自旋-电荷相互转换现象及自旋轨道矩效率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MoTe₂中的自旋-电荷转换和自旋轨道矩效率基本不依赖于MoTe₂厚度，表明该转换主要由Py/MoTe₂界面处的Rashba-Edelstein效应主导，而非体态自旋输运贡献。这一行为与Pt异质结中典型的厚度依赖特征形成鲜明对比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MoTe₂中的自旋-电荷转换和自旋轨道矩效率基本不依赖于MoTe₂厚度，表明该转换主要由Py/MoTe₂界面处的Rashba-Edelstein效应主导，而非体态自旋输运贡献。这一行为与Pt异质结中典型的厚度依赖特征形成鲜明对比。；创新点：通过厚度依赖实验直接区分了体态与界面贡献，明确揭示了TMD基异质结中自旋-电荷转换的界面主导机制（Rashba-Edelstein效应），而非此前研究中常被归因的体态自旋霍尔效应或外尔半金属体态输运。
papers.method_zh: 自旋泵浦-铁磁共振（SP-FMR）和自旋力矩-铁磁共振（ST-FMR）技术；厚度依赖测量；双向SP-FMR测量；界面分离（interface-separation）测量。

papers.title: Compensation in continuous symmetric trilayered planar ferrimagnet
papers.abstract: The trilayered (A-B-A type) anisotropic (single site) XY magnetic model is considered with the intra-plane ferromagnetic and the inter-plane antiferromagnetic interactions. The equilibrium properties of such trilayered anisotropic XY system has been studied by Monte Carlo simulation with Metropolis single spin (randomly chosen) update algorithm. In a given range of interaction parameters, the system has been found to exhibit the high temperature {\it critical} (vanishing sublattice magnetisations and total magnetisation) and low temperature {\it compensation} (vanishing total magnetisation even for non-vanishing sublattice magnetisations) behaviours. The compensation temperature and the critical temperature both are found to increase with the increase of single site anisotropy. The comprehensive phase diagram is drawn. The finite size study reveals the growth of correlations near the critical temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Monte Carlo simulation with Metropolis single spin update algorithm”，属于数值模拟研究。；研究对象：连续对称的三层（A-B-A型）平面铁磁体（trilayered planar ferrimagnet），具体为具有面内铁磁、层间反铁磁耦合的各向异性（单离子）XY模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在该三层各向异性XY模型中，在特定相互作用参数范围内，系统同时表现出高温临界行为（子格磁化与总磁化均消失）和低温补偿行为（子格磁化非零但总磁化消失）。补偿温度和临界温度均随单离子各向异性增强而升高。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在该三层各向异性XY模型中，在特定相互作用参数范围内，系统同时表现出高温临界行为（子格磁化与总磁化均消失）和低温补偿行为（子格磁化非零但总磁化消失）。补偿温度和临界温度均随单离子各向异性增强而升高。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该工作系统研究了连续对称三层铁磁体中的补偿现象及其与单离子各向异性的依赖关系，并给出了包含补偿温度和临界温度的完整相图。
papers.method_zh: 蒙特卡罗模拟，采用Metropolis单自旋（随机选取）更新算法；进行了有限尺寸标度分析以研究临界温度附近的关联增长；绘制了完整相图。

papers.title: Stoner contributions to the magnon equation of motion
papers.abstract: From linear response theory, we derive the equation of motion for Landau-damped magnon quasi-particles in absence of spin-orbit coupling. The derivation is based on a minimal set of assumptions, namely that the transverse magnetic susceptibility is diagonalized by one collective eigenmode per magnetic atom in the unit cell, and that the spectrum of each collective eigenmode is dominated by a single magnon resonance. The resulting equation of motion leads to a natural definition of the exchange interaction as the restoring force acting on the collective mode magnetization near equilibrium. In addition to magnetic exchange, the magnon equation of motion also contains a damping term and a dispersive quasi-particle mass, both originating from the electron-magnon coupling. The effect of these terms is illustrated for a prototypical itinerant ferromagnet, where they redshift the magnon dispersion and reduce the magnon lifetime as the magnon enters the Stoner continuum. By further assuming wave vector independence of the collective magnon subspace, the magnon equation of motion becomes atomistic with well defined magnetic sites. For real materials, one can approximate the magnon coupling constants using an arbitrary level of band theory for the dynamic transverse magnetic susceptibility.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提及“From linear response theory, we derive...”（从线性响应理论出发推导），以及“The derivation is based on a minimal set of assumptions”（推导基于一组最小假设），属于解析理论推导工作。；研究对象：无自旋轨道耦合的巡游铁磁体中的Landau阻尼磁振子准粒子，重点关注磁振子进入Stoner连续体时的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从线性响应理论出发，推导出包含交换恢复力、阻尼项和色散准粒子质量（后两者源于电子-磁振子耦合）的磁振子运动方程。该方程能自然解释磁振子进入Stoner连续体时发生的色散红移和寿命缩短现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从线性响应理论出发，推导出包含交换恢复力、阻尼项和色散准粒子质量（后两者源于电子-磁振子耦合）的磁振子运动方程。该方程能自然解释磁振子进入Stoner连续体时发生的色散红移和寿命缩短现象。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可看出其新意在于：仅基于最小假设（而非具体模型）推导出包含Landau阻尼和色散质量的磁振子运动方程，并给出了交换相互作用的自然定义（作为恢复力），同时提供了将第一性原理能带理论结果映射到该运动方程的近似途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为线性响应理论，基于两个关键假设：(1) 横磁化率可由每个磁性原子一个集体本征模对角化；(2) 每个集体模谱由一个磁振子共振主导。推导中未引入自旋轨道耦合，并进一步假设集体磁振子子空间与波矢无关以得到原子尺度的运动方程。

papers.title: Breakdown of Charge-Conjugation Symmetry of Disclinations in 2D Crystals
papers.abstract: Disclinations are elementary topological defects in two-dimensional (2D) crystalline membranes, yet their elastic properties remain largely unexplored. Using atomistic simulations, we address the energetics, morphology, and interactions of disclinations in free-standing graphene, a prototypical 2D crystal. We find that while disclinations with positive topological charges follow an expected behavior, negative disclinations exhibit sublinear energy scaling with charge as well as equilibrium shape that deviates sharply from the conventional saddle ansatz. This breakdown of charge-conjugation symmetry leads to qualitatively distinct interactions: positive disclinations repel, whereas negative disclinations display a robust long-range attraction. These trends are shown to be further amplified by self-adhesion in folded membranes. Our results uncover a fundamentally different energetic landscape for negative curvature defects and provide a basis for understanding the stability, self-folding behavior, and defect-driven morphology of graphene and other 2D membranes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Using atomistic simulations”（原子级模拟）。；研究对象：二维晶体中的向错（disclinations），以自由悬浮石墨烯（free-standing graphene）作为典型二维晶体体系，研究其能量学、形貌与相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 正拓扑荷向错行为符合预期，但负向错表现出亚线性的能量-电荷标度关系，且平衡形状显著偏离传统鞍面假设，导致电荷共轭对称性破缺：正向错相互排斥，负向错则呈现稳健的长程吸引。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：正拓扑荷向错行为符合预期，但负向错表现出亚线性的能量-电荷标度关系，且平衡形状显著偏离传统鞍面假设，导致电荷共轭对称性破缺：正向错相互排斥，负向错则呈现稳健的长程吸引。；创新点：首次系统揭示负曲率向错（负拓扑荷）在二维晶体中具有与传统预期截然不同的能量景观和相互作用规律，并指出自粘附（self-adhesion）效应会进一步放大这些行为，为理解石墨烯等二维膜的自折叠与缺陷驱动形貌提供了新基础。
papers.method_zh: 原子级模拟（atomistic simulations），具体方法细节（如势函数类型、模拟尺度等）摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Anomalous temperature dependence in phase transitions via ballistic coalescence
papers.abstract: We study kinetics of phase transitions within a single component Lennard-Jones model. For low enough particle densities disconnected clusters form that can move ballistically in an inviscid vapor background. The clusters undergo sticky collisions, thereby forming larger aggregates, which can be of fractal nature at ultra cold temperatures. As the temperature is varied, the exponent of the algebraic growth of average cluster mass changes, exhibiting pronounced nonmonotonic character. We capture this anomalous behavior, in two and three space dimensions, within a ballistic aggregation theory. We show that the scope of the theory is much broader than the typically considered case where cluster motions are uncorrelated. An analysis of the theory shows that ballistic aggregation can even occur exponentially fast. This is in sharp contrast with the conventional algebraic picture, regarding passive matter phase transitions. We discuss scenario where such explosive growth can be realized. In addition, our results are widely relevant in understanding structure and growth in aerosols, cosmic dust and other aggregation processes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提到“We study kinetics of phase transitions within a single component Lennard-Jones model”（基于Lennard-Jones模型的动力学研究），以及“We capture this anomalous behavior... within a ballistic aggregation theory”（建立弹道聚集理论），属于计算模拟与理论分析结合。；研究对象：单组分Lennard-Jones模型中的相变动力学，具体研究低密度下孤立团簇在无黏性蒸气背景中的弹道运动、黏性碰撞及聚集生长过程，涉及气溶胶、宇宙尘埃等聚集过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低密度条件下，团簇平均质量的代数增长指数随温度变化呈现显著的非单调（反常）行为；进一步分析表明，弹道聚集过程甚至可能以指数级（爆炸式）速度发生，与传统被动物质相变中的代数增长图像截然不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低密度条件下，团簇平均质量的代数增长指数随温度变化呈现显著的非单调（反常）行为；进一步分析表明，弹道聚集过程甚至可能以指数级（爆炸式）速度发生，与传统被动物质相变中的代数增长图像截然不同。；创新点：将弹道聚集理论的适用范围从通常假设的“团簇运动无关联”情形拓展到更一般的情形，并首次指出弹道聚集可以指数级快速发生，提出了实现这种爆炸式增长的物理场景。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用单组分Lennard-Jones模型的动力学模拟（具体模拟细节摘要未明确说明），并结合弹道聚集理论（ballistic aggregation theory）在二维和三维空间中解析描述团簇生长行为。

papers.title: Signatures of inter-sideband coherence in the resonance fluorescence spectrum of an acoustically-modulated quantum dot
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate the inter-sideband phase coherence within the resonance fluorescence spectrum of an acoustically modulated quantum dot using a filtered-field formalism for a Mach-Zehnder configuration. We demonstrate that geometric slant of the interferograms provides an indicator of phase coherence that is resilient to environmental white noise. Specifically, noise-induced spectral diffusion reduces the global fringe intensity, while leaving the characteristic inclination strictly invariant. Our findings establish a framework for verifying single-photon coherence between spectral sidebands, essential for frequency-bin encoding and scalable quantum networking in realistic, noisy solid-state architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“theoretically investigate”和“filtered-field formalism”等理论分析关键词。；研究对象：声学调制的量子点体系，具体研究其共振荧光光谱中的**带间相位相干性**（inter-sideband phase coherence），并涉及Mach-Zehnder干涉构型下的单光子频率分箱编码。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 干涉图的几何倾斜度可作为对环境白噪声鲁棒的相位相干性指标：噪声引起的谱扩散只降低整体条纹强度，而特征倾斜角严格不变，从而为验证噪声固态体系中光谱边带间的单光子相干性提供了可行框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：干涉图的几何倾斜度可作为对环境白噪声鲁棒的相位相干性指标：噪声引起的谱扩散只降低整体条纹强度，而特征倾斜角严格不变，从而为验证噪声固态体系中光谱边带间的单光子相干性提供了可行框架。；创新点：提出利用干涉图几何倾斜度作为抗噪声的相位相干性度量，该指标在环境白噪声下保持严格不变，为频率分箱编码和可扩展量子网络在真实噪声固态架构中的实现提供了验证方案。
papers.method_zh: 采用**滤波场形式**（filtered-field formalism）对Mach-Zehnder干涉配置下的共振荧光光谱进行理论建模，分析噪声诱导的谱扩散对干涉条纹全局强度和几何倾斜度的影响。

papers.title: Local phase-space Berry curvature and Hall transport in textured twisted bilayer graphene
papers.abstract: Slow twist-angle and heterostrain textures in twisted bilayer graphene provide a natural route to phase-space Berry geometry. We show that a purely geometric tetrad/shift sector does not generate mixed Berry curvature once the spin connection is treated consistently. By contrast, a projected textured mini-Dirac cone in twisted bilayer graphene acquires genuine mixed phase-space curvature. We analyze a controlled local Hall-bar limit with a one-dimensional texture and mirror $M_x$. In that limit the pseudogauge gradient renormalizes only the longitudinal conductivity along the textured direction, while a dc nonlinear Hall response appears only when an additional valley-odd tilt generates a Berry-curvature dipole. Both geometric responses peak at the same local filling, $μ_{\rm loc}=\sqrt{2}\,m$, providing a gate-tunable fingerprint of their common origin. All local-cone parameters and their texture susceptibilities are extracted from a heterostrained Bistritzer-MacDonald model at $θ=1.3^\circ$. The tilt invoked in the transport estimates corresponds to heterostrain of only $0.03\%-0.2\%$, below values routinely imaged in devices. The resulting theory provides a local analytic framework for textured moiré Dirac materials and cleanly separates geometric, texture-induced, and transport-level ingredients relevant to realistic TBG.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中大量使用理论推导语言，如“We show that”“We analyze”“provides a local analytic framework”，且未提及任何实验测量手段。；研究对象：扭转双层石墨烯（twisted bilayer graphene, TBG）中的局域相空间贝里曲率与霍尔输运，具体关注慢变扭转角纹理和异质应变纹理对相空间几何效应的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在扭转双层石墨烯中，投影后的纹理化迷你狄拉克锥会获得真实的混合相空间曲率；在具有一维纹理和镜面对称M_x的局域霍尔棒极限下，赝规范梯度仅重正化沿纹理方向的纵向电导率，而直流非线性霍尔响应仅在额外的谷奇倾斜产生贝里曲率偶极子时才出现。两种几何响应在相同的局域填充μ_loc=√2 m处达到峰值，提供了可栅压调控的共同起源指纹。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在扭转双层石墨烯中，投影后的纹理化迷你狄拉克锥会获得真实的混合相空间曲率；在具有一维纹理和镜面对称M_x的局域霍尔棒极限下，赝规范梯度仅重正化沿纹理方向的纵向电导率，而直流非线性霍尔响应仅在额外的谷奇倾斜产生贝里曲率偶极子时才出现。两种几何响应在相同的局域填充μ_loc=√2 m处达到峰值，提供了可栅压调控的共同起源指纹。；创新点：首次将相空间贝里几何框架系统应用于纹理化扭转双层石墨烯，并严格区分了几何tetrad/shift贡献与投影纹理贡献；建立了纹理诱导的几何响应与可实验调控的局域填充之间的明确联系，且所需异质应变（0.03%-0.2%）低于器件中常规成像到的应变值，具有实验可行性。摘要未突出说明与已有相空间几何研究的其他对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合模型计算：采用Bistritzer-MacDonald模型（θ=1.3°）提取局域锥参数及其纹理敏感性；利用局域相空间几何框架（tetrad/shift sector、自旋联络、混合贝里曲率）进行解析推导；通过一维纹理和镜面对称性约束下的局域霍尔棒极限分析输运系数。

papers.title: On the relaxation problem in statistical mechanics
papers.abstract: We reformulate the relaxation problem in statistical mechanics by making explicit what are the \emph{operational} objects subject to relaxation: the local time statistics of the recorded signal $Z(t)$. These local time statistics are simply the estimated histograms of observations $\{Z(t_i)\}_{i=1}^M$ performed at uniformly random times $\{t_i\}_{i=1}^M$ by a clockless observer. The subject of prediction is a belief about a future fresh out-of-sample reading of a measurement outcome whose distribution is inferred from the mathematical model believed to be true. For finite bounded systems of $N\ge 1$ degrees of freedom global irreversible relaxation of predictions can occur but special initial conditions exist. The form of the predictions depends on certain loss functions whose choice is up to the particular observer. Finally, entropy is given a learning interpretation as mutual information between the observer and the unknown past of the system under consideration and, in complete generality, its stationary value depends on the information available.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要聚焦于统计力学中弛豫问题的理论重构，涉及数学形式化、预测与信息论概念，未提及实验或数值计算手段。；研究对象：统计力学中的弛豫问题，具体为有限有界多体系统（N≥1个自由度）中观测信号Z(t)的局部时间统计的不可逆弛豫行为，以及熵与观测者信息获取之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 全局不可逆弛豫可以发生在有限有界系统中，但存在特殊初始条件使其不成立；熵的稳态值并非普适常数，而是依赖于观测者可获得的信息量，可被解释为观测者与系统未知过去之间的互信息。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：全局不可逆弛豫可以发生在有限有界系统中，但存在特殊初始条件使其不成立；熵的稳态值并非普适常数，而是依赖于观测者可获得的信息量，可被解释为观测者与系统未知过去之间的互信息。；创新点：将弛豫问题从传统的时间演化视角重新定义为“观测者预测”问题，强调弛豫对象是记录信号的局部时间统计而非系统微观态本身；首次将熵的稳态值明确与观测者可用信息量挂钩，赋予熵以学习/信息获取的诠释。摘要未突出说明与其他具体理论框架（如遍历理论、粗粒化方法）的对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论形式化重构：明确弛豫的操作性对象为局部时间统计（无时钟观测者在均匀随机时刻采样得到的直方图），引入损失函数描述预测形式，并采用信息论框架（互信息）重新诠释熵。

papers.title: Self-Diffusion of Water through Thermally Activated Membranes
papers.abstract: Diffusion processes involving membranes are of fundamental importance in both science and technology, since membranes serve as selective interfaces that regulate the transport of mass, charge, and information across multiple length and time scales. In this study, we employ molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to calculate the self-diffusion coefficient, tetrahedral order parameter and hydrogen-bond (HB) lifetime of SPC/E water over a wide high-temperature range in the presence of thermally activated membranes (TAMs). These membranes exhibit thermally controlled stochastic behavior that locally influences particle dynamics by probabilistically inducing elastic scattering events as particles traverse the membrane. The stochastic behavior of the membranes is governed by a sigmoidal profile, which depend on the reduced temperature of the system. The effective activation energy for diffusion is estimated for several membrane configurations. It is found that the diffusion coefficients generally decrease with an increase in the number of membranes and are in reasonable agreement with the Arrhenius approximation at high temperatures. Additionally, both the tetrahedral order parameter and the HB lifetime are only locally sensitive to the action of the membranes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“分子动力学（MD）模拟”计算扩散系数等物理量。；研究对象：水分子（SPC/E 模型水）在“热激活膜”（TAMs）存在下的自扩散行为，以及膜对水局部结构（四面体序参数）和氢键动力学的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 水的自扩散系数随膜数量增加而普遍降低，且高温下与 Arrhenius 近似吻合；膜的作用仅对水的四面体序参数和氢键寿命产生局部影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：水的自扩散系数随膜数量增加而普遍降低，且高温下与 Arrhenius 近似吻合；膜的作用仅对水的四面体序参数和氢键寿命产生局部影响。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其新意在于引入“热激活膜”这一具有温度依赖随机散射行为的膜模型，并系统研究其对水扩散和局部结构的影响。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学（MD）模拟。具体计算了 SPC/E 水的自扩散系数、四面体序参数和氢键寿命，并估算了不同膜构型下的有效扩散激活能。膜的热激活随机行为由依赖于系统约化温度的 sigmoidal 函数控制。

papers.title: Inertia-Driven Information Flow and Symmetry Breaking in a Nonequilibrium Two-Bead System
papers.abstract: We investigate information-flow generation in a nonequilibrium two-bead system coupled to two heat baths. We show that the system acts as an information-flow generator in both overdamped and underdamped regimes, with the underdamped dynamics revealing a divergence of the scaled information flow along specific paths in the thermal asymmetry--inertia parameter space that is hidden in the overdamped limit. This information generation suggests a possible route toward information engines and demon-like mechanisms in nanomachines. A symmetry-perturbation analysis of the response landscape of information flow reveals a geometric structure reminiscent of a Ginzburg--Landau framework: the symmetric reference state can correspond to a minimum or maximum depending on the perturbation direction, while the flat overdamped landscape develops a finite curvature under inertia. Mass asymmetry shifts the resulting maxima, and Hessian eigenvalue and eigenvector analysis reveals level touching of principal modes and bimodality along a constant-diffusion path. These results establish a minimal framework for understanding how inertia and microscopic heterogeneity shape information landscapes in nonequilibrium systems, with potential extensions to more complex heterogeneous networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“动力学分析”“对称性微扰分析”“Hessian 本征值与本征向量分析”等理论建模与数值计算关键词。；研究对象：一个由两个珠子（two-bead）组成的非平衡系统，耦合到两个不同温度的热浴，研究其信息流（information flow）的产生与对称性破缺行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该系统在过阻尼和欠阻尼两种动力学条件下均可作为信息流发生器；在欠阻尼条件下，沿热不对称性—惯性参数空间中的特定路径，标度信息流出现发散，而这一行为在过阻尼极限下被隐藏。此外，惯性使原本平坦的过阻尼信息流响应景观产生有限曲率，质量不对称会移动极大值位置，并出现主模式能级接触与双峰行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该系统在过阻尼和欠阻尼两种动力学条件下均可作为信息流发生器；在欠阻尼条件下，沿热不对称性—惯性参数空间中的特定路径，标度信息流出现发散，而这一行为在过阻尼极限下被隐藏。此外，惯性使原本平坦的过阻尼信息流响应景观产生有限曲率，质量不对称会移动极大值位置，并出现主模式能级接触与双峰行为。；创新点：首次在最小两珠非平衡体系中揭示惯性对信息流景观的定性重塑作用，包括欠阻尼下信息流的发散行为、过阻尼平坦景观在惯性下获得有限曲率，以及质量不对称导致的极大值移动和模式简并——这些结果将信息流生成与Ginzburg–Landau型对称性破缺框架联系起来，为理解非平衡系统中惯性及微观异质性对信息景观的影响提供了最小模型。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值计算相结合：对信息流响应景观进行对称性微扰分析，构建类似Ginzburg–Landau框架的几何结构；使用Hessian矩阵的本征值与本征向量分析，研究沿恒定扩散路径上的模式简并（level touching）与双峰性。

papers.title: Role of self-coherence in single-electron phase contrast imaging
papers.abstract: The extension of coherent lattice contrast into the energy loss region in high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) is described by a pulse-like electron-sample interaction in the energy/time uncertainty limit. It generates a wave packet by electron self-interference in any coherent-inelastic scattering event with energy loss. The width of this wave packet is characterized by a self-coherence length ls(ΔE) that is predictable because an intrinsic decoherence phase around one radian is set by the expectation value for phase fluctuations. In this case the visibility of interference contrast from a crystalline sample with lattice parameter a is limited by a Rayleigh-like transfer factor P(ls, a) in the self-coherently illuminated sample area. The model is verified by energy-filtered HRTEM images of hexagonal BN and identifies energy-loss-induced phase noise as a single-electron visibility limit distinct from resolution limitations caused by ensemble-coherence or counting-statistical noise.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论结合实验验证的文章。判断依据：摘要中既有理论模型（“pulse-like electron-sample interaction”“self-coherence length”），又有实验验证（“verified by energy-filtered HRTEM images of hexagonal BN”）。；研究对象：高分辨透射电子显微镜（HRTEM）中单电子相位衬度成像的物理机制，具体聚焦于电子能量损失（inelastic scattering with energy loss）过程中自相干性对晶格衬度的影响，并以六方氮化硼（hexagonal BN）为验证体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在能量/时间不确定极限下，单电子在相干非弹性散射事件中通过自干涉产生波包，其自相干长度 ls(ΔE) 可由约一弧度的内禀退相干相位预期值预测；该自相干长度通过类瑞利传递因子 P(ls, a) 限制晶格衬度的可见度，从而将能量损失诱导的相位噪声确立为一种单电子可见度极限，区别于系综相干性或计数统计噪声导致的分辨率限制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在能量/时间不确定极限下，单电子在相干非弹性散射事件中通过自干涉产生波包，其自相干长度 ls(ΔE) 可由约一弧度的内禀退相干相位预期值预测；该自相干长度通过类瑞利传递因子 P(ls, a) 限制晶格衬度的可见度，从而将能量损失诱导的相位噪声确立为一种单电子可见度极限，区别于系综相干性或计数统计噪声导致的分辨率限制。；创新点：将单电子自相干性（而非传统系综相干性）引入非弹性散射相位衬度理论，提出能量损失诱导的相位噪声是独立于统计噪声和系综退相干的单电子可见度极限。摘要未突出说明与其他理论模型的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于能量/时间不确定关系的脉冲式电子-样品相互作用模型，引入自相干长度 ls(ΔE) 和类瑞利传递因子 P(ls, a)；实验手段：能量过滤高分辨透射电子显微镜（energy-filtered HRTEM），对六方氮化硼进行成像验证。

papers.title: Supermoiré Reconstruction and Topological Mosaics in Twisted Trilayer WSe$_2$ and MoTe$_2$
papers.abstract: We investigate lattice relaxation and band structures of helical and alternating twisted trilayer WSe$_2$ and MoTe$_2$ using machine-learning force fields and large-scale ab initio calculations. Interference between the two bilayer moiré lattices generates a supermoiré lattice that, upon relaxation, reconstructs into a few dominant domain types with locally commensurate bilayer moiré lattices. Because the systems lack $C_{2z}$ symmetry, domains otherwise related by this symmetry become energetically and topologically distinct, unlike in twisted trilayer graphene. Band structure calculations show that the topmost valence bands originate from the $K$ ($K'$) valleys and carry domain-dependent valley Chern numbers. The resulting supermoiré lattice hosts a mosaic of topologically inequivalent domains, offering a platform for exploring correlated and topological physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要提及“machine-learning force fields”和“large-scale ab initio calculations”，属于大规模第一性原理与机器学习势计算。；研究对象：螺旋（helical）与交替（alternating）堆垛的三层转角 WSe₂ 和 MoTe₂ 体系，重点研究其超莫尔（supermoiré）晶格重构、局域能带结构及拓扑性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 双层莫尔晶格干涉形成的超莫尔晶格在弛豫后重构为少数几种具有局域共度双层莫尔晶格的畴区；由于体系缺乏 C₂z 对称性，这些畴区在能量和拓扑上彼此不等价，顶层价带来自 K（K′）谷且携带畴依赖的谷陈数，从而形成拓扑不等价畴的马赛克结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：双层莫尔晶格干涉形成的超莫尔晶格在弛豫后重构为少数几种具有局域共度双层莫尔晶格的畴区；由于体系缺乏 C₂z 对称性，这些畴区在能量和拓扑上彼此不等价，顶层价带来自 K（K′）谷且携带畴依赖的谷陈数，从而形成拓扑不等价畴的马赛克结构。；创新点：与转角三层石墨烯不同，该体系因缺乏 C₂z 对称性，原本由该对称性联系的畴区在能量和拓扑上发生分裂，形成拓扑不等价畴的马赛克，为关联与拓扑物理提供了新平台。摘要未突出说明其他方法或理论框架层面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习力场（machine-learning force fields）用于大尺度晶格弛豫；大规模从头算（large-scale ab initio calculations）用于能带结构计算；通过分析谷陈数（valley Chern numbers）表征各畴的拓扑性质。

papers.title: Kinetic temperatures and inertial effects in a nonequilibrium bead-spring model
papers.abstract: We investigate a nonequilibrium steady-state model consisting of two coupled beads with arbitrary masses in contact with two thermal baths at different temperatures. Using a covariance-matrix approach together with numerical simulations of the underdamped Langevin dynamics, we characterize steady-state probability distributions, heat transport, and entropy production. We show that irreversibility measures such as entropy production and heat current are invariant under an exchange of the bead masses, whereas energy-storage observables depend explicitly on the mass arrangement in a symmetrical set up. This reveals a fundamental distinction: energy observables exhibit path dependence in singular mass limits, while transport and irreversibility remain well defined. We show that kinetic temperatures provide the natural variables governing the thermodynamics of the system: their difference controls transport and entropy production, while their sum determines the mean energy via a model specific generalized equipartition relation. In the infinite-mass limit, only constitutive relations expressed in terms of kinetic temperatures remain meaningful. Thus, energy, transport, and irreversibility are unified through kinetic temperatures as the organizing variables. We also derive an effective temperature that defines an equilibrium-like canonical distribution. Finally, we analyze the notion of ergodicity and show that the time-averaged observables converge significantly faster than the ensemble averages.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要提及“covariance-matrix approach”“numerical simulations of the underdamped Langevin dynamics”。；研究对象：一个由两个任意质量珠子组成的、分别与两个不同温度热源接触的珠簧模型（bead-spring model），处于非平衡稳态。属于非平衡统计物理中的介观热输运模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 动能温度（kinetic temperatures）是该非平衡系统热力学的自然变量：其差值控制热流与熵产生，其和值通过广义均分关系决定平均能量；在无限质量极限下，只有用动能温度表达的输运关系仍有意义。此外，熵产生与热流在交换两珠质量时不变，而能量存储观测量则依赖质量排列。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：动能温度（kinetic temperatures）是该非平衡系统热力学的自然变量：其差值控制热流与熵产生，其和值通过广义均分关系决定平均能量；在无限质量极限下，只有用动能温度表达的输运关系仍有意义。此外，熵产生与热流在交换两珠质量时不变，而能量存储观测量则依赖质量排列。；创新点：揭示了能量观测量与输运/不可逆性观测量在质量交换下的不同行为（能量具有路径依赖，输运与不可逆性定义良好），并统一以动能温度作为能量、输运和不可逆性的组织变量；还推导出一个定义类平衡正则分布的有效温度，并分析了遍历性及时间平均收敛速度。
papers.method_zh: 协方差矩阵方法（covariance-matrix approach）结合欠阻尼朗之万动力学的数值模拟，用于求解稳态概率分布、热输运和熵产生。

papers.title: Chiral Color Ice: Exact Local Handedness Constraints and Möbius Zero Modes in Frustrated Magnets
papers.abstract: Local constraints govern the low-energy physics of frustrated matter, but familiar ice-type rules constrain flux-like quantities and are insensitive to handedness. Here we show that handedness itself can be imposed as an exact local quantum constraint without selecting an axis in spin space. We construct positive-semidefinite, SU(2)-invariant parent Hamiltonians whose complete zero-energy space on a tetrahedron has a prescribed chirality sign, rather than selecting a particular chiral wave function. For spin-1/2 the local term is a rank-one projector onto a chiral tetrahedral singlet, while for arbitrary spin it factorizes as $B^\dagger B$ through a singlet-annihilation operator, with a completely characterized kernel given by the span of the globally rotated chiral color-ice states. For coherent states, the same zero-energy condition becomes an $S$-independent nonlinear constraint in which three spin directions determine the fourth through a Möbius transformation; compositions of these maps define constraint holonomies on extended lattices. Connecting the same local constraint in different ways produces qualitatively different collective regimes: corner-sharing lattices retain exponentially large quantum ground-state kernels, with rigorous lower bounds exceeding conventional ice benchmarks; edge-sharing lattices support subdimensional plane or line zero modes; while triangular constructions suppress nonuniform coherent deformations and contain the complete Anderson tower of tetrahedral magnetic order at exactly zero energy. Two inequivalent triangular coverings further show that harmonic zero-mode counting does not determine the size of the quantum kernel. These results establish a tractable setting in which local handedness, nonlinear constraint geometry, and quantum degeneracy can be disentangled and related directly to the connectivity of the constraint network.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“parent Hamiltonians”“zero-energy space”“spin-1/2”“coherent states”等理论构造与解析分析关键词，未涉及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：阻挫磁体中的手征自旋冰（chiral color ice）模型，具体为四面体上具有精确局域手征约束的量子自旋系统，涵盖自旋1/2与任意自旋S情形，以及不同晶格连接方式（角共享、边共享、三角覆盖）下的集体行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 手征性本身可以被构造为精确的局域量子约束（不依赖自旋空间选轴），其零能空间由全局旋转的手征色冰态张成；该约束在不同晶格连接方式下产生截然不同的集体相：角共享晶格保留指数大的量子基态简并，边共享晶格支持亚维平面/线零模，三角构造则在零能处包含完整的四面体磁有序Anderson塔。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：手征性本身可以被构造为精确的局域量子约束（不依赖自旋空间选轴），其零能空间由全局旋转的手征色冰态张成；该约束在不同晶格连接方式下产生截然不同的集体相：角共享晶格保留指数大的量子基态简并，边共享晶格支持亚维平面/线零模，三角构造则在零能处包含完整的四面体磁有序Anderson塔。；创新点：首次将“手征性”本身（而非特定手征波函数）作为精确局域量子约束实现，且不依赖自旋空间选轴；揭示了非线性约束几何（Möbius变换）与量子简并度之间的直接联系，并证明谐波零模计数不能决定量子核大小（两个不等价三角覆盖给出反例）。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造方法：构建正半定、SU(2)不变的父哈密顿量，对自旋1/2为秩一投影算符（投影到手征四面体单重态），对任意自旋通过单重态湮灭算符因子化为B†B形式；利用相干态将零能条件转化为与自旋S无关的非线性约束（Möbius变换），并分析约束联络的holonomy；通过不同晶格连接方式（角共享、边共享、三角覆盖）比较零模计数与量子核大小。

papers.title: Learning rules for complex-valued patterns in networks of oscillators
papers.abstract: In this article, we extend learning rules from real binary to complex-valued spins. This formulation allows for a robust and natural representation of grayscale patterns, where spins behave as multi-state neurons and can be stored in a complex-valued weight matrix. We describe a rule that performs better than standard methods, such as Hebbian learning, to encode information in a suitable form for pattern retrieval with networks of oscillators. Since in neural networks it is of interest to have local and incremental learning rules, we prove the extension of a result by Diederich and Opper with our complex-valued spin formulation. We then test the behavior of the associative memory for the system of oscillators under different circumstances for both real-valued, as well as complex-valued correlated and random patterns.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“learning rules”“formulation”“prove the extension of a result”等理论推导与算法描述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：振荡器网络中的联想记忆模型，具体为复值自旋（complex-valued spins）系统，用于表示灰度模式（grayscale patterns）并存储于复值权重矩阵中。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种针对复值自旋的扩展学习规则，其编码信息用于振荡器网络模式检索时优于标准方法（如Hebbian学习）；并证明了Diederich–Opper结果在复值自旋表述下的推广。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种针对复值自旋的扩展学习规则，其编码信息用于振荡器网络模式检索时优于标准方法（如Hebbian学习）；并证明了Diederich–Opper结果在复值自旋表述下的推广。；创新点：首次将学习规则从实二值自旋系统推广到复值自旋系统，从而实现对灰度模式更自然且鲁棒的表示，并证明该规则在振荡器网络联想记忆中优于传统Hebbian方法；同时给出了局部增量学习规则的数学证明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：将实二值自旋学习规则推广至复值自旋，构建复值权重矩阵；采用局部、增量式学习规则（符合神经网络要求）；通过数学证明（Diederich–Opper结果的复值扩展）及数值测试（对实值、复值相关及随机模式进行联想记忆行为测试）验证性能。

papers.title: Fine structure of the M-center in Si
papers.abstract: Color centers in silicon offer great possibilities for scalable quantum technologies. The M-center, proposed to originate from a carbon-hydrogen complex, offers telecommunications-band emission and a paramagnetic ground state similar to the T-center. Here, we report on photoluminescence lines in the vicinity of the M-center and investigate their properties, including their dependence on temperature, implantation fluence, implantation isotope, and annealing temperature. Three emission lines are observed that are blue-shifted by 1.1, 2.8 and 3.6 meV relative to the 761 meV zero phonon line of the M center, where the 2.8 meV line exhibits negative thermal quenching and is therefore proposed to originate from a second excited state of the M-center. The remaining blue-shifted emission lines, together with two additional red-shifted (4.7 and 6.4 meV) emission lines display normal thermal quenching, and are unaffected by an isotope shift of the implanted carbon atom ($^{12}$C versus $^{13}$C implantation) and implantation fluence. Thus, they likely arise either from other defects with similar emission energies or from a perturbed configuration of the M-center.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“photoluminescence lines”（光致发光谱线）的测量，并涉及温度、注入剂量、同位素、退火温度等实验变量的依赖关系。；研究对象：硅中的M色心（M-center），一种被认为源自碳-氢复合体的发光缺陷，具有电信波段发射和顺磁基态，与T-center类似。具体研究其零声子线（761 meV）附近的多条精细发光谱线。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在M-center主零声子线高能侧观察到三条蓝移（1.1、2.8、3.6 meV）的发射线，其中2.8 meV线表现出负热猝灭行为，被指认为M-center的第二激发态；其余蓝移线及两条红移线（4.7、6.4 meV）表现出正常热猝灭，且不受碳同位素替换和注入剂量影响，可能来自其他相似能量缺陷或M-center的微扰构型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在M-center主零声子线高能侧观察到三条蓝移（1.1、2.8、3.6 meV）的发射线，其中2.8 meV线表现出负热猝灭行为，被指认为M-center的第二激发态；其余蓝移线及两条红移线（4.7、6.4 meV）表现出正常热猝灭，且不受碳同位素替换和注入剂量影响，可能来自其他相似能量缺陷或M-center的微扰构型。；创新点：首次系统表征了M-center零声子线附近的精细结构，并识别出一个新的第二激发态（2.8 meV线），同时通过同位素和剂量控制排除了部分伴线来自碳相关缺陷的可能性，为M-center的能级结构提供了新的实验约束。
papers.method_zh: 光致发光（photoluminescence）光谱测量，系统改变温度、注入剂量（implantation fluence）、注入同位素（¹²C vs ¹³C）以及退火温度，通过谱线能量位移和热猝灭行为进行归属分析。

papers.title: Resonance statistics, Fock-space branching, and long-range pair networks in slowly varying interacting chains
papers.abstract: In a slowly varying aperiodic potential $h_i=h\cos(2πβi^n+φ)$ with random power-law density interactions $V_{ij}/|i-j|^α$, the resonant-object ensemble changes across $α=2n$, wherever Hartree fragmentation is operative, from isolated two-level bonds to a mixture of fragmented multi-site clusters and isolated wing bonds that survive at finite density, while the pair-resonance scaling $x_{\rm pair}^{4-2n-α}\ln x_{\rm pair}\propto h^2/(Vt_0)$ is unchanged~\cite{letter}. Here we develop the microscopic resonance theory underlying these results, together with its domain of validity. We derive the exact phase-averaged resonance statistics --- the supply $N_0\propto L^{2-n}/h$, the correlated common-phase comb, and the closed-form Hartree variance --- proving that the interaction leaves the leading supply law unchanged. Exact construction of the resonant Fock-space graph at $L\le18$ shows that the order-one forward-branching scale $h_{\rm FB}\propto L^{2-n}$ carries no giant component: one-step branching and connectivity are inequivalent. We separate the fixed-pair matching law from the shell-averaged $q\ln(1/q)$ law of the bond ensemble and develop the comb into a mesoscopic shell theory; we map the fragmentation domain, with its support threshold $V_*(α)$ and the boundary-healing recursion; and we treat the marginal case $α=2$, where shell and matching marginalities compound into a double logarithm. Three long-range thresholds emerge with distinct meanings --- $α=1/2$ (the exact variance threshold of the random Fock-space energy and the square-summability boundary of the leading LIOM-dressing estimate), $α=2n$ (change of the local resonant objects), and $α=2$ (marginality of the long-range shell sum) --- none of which is, by itself, a localization transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：microscopic resonance theory、derive exact statistics、exact construction、mapping。；研究对象：缓慢变化非周期势（$h_i=h\cos(2\pi\beta i^n+\phi)$）中具有随机幂律密度相互作用（$V_{ij}/|i-j|^\alpha$）的一维相互作用链，具体关注其共振对象系综、Fock空间图结构及长程配对网络。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Hartree碎裂起作用的条件下，共振对象系综在$\alpha=2n$处从孤立两能级键转变为碎裂多格点团簇与孤立翼键的混合体；同时推导出精确的相位平均共振统计，证明相互作用不改变前导供给律$N_0\propto L^{2-n}/h$，并指出三个长程阈值（$\alpha=1/2$、$2n$、$2$）各自具有不同含义，但均非局域化相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Hartree碎裂起作用的条件下，共振对象系综在$\alpha=2n$处从孤立两能级键转变为碎裂多格点团簇与孤立翼键的混合体；同时推导出精确的相位平均共振统计，证明相互作用不改变前导供给律$N_0\propto L^{2-n}/h$，并指出三个长程阈值（$\alpha=1/2$、$2n$、$2$）各自具有不同含义，但均非局域化相变。；创新点：建立了微观共振理论及其适用范围，严格证明相互作用不改变前导供给律；揭示前向分支尺度$h_{\rm FB}\propto L^{2-n}$处无巨连通分量（一步分支与连通性不等价）；区分了三个长程阈值的不同物理意义。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导（精确相位平均共振统计、闭式Hartree方差、固定配对匹配律与壳层平均$q\ln(1/q)$律的分离）；精确构造$L\le18$的共振Fock空间图；壳层介观理论（comb发展为介观壳层理论）；碎裂域映射与边界愈合递推；边际情形$\alpha=2$的双对数处理。

papers.title: Hartree Fragmentation and Long-Range Pair Networks in Aperiodic Chains
papers.abstract: For fermions in a slowly varying aperiodic potential with random interactions $V_{ij}/|i-j|^α$, the potential fixes the resonance supply $N_0 \propto L^{2-n}/h$. On crossing $α-2n$, wherever Hartree fragmentation is operative, the resonant-object ensemble reconstructs: turning-point runs fragment into clusters whose intrinsic matching law resolves no logarithmic singularity, while isolated wing bonds survive at finite density and restore a reduced logarithm. The scaling $x^{4-2n-α}_{pair} ln{x_{pair}} \propto h^2/(V t0)$ is unchanged. Random coefficient fluctuations sustain the $R^{-α}$ coupling; uniform ones cancel to $R^{-α-2}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“Hartree fragmentation”“scaling”“resonant-object ensemble”等理论分析术语，且无实验或数值模拟关键词。；研究对象：非周期链（aperiodic chains）中的费米子体系，具体为缓变非周期势场中具有随机长程相互作用（\(V_{ij}/|i-j|^\alpha\)）的量子系统，关注其共振态结构及配对关联的标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Hartree碎裂机制起作用的参数区间（\(\alpha-2n\) 交叉处），共振客体系综发生重构：转折点运行片段碎裂为团簇，其内在匹配律消除了对数奇异性，而孤立的翼键以有限密度存活并恢复约化对数标度；配对长度标度 \(x_{\rm pair}^{4-2n-\alpha}\ln x_{\rm pair} \propto h^2/(V t_0)\) 保持不变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Hartree碎裂机制起作用的参数区间（\(\alpha-2n\) 交叉处），共振客体系综发生重构：转折点运行片段碎裂为团簇，其内在匹配律消除了对数奇异性，而孤立的翼键以有限密度存活并恢复约化对数标度；配对长度标度 \(x_{\rm pair}^{4-2n-\alpha}\ln x_{\rm pair} \propto h^2/(V t_0)\) 保持不变。；创新点：揭示了非周期链中Hartree碎裂对共振客体系综的重新组织机制，并证明该机制可消除对数奇异性而保留约化对数标度，同时澄清了随机与均匀系数涨落对长程耦合衰减律的不同贡献。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论分析。具体包括：基于共振供给数 \(N_0 \propto L^{2-n}/h\) 的标度论证，Hartree碎裂框架下的团簇重构分析，以及随机/均匀系数涨落对长程耦合 \(R^{-\alpha}\) 与 \(R^{-\alpha-2}\) 行为的区分处理。

papers.title: Coarse-grained simulations of dsDNA polycatenanes and network formation in annular nanochannels with topoisomerase II
papers.abstract: We numerically investigate the behavior of a system of initially unlinked nicked dsDNA rings confined into an annular square nanochannel in the presence of TopoII. Channel confinement can enhance the catenation likelihood by bringing highly bent regions from different rings in close proximity, while at the same time reducing the emergence of knots. The annular channel topology simplifies the characterization of the system by removing periodic boundary conditions and can lead to the formation of circular catenanes.We characterize the equilibrium and dynamical properties of the steady-state system, including the amount of catenation and the topologies explored by the system, under different parameters of the model and for different levels of confinement. We argue that a similar setup could allow for a direct comparison between experiments and simulations under well characterized and controlled conditions, thus providing a way to select and tune computational models of TopoII, as well as provide a way to obtain dsDNA interlocked materials in a controlled fashion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“numerically investigate”（数值研究）和“simulations”（模拟）。；研究对象：研究对象为dsDNA（双链DNA）多连环体系，具体是初始未连接的带切口dsDNA环在环形方形纳米通道中的行为，以及拓扑异构酶II（TopoII）存在下的链间连环（catenation）与网络形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通道约束通过使不同DNA环的高弯曲区域靠近，增强了连环形成的概率，同时抑制了打结的出现；环形通道几何可导致环形连环（circular catenanes）的形成，并便于系统表征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通道约束通过使不同DNA环的高弯曲区域靠近，增强了连环形成的概率，同时抑制了打结的出现；环形通道几何可导致环形连环（circular catenanes）的形成，并便于系统表征。；创新点：利用环形纳米通道的拓扑结构消除了周期性边界条件带来的复杂性，从而简化了连环化表征；该设置有望在受控条件下实现实验与模拟的直接对比，为筛选和调优TopoII计算模型以及可控制备dsDNA互锁材料提供途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用粗粒化（coarse-grained）计算机模拟方法，对dsDNA多连环体系在环形纳米通道中的平衡态和动力学性质进行数值研究，系统扫描了不同模型参数和不同约束强度。

papers.title: Universal unconventional responses controlled by ferroaxial order
papers.abstract: Ferroaxial materials are an emerging class of ferroic materials that, in contrast to ferromagnets and ferroelectrics, are fully robust against stray fields, making them ideally suited for data storage and other nonvolatile applications. However, detection of the ferroaxial state remains challenging, as ferroaxiality does not manifest directly through a measurable macroscopic electric polarization or magnetization, and probes are mostly limited to optical methods. Here, we theoretically establish that ferroaxial order universally generates unconventional components of responses to external stimuli, such as the spin Hall effect, magneto-Seebeck effect, or Faraday effect, across a broad range of linear and nonlinear transport, optical and equilibrium phenomena. These unconventional responses are always directly coupled to ferroaxial order and can distinguish ferroaxial domains, providing probes of ferroaxial order. This general connection also reveals a largely unexplored class of ferroaxial metals, in which unconventional transport provides a natural probe of ferroaxial order, as demonstrated by our first-principles calculations for representative materials. Our results reveal a fundamentally different way for ferroic order to manifest -- ferroaxiality primarily shows unconventional material responses rather than the directly measurable order parameters, broadening the possibilities of nonvolatile ferroic control and flexible device design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“theoretically establish”“first-principles calculations”等关键词。；研究对象：铁轴性（ferroaxial）材料，包括铁轴性绝缘体和铁轴性金属，以及由铁轴序控制的非常规响应现象（如自旋霍尔效应、磁塞贝克效应、法拉第效应等）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 铁轴序能够普遍地产生对外界刺激的非常规响应分量（如自旋霍尔效应、磁塞贝克效应、法拉第效应等），这些响应与铁轴序直接耦合，可用于区分铁轴畴，从而作为探测铁轴序的普适探针。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：铁轴序能够普遍地产生对外界刺激的非常规响应分量（如自旋霍尔效应、磁塞贝克效应、法拉第效应等），这些响应与铁轴序直接耦合，可用于区分铁轴畴，从而作为探测铁轴序的普适探针。；创新点：首次建立了铁轴序与多种非常规线性/非线性输运、光学及平衡态响应之间的普适联系，并揭示了一类此前未被充分探索的铁轴性金属，其中非常规输运可作为铁轴序的自然探针。摘要未突出说明与具体实验方法的对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与第一性原理计算。摘要明确提及“first-principles calculations”，但未具体说明所用泛函或软件（如VASP、Wien2k等），摘要未明确说明具体计算细节。

papers.title: Coexistence of polariton bound states in the continuum and 2D radiative excitons
papers.abstract: Bound states in the continuum (BICs) enable optical modes with ideally infinite radiative lifetimes despite lying within the radiation continuum. Radiation-matter interaction in periodically patterned planar waveguides embedding two-dimensional (2D) optically active excitations can be described quantum mechanically by diagonalizing a non-Hermitian operator, known as the Hopfield matrix, which can be generalized to incorporate independent photonic and excitonic losses into the polaritonic states. However, since 2D excitons undergo intrinsic wavevector-dependent radiative decay within the light cone, whether the Hopfield formalism can consistently account for this process while preserving polariton BICs has remained an open question. Here we show that a non-Hermitian Hopfield formalism incorporating excitonic radiative losses correctly captures the existence of genuine $k=0$ polariton BICs with diverging radiative lifetimes. The theory provides a unified microscopic framework for radiative excitons and polariton BICs, and an efficient predictive tool for designing photonic-crystal platforms coupled to quantum wells, transition-metal dichalcogenides, and other 2D excitonic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“quantum mechanical”“diagonalizing a non-Hermitian operator”“Hopfield formalism”，属于理论建模与解析推导。；研究对象：周期性图案化平面波导中嵌入二维（2D）光学活性激子（如量子阱、过渡金属二硫化物等）所构成的极化激元体系，具体物理现象为连续谱中的束缚态（BIC）与二维辐射激子的共存。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在包含激子辐射损耗的非厄米Hopfield形式下，体系可以存在真正的k=0极化激元BIC，其辐射寿命发散；该理论为辐射激子与极化激元BIC提供了统一的微观描述框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在包含激子辐射损耗的非厄米Hopfield形式下，体系可以存在真正的k=0极化激元BIC，其辐射寿命发散；该理论为辐射激子与极化激元BIC提供了统一的微观描述框架。；创新点：首次证明在计入二维激子固有辐射损耗的情况下，Hopfield形式仍能自洽地保留极化激元BIC的存在性，解决了此前该形式能否同时描述辐射激子与BIC的开放问题，并提供了面向光子晶体平台的设计预测工具。
papers.method_zh: 非厄米Hopfield矩阵对角化方法，推广了原有Hopfield形式以纳入独立的光子与激子损耗，并显式处理二维激子波矢依赖的辐射衰减（光锥内过程）。

papers.title: Halide donors in monoclinic- and corundum-phase Ga$_2$O$_3$ and Al$_2$O$_3$
papers.abstract: We present a systematic first-principles investigation of halide impurities (F and Cl) in Ga$_2$O$_3$ and Al$_2$O$_3$, considering both monoclinic and corundum phases. Our study of the structural properties, formation energies, and charge-state transition levels establishes the relative stability of different atomic configurations and charge states. We find that F and Cl on oxygen sites act as shallow donors in Ga$_2$O$_3$ in both the monoclinic and corundum phases. However, their behavior differs substantially as the band gap increases with greater Al compositions. Fluorine is prone to $DX$-center formation with increased Al composition, leading to self-compensation at 38% Al concentration in monoclinic (Al$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$)$_2$O$_3$ and 70% Al concentration in corundum (Al$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$)$_2$O$_3$. Chlorine is more resistant to $DX$-center formation: in monoclinic (Al$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$)$_2$O$_3$, Cl$_\mathrm{O}$ on the lowest-energy oxygen site shows an onset of $DX$ behavior at 50% alloy composition, while in corundum (Al$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$)$_2$O$_3$ this onset for Cl$_\mathrm{O}$ occurs only at Al concentrations as high as 84%. We also study F and Cl interstitials, finding that they act as compensating centers but also exhibit migration barriers that are low enough for them to be removed by post-growth annealing. Surprisingly, in both monoclinic and corundum Al$_2$O$_3$, Cl$_\mathrm{O}$ exhibits a relatively shallow transition level located at $\sim$0.48 eV below the conduction-band minimum, much shallower than F$_\mathrm{O}$ and other donor candidates. These remarkable results identify Cl as an unusually promising donor candidate in (Al$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$)$_2$O$_3$ alloys and even pure Al$_2$O$_3$, although high formation energies and compensation will render observation of true $n$-type conductivity in Al$_2$O$_3$ difficult.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要明确提到“first-principles investigation”（第一性原理研究），涉及形成能、电荷态跃迁能级等计算量。；研究对象：卤素杂质（F和Cl）在Ga₂O₃和Al₂O₃中的掺杂行为，涵盖单斜相（β相）和刚玉相两种晶体结构，以及(AlₓGa₁₋ₓ)₂O₃合金体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: F和Cl在氧位点上均为Ga₂O₃中的浅施主，但在Al含量增加时F易形成DX中心导致自补偿；Cl对DX中心形成更具抗性，且在Al₂O₃中Cl_O的跃迁能级（~0.48 eV）异常浅，使其成为(AlₓGa₁₋ₓ)₂O₃合金乃至纯Al₂O₃中有前景的施主候选，尽管高形成能和补偿效应使Al₂O₃中实现真正n型导电仍困难。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：F和Cl在氧位点上均为Ga₂O₃中的浅施主，但在Al含量增加时F易形成DX中心导致自补偿；Cl对DX中心形成更具抗性，且在Al₂O₃中Cl_O的跃迁能级（~0.48 eV）异常浅，使其成为(AlₓGa₁₋ₓ)₂O₃合金乃至纯Al₂O₃中有前景的施主候选，尽管高形成能和补偿效应使Al₂O₃中实现真正n型导电仍困难。；创新点：首次系统对比F和Cl在Ga₂O₃和Al₂O₃两种相（单斜和刚玉）中的施主行为，揭示了Cl在宽带隙(AlₓGa₁₋ₓ)₂O₃合金中作为浅施主的独特优势，特别是Cl_O在Al₂O₃中异常浅的跃迁能级这一反直觉发现。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（DFT），具体包括：结构性质计算、形成能计算、电荷态跃迁能级计算，以及迁移势垒计算（用于评估间隙杂质的退火可去除性）。

papers.title: Active Brownian Dynamics from a Hamiltonian Model: Transitioning from Equilibrium to Activity
papers.abstract: We introduce a Hamiltonian Active Brownian Particle (HABP) model that connects equilibrium dynamics with the non-equilibrium, two-dimensional overdamped behavior of standard Active Brownian Particles (ABPs). In equilibrium, the system follows overdamped Langevin equations that strictly satisfy the fluctuation-dissipation theorem. Coupling translational and rotational degrees of freedom to separate heat baths ($T_θ > T_{\textrm{tr}}$), drives the system out of equilibrium. In free space, matching the diffusion coefficients yields quantitative agreement with the ABP model in the limit $T_θ/T_{\textrm{tr}}\to \infty$, whereas in a harmonic potential, this matching is recovered even at finite temperature ratios. Entropy production analysis demonstrates that in the ABP limit, all energy injected by the swim force dissipates into the translational bath, leaving the rotational bath as a zero-cost entropy source. These insights provide the first steps toward equilibrium-inspired descriptions of active matter, facilitating the development of new theoretical frameworks to study activity-induced fluctuations, transport, and phase behavior in living and non-living soft matter systems far from equilibrium.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“We introduce a Hamiltonian model”，并进行了“Entropy production analysis”，属于理论建模与分析。；研究对象：活性布朗粒子（ABPs）的过阻尼非平衡动力学，以及其与平衡态哈密顿动力学之间的桥梁。具体涉及平移与转动自由度耦合到不同温度热浴的二维体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入哈密顿活性布朗粒子（HABP）模型，在自由空间中当温度比趋于无穷时，可定量复现标准ABP模型行为；在谐振子势中，有限温度比下即可恢复该匹配。熵产生分析表明，在ABP极限下，泳力注入的能量全部耗散到平移热浴，转动热浴成为零成本熵源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入哈密顿活性布朗粒子（HABP）模型，在自由空间中当温度比趋于无穷时，可定量复现标准ABP模型行为；在谐振子势中，有限温度比下即可恢复该匹配。熵产生分析表明，在ABP极限下，泳力注入的能量全部耗散到平移热浴，转动热浴成为零成本熵源。；创新点：首次从哈密顿模型出发，将平衡态过阻尼朗之万动力学（严格满足涨落耗散定理）与非平衡ABP行为统一起来，为活性物质提供“平衡态启发式”描述框架。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：哈密顿动力学建模，将平移与转动自由度分别耦合到不同温度（T_θ > T_tr）的热浴；通过匹配扩散系数与标准ABP模型对比；在自由空间和谐波势两种情形下分析；利用熵产生率分析能量耗散路径。

papers.title: Terahertz Control of Optical Second-Harmonic Generation in Displacive Ferroelectrics: Electronic Bloch-State Reconstruction
papers.abstract: Optical second-harmonic generation (SHG) is a powerful probe of ferroelectric order, yet its microscopic origin and dynamical control are often understood primarily from symmetry considerations rather than from the underlying electronic processes. Here, we develop a microscopic theory of terahertz-controlled optical SHG in displacive ferroelectrics, establishing a direct connection between THz-driven polar lattice distortions and the resulting electronic nonlinear optical response. Starting from a complete Bloch-band representation, we show that an inversion-breaking lattice distortion reconstructs electronic Bloch wave functions, modifies optical dipole matrix elements, and activates nonlinear optical pathways that are forbidden in the centrosymmetric structure. We derive the second-order susceptibility in terms of the distortion-induced reconstruction of electronic states and optical transition matrix elements, and demonstrate that the electronic SHG susceptibility is linear in the polar distortion, $χ^{(2)}({\bf Q})\propto{\bf Q}$, leading to an SHG intensity quadratic in the inversion-breaking order parameter. When the polar mode is coherently driven by a terahertz electric field, the resulting time-dependent lattice distortion dynamically reconstructs the electronic states and thereby modulates the optical SHG response, with $I_{2ω}(t)\propto|{\bf Q}(t)|^2$ to leading order. This framework distinguishes the THz-driven lattice dynamics from the electronic interband processes responsible for optical SHG, which is particularly important in insulating ferroelectrics where low-energy carrier dynamics are absent. Our theory thus provides a microscopic bridge between nonequilibrium polar lattice dynamics and ultrafast electronic nonlinear optics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“develop a microscopic theory”“derive”“framework”等关键词，属于第一性原理/解析理论推导，无实验或数值计算细节。；研究对象：位移型铁电体（displacive ferroelectrics）中，太赫兹（THz）电场驱动的极性晶格畸变与光学二次谐波产生（SHG）之间的微观联系，具体关注电子布洛赫态重构对非线性光学响应的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出SHG二阶极化率与极性畸变呈线性关系，χ⁽²⁾(Q) ∝ Q，因此SHG强度与反演对称破缺序参量的平方成正比（I₂ω ∝ |Q(t)|²）。THz相干驱动极性声子可动态重构电子态，从而实时调制SHG响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出SHG二阶极化率与极性畸变呈线性关系，χ⁽²⁾(Q) ∝ Q，因此SHG强度与反演对称破缺序参量的平方成正比（I₂ω ∝ |Q(t)|²）。THz相干驱动极性声子可动态重构电子态，从而实时调制SHG响应。；创新点：将THz驱动的极性晶格动力学与电子非线性光学响应在微观层面直接桥接，明确区分了晶格运动（低频）与电子带间过程（负责SHG）的贡献，特别适用于无低能载流子动力学的绝缘铁电体。摘要未突出说明与以往唯象对称性分析相比的具体理论突破。
papers.method_zh: 基于完整布洛赫带表示（complete Bloch-band representation）的微观理论推导。具体包括：分析反演对称破缺晶格畸变对电子布洛赫波函数的重构、光学偶极矩阵元的修正，以及非线性光学路径的激活；推导二阶极化率与畸变诱导电子态重构及跃迁矩阵元的关系。

papers.title: Emergence and suppression of phonon vortices in two-dimensional crystals: Interplay of lattice symmetry, heavy impurities, and shear
papers.abstract: Phonon vortices are vortex-like displacement fields that appear in the vibrational modes of two- dimensional materials. Here, we demonstrate that these vortices arise as symmetry-adapted linear combinations of degenerate planar phonon modes, with the superposition coefficients uniquely de- termined by the lattice point group. This symmetry principle establishes that vortices are intrinsic standing-wave solutions in perfect crystals, requiring neither impurities nor disorder. A heavy mass impurity favors vortex modes over planar modes through stronger resonance-induced frequency soft- ening, whereas shear deformation suppresses vortex modes by breaking rotational symmetry. The competition between these two effects gives rise to a precisely predictable strain threshold. The proposed framework, grounded in symmetry and energy-minimization, provides a useful basis for understanding vibrational topological defects induced by other types of impurities or defects. This study further suggests that defect and shear engineering constitutes an effective tuning strategy for controlling vibrational modes and the associated thermal and mechanical properties of crystals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中强调“symmetry principle”“symmetry-adapted linear combinations”“energy-minimization”等理论框架，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：二维晶体中的声子涡旋（phonon vortices），具体关注晶格对称性、重质量杂质以及剪切形变对声子涡旋产生与抑制的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 声子涡旋是完美晶体中由晶格点群对称性决定的简并平面声子模式的对称性适配线性组合，属于本征驻波解，无需杂质或无序；重杂质通过共振诱导频率软化增强涡旋模式，而剪切形变通过破缺旋转对称性抑制涡旋模式，二者竞争产生可精确预测的应变阈值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：声子涡旋是完美晶体中由晶格点群对称性决定的简并平面声子模式的对称性适配线性组合，属于本征驻波解，无需杂质或无序；重杂质通过共振诱导频率软化增强涡旋模式，而剪切形变通过破缺旋转对称性抑制涡旋模式，二者竞争产生可精确预测的应变阈值。；创新点：首次将声子涡旋的起源归结为晶格点群对称性决定的简并模式组合，确立其为完美晶体的本征解，并定量给出重杂质与剪切形变竞争导致的应变阈值；该对称性+能量最小化框架可推广至其他类型杂质或缺陷诱导的振动拓扑缺陷。
papers.method_zh: 基于晶格点群对称性分析（对称性适配线性组合）与能量最小化原理构建理论框架，推导声子涡旋的存在条件及其与杂质、剪切应变的耦合规律。

papers.title: Topological and spin-orbit effects on orbital moments in ultra-thin magnetic films
papers.abstract: Topological orbital moments (TOMs) are a direct hallmark of a magnetic texture with a non-trivial spin topology. In addition to giving insight into the topology of the magnetic texture, TOMs could also be used to manipulate magnetic structures with a compensated total spin moment. Experimental evidence of TOMs has been provided via transport measurements of the Hall effect in intercalated van-der-Waals materials. However, a direct observation of TOMs is still missing. Another complication arises for the unambiguous proof of the topological origin since orbital moments can also occur due to spin-orbit coupling. Here, we use first-principles electronic structure theory to investigate the origin of orbital moments in different compensated spin structures with a non-trivial topology. We focus on ultrathin magnetic films at surfaces such as Pd/Mn bilayers on Re(0001) which represent ideal model systems for the detection of TOMs since it is possible to apply experimental techniques with local resolution of magnetic properties such as spin-polarized scanning tunneling microscopy. Due to its trivial topology we use the row-wise antiferromagnetic (RW-AFM) state in a hexagonal monolayer to analyze the spin-orbit induced contributions. The triple-Q (3Q) state is a superposition state of three RW-AFM (1Q) states and thus electronically similar, however, due to its non-trivial spin topology it exhibits TOMs. The comparison between these two spin states allows us to disentangle the topological and spin-orbit contributions to the orbital moments. We find that TOMs have an important contribution in spin-compensated systems, since the spin-orbit coupling induced orbital moments are nearly compensated. First-principles calculations for atomic-scale skyrmion lattices in Fe monolayers on different surfaces exhibit the same general trend found for the 3Q state.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“first-principles electronic structure theory”（第一性原理电子结构理论）和“First-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：超薄磁性薄膜中的轨道磁矩，具体体系包括Re(0001)表面上的Pd/Mn双层膜，以及不同表面上Fe单层膜中的原子级斯格明子晶格。物理现象聚焦于拓扑轨道磁矩（TOMs）与自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）诱导的轨道磁矩的区分。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在自旋补偿体系中，拓扑轨道磁矩（TOMs）具有重要贡献，而自旋-轨道耦合诱导的轨道磁矩几乎相互抵消。通过对比具有平凡拓扑的行反铁磁（RW-AFM）态与非平凡拓扑的三重Q（3Q）态，可以清晰分离拓扑与自旋-轨道耦合对轨道磁矩的贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在自旋补偿体系中，拓扑轨道磁矩（TOMs）具有重要贡献，而自旋-轨道耦合诱导的轨道磁矩几乎相互抵消。通过对比具有平凡拓扑的行反铁磁（RW-AFM）态与非平凡拓扑的三重Q（3Q）态，可以清晰分离拓扑与自旋-轨道耦合对轨道磁矩的贡献。；创新点：提出了一种通过对比RW-AFM（1Q）态与3Q态来解耦拓扑与自旋-轨道耦合对轨道磁矩贡献的方法，并指出在自旋补偿体系中TOMs是主导贡献，为实验上直接探测TOMs提供了理论指导。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理电子结构计算（DFT），用于计算不同自旋结构（RW-AFM态与3Q态）中的轨道磁矩，并通过对比这两种电子结构相似但拓扑性质不同的自旋态来分解拓扑与SOC贡献。同时计算了Fe单层膜中原子级斯格明子晶格以验证普适性。

papers.title: Effective Hardcore Exclusion Without Exclusion: Two-Species Pair Annihilation Revisited
papers.abstract: Reaction-diffusion systems with two species that mutually annihilate through $A+B\to\emptyset$ reactions display a slow decay of the total density $ρ$ which follows an anomalous power law in low dimensions. For hardcore particles in one dimension, this decay follows $ρ\sim t^{-1/4}$ under symmetric diffusion and $ρ\sim t^{-1/3}$ under asymmetric diffusion without relative bias between the two species. The $t^{-1/3}$ behavior, in particular, has so far been observed exclusively in systems with hardcore exclusion. Here we construct a model of particles without hardcore exclusion that reproduces this same $t^{-1/3}$ scaling. In our model, both species undergo asymmetric diffusion with a rate that depends nonlinearly on the local density, a form of transport that, in the absence of the other species, is superdiffusive and falls into the Kardar-Parisi-Zhang universality class. The scaling behavior of $t^{-1/3}$ occurs when at least one of the two species undergoes asymmetric diffusion induced by microscopic processes involving pairs of particles, while asymmetric processes involving groups of three particles lead to $t^{-1/4}$ scaling associated with symmetric diffusion. This demonstrates that the pair annihilation density decay exponent is not determined exclusively by the transport properties of the isolated particle species.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。摘要中未提及实验或数值模拟手段，主要基于模型构建与标度分析，属于理论/解析研究。；研究对象：双物种（A+B→∅）反应-扩散系统中的对湮灭动力学，特别关注一维无硬核排斥条件下粒子密度的时间衰减标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在不含硬核排斥的粒子模型中，通过引入依赖于局域密度的非线性非对称扩散（孤立物种表现为超扩散并属于Kardar-Parisi-Zhang普适类），可以复现此前仅在硬核排斥系统中观察到的密度衰减标度ρ∼t^{-1/3}。该标度出现在至少一个物种的扩散由双粒子微观过程诱导时，而三粒子过程则导致与对称扩散相关的ρ∼t^{-1/4}标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在不含硬核排斥的粒子模型中，通过引入依赖于局域密度的非线性非对称扩散（孤立物种表现为超扩散并属于Kardar-Parisi-Zhang普适类），可以复现此前仅在硬核排斥系统中观察到的密度衰减标度ρ∼t^{-1/3}。该标度出现在至少一个物种的扩散由双粒子微观过程诱导时，而三粒子过程则导致与对称扩散相关的ρ∼t^{-1/4}标度。；创新点：首次证明对湮灭密度衰减指数并非仅由孤立物种的输运性质决定——即使没有硬核排斥，通过非线性密度依赖的非对称扩散也能产生t^{-1/3}标度，从而打破了此前认为该标度必须依赖硬核排斥的认知。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与标度分析。构建了无硬核排斥的粒子模型，其中两种物种均具有依赖于局域密度的非对称扩散速率；通过分析不同微观过程（双粒子 vs 三粒子）对密度衰减指数的影响，并与已知的硬核排斥系统结果（t^{-1/4}与t^{-1/3}）进行对比。

papers.title: Predictive wavelength tailoring of uniform GaSb-based quantum dots for emission at 1.55 um
papers.abstract: A detailed study of emission wavelength tailoring of GaSb-based QDs formed by InGaSb-filling of droplet-etched nanoholes in AlGaSb is presented. The study shows that the emission wavelength can be modified from 1.48 um to the center of the telecom C-band at 1.55 mm by independently varying the QD composition and size. More specifically, the optical transition energy shifts linearly as a function of In-content of the QD material at a rate of -4.4 meV/In-percentage, and with the number of monolayers (ML) of material used for filling the nanoholes, at -2.0 meV/ML. These experimentally observed energy shifts are well predicted by simulations yielding rates of -4.3 meV/In-percentage and -2.1 meV/ML, respectively. For the simulation, a uniform In composition, low intermixing, and microscopically measured QD geometry is considered. Additionally, excellent ensemble QD uniformity, with unprecedented inhomogeneous broadening well-below 7 meV across all samples is demonstrated. Finally, photoluminescence of single-QDs reveals narrow excitonic emission lines of 13.8+/-6.7 ueV and low fine-structure splitting values reaching <10 ueV. These results identify GaSb-based LDE QDs as a tunable telecom platform for scaling quantum-photonic applications over long-haul optical fiber networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含模拟验证）。判断依据：摘要描述“experimentally observed energy shifts”“photoluminescence”等实验手段，同时提及“simulations”作为辅助验证，属于实验为主、模拟为辅的混合类型。；研究对象：基于GaSb的量子点体系，具体为通过InGaSb填充液滴刻蚀纳米孔（droplet-etched nanoholes）在AlGaSb势垒中形成的量子点，研究其发射波长调控及光学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过独立调节量子点的In组分和尺寸，可将发射波长从1.48 μm精确调谐至电信C波段中心1.55 μm；实验测得跃迁能量随In含量和填充单层数（ML）的线性红移速率分别为-4.4 meV/In%和-2.0 meV/ML，与模拟值（-4.3 meV/In%和-2.1 meV/ML）高度吻合。同时，该量子点展现出优异的均匀性（非均匀展宽<7 meV）和单量子点级窄线宽发射（13.8±6.7 μeV）及低精细结构劈裂（<10 μeV）。
