papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过独立调节量子点的In组分和尺寸，可将发射波长从1.48 μm精确调谐至电信C波段中心1.55 μm；实验测得跃迁能量随In含量和填充单层数（ML）的线性红移速率分别为-4.4 meV/In%和-2.0 meV/ML，与模拟值（-4.3 meV/In%和-2.1 meV/ML）高度吻合。同时，该量子点展现出优异的均匀性（非均匀展宽<7 meV）和单量子点级窄线宽发射（13.8±6.7 μeV）及低精细结构劈裂（<10 μeV）。；创新点：首次系统展示了GaSb基液滴刻蚀量子点（LDE QDs）作为可调谐电信波段（1.55 μm）量子光源的可行性，实现了发射波长从1.48 μm到C波段的精确预测性调控，并同时达到创纪录的低非均匀展宽（<7 meV）和极低精细结构劈裂（<10 μeV），为长距离光纤网络中的量子光子应用提供了可扩展平台。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）生长量子点；利用液滴刻蚀（droplet etching）形成纳米孔并用InGaSb填充；光致发光（PL）谱测量发射波长与能量位移；单量子点PL谱测量激子线宽和精细结构劈裂；结合微观几何形貌测量（如原子力显微镜等）进行量子点能级模拟计算。

papers.title: Time-delayed feedback turns Arrhenius escape logarithmic
papers.abstract: Thermal escape is governed by the Arrhenius law, where the mean escape time scales exponentially with the barrier height. We show that the non-Markovianity induced by time-delayed feedback in the confining force removes this exponential scaling. Beyond a threshold set by the curvature of the minimum, the delay destabilizes the well, and the thermal noise seeds an instability that is subsequently amplified deterministically to the boundary leading to \textit{slingshot} escape trajectories. The escape time becomes logarithmic in the barrier, its fluctuations follow a Gumbel law, and an optimal delay enables escape faster than free diffusion. Our results propose time delay as a tunable and experimentally feasible control parameter for accelerating activated processes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“We show that...”“the escape time becomes...”“our results propose...”等理论推导与机制分析表述，未提及实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：热逃逸（thermal escape）过程，具体为在含时延反馈的非马尔可夫约束力作用下，粒子从势阱中逃逸的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 时延反馈引入的非马尔可夫性可消除Arrhenius定律中逃逸时间随势垒高度指数增长的行为，使逃逸时间变为势垒高度的对数函数；且存在最优时延可使逃逸快于自由扩散。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：时延反馈引入的非马尔可夫性可消除Arrhenius定律中逃逸时间随势垒高度指数增长的行为，使逃逸时间变为势垒高度的对数函数；且存在最优时延可使逃逸快于自由扩散。；创新点：首次提出将时延反馈作为可调且实验可行的控制参数，用于加速活化过程，并揭示“弹弓”（slingshot）逃逸轨迹这一新机制，使逃逸时间从指数标度转变为对数标度。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于含时延反馈的朗之万方程（或等效福克-普朗克框架），分析势阱稳定性阈值、噪声触发的不稳定性放大机制，并推导逃逸时间的标度律与涨落分布（Gumbel分布）。

papers.title: Layer Axial Phonons and Dipolar Thermal Response in Centrosymmetric Thin Films
papers.abstract: In nonmagnetic centrosymmetric materials, $\mathcal{PT}$ symmetry enforces vanishing total phonon angular momentum (phonon AM) at every wave vector, making them appear unsuitable as hosts of axial phonons. Here, using first-principles calculations for BaAgAs and representative van der Waal's layered materials, we show that centrosymmetric slabs can still host large hidden layer-resolved phonon AM with both chiral and cycloidal modes. This hidden phonon AM texture produces layer resolved phonon thermal Edelstein-like responses and a real-space phonon AM dipole response, both tunable by strain. Our results establish centrosymmetric layered materials as an exciting platform for hidden axial phonon and multipolar phonon thermal response.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“using first-principles calculations”。；研究对象：中心对称薄膜材料中的层分辨声子角动量（layer-resolved phonon AM）及其热响应，具体材料包括BaAgAs和代表性范德华层状材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非磁性中心对称材料中，尽管整体声子角动量因$\mathcal{PT}$对称性在每个波矢处为零，但中心对称薄膜仍可承载巨大的隐藏层分辨声子角动量，包含手性和摆线（cycloidal）模式，并产生层分辨的声子热Edelstein类响应及实空间声子角动量偶极响应，且均可由应变调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非磁性中心对称材料中，尽管整体声子角动量因$\mathcal{PT}$对称性在每个波矢处为零，但中心对称薄膜仍可承载巨大的隐藏层分辨声子角动量，包含手性和摆线（cycloidal）模式，并产生层分辨的声子热Edelstein类响应及实空间声子角动量偶极响应，且均可由应变调控。；创新点：首次在中心对称材料中揭示隐藏的层分辨声子角动量及其多极热响应，打破了此前认为中心对称材料不适合作为轴向声子载体的认知，并建立了应变可调的声子角动量偶极响应平台。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），具体针对BaAgAs和范德华层状材料进行声子色散、声子角动量及热响应性质的计算。

papers.title: Quadratic pair-breaking absorption edge from Anderson localization in a superconducting wire
papers.abstract: We show that Anderson localization fundamentally reshapes dissipative superconducting electrodynamics, replacing the linear Mattis--Bardeen pair-breaking onset with a parametrically weaker quadratic Mott edge while leaving the quasiparticle spectrum unchanged. We derive this behavior for a weakly disordered single-channel wire with a spatially uniform $s$-wave pair potential using a Nambu-space extension of the Berezinskii diagram technique that resums elastic impurity scattering to all orders. Conservation of the Bogoliubov branch collapses the Nambu diagram hierarchy onto an exactly solvable localization problem. The localization length remains equal to its normal-state value, whereas the localization time diverges at the gap edge. The new absorption edge results from the product of the superconducting pair-creation coherence factor and the Mott-suppressed current matrix elements between localized orbitals, which generates the characteristic double logarithm. Localization also reduces the Hebel--Slichter coherence peak. The resulting theory provides an all-orders benchmark for microwave and spin-relaxation experiments on localized superconducting nanowires.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“We derive this behavior...”、“using a Nambu-space extension of the Berezinskii diagram technique”，属于解析理论推导。；研究对象：弱无序单通道超导纳米线（weakly disordered single-channel wire）中的耗散超导电动力学，具体聚焦于安德森局域化对超导对破缺吸收边的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 安德森局域化将超导对破缺吸收边从传统的线性Mattis-Bardeen行为改变为参数上更弱的二次方Mott边（quadratic Mott edge），同时准粒子谱保持不变。该新吸收边源于超导配对相干因子与局域轨道间Mott抑制的电流矩阵元的乘积，并产生特征性的双对数行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：安德森局域化将超导对破缺吸收边从传统的线性Mattis-Bardeen行为改变为参数上更弱的二次方Mott边（quadratic Mott edge），同时准粒子谱保持不变。该新吸收边源于超导配对相干因子与局域轨道间Mott抑制的电流矩阵元的乘积，并产生特征性的双对数行为。；创新点：首次证明安德森局域化从根本上重塑了耗散超导电动力学，给出了超越微扰论的全阶基准结果；同时发现局域化长度保持正常态值不变，而局域化时间在能隙边缘发散，并预言局域化会抑制Hebel-Slichter相干峰。该理论为局域化超导纳米线的微波和自旋弛豫实验提供了全阶理论基准。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为Nambu空间的Berezinskii图技术扩展，该方法将弹性杂质散射重求和到所有阶（all orders）。通过利用Bogoliubov支的守恒性，将Nambu图层级约化为一个可精确求解的局域化问题。

papers.title: Freezing of a deformable water-saturated porous medium. Part I: THM formulation, OpenGeoSys-6 implementation and benchmarking
papers.abstract: In this contribution, Part I, we present a coupled thermo-hydro-mechanical formulation for modeling and analyzing water-to-ice phase change in a deformable fully-saturated porous medium. It is implemented in the multi-physics computational platform OpenGeoSys-6. We compute a series of carefully designed benchmark problems which critically examine the corresponding formulation components and the overall implementation. Several ingredients that have a qualitative and quantitative impact on the numerical results are identified, particularly dissected and commented on. Simulations also account for soil deformation induced by freezing (as a result of 9% volumetric expansion caused by water-to-ice phase transition). The forthcoming Part II will complete the code verification and validation campaign by considering a real full-scale three-dimensional case study of shallow subsurface ice storage. More specifically, we simulate the ice growth process in a fully saturated soil specimen surrounding a group of borehole heat exchangers (BHEs) that contain subzero temperature coolant fluid. A snapshot of the numerical results of this task is already depicted here in Part I as a teaser.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数值模拟文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“implemented in the multi-physics computational platform OpenGeoSys-6”，并“compute a series of carefully designed benchmark problems”。；研究对象：可变形、完全饱和多孔介质中的水-冰相变（冻结）过程，具体涉及土壤冻结引起的变形（水转冰9%体积膨胀），以及浅层地下冰储存系统中钻孔换热器（BHEs）周围饱和土体的冰生长过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确给出单一物理结论，但指出识别出若干对数值结果有定性和定量影响的关键因素（ingredients），并对其进行了剖析和评论；同时实现了对冻结引起的土壤变形（9%体积膨胀）的模拟。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确给出单一物理结论，但指出识别出若干对数值结果有定性和定量影响的关键因素（ingredients），并对其进行了剖析和评论；同时实现了对冻结引起的土壤变形（9%体积膨胀）的模拟。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的独特创新点，但可看出其贡献在于：在OpenGeoSys-6中实现了可变形饱和多孔介质水-冰相变的完整THM耦合公式，并通过系统基准测试对影响数值结果的关键因素进行了识别和剖析。
papers.method_zh: 耦合热-水-力学（THM）数值公式，基于多物理场计算平台OpenGeoSys-6实现；通过一系列精心设计的基准问题（benchmark problems）对公式各组成部分和整体实现进行检验。

papers.title: Machine learning reveals common features of unconventional superconductors with high transition temperatures
papers.abstract: Superconductors with high critical temperatures that emerges beyond the phonon-mediated regime are usually considered unconventional in nature, yet unlike conventional superconductors, no broadly applicable predictive theory currently guides their discovery. Here, we use interpretable machine learning to uncover a common materials-space signature of high-$T_{\mathrm{c}}$ unconventional superconductors and develop a data-driven strategy for materials discovery. We construct a unified feature representation for each material by integrating compositional statistics, structural information, and latent representations from trained property-prediction models, followed by structure-aware filtering of an experimentally established superconducting dataset. Without using transition-temperature information, unsupervised analysis shows that cuprate and iron-based superconductors occupy a common region of materials space, characterized primarily by large electronegativity deviation and intermediate mean valence-electron number. A supervised $T_{\text{c}}$ model independently identifies the same descriptors as dominant features, providing complementary evidence for their relevance. Using this empirical materials-space prior together with the $T_{\text{c}}$ model, we prioritize candidate materials, recover recently discovered nickelate superconductors, and identify chemically distinct candidates for future investigation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数据驱动文章。判断依据：使用“interpretable machine learning”“unsupervised analysis”“supervised \(T_c\) model”等数据驱动方法，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：非常规超导体，特别是铜氧化物（cuprate）和铁基超导体，以及潜在的高临界温度（\(T_{\mathrm{c}}\)）超导候选材料（如镍酸盐超导体）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过可解释机器学习，发现高\(T_{\mathrm{c}}\)非常规超导体在材料空间中具有共同特征，主要由大的电负性偏差和中等平均价电子数刻画；该特征不依赖\(T_{\mathrm{c}}\)信息即可从无监督分析中涌现，并被监督模型独立确认。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过可解释机器学习，发现高\(T_{\mathrm{c}}\)非常规超导体在材料空间中具有共同特征，主要由大的电负性偏差和中等平均价电子数刻画；该特征不依赖\(T_{\mathrm{c}}\)信息即可从无监督分析中涌现，并被监督模型独立确认。；创新点：提出一种不依赖\(T_{\mathrm{c}}\)标签的、基于材料空间共同特征的数据驱动超导材料发现策略，并成功恢复近期发现的镍酸盐超导体，同时识别出化学上不同的新候选材料。摘要未突出说明与传统机器学习方法在特征工程或模型可解释性上的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 构建统一材料特征表示（整合组分统计、结构信息、预训练性质预测模型的潜在表示），对实验超导数据集进行结构感知过滤；使用无监督聚类分析（未使用\(T_{\mathrm{c}}\)信息）和有监督\(T_{\mathrm{c}}\)预测模型，并结合材料空间先验进行候选材料筛选。

papers.title: A closed-form theory of charge-regulated electrostatic interactions between anisotropically charged spheres
papers.abstract: Proteins and many other colloids carry ionizable surface groups that are both spatially inhomogeneous (patchy) and pH-responsive (charge-regulating). In the description of the electrostatic interactions between such particles, these two aspects are often treated separately, especially from a theoretical perspective. We present a unified, closed-form theory that unites charge regulation and patchiness within the linearized Poisson--Boltzmann approximation. For spherical particles with anisotropic distributions of titratable sites, we derive both the leading-order mean-field interaction energy as well as the Kirkwood--Shumaker fluctuation interaction. The theory exposes a qualitatively new effect between two electroneutral anisotropic particles: proximity-induced charge regulation generates a net monopole, and splits orientational branches that are degenerate in any linear fixed-charge model. The accompanying correction to the interaction energy has no fixed sign---it softens like-charge repulsion but can deepen or create attraction away from the isoelectric point. We benchmark three ingredients of the theory against published results; no existing simulation probes their combination, which would capture the central prediction of the theory. Lastly, we apply the theory to two proteins---lysozyme and $α$-chymotrypsinogen A---and show that it not only reproduces the measured second virial coefficients reasonably well but also predicts how charge regulation expands the range of pH and screening strength where the protein--protein interaction is attractive.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“closed-form theory”“linearized Poisson–Boltzmann approximation”“derive”，属于解析理论推导，无实验或数值模拟数据。；研究对象：带各向异性（斑块状）电荷分布且具有pH响应性（电荷调节）的球形胶体粒子，具体应用于蛋白质（溶菌酶和α-胰凝乳蛋白酶原A）之间的静电相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在电中性各向异性粒子之间，邻近诱导的电荷调节会产生净单极矩，并分裂在固定电荷线性模型中简并的取向分支；该相互作用能修正项符号不固定——可软化同号电荷排斥，但在等电点附近可加深或产生吸引。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在电中性各向异性粒子之间，邻近诱导的电荷调节会产生净单极矩，并分裂在固定电荷线性模型中简并的取向分支；该相互作用能修正项符号不固定——可软化同号电荷排斥，但在等电点附近可加深或产生吸引。；创新点：首次在统一闭式理论框架中同时处理电荷调节和电荷斑块各向异性，揭示了二者耦合产生的新物理效应（邻近诱导单极矩和取向分支分裂），该组合效应尚无现有模拟可验证。
papers.method_zh: 线性化Poisson–Boltzmann近似下的解析理论推导，给出平均场相互作用能和Kirkwood–Shumaker涨落相互作用的闭式表达式；并将理论应用于两种蛋白质的第二维里系数计算。

papers.title: Heterogeneous ferroelectricity and conductivity of oxidized BaTiO$_3$ crystals: the role of nanoscale phase segregation in the surface region
papers.abstract: We investigate the effect of thermal oxidation on BaTiO$_3$ single crystals. Our results reveal that, even at moderate temperatures of up to 1000 °C, complex segregation mechanisms occur involving the movement of Ba-rich compounds to the upper surface, where they form inhomogeneously distributed BaO nanocrystals. As a result, deeper regions of the surface layer become depleted in Ba and become TiO$_2$-rich. A sandwich-like structure evolves in the surface layer, exhibiting a measurable electromotive force and self-polarization. This, in turn, screens the polarization and diminishes the global ferroelectric response. The conductivity is also strongly influenced by the irreversible segregation effects in the surface region. An as-received crystal can be transformed into a metallic state, while oxidation induces semiconducting properties and prevents a return to the metallic state upon subsequent reduction. Nanoscale analysis demonstrates that the conductivity is channeled to filaments forming along dislocations, whose local chemical composition changes upon reduction and oxidation even at moderate temperatures due to preferential Ba and O pipe diffusion thus determining the electric behavior of the whole sample.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要描述了对BaTiO₃单晶的热氧化处理、结构表征、电学测量及纳米尺度分析，属于实验研究。；研究对象：氧化处理的BaTiO₃单晶，具体关注表面区域纳米尺度相分离、铁电性与导电性的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 热氧化即使在1000°C的适中温度下也会引发BaTiO₃表面层复杂的偏析机制，形成BaO纳米晶与TiO₂-rich区域的夹层结构，产生自极化和电动势，同时屏蔽极化并削弱整体铁电响应；氧化使晶体从金属态转变为半导体态，且后续还原无法恢复金属态，导电性沿位错形成的丝状通道传输。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：热氧化即使在1000°C的适中温度下也会引发BaTiO₃表面层复杂的偏析机制，形成BaO纳米晶与TiO₂-rich区域的夹层结构，产生自极化和电动势，同时屏蔽极化并削弱整体铁电响应；氧化使晶体从金属态转变为半导体态，且后续还原无法恢复金属态，导电性沿位错形成的丝状通道传输。；创新点：揭示了即使在适中温度下，BaTiO₃表面区域也会发生不可逆的Ba和Ti偏析及BaO纳米晶析出，形成夹层结构并主导宏观电学行为；发现导电性沿位错丝状通道传输，且Ba和O的管道扩散在适中温度下即可改变局域化学组分，从而决定整体电学性质。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 热氧化处理（最高1000°C）、还原处理、宏观电学输运测量（金属态/半导体态表征）、纳米尺度成分与导电性分析（如沿位错的局域化学组分表征，摘要未明确具体手段名称，如TEM/STEM-EDS等未提及）。

papers.title: Temperature Dependence of the Refractive Index for AlAsGaSb
papers.abstract: Accurate design and optimization of photonic multilayer structures like distributed Bragg reflectors (DBRs) require precise knowledge of material optical constants, particularly the temperature dependence of the refractive index. While these parameters are well established for widely used semiconductors, for emerging materials such as antimonides they are often limited to room-temperature data, especially for new spectral ranges of interest. Antimonide compounds, in particular GaSb-based alloys, are promising for quantum photonics applications. In this work, we investigated DBRs lattice-matched to GaSb and designed for operation in the third telecommunication window. Reflectivity spectra were measured in the temperature range from 11.5 K to 300 K, and then fitted using the transfer matrix method (TMM), combined with a dedicated recursive numerical fitting algorithm. Initial parameters included layer thicknesses determined by scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and literature values of refractive indices at room temperature. This approach enabled extraction of the temperature-dependent refractive indices of two AlGaAsSb alloys suitable for forming DBR mirrors for 1.5 um wavelengths. The obtained results provide essential input for reliable DBR design, ensuring proper stopband positioning and high reflectivity under cryogenic operating conditions required for efficient quantum emitter performance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要中明确提到“Reflectivity spectra were measured”（反射谱测量）以及“fitted using the transfer matrix method”（传输矩阵法拟合），属于实验测量与数值拟合结合的工作。；研究对象：AlGaAsSb合金（具体为两种AlGaAsSb四元合金），用于与GaSb衬底晶格匹配、工作在1.5 μm（第三电信窗口）的分布式布拉格反射镜（DBR）结构。研究其折射率随温度的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在11.5 K至300 K温度范围内，提取了两种AlGaAsSb合金的温变折射率数据，为低温下DBR的阻带定位和高反射率设计提供了关键参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在11.5 K至300 K温度范围内，提取了两种AlGaAsSb合金的温变折射率数据，为低温下DBR的阻带定位和高反射率设计提供了关键参数。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其新意在于：针对锑化物（antimonide）材料体系，提供了此前缺乏的低温（11.5 K–300 K）折射率温度依赖数据，填补了该材料在1.5 μm波段低温光学常数方面的空白。
papers.method_zh: 实验上测量DBR样品的反射光谱（温度范围11.5 K–300 K）；使用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）确定各层厚度；采用传输矩阵方法（TMM）结合递归数值拟合算法，以室温文献折射率值为初始参数，对反射谱进行拟合以提取温变折射率。

papers.title: Mass-gap functional determinant approach for mobile Fermi polarons
papers.abstract: We extend the functional determinant approach (FDA), previously restricted to static impurities, to the case of finite-mass impurities by using the mass-gap description of Fermi polarons [Phys. Rev. Lett. 135, 193401 (2025)]. The quadratic structure of the mass-gap model enables the exact evaluation of many-body spectra and Ramsey dynamics for mobile impurities. We show that this mass-gap FDA smoothly interpolates between the Fermi-edge singularity for infinitely heavy impurities and the emergence of quasiparticle weight for finite impurity mass. Our results demonstrate that the mass-gap FDA provides a transparent and computationally efficient framework to describe the quantum dynamics of mobile impurities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“functional determinant approach”“exact evaluation”“framework”等理论推导与计算方法关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：费米极化子（Fermi polarons）体系，具体关注有限质量杂质（mobile impurities）在费米海中的多体物理，包括多体谱与Ramsey动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该质量间隙泛函行列式方法（mass-gap FDA）能够平滑插值两种极限行为：无限重杂质对应的费米边奇异（Fermi-edge singularity）与有限杂质质量下准粒子权重的涌现，从而统一描述移动杂质的量子动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该质量间隙泛函行列式方法（mass-gap FDA）能够平滑插值两种极限行为：无限重杂质对应的费米边奇异（Fermi-edge singularity）与有限杂质质量下准粒子权重的涌现，从而统一描述移动杂质的量子动力学。；创新点：将原本仅适用于静态杂质的FDA推广到有限质量杂质，并证明该框架在计算上高效且物理图像透明，能够统一处理从费米边奇异到准粒子行为的过渡。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为泛函行列式方法（FDA），并扩展至有限质量杂质情形；核心工具是质量间隙模型（mass-gap description，见 Phys. Rev. Lett. 135, 193401 (2025)），利用其二次型结构对多体谱和Ramsey动力学进行精确求解。

papers.title: Exact fluctuation relations in voltage- and temperature-biased Laughlin-edge constrictions
papers.abstract: We present a comprehensive analysis of non-equilibrium fluctuation-dissipation relations connect- ing experimentally accessible chiral-current auto- and cross-correlations to the tunneling-current noise and conductance in Laughlin edge states coupled through a quantum point contact (QPC). We examine their validity for two chiral Laughlin edges held at different temperatures and voltages and show that the relations remain exact for arbitrary tunneling strength, voltage bias, and edge- state temperatures. We further generalize them to spatially extended QPCs and to tunneling am- plitudes with an explicit voltage dependence, and discuss the conditions and limitations associated with these generalizations. Our results establish that the local tunneling-current noise generated at the QPC can be reliably reconstructed from experimentally accessible auto- and cross-correlations measured downstream, providing a robust route to characterize non-equilibrium transport in chiral edge states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“分析”“证明”“推广”等理论推导性词汇，且未提及任何实验手段或数值模拟方法。；研究对象：Laughlin边缘态通过量子点接触（QPC）耦合形成的分数量子霍尔体系，具体研究在电压偏置和温度偏置下的手征边缘态输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Laughlin边缘态QPC结构中，连接手征电流自关联/互关联与隧穿电流噪声及电导的非平衡涨落-耗散关系，在任意隧穿强度、电压偏置和边缘态温度下均严格成立；该关系可推广至空间扩展QPC及具有显式电压依赖的隧穿振幅情形。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Laughlin边缘态QPC结构中，连接手征电流自关联/互关联与隧穿电流噪声及电导的非平衡涨落-耗散关系，在任意隧穿强度、电压偏置和边缘态温度下均严格成立；该关系可推广至空间扩展QPC及具有显式电压依赖的隧穿振幅情形。；创新点：首次系统证明此类涨落-耗散关系在任意隧穿强度和温度/电压偏置下的精确性，并给出向空间扩展QPC及电压依赖隧穿振幅的推广条件与限制；摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为Laughlin边缘态的手征Luttinger液体模型，结合非平衡涨落-耗散关系分析，对隧穿电流噪声与下游可测电流关联函数进行解析推导与严格性论证。

papers.title: Moiré-induced lattice reconstruction at buried atomic interfaces
papers.abstract: Atomic reconstruction at twisted two-dimensional interfaces governs many of their emergent optical, electronic, and mechanical properties, including sliding ferroelectricity. Despite recent progress in understanding lattice reconstruction in suspended twisted bilayers, structural changes at van der Waals heterointerfaces between multilayer crystals remain largely unexplored. Here we use multi-slice electron ptychography to non-invasively recover the three-dimensional atomic structure at marginally twisted rhombohedral interfaces between thick transition-metal dichalcogenide crystals. With a position precision of ~3 pm and a depth resolution ~1 nm, we resolve the twist-induced lattice reconstruction field per layer, and the resulting dislocation network at the buried interface. Despite the bulk nature, we observe markedly strong in-plane interfacial reconstruction due to suppression of the out-of-plane bending by outer layers, exceeding predictions from our three-dimensional modelling. Furthermore, we extract the strain tensor evolution during the decay of the reconstruction into the bulk, providing a structural foundation for understanding multi-layer moiré systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用多切片电子叠层衍射（multi-slice electron ptychography）进行实验测量。；研究对象：厚过渡金属二硫属化物（TMD）晶体之间轻微扭转的菱面体堆垛异质界面，具体关注莫尔超晶格诱导的晶格重构、位错网络及应变场。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在厚层块体TMD晶体间的埋藏原子界面处，由于外层晶体抑制了面外弯曲，面内晶格重构异常强烈，其幅度超过三维模型预测；同时提取了重构向块体内部衰减过程中的应变张量演化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在厚层块体TMD晶体间的埋藏原子界面处，由于外层晶体抑制了面外弯曲，面内晶格重构异常强烈，其幅度超过三维模型预测；同时提取了重构向块体内部衰减过程中的应变张量演化。；创新点：首次对多层晶体间范德华异质界面的埋藏原子结构进行非侵入式三维成像，揭示了块体约束下面内重构增强这一与悬浮双层体系不同的新机制，并给出了重构向体相衰减的应变张量演化。
papers.method_zh: 多切片电子叠层衍射（multi-slice electron ptychography），实现约3 pm的位置精度和约1 nm的深度分辨率，逐层解析扭转诱导的晶格重构场及界面位错网络；辅以三维建模进行对比。

papers.title: Chemically Resolved Topological Coordinates Link Structural Dynamics and Configurational Thermodynamics
papers.abstract: Atomic coordinates specify a structure, but they do not reveal how chemical connectivity across several length scales relates to atomic motion and configurational energy ordering. We formulate chemically directed persistent homology at four resolutions---complete networks, individual sites, spatial fields, and substitutional arrangements---while retaining the chemical identity and length scale of each connectivity feature. In \textit{ab initio} molecular dynamics (AIMD) trajectories of $δ$- and $γ$-CsPbI$_3$ at five temperatures spanning 500--700 K, the corner-sharing $γ$ network has a lower Pb--I restoring stiffness and permits larger iodide excursions, yet iodide positional correlations decay 2.27 times more slowly and Pb-network topology retains memory 1.63 times longer than in the edge-sharing $δ$ phase. Local softness and loss of network memory are therefore distinct. At individual sites, rare $γ$-phase Pb environments with a $δ$-like Cs-cage connectivity precede 0.17 $\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$ greater Pb displacement over the subsequent 0.5 ps. The same Pb-network coordinate resolves disruption of corner-sharing connectivity across a 2560-atom $δ|γ$ boundary. In substituted CsPbI$_3$, compact dopant arrangements undergo greater cooperative host relaxation and lie lower in density-functional-theory (DFT) energy than dispersed arrangements of the same composition. SchNet and Allegro model families with comparable energy errors encode opposite ordering along this coordinate, and 61 of 247 supplied models with errors below 1 meV atom$^{-1}$ on separate test structures reverse the DFT relation. Because relative configurational energies set Boltzmann populations, chemical network topology links structure to physical response and tests whether learned energy models preserve DFT configurational ordering even when their average errors are small.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) trajectories”、“density-functional-theory (DFT) energy”以及机器学习势（SchNet、Allegro）的对比测试，属于第一性原理计算与机器学习模型评估类研究。；研究对象：CsPbI₃钙钛矿材料的δ相（edge-sharing）与γ相（corner-sharing）结构，以及取代掺杂（substituted CsPbI₃）体系；具体关注化学连通性拓扑、原子运动动力学、构型能量排序及机器学习势的可靠性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 化学网络拓扑坐标（化学定向持久同调）能够区分局部软度与网络记忆丧失：γ相Pb–I恢复刚度更低但碘位移相关性衰减慢2.27倍、Pb网络拓扑记忆保持时间长1.63倍；同时，该坐标可预测单个Pb位点的后续位移，并能揭示δ|γ界面处连通性破坏。在取代体系中，紧凑掺杂排列比分散排列具有更大的协同宿主弛豫和更低的DFT能量，但许多低误差机器学习模型（61/247个，误差<1 meV/atom）却给出相反的排序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：化学网络拓扑坐标（化学定向持久同调）能够区分局部软度与网络记忆丧失：γ相Pb–I恢复刚度更低但碘位移相关性衰减慢2.27倍、Pb网络拓扑记忆保持时间长1.63倍；同时，该坐标可预测单个Pb位点的后续位移，并能揭示δ|γ界面处连通性破坏。在取代体系中，紧凑掺杂排列比分散排列具有更大的协同宿主弛豫和更低的DFT能量，但许多低误差机器学习模型（61/247个，误差<1 meV/atom）却给出相反的排序。；创新点：首次将化学身份与长度尺度信息保留在持久同调拓扑坐标中，建立化学连通性拓扑与原子运动动力学、构型热力学之间的直接联系；并利用该坐标系统检验机器学习势是否保持DFT的构型能量排序，揭示“平均误差小”不等于“相对能量排序正确”这一关键问题。
papers.method_zh: 化学定向持久同调（chemically directed persistent homology）在四个分辨率（完整网络、单个位点、空间场、取代排列）下构建拓扑坐标；结合从头算分子动力学（AIMD）模拟（500–700 K五个温度）；密度泛函理论（DFT）能量计算；以及SchNet和Allegro两类机器学习势模型的能量排序对比测试。

papers.title: Dynamics of a nanoscale ferromagnetic vortex
papers.abstract: We propose a ferromagnetic vortex stabilized by the interfacial Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction (iDMI) and investigate its properties through theoretical analysis and micromagnetic simulations. Our results demonstrate that this vortex can remain stable even in nanoscale ferromagnetic disks with radii below $5\,\text{nm}$---far smaller than those of conventional nanodot vortices having about $1\,μ\text{m}$ radius. We analytically solve the nonlinear equation of motion describing the anharmonic vortex oscillation, and identify the critical frequency that determines the stability of the driven oscillation of the vortex. This nanoscale vortex exhibits conventional properties of microscale vortices, including gyrotropic oscillation and resonance frequency shift under an out-of-plane magnetic field. It also exhibits unconventional behaviors, such as a strongly anharmonic potential, nonlinear oscillations, and a Duffing-oscillator-like response under the external AC bias.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含微磁模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“theoretical analysis and micromagnetic simulations”。；研究对象：由界面Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya相互作用（iDMI）稳定的纳米尺度铁磁涡旋，具体为半径小于5 nm的铁磁纳米盘中的涡旋态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该iDMI稳定的铁磁涡旋可在半径远小于传统纳米点涡旋（约1 μm）的纳米盘中保持稳定，且其驱动振荡存在一个决定稳定性的临界频率；该涡旋兼具传统回旋振荡与强非谐性、非线性及Duffing振子响应等非常规行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该iDMI稳定的铁磁涡旋可在半径远小于传统纳米点涡旋（约1 μm）的纳米盘中保持稳定，且其驱动振荡存在一个决定稳定性的临界频率；该涡旋兼具传统回旋振荡与强非谐性、非线性及Duffing振子响应等非常规行为。；创新点：首次提出利用iDMI在亚5 nm尺度稳定铁磁涡旋，突破了传统纳米点涡旋约1 μm的尺寸下限，并揭示了该尺度下强非谐势与Duffing类非线性响应等新物理。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析求解描述非谐涡旋振荡的非线性运动方程，并结合微磁模拟（micromagnetic simulations）研究涡旋稳定性与动力学性质。

papers.title: Dark exciton signatures in the infrared transient absorption of MoS$_2$ monolayer
papers.abstract: Dark excitons play a central role in the nonequilibrium dynamics of two-dimensional semiconductors, but remain difficult to characterize. In this work we show that transient-absorption experiments, with probe pulses tuned in the exciton-exciton transitions energy range (exc-tr-abs), can be used to detect excitations from any populated dark excitonic state, including symmetry-forbidden, spin-forbidden, and finite momentum ones. We develop a fully ab initio scheme, on top of $GW$+BSE, for computing exc-tr-abs spectra from arbitrary populated exciton distributions. The different classes of dark excitons are included on an equal footing, by evaluating exciton-exciton dipole matrix elements in a locally smooth gauge, which accounts for both intra-band and inter-band contributions. As a test case, we consider monolayer MoS$_2$, for which experimental data are available. The exc-tr-abs signal emerges from a sum of contributions from four different valleys in the exciton dispersion, namely $Γ$, $K$, $M$, and $Q$ valleys. The interpretation of the final signal is substantially different from the one based on transitions at $\mathbf{q}=Γ$ alone. The exciton-exciton dipoles show similar intensity among these valleys, while their relative weight is mostly dictated by the initial excitonic population. State- and spin-resolved analyses show that the main peaks can be described as $1s \rightarrow 2p$ and $1s \rightarrow 3p$ transitions from A and B excitons, but with a superposition of transitions from both spin-flip and spin-conserving excitons across the valleys, and with contributions averaged over different momenta within the individual valleys.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。依据：摘要明确提到“fully ab initio scheme”“GW+BSE”“evaluating exciton-exciton dipole matrix elements”，属于第一性原理计算与理论建模工作，未涉及实验测量。；研究对象：单层二硫化钼（MoS₂ monolayer）中的暗激子（dark excitons），具体关注其在红外瞬态吸收（exc-tr-abs）光谱中的特征信号，涵盖对称禁戒、自旋禁戒及有限动量暗激子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 瞬态吸收实验（探针调谐至激子-激子跃迁能量范围）可探测任意布居的暗激子态；在MoS₂单层中，exc-tr-abs信号来自激子色散中Γ、K、M、Q四个谷的贡献之和，其解释与仅考虑q=Γ跃迁的图景有本质不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：瞬态吸收实验（探针调谐至激子-激子跃迁能量范围）可探测任意布居的暗激子态；在MoS₂单层中，exc-tr-abs信号来自激子色散中Γ、K、M、Q四个谷的贡献之和，其解释与仅考虑q=Γ跃迁的图景有本质不同。；创新点：首次在完全从头算框架内统一处理各类暗激子（包括有限动量暗激子）的瞬态吸收信号，并揭示多谷（Γ、K、M、Q）贡献对最终光谱解释的关键影响，而非仅考虑Γ点跃迁。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于GW+BSE的第一性原理方案，计算任意激子布居分布下的exc-tr-abs光谱。具体包括：在局域光滑规范下计算激子-激子偶极矩阵元，同时考虑带内与带间贡献；对暗激子进行分类（对称禁戒、自旋禁戒、有限动量）并平等处理；进行态分辨与自旋分辨分析。

papers.title: Polymer Membrane Tensegrity: Inverse Design of Polymer Films Morphing into Freeform 3D Surfaces with Digital Photopatterning Technique
papers.abstract: In Metamorphosis of Plants (1790), Goethe traced diverse plant organs to transformations of a common leaf-like structure -- a principle modern mechanics attributes to two material ingredients: non-uniform in-plane strain from differential growth or shrinkage, and spatially patterned stiffness. Here we translate this principle into a synthetic fabrication framework called Polymer Membrane Tensegrity (PMT). A flat elastomeric film swollen with a second monomer is selectively UV-cured through a liquid-crystal display (LCD) photomask in a single-side digital photopatterning step, producing rigid rods embedded in a soft, shrinkable membrane. After the unreacted monomer is extracted with a solvent and the film is dried, the membrane shrinks far more than the rods, generating a ~50% in-plane strain differential and a ~2,000-fold modulus contrast -- conditions under which the contracting membrane is held in tension by mutually unconnected rods, a tensegrity-inspired arrangement within a single film. An origami-based inverse design algorithm computes the rod layout that morphs the film into a prescribed 3D surface. We demonstrate PMT on a dome, a hyperbolic surface, and a gyroid unit cell -- positively and negatively curved targets -- reproducing all three with mean deviations of 1.0-2.1% of the target size; perimeter curve optimization halves the mean deviation of the gyroid. Because patterning occurs on one side only, PMT eliminates the front-to-back alignment demanded by bilayer methods, offering a scalable route from flat polymer films to freeform 3D surfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含计算辅助设计）。判断依据：摘要描述实际制备流程（UV固化、溶剂提取、干燥）、实验表征（形貌偏差测量），并包含“origami-based inverse design algorithm”作为计算设计环节，属于实验与计算结合。；研究对象：聚合物薄膜体系：一种溶胀了第二单体的平坦弹性体薄膜，经单侧数字光图案化后形成“刚性杆嵌入软可收缩膜”的复合结构（Polymer Membrane Tensegrity, PMT）。研究其从平面薄膜形变为自由形态三维曲面的物理机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过单侧数字光图案化在单一薄膜内产生约50%的面内应变差和约2000倍的模量对比，使收缩膜被互不相连的刚性杆张紧（张拉整体式构型），从而可将平面聚合物薄膜精确形变为预定三维曲面（穹顶、双曲曲面、螺旋二十四面体单胞），平均偏差为目标尺寸的1.0–2.1%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过单侧数字光图案化在单一薄膜内产生约50%的面内应变差和约2000倍的模量对比，使收缩膜被互不相连的刚性杆张紧（张拉整体式构型），从而可将平面聚合物薄膜精确形变为预定三维曲面（穹顶、双曲曲面、螺旋二十四面体单胞），平均偏差为目标尺寸的1.0–2.1%。；创新点：PMT方法仅需单侧图案化，消除了双层（bilayer）方法所需的前后对准步骤，提供了一条从平面聚合物薄膜可扩展制备自由形态三维曲面的新路径。摘要未突出说明与现有光图案化或张拉整体结构制备方法在性能上的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用液晶显示（LCD）光掩模进行单侧数字光图案化（digital photopatterning），对溶胀单体的弹性体薄膜选择性UV固化；随后用溶剂提取未反应单体并干燥，触发膜收缩。设计上采用基于折纸（origami）的逆向设计算法计算刚性杆布局，并通过周长曲线优化降低形变误差。

papers.title: A multi-scale study to unravel the dehydration mechanism of hydrated salts
papers.abstract: Understanding the dehydration mechanism of hydrated salts remains fundamentally important in solid state chemistry, as their behavior affect fields ranging from heat storage to heritage conservation and pharmaceutical crystallization. Combining Raman confocal microscopy, dynamic weight loss measurements, SEM, and micro CT, we show that dehydration kinetics of sodium sulfate decahydrate (mirabilite) unfold through two regimes: an initial nucleation controlled phase, where atomic rearrangement drives two dimensional lateral growth following an exponential law, and a subsequent phase boundary controlled regime, where growth advances into the crystal depth, limited by water vacancy formation at the hydrated dehydrated interface. The resulting thenardite product shows around 35 percent shrinkage and forms a porous, layered dual porosity nanocrystalline structure, with relative humidity directly governing crystal size. Extending this analysis to other sulfate hydrates reveals that crystallographic symmetry changes between hydrate and anhydrous phases dictate surface morphology, linking microstructure to mechanism. This multiscale framework uncovers dynamics hidden from bulk measurements and suggests structural indicators could predict dehydration pathways in other hydrated salt families, and opening route toward designing thermal energy storage materials without exhaustive experimental screening.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Raman confocal microscopy, dynamic weight loss measurements, SEM, and micro CT”等实验手段。；研究对象：水合盐的脱水机制，具体以十水硫酸钠（芒硝，mirabilite）为主要研究对象，并扩展到其他硫酸盐水合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 硫酸钠十水合物的脱水动力学分为两个阶段：初始成核控制阶段（原子重排驱动二维横向生长，遵循指数规律）和随后的相界面控制阶段（生长向晶体深度推进，受水空位形成限制）。脱水产物无水硫酸钠（thenardite）收缩约35%，形成多孔、层状双尺度纳米晶结构，且相对湿度直接控制晶体尺寸。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：硫酸钠十水合物的脱水动力学分为两个阶段：初始成核控制阶段（原子重排驱动二维横向生长，遵循指数规律）和随后的相界面控制阶段（生长向晶体深度推进，受水空位形成限制）。脱水产物无水硫酸钠（thenardite）收缩约35%，形成多孔、层状双尺度纳米晶结构，且相对湿度直接控制晶体尺寸。；创新点：建立了从微观结构到宏观机制的多尺度脱水动力学框架，揭示了体相测量无法观测的隐藏动力学，并提出晶体学对称性变化可作为预测其他水合盐家族脱水路径的结构指标，为热储能材料设计提供无需大量实验筛选的途径。
papers.method_zh: 共聚焦拉曼显微镜、动态失重测量、扫描电子显微镜（SEM）、微计算机断层扫描（micro CT），并结合多尺度分析框架。

papers.title: Viscoelastic interfacial structures in undersaturated calcium solutions under nanoconfinement
papers.abstract: Calcium mineralisation underpins processes ranging from biomineralisation to scalable carbon storage, yet the earliest stages of nucleation remain unresolved. Here we investigate calcium-containing solutions under nanoscopic confinement while remaining undersaturated with respect to bulk calcium carbonate precipitation. Using sensitive surface force measurements, we identify a long-range non-DLVO repulsive interaction specific to calcium solutions, which we attribute to hydrated ion networks at mineral interfaces. These interfacial networks exhibit viscoelastic behaviour distinct from the bulk solution, persist across a broad pH range, and can be disrupted by competing ions with strong surface affinity. Our findings provide experimental evidence that stable hydrated ion networks can emerge at mineral interfaces under undersaturated conditions, supporting the possibility that interfaces and confinement stabilise intermediate ion assemblies prior to nucleation. These results bridge classical and nonclassical descriptions of mineral nucleation and highlight the central role of interfaces and confinement in directing crystallisation pathways.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“使用灵敏的表面力测量”（sensitive surface force measurements），属于实验手段。；研究对象：纳米限域条件下、相对于块体碳酸钙沉淀仍处于欠饱和状态的含钙溶液，以及矿物界面处形成的含水离子网络结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在欠饱和钙溶液中，矿物界面处可形成长程、非DLVO型的排斥性相互作用，源于界面处稳定的水合离子网络；该网络具有区别于体相溶液的黏弹性，可在宽pH范围内存在，并能被强表面亲和力的竞争离子破坏。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在欠饱和钙溶液中，矿物界面处可形成长程、非DLVO型的排斥性相互作用，源于界面处稳定的水合离子网络；该网络具有区别于体相溶液的黏弹性，可在宽pH范围内存在，并能被强表面亲和力的竞争离子破坏。；创新点：首次在欠饱和条件下提供实验证据，表明矿物界面可自发形成稳定的水合离子网络，支持“界面与限域可在成核前稳定中间离子组装体”的非经典成核路径假设，从而桥接经典与非经典成核理论。
papers.method_zh: 灵敏的表面力测量（surface force measurements），用于探测纳米限域下钙溶液与矿物界面之间的相互作用力曲线，并结合不同pH和竞争离子条件进行系统表征。

papers.title: Coupling of two individual magnon resonators via a superconducting microwave resonator operating in the strong coupling regime
papers.abstract: We demonstrate coherent coupling of ferromagnetic resonance in two individual permalloy stripes via a superconducting coplanar waveguide resonator. The two stripes are placed on top of the resonator with an angle of 50$^{\circ}$ between their respective long axes. This alignment enables us to separately tune their ferromagnetic resonance frequency by exploiting their shape anisotropy by simply rotating the external bias magnetic field in the sample plane. Both individual ferromagnets exhibit strong coupling with the microwave resonator. This method avoids the use of local individual bias coils and facilitates the integration of similar experiments into planar device infrastructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“demonstrate”“placed on top”“rotating the external bias magnetic field”等实验操作与观测表述。；研究对象：两个独立的坡莫合金（permalloy）微米条带中的铁磁共振模式，以及它们通过超导共面波导谐振腔实现的相干耦合。体系为“磁子-微波光子”混合量子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 两个独立的坡莫合金条带可通过同一个超导微波谐振腔实现相干耦合，且每个铁磁体都与谐振腔处于强耦合状态；通过旋转面内外加磁场即可利用形状各向异性分别调谐两个条带的铁磁共振频率，无需局部偏置线圈。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：两个独立的坡莫合金条带可通过同一个超导微波谐振腔实现相干耦合，且每个铁磁体都与谐振腔处于强耦合状态；通过旋转面内外加磁场即可利用形状各向异性分别调谐两个条带的铁磁共振频率，无需局部偏置线圈。；创新点：利用两个条带长轴呈50°角的几何排布，仅通过旋转面内磁场即可分别调谐两个铁磁体的共振频率，避免了使用局部独立偏置线圈，从而便于将此类实验集成到平面器件结构中。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用超导共面波导谐振腔作为耦合媒介，将两个坡莫合金条带以长轴夹角50°放置于谐振腔上方；通过旋转样品平面内的外加磁场，利用形状各向异性独立调节两个条带的铁磁共振频率，并测量其与谐振腔的强耦合行为。

papers.title: Evanescent-mode Casimir-Josephson force and gate-controlled resonances in ballistic graphene Josephson junctions
papers.abstract: We develop a microscopic scattering theory of the phase-dependent equilibrium mechanical response of a ballistic superconductor-graphene-superconductor Josephson junction. The calculation is based on an energy-dependent Dirac scattering matrix embedded in a normalized Matsubara determinant, so the reported force correction contains the complete Bogoliubov-de Gennes spectrum of the stated ideal model. At charge neutrality the full determinant approaches a closed-form evanescent-mode result proportional to $ΔW/L^2$, reaching $2\ln 2\,ΔW/(πL^2)$ at phase difference $π$ in the zero-temperature short-junction limit. Gate doping produces propagating channels and Fabry-Pérot structure, causing large oscillations and sign reversals of the phase-dependent force correction $δF=F(φ)-F(0)$. We distinguish the interband-to-intraband Andreev crossover, controlled by $|μ|/Δ$, from the evanescent-to-propagating crossover, controlled by $|μ|L/(\hbar v_F)$. Exact real-energy subgap poles obtained from the same energy-dependent scattering matrix are used to diagnose specular/interband and retro/intraband character; these labels are not treated as separately measurable thermodynamic forces in the mixed regime. We also quantify the difference between the complete determinant result and the frozen-scattering short-junction approximation without identifying that difference with a pure continuum force. The resulting gate- and phase-dependent mechanical signal provides a Dirac-material extension of earlier superconductivity-induced mechanical-force proposals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“微观散射理论”“计算”“散射矩阵”“Matsubara行列式”等理论推导与数值计算关键词。；研究对象：弹道超导体-石墨烯-超导体（SGS）约瑟夫森结，具体研究其相位依赖的平衡力学响应（即Casimir-Josephson力），以及门电压调控下的共振行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在电荷中性点，相位依赖的力修正趋近于一个闭式衰逝模结果，正比于ΔW/L²，在零温短结极限、相位差为π时达到2ln2·ΔW/(πL²)。门掺杂会引入传播通道和Fabry-Pérot结构，导致力修正δF出现大幅振荡和符号反转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在电荷中性点，相位依赖的力修正趋近于一个闭式衰逝模结果，正比于ΔW/L²，在零温短结极限、相位差为π时达到2ln2·ΔW/(πL²)。门掺杂会引入传播通道和Fabry-Pérot结构，导致力修正δF出现大幅振荡和符号反转。；创新点：将超导诱导的力学力提案扩展到狄拉克材料体系，给出了门电压和相位依赖的力学信号；区分了由|μ|/Δ控制的带间-带内Andreev交叉与由|μ|L/(ħv_F)控制的衰逝-传播交叉两种不同机制。摘要未突出说明与具体实验方案的结合或可测性讨论。
papers.method_zh: 基于能量依赖的Dirac散射矩阵，嵌入归一化Matsubara行列式，完整包含Bogoliubov-de Gennes谱。利用同一散射矩阵的实能量亚隙极点来诊断镜面/带间与回扫/带内Andreev过程的特征。同时对比了完整行列式结果与冻结散射短结近似之间的差异。

papers.title: d'Q = TdS for Infinitesimal Irreversible Processes: On the Differential Form of the Clausius Inequality
papers.abstract: Conventionally, the differential form of the Clausius inequality is adopted for infinitesimal irreversible processes. We show that the correct first-order form for infinitesimal quasi-static irreversible processes is the equality d'Q=TdS rather than d'Q < TdS. This provides a purely thermodynamic proof that internal entropy production is second-order or higher and confirms that entropy remains a well-defined state quantity even when quasi-static irreversible processes are included, without resorting to the Boltzmann relation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：purely thermodynamic proof（纯热力学证明）、differential form（微分形式）。；研究对象：热力学中克劳修斯不等式（Clausius inequality）的微分形式，具体针对无限小准静态不可逆过程（infinitesimal quasi-static irreversible processes）中熵与热交换的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于无限小准静态不可逆过程，正确的一阶微分形式是等式 d'Q = TdS，而非传统采用的 d'Q < TdS。内部熵产生是二阶或更高阶小量，因此即使包含准静态不可逆过程，熵仍然是定义良好的状态量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于无限小准静态不可逆过程，正确的一阶微分形式是等式 d'Q = TdS，而非传统采用的 d'Q < TdS。内部熵产生是二阶或更高阶小量，因此即使包含准静态不可逆过程，熵仍然是定义良好的状态量。；创新点：推翻了传统教材中“不可逆过程微分形式为 d'Q < TdS”的惯例，证明在准静态不可逆情形下该不等式的一阶形式应取等号，并由此给出熵作为状态量的纯热力学论证，无需统计力学假设。
papers.method_zh: 纯热力学推导（purely thermodynamic proof），不借助玻尔兹曼关系（Boltzmann relation），仅基于热力学第一定律与克劳修斯不等式的自洽性分析。

papers.title: Extending the Pnictide Chemical Space for Photovoltaics
papers.abstract: Developing novel and efficient materials that are beyond silicon for photovoltaic (PV) applications is required to meet the upcoming energy needs of our societies. To identify novel candidate materials that can act as PVs, we use first principles calculations to perform a systematic screening of the pnictide chemical space (i.e., nitrides and phosphides). Specifically, we explore three different ternary and quaternary pnictide classes, namely, ABCX$_2$, BB'B"X$_2$, and A$_4$BX$_2$ (A = Li, Na, or K; B, B', B" = Ca, Sr, Mg, or Zn; C = Al, Ga, or In; X = N or P), leading to a set of 104 possible pnictide compositions. Based on our evaluations of ground state structures, 0 K thermodynamic stabilities, electronic structures, carrier effective masses, dynamic stabilities, and intrinsic point defect formation energies, we arrive at three promising candidates, namely, NaCaInN$_2$, NaSrInN$_2$, and K$_4$ZnP$_2$. Notably, all the identified candidates are thermodynamically (meta)stable, exhibit direct (or nearest direct) band gaps that are optimal for PV applications, and are resistant to forming several types of point defects. We hope that our first principles driven workflow and the identified candidates will advance the development of novel PV materials and reinvigorate interest in the exploration of pnictides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“first principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）、“systematic screening”（系统筛选）。；研究对象：光伏应用的新型氮化物和磷化物（pnictide）材料，具体探索三类三元/四元化合物：ABCX₂、BB'B"X₂ 和 A₄BX₂（A = Li, Na, K；B, B', B" = Ca, Sr, Mg, Zn；C = Al, Ga, In；X = N, P），共104种可能的组分。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过第一性原理筛选，识别出三种有前景的光伏候选材料：NaCaInN₂、NaSrInN₂ 和 K₄ZnP₂。这三种材料均具有热力学（亚）稳定性、适合光伏应用的直接（或近直接）带隙，且对多种点缺陷具有抗性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过第一性原理筛选，识别出三种有前景的光伏候选材料：NaCaInN₂、NaSrInN₂ 和 K₄ZnP₂。这三种材料均具有热力学（亚）稳定性、适合光伏应用的直接（或近直接）带隙，且对多种点缺陷具有抗性。；创新点：将光伏材料搜索扩展到此前较少被关注的氮化物/磷化物（pnictide）化学空间，建立了从热力学稳定性到缺陷物理的多层次高通量筛选流程，并提出了三种此前未被报道的候选光伏材料。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算（DFT）进行系统筛选，评估内容包括：基态结构、0 K热力学稳定性、电子结构、载流子有效质量、动力学稳定性以及本征点缺陷形成能。

papers.title: Pseudospin Dynamics of Charge Order
papers.abstract: Charge order is conventionally viewed as a static modulation of the electronic density, despite growing experimental capabilities to probe and manipulate its nonequilibrium evolution. In contrast to spin-ordered systems, a microscopic framework for charge-order dynamics and its control under external driving remains largely underdeveloped. Here, starting from an extended Hubbard model, we derive an effective pseudospin model in which the charge-ordered state maps onto staggered pseudospin order. The resulting charge-order dynamics is governed by Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert-like equations for the pseudospins, closely analogous to those of a bipartite antiferromagnet. We show that an external electric field directly controls the staggered pseudospin order and, above a threshold field, drives coherent reversal of the charge-order polarity by destabilizing collective pseudospin excitations. Our results establish the charge pseudospin as a microscopic dynamical degree of freedom for coherent switching and control of charge order, providing a charge-sector analogue of the well-established framework for spin-order dynamics in spintronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“derive an effective pseudospin model”（推导有效赝自旋模型）、“governed by Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert-like equations”（由类LLG方程支配），属于解析理论推导。；研究对象：电荷有序（charge order）体系的非平衡动力学，具体从扩展Hubbard模型出发，研究电荷有序态在外加电场下的集体激发与极性反转。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电荷有序态可映射为交错赝自旋序，其动力学由类Landau–Lifshitz–Gilbert方程描述；外加电场可直接控制该赝自旋序，超过阈值场后可通过失稳集体赝自旋激发实现电荷有序极性的相干反转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电荷有序态可映射为交错赝自旋序，其动力学由类Landau–Lifshitz–Gilbert方程描述；外加电场可直接控制该赝自旋序，超过阈值场后可通过失稳集体赝自旋激发实现电荷有序极性的相干反转。；创新点：建立了电荷有序动力学的微观赝自旋框架，将自旋电子学中成熟的自旋序动力学方法推广到电荷序通道，为电荷序的相干开关与控制提供了微观自由度。摘要未突出说明与具体实验的对比或数值验证细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：从扩展Hubbard模型出发，推导有效赝自旋模型；采用Landau–Lifshitz–Gilbert方程框架描述赝自旋动力学，类比反铁磁体的双子格自旋动力学。

papers.title: Optimal Transport of an Anisotropic Tracer in Dense Active Suspensions
papers.abstract: The transport of anisotropic tracers in active fluids exhibits rich dynamical behavior arising from the interplay between particle shape, activity, and steric interactions. We employ Brownian dynamics simulations to investigate the motion of an elliptical tracer immersed in a suspension of active dumbbells. We find that both translational and rotational transport, characterized by the mean-square speed and diffusivity, are enhanced by more than an order of magnitude with increasing area fraction, $φ$, of active dumbbells. Notably, tracer motion is enhanced along the major axis relative to the minor axis, with $\mathrm{v}_{\parallel}>\mathrm{v}_{\perp}$ and $D_{\parallel}>D_{\perp}$. Remarkably, both translational and rotational transport exhibit an optimum at an intermediate packing fraction of active dumbbells, with the corresponding transport coefficients decreasing at higher densities. We show that this non-monotonic transport arises from the anisotropic accumulation and aggregation of active dumbbells around the tracer, which control the non-equilibrium force and torque fluctuations. Thus, establish a direct connection between the collective organization of active dumbbells at the tracer surface and its emergent translational and rotational transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“Brownian dynamics simulations”（布朗动力学模拟）。；研究对象：致密活性悬浮液中的各向异性示踪粒子（椭圆示踪粒子）的输运行为，具体体系为活性哑铃粒子悬浮液。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 椭圆示踪粒子的平动和转动输运（均方速度与扩散系数）随活性哑铃面积分数φ增加而增强超过一个数量级，且在中等堆积分数下出现最优值（非单调行为）；沿长轴的输运强于沿短轴（v∥>v⊥，D∥>D⊥）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：椭圆示踪粒子的平动和转动输运（均方速度与扩散系数）随活性哑铃面积分数φ增加而增强超过一个数量级，且在中等堆积分数下出现最优值（非单调行为）；沿长轴的输运强于沿短轴（v∥>v⊥，D∥>D⊥）。；创新点：揭示了活性哑铃在示踪粒子表面的各向异性聚集与堆积直接控制非平衡力/力矩涨落，从而建立了活性粒子集体组织与示踪粒子平动/转动输运之间的直接联系，解释了输运系数随密度非单调变化（存在最优密度）的微观机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用布朗动力学（Brownian dynamics）模拟，研究浸没在活性哑铃悬浮液中的单个椭圆示踪粒子的运动，系统考察面积分数φ对输运系数的影响。

papers.title: Real-space overlap is not enough: ambiguity in nanobeam iterative ptychography
papers.abstract: High-resolution iterative ptychography typically relies on a well-aligned, high-convergence-angle electron probe. Here we explore whether it can instead be performed at small convergence angles, relaxing the need for probe correctors and enabling experiments at low accelerating voltages or with a de-excited objective lens, as in Lorentz mode. Through experiments and simulations, we show that once the convergence angle is small enough that no diffracted disks overlap, the resulting reconstruction is ambiguous, posing a significant challenge for robust interpretation of results. This challenge arises because of the lack of interference between Bragg disks in the recorded diffraction pattern intensity, leading to no phase information for each reflection. Reconstructions with these data lead to degenerate objects in which rigid translations of the lattice and reversals of contrast of the object produce the same error between experimental data and the ptychography forward model. Increasing the real-space overlap between probe positions does not lift this degeneracy. An amorphous substrate can supply the missing phase relationships by giving the Bragg beams support in the gaps between disks. This phasing is fragile, however, and survives only where the forward model matches the experiment. At fixed dose, either constraining the object to be a pure phase object or introducing thermal motion into the forward model is enough on its own to make the solution non-unique, highlighting why our experimental reconstructions below the overlap threshold are ambiguous despite ample dose and real-space redundancy. Most troublingly, the lattice spacing and orientation are always recovered correctly, so a non-unique reconstruction looks convincing and can be diagnosed only by repeating the reconstruction from different starting points.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与模拟相结合）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Through experiments and simulations”。；研究对象：纳米束迭代叠层成像（nanobeam iterative ptychography）技术在小会聚角（small convergence angles）条件下的成像行为，具体涉及洛伦兹模式（Lorentz mode）或低加速电压下的电子显微成像。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当会聚角足够小以至于衍射盘不再重叠时，叠层成像重建结果具有歧义性（ambiguous），即存在简并解：晶格的刚性平移和衬度反转会产生与实验数据相同的误差。增加探针位置间的实空间重叠无法消除该简并，而重建结果在晶格间距和取向上总是正确的，使得歧义解看起来可信，只能通过不同起始点的重复重建来诊断。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当会聚角足够小以至于衍射盘不再重叠时，叠层成像重建结果具有歧义性（ambiguous），即存在简并解：晶格的刚性平移和衬度反转会产生与实验数据相同的误差。增加探针位置间的实空间重叠无法消除该简并，而重建结果在晶格间距和取向上总是正确的，使得歧义解看起来可信，只能通过不同起始点的重复重建来诊断。；创新点：揭示了小会聚角（衍射盘不重叠）条件下叠层成像重建的固有歧义性，并系统分析了其物理根源（缺乏Bragg盘间干涉导致的相位信息缺失），指出实空间重叠不足以保证重建唯一性。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用纳米束叠层成像（nanobeam ptychography），在洛伦兹模式或去激发的物镜条件下进行小会聚角测量；同时配合数值模拟。研究中还测试了将物体约束为纯相位物体（pure phase object）或在正向模型中引入热运动（thermal motion）等不同建模方案。

papers.title: Holographic Representations of Topological Quantum Criticality: Emergent Symmetry Approach around the Bott Clock
papers.abstract: In this article, we apply the idea of emergent symmetries to construct holographic representations of a broad class of topological quantum critical points (tQCPs) that appear in fermionic classes in the Bott clock. We show explicitly that around the Bott clock, an emergent symmetry $U_{EM}$ exists at a tQCP between different symmetry protected gapped phases with protecting symmetry $G_p$ in $d$ spatial dimensions. This emergent symmetry can be used to construct a $(d+1)$ spatial dimensional lattice model with a properly upgraded symmetry such as $U_{EM}\times G_p$ or $U_{EM} \rtimes G_p$, etc. By doubling the degrees of freedom of the adjacent topological class in $d$-dimensions, we successfully show that the $(d+1)$-dimensional lattice models constructed in this way have the desired enlarged symmetry groups that precisely belong to the adjacent topological classes, counterclockwise around the Bott clock. Furthermore, $d$-dimensional boundaries of these $(d+1)$ dimensional lattice models of gapped topological classes are shown to exhibit identical infrared dynamics as the corresponding tQCPs in the $d$-dimensional adjacent topological phases in the Bott clock, with lower symmetries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“construct holographic representations”“lattice model”“emergent symmetry”等理论构造与对称性分析关键词，未涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：Bott clock（Bott 时钟）中费米子对称性保护拓扑相（SPT）之间的拓扑量子临界点（tQCP），以及由这些临界点构造的 (d+1) 维晶格模型及其 d 维边界。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Bott clock 中，任意 d 维 tQCP 处存在一个涌现对称性 U_EM，利用该对称性可将相邻拓扑类的自由度加倍，构造出具有更大对称群（如 U_EM×G_p 或 U_EM⋊G_p）的 (d+1) 维晶格模型，其对称群恰好属于 Bott clock 逆时针方向的相邻拓扑类；这些 (d+1) 维模型的 d 维边界表现出与原始 tQCP 相同的红外动力学，但对称性更低。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Bott clock 中，任意 d 维 tQCP 处存在一个涌现对称性 U_EM，利用该对称性可将相邻拓扑类的自由度加倍，构造出具有更大对称群（如 U_EM×G_p 或 U_EM⋊G_p）的 (d+1) 维晶格模型，其对称群恰好属于 Bott clock 逆时针方向的相邻拓扑类；这些 (d+1) 维模型的 d 维边界表现出与原始 tQCP 相同的红外动力学，但对称性更低。；创新点：首次系统地将涌现对称性思想应用于 Bott clock 中所有费米子类 tQCP 的全息表示构造，实现了从 d 维临界点到 (d+1) 维体态拓扑类的统一映射，并建立了边界动力学与原始临界点之间的等价性。摘要未突出说明与已有全息构造方法的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为涌现对称性方法（emergent symmetry approach）与全息表示（holographic representation）构造。具体步骤包括：识别 tQCP 处的涌现对称性 U_EM，对 d 维相邻拓扑类的自由度进行加倍，并升级对称群以构建 (d+1) 维晶格模型，最后通过边界-体对应分析边界红外行为。

papers.title: Scalar Spin Chirality from Dissipative Pumping and Lamb Shift Precession
papers.abstract: Circulating currents in triangular triple quantum dots reverse repeatedly with bias even at zero magnetic flux and for a real Hamiltonian, a phenomenon whose origin has remained unclear. We show that dissipative tunneling prepares an orbital pseudospin, while virtual charge fluctuations generate a noncollinear Lamb field that rotates it toward the chiral direction. Bias changes their relative orientation and thereby reverses the current. This reservoir-induced orbital Hanle effect converts a nonchiral orbital polarization into scalar spin chirality, which an exact ground-multiplet identity links to the circulating current. Hierarchical-equations-of-motion calculations show that the low-bias reversal survives beyond the second-order weak-coupling description, while the quadratic growth of chirality after a sudden voltage switch identifies precession. More broadly, time-reversal-odd responses can emerge in open quantum systems from the interplay between dissipative state preparation and coherent precession.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“Hierarchical-equations-of-motion calculations”（层级运动方程计算）以及“second-order weak-coupling description”（二阶弱耦合描述），属于理论建模与数值计算结合的研究。；研究对象：三角三量子点（triangular triple quantum dots）系统中的标量自旋手性（scalar spin chirality）与循环电流（circulating current）现象。具体关注在零磁通、实哈密顿量条件下，电流随偏压反复反转的物理机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作揭示了耗散隧穿（dissipative tunneling）可制备轨道赝自旋，而虚电荷涨落产生的非共线Lamb场会将其旋转至手性方向，从而将非手性轨道极化转化为标量自旋手性，并驱动循环电流。偏压改变两者的相对取向，导致电流反转。这一“储库诱导的轨道Hanle效应”解释了此前难以理解的电流随偏压反复反转现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作揭示了耗散隧穿（dissipative tunneling）可制备轨道赝自旋，而虚电荷涨落产生的非共线Lamb场会将其旋转至手性方向，从而将非手性轨道极化转化为标量自旋手性，并驱动循环电流。偏压改变两者的相对取向，导致电流反转。这一“储库诱导的轨道Hanle效应”解释了此前难以理解的电流随偏压反复反转现象。；创新点：首次将耗散态制备与相干进动之间的相互作用作为时间反演破缺响应（time-reversal-odd responses）的普适来源，提出了“储库诱导的轨道Hanle效应”这一新机制，将非手性轨道极化转化为标量自旋手性。该机制超越了传统的二阶弱耦合微扰描述，为开放量子系统中手性输运现象提供了新的理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合层级运动方程（HEOM）数值计算。摘要明确提到使用了“Hierarchical-equations-of-motion calculations”验证低偏压反转在二阶弱耦合描述之外仍然存在；同时通过突然施加电压后手性的二次增长行为来识别进动（precession）特征。此外，还使用了“exact ground-multiplet identity”（精确基态多重态恒等式）将手性与循环电流联系起来。

papers.title: Singlet-doublet transitions and Josephson currents in a superconducting ring with a quantum dot
papers.abstract: We investigate the ground state properties of a superconducting ring embedded with a quantum dot (QD) by using a variational wave-function approach. A theoretical formulation for the treatment of the finite-U Anderson impurity coupled with a superconducting ring are presented. We demonstrate singlet-doublet transitions of the ground state for this system with the QD in the mixed valence regime. It is shown that the supercurrent in the superconductor ring shows oscillations with the external enclosed magnetic flux and exhibits abrupt jumps at the singlet-doublet phase transition points.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“variational wave-function approach”（变分波函数方法）和“theoretical formulation”（理论公式化）。；研究对象：嵌入量子点（QD）的超导环体系，具体研究该混合系统中有限U安德森杂质与超导环耦合的基态性质，以及超电流随磁通的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在量子点处于混合价态时，体系基态会发生单重态-双重态（singlet-doublet）相变；超导环中的超电流随外磁通振荡，并在单重态-双重态相变点处出现突变跳变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在量子点处于混合价态时，体系基态会发生单重态-双重态（singlet-doublet）相变；超导环中的超电流随外磁通振荡，并在单重态-双重态相变点处出现突变跳变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用变分波函数方法（variational wave-function approach），并建立了处理有限U安德森杂质与超导环耦合的理论公式。

papers.title: Covariant formula for the driving force for interface migration
papers.abstract: Interfaces of crystalline materials are strongly affected by the anisotropy of interface energy. A key quantity in this context is the interface stiffness tensor, which characterizes the response of the interface energy to changes in interface orientation and plays a role in determining the driving force for interface migration. The latter is expressible via contraction of the stiffness tensor and interface curvature tensor. Practical computations involving tensors necessarily rely on their individual components. In this work, an explicit component-wise expression is derived for the contraction of the stiffness and curvature tensors, valid in arbitrary coordinate systems. Within this formulation, to get the driving force, the curvature tensor is contracted with the pullback of a stiffness-related tensor - originally defined in three-dimensional Euclidean space - onto the interface manifold. This covariant treatment establishes a physically consistent foundation for three-dimensional computational models involving interface stiffness.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确涉及“推导”（derived）、“协变处理”（covariant treatment）、“张量收缩”（contraction of tensors）等理论推导关键词，未提及任何实验或数值模拟手段。；研究对象：晶体材料中界面迁移的驱动力，具体聚焦于界面刚度张量与曲率张量的收缩运算在任意坐标系下的显式表达式。研究对象为界面几何与能量各向异性之间的数学物理关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 给出了界面刚度张量与曲率张量收缩的显式分量表达式，该表达式在任意坐标系下均成立。该协变公式将曲率张量与刚度相关张量（原定义于三维欧氏空间）拉回到界面流形上进行收缩，从而为三维计算模型提供了物理自洽的基础。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：给出了界面刚度张量与曲率张量收缩的显式分量表达式，该表达式在任意坐标系下均成立。该协变公式将曲率张量与刚度相关张量（原定义于三维欧氏空间）拉回到界面流形上进行收缩，从而为三维计算模型提供了物理自洽的基础。；创新点：以往涉及界面刚度与曲率张量的计算依赖于具体坐标系中的分量，本文首次给出了在任意坐标系下均有效的显式分量表达式，并通过协变处理保证了三维计算模型中界面刚度处理的物理一致性。摘要未突出说明与具体数值方法（如相场法、尖锐界面模型）的耦合细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导。采用微分几何中的协变形式（covariant formulation），将三维欧氏空间中的刚度相关张量通过拉回（pullback）操作限制到二维界面流形上，并与界面曲率张量进行收缩，得到驱动力的一般分量表达式。

papers.title: Switchable Magnetoelectric Transport in Graphene via a Van der Waals Multiferroic
papers.abstract: Electric and magnetic control of transport properties at atomic interfaces is central to the development of next generation electronics and spintronics. Van der Waals multiferroics materials that simultaneously host dielectric and magnetic orders down to the monolayer limit offer a promising platform for such interfacial control, yet the realization of electronic functionalities that exploit the unique attributes of van der Waals multiferroics has largely remained elusive. Here, we realize a van der Waals heterostructure comprising graphene and the multiferroic CuCrP2S6, enabling gate-switchable magnetoelectric transport in graphene, mediated by the multiferroic layer. The charge-neutrality resistance peak of graphene exhibits pronounced hysteresis arising from polarization flip in the multiferroic state. Application of an in-plane magnetic field shifts this peak in a polarization-dependent manner, revealing magnetic-field-induced polarization modulation a direct signature of the magnetoelectric effect. Furthermore, cooling the device under an applied electric field enables domain control of the multiferroic order, allowing reversible switching of the interfacial magnetoelectric transport. These results provide the first demonstration of interfacial magnetoelectric transport in a vdW heterostructure, and establish a pathway for engineering two-dimensional van der Waals interfaces for functional device applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中出现了“we realize”“Application of...”“cooling the device under...”等实验操作描述，以及“hysteresis”“resistance peak”等测量结果。；研究对象：石墨烯与多铁性材料CuCrP2S6构成的范德华异质结，研究其界面磁电输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在石墨烯/CuCrP2S6范德华异质结中实现了可通过栅压切换的磁电输运，多铁层的极化翻转导致石墨烯电荷中性点电阻峰出现显著滞回，而面内磁场可依赖极化方向移动该峰，直接证明磁电效应；电场冷却可实现多铁畴控制，从而可逆切换界面磁电输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在石墨烯/CuCrP2S6范德华异质结中实现了可通过栅压切换的磁电输运，多铁层的极化翻转导致石墨烯电荷中性点电阻峰出现显著滞回，而面内磁场可依赖极化方向移动该峰，直接证明磁电效应；电场冷却可实现多铁畴控制，从而可逆切换界面磁电输运。；创新点：首次在范德华异质结中演示了界面磁电输运效应，利用单层极限下同时具有介电和磁有序的范德华多铁体实现对石墨烯输运的电学和磁学双重调控，为二维范德华界面功能器件提供了新路径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上构建石墨烯/CuCrP2S6范德华异质结器件，通过栅压调控测量电荷中性点电阻峰的滞回行为；施加面内磁场观察电阻峰位移；在电场下冷却器件以实现多铁畴的取向控制。

papers.title: Coexisting Large and Small Polarons in Photoexcited CeO$_2$
papers.abstract: Time-resolved terahertz (THz) spectroscopy is used to probe polaron formation in CeO$_2$. The ultrafast THz photoconductivity is dominated by contributions from large hole and small electron polarons. Delocalized large hole polarons are formed on a $820 \pm 50$ fs time scale and are of Fröhlich type, with optical conductivity well described by a simple Drude model and a transient hole mobility of $100$ cm$^2$/Vs. Small electron polarons form via localized coupling to Ce lattice sites, revealed by reduction in the lattice Born effective charge causing a transient phonon softening. These results establish the dual polaron nature of CeO$_2$ and provide a basis for understanding charge transfer dynamics in metal oxide photocatalysts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Time-resolved terahertz (THz) spectroscopy is used to probe”，属于时间分辨太赫兹光谱实验。；研究对象：CeO₂（二氧化铈）中光激发后的极化子形成过程，具体涉及大极化子（空穴型）与小极化子（电子型）的共存及其动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CeO₂在光激发下同时形成离域的大空穴极化子（Fröhlich型，形成时间约820 fs，瞬态空穴迁移率约100 cm²/Vs）和局域的小电子极化子（通过Ce晶格位点耦合形成，伴随Born有效电荷降低和瞬态声子软化），确立了CeO₂的双极化子本质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CeO₂在光激发下同时形成离域的大空穴极化子（Fröhlich型，形成时间约820 fs，瞬态空穴迁移率约100 cm²/Vs）和局域的小电子极化子（通过Ce晶格位点耦合形成，伴随Born有效电荷降低和瞬态声子软化），确立了CeO₂的双极化子本质。；创新点：首次在实验上直接观测到CeO₂中光激发下大空穴极化子与小电子极化子共存，并定量给出大极化子的形成时间尺度和迁移率，为理解金属氧化物光催化剂中的电荷转移动力学提供了微观极化子图像。（摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异，但“establish the dual polaron nature”表明这是首次明确建立双极化子共存图像。）
papers.method_zh: 时间分辨太赫兹光谱（TRTS），结合光学电导率分析（Drude模型拟合）以及晶格Born有效电荷变化的探测（用于揭示声子软化）。

papers.title: Linear stability and viscoelastic response in weakly jammed frictional granular systems
papers.abstract: Granular particles typically feature contact friction, which gives rise to various nontrivial properties of granular materials. In this work, we investigate the linear stability of static packings composed of frictional spheres, whose interactions are modeled using the discrete element method. We discuss a key difficulty in properly modeling static friction and address the problem of identifying rattlers. We also explore the spectrum of the energy matrix, which governs the linear viscoelastic response of the system. The intermediate- and high-frequency regimes of the spectrum remain qualitatively independent of both the friction coefficient and the packing fraction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“使用离散元方法（discrete element method）进行建模”，属于数值模拟研究。；研究对象：弱堵塞（weakly jammed）状态下的摩擦颗粒体系，具体为摩擦球体的静态堆积（static packings of frictional spheres），关注其线性稳定性与线性黏弹性响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 能量矩阵的中间频率和高频率谱区在定性上不依赖于摩擦系数和堆积分数，表明这些频段的黏弹性响应具有普适性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：能量矩阵的中间频率和高频率谱区在定性上不依赖于摩擦系数和堆积分数，表明这些频段的黏弹性响应具有普适性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可看出其新意在于系统性地处理了摩擦颗粒体系中静态摩擦建模的难点，并首次在弱堵塞摩擦体系中系统考察了能量矩阵谱对摩擦系数和堆积分数的依赖关系。
papers.method_zh: 采用离散元方法（DEM）模拟摩擦球体间的相互作用，构建静态堆积；通过分析能量矩阵（energy matrix）的谱来研究系统的线性黏弹性响应；同时讨论了静态摩擦建模中的关键困难以及rattlers（非受力颗粒）的识别问题。

papers.title: Universal tuning of Förster resonance energy transfer in gate-programmable conductor-dielectric-conductor heterostructures
papers.abstract: We develop a quantum-electrodynamical theory for universal tuning of spontaneous emission and Förster resonance energy transfer (FRET) in a material-agnostic conductor-dielectric-conductor heterostructure. The platform consists of a dielectric spacer of thickness $W$ bounded by two gate-tunable two-dimensional conductors. The only microscopic input from the surrounding materials is the transverse-magnetic and transverse-electric reflection amplitudes $r_{\TM/\TE}(q_ρ,ω)$ of the two sheets. Starting from the QED photon propagator, we derive the retarded Maxwell dyadic, the vacuum/Hadamard field propagator, and the time-ordered Feynman propagator in the same geometry. The spontaneous-emission rate is controlled by the local vacuum spectral density, while FRET is controlled by the nonlocal retarded/advanced product $\obG_{\text R}(\bx_D,\bx_A;ω_D)\Im\,\balpha_A(ω_D)\obG_{\text A}(\bx_A,\bx_D;ω_D)$. In the transparent limit $r_{\TM}\to 0$, the near-field FRET rate recovers the bulk $x_ρ^{-6}$ law. In the Dirichlet/PEC branch $r_{\TM}\to -1$, the gapless transverse mode is removed and the donor-acceptor coupling acquires a Bessel-$K$ envelope, giving an exponentially screened FRET rate $Γ_{D\to A}\propto\exp(-2πx_ρ/W)$ at large lateral separation. In the opposite Neumann/PMC-like branch $r_{\TM}\to 1^{-}$, a nearly gapless transverse mode survives and produces a wide quasi-two-dimensional logarithmic propagator, enhancing the nonlocal electromagnetic coupling over a gate-programmable range $x_{ρ,*}\sim W/(1-r_{\TM})$. For graphene-Er implementations, the same retarded Green tensor also separates dissipative on-shell Er-to-graphene decay, governed by its absorptive part, from dispersive virtual-plasmon-mediated Er-Er coupling, governed by its reactive part; a plasmonic band gap can suppress the former while retaining the latter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“We develop a quantum-electrodynamical theory”，并推导光子传播子、麦克斯韦并矢等解析表达式，属于理论/解析建模工作。；研究对象：导体-介电-导体异质结构中的自发辐射与Förster共振能量转移（FRET）过程。具体体系为厚度为W的介电间隔层夹在两个栅极可调二维导体之间，并以石墨烯-铒（Er）体系作为具体实现示例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节二维导体的反射振幅r_TM，可在同一异质结构中实现FRET速率的普适调控：从体相x_ρ^{-6}律（透明极限），到指数屏蔽exp(-2πx_ρ/W)（PEC/Dirichlet分支），再到近无间隙横模导致的准二维对数传播子增强（Neumann/PMC分支）。在石墨烯-Er体系中，耗散性Er-石墨烯衰减与色散性虚等离子体介导的Er-Er耦合可被分离，且等离子体能隙可抑制前者而保留后者。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节二维导体的反射振幅r_TM，可在同一异质结构中实现FRET速率的普适调控：从体相x_ρ^{-6}律（透明极限），到指数屏蔽exp(-2πx_ρ/W)（PEC/Dirichlet分支），再到近无间隙横模导致的准二维对数传播子增强（Neumann/PMC分支）。在石墨烯-Er体系中，耗散性Er-石墨烯衰减与色散性虚等离子体介导的Er-Er耦合可被分离，且等离子体能隙可抑制前者而保留后者。；创新点：提出了一个材料无关（material-agnostic）的普适理论框架，仅需两个反射振幅即可统一描述自发辐射与FRET的调控；揭示了FRET速率从幂律到指数屏蔽再到对数增强的三种截然不同的空间依赖行为，并指出可通过栅压编程实现；首次在同一格林张量框架下区分了耗散性衰减与色散性虚等离子体耦合，并展示了等离子体能隙对二者的选择性抑制。
papers.method_zh: 量子电动力学（QED）理论框架。从QED光子传播子出发，推导推迟麦克斯韦并矢、真空/Hadamard场传播子及时序Feynman传播子；利用横向磁/横向电反射振幅r_TM/TE作为唯一材料输入；通过推迟/超前格林函数乘积计算FRET速率，并分析透明、Dirichlet/PEC、Neumann/PMC三个极限分支。

papers.title: Superconductivity of Tellurium Polyhydride with Tc above 90K
papers.abstract: We report experimental diacovery of superconductivity (SC) in tellurium (Te) polyhydride. The compound was synthesized at high pressure and high temperature conditions using a diamond anvil cell combined with a laser heating system. Subsequent in situ transport measurements at high pressures, performed as a function of temperature and applied magnetic field, revealed a superconducting transition with a critical temperature Tc about 91 K at 263 GPa. The superconducting phase is assigned to TeH4 with characterized face shared TeH12 cage forming quasi molecular H2 units based on synchrotron x-ray diffraction experiments. Analysis of the SC behavior at magnetic fields yielded a Ginzburg Landau (GL) coherence length of approximately 47 angstroms. Tellurium polyhydride thus becomes another chalcogen polyhydride superconductor in addition to the landmark discovery of the first polyhydride high Tc SC SH3.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“experimental discovery”“synthesized at high pressure”“in situ transport measurements”“synchrotron x-ray diffraction experiments”。；研究对象：碲（Te）多氢化物，具体为高压下合成的TeH4化合物，研究其超导电性及晶体结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在263 GPa高压下，碲多氢化物TeH4表现出超导转变，临界温度Tc约为91 K；该化合物成为继SH3之后第二个被发现的高Tc多氢化物超导体（硫族多氢化物家族）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在263 GPa高压下，碲多氢化物TeH4表现出超导转变，临界温度Tc约为91 K；该化合物成为继SH3之后第二个被发现的高Tc多氢化物超导体（硫族多氢化物家族）。；创新点：首次实验发现碲多氢化物的超导电性，将硫族多氢化物高温超导家族从硫（SH3）拓展至碲（TeH4），并确定了其独特的晶体结构（面共享TeH12笼+准分子H2单元）。
papers.method_zh: 金刚石对顶砧（DAC）结合激光加热系统进行高温高压合成；原位输运测量（变温、变磁场）确定超导转变；同步辐射X射线衍射实验确定晶体结构；基于磁场下超导行为的分析提取Ginzburg-Landau相干长度。

papers.title: Attosecond Reconstruction of Strain Tensors via Electronic Fingerprints
papers.abstract: We demonstrate an attosecond transient absorption spectroscopy (ATAS) scheme for reconstructing strain tensors in two-dimensional materials. Using strained graphene as a prototype system, we show that the fishbone structures in ATAS serve as distinctive spectral fingerprints of strain, where strain-induced shifts and splittings of van Hove singularities encode the magnitude and orientation of the strain tensor, respectively. By combining density-matrix simulations with analytical modeling, we establish a direct mapping between transient absorption spectra and strain tensors, enabling accurate retrieval of lattice deformation from ultrafast electronic responses. Our work introduces an attosecond spectroscopic paradigm for ultrafast strain metrology, where electronic fingerprints replace conventional structural probes for sensing lattice deformation in quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要提及“density-matrix simulations”与“analytical modeling”，未提及实验数据采集。；研究对象：二维材料中的应变张量，以应变石墨烯为原型体系；具体物理现象为超快应变诱导的电子结构变化及其在阿秒瞬态吸收光谱中的指纹特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 应变石墨烯的ATAS谱中“鱼骨结构”可作为应变的独特光谱指纹：应变导致的van Hove奇点位移编码应变大小，劈裂编码应变方向，从而可从超快电子响应中精确反演晶格形变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：应变石墨烯的ATAS谱中“鱼骨结构”可作为应变的独特光谱指纹：应变导致的van Hove奇点位移编码应变大小，劈裂编码应变方向，从而可从超快电子响应中精确反演晶格形变。；创新点：提出一种基于电子指纹而非传统结构探针的阿秒光谱学范式，用于量子材料中超快应变计量，实现了从电子超快响应直接重构应变张量。摘要未突出说明与已有应变测量方法（如X射线衍射、拉曼光谱）的具体对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 阿秒瞬态吸收光谱（ATAS）方案的理论模拟；结合密度矩阵数值模拟与解析建模，建立瞬态吸收谱与应变张量之间的直接映射关系。

papers.title: Two-step transient liquid phase bonding of NiTi to Ti-6Al-4V through a NbZrW barrier
papers.abstract: Dissimilar joining of NiTi to Ti-6Al-4V (Ti-64) is limited by brittle Ti2Ni formation and degradation of NiTi functionality. A two-step transient liquid phase (TLP) route was developed in which a refractory NbZrW diffusion barrier converts the incompatible couple into two independently bondable interfaces. The barrier plays a different role for each alloy: a reactive substrate for NiTi, dissolving to form a Ti-rich Ni-Ti-Nb liquid that infiltrates its own grain boundaries and is terminated by selective Ti absorption into the barrier; and an inert substrate for Ti-64, joined through contact melting of a sacrificial Cu foil. Both interfaces are fully dense and free of continuous intermetallic layers. In tension, joints spanning both interfaces began transforming at 350 MPa, exhibited a stress plateau to 2.5 global strain (consistent with stress-induced transformation of the NiTi half of the gauge) and failed beyond the plateau at 380-410 MPa. Five load-unload cycles to 460 MPa showed stable superelastic loops with minor ratcheting. These results demonstrate that a diffusion barrier enables dissimilar TLP joining of otherwise incompatible alloys.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：developed、bonding、exhibited、load-unload cycles 等实验操作与性能测试描述。；研究对象：NiTi 形状记忆合金与 Ti-6Al-4V（Ti-64）钛合金的异种材料连接，具体涉及通过 NbZrW 难熔扩散阻挡层实现的两步瞬态液相（TLP）扩散焊界面体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过 NbZrW 扩散阻挡层将 NiTi/Ti-64 不相容连接对拆分为两个可独立焊接的界面，获得了无连续金属间化合物层、全致密的接头；接头在拉伸下表现出超弹性行为（350 MPa 开始相变，应力平台至 2.5% 全局应变，断裂强度 380–410 MPa），且循环加载下具有稳定的超弹性滞回环。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过 NbZrW 扩散阻挡层将 NiTi/Ti-64 不相容连接对拆分为两个可独立焊接的界面，获得了无连续金属间化合物层、全致密的接头；接头在拉伸下表现出超弹性行为（350 MPa 开始相变，应力平台至 2.5% 全局应变，断裂强度 380–410 MPa），且循环加载下具有稳定的超弹性滞回环。；创新点：首次提出利用难熔 NbZrW 扩散阻挡层将原本不相容的 NiTi/Ti-64 连接体系转化为两个可独立优化的 TLP 界面，同时避免了脆性 Ti₂Ni 相的形成和 NiTi 功能退化，实现了兼具致密微观结构和超弹性力学响应的异种接头。
papers.method_zh: 两步瞬态液相扩散焊（two-step TLP bonding）：对 NiTi 侧利用 NbZrW 作为反应性基体，溶解形成富 Ti 的 Ni-Ti-Nb 液相并沿晶界渗透，通过选择性 Ti 吸收终止反应；对 Ti-64 侧利用牺牲 Cu 箔的接触熔化实现连接。性能表征包括拉伸测试（应力-应变曲线）和循环加载-卸载测试（5 次循环至 460 MPa）。

papers.title: Experimental Observation of Mesoscopic Dynamic Fluctuations in Water-Alcohol Mixtures
papers.abstract: We applied a dynamic fluctuation measurement method to liquid water-methanol mixtures over a wide range of compositions and temperatures. This method, which we developed in recent years, combines ultrasonic and inelastic X-ray scattering techniques to detect mesoscopic-level fluctuations-that is, the degree of heterogeneity-in liquids using sound waves. The results showed that the strength of dynamic fluctuations increased as the alcohol composition decreased and as the temperature decreased. This trend was also observed in water-ethanol and water-glycerol mixtures. From these results, we concluded that the origin of these fluctuations lies in the low-temperature (supercooled) region of water alone, and that mixing with alcohol eliminates the dynamic fluctuations. This conclusion-that mixing substances reduces fluctuations or heterogeneity-may seem strange at first glance, but it is actually consistent with the framework of the liquid-liquid phase transition hypothesis, which explains the thermodynamic anomalies of water. It also aligns with the results of our recent measurements of the strength of dynamic fluctuations in water across a wide range of temperature and pressure conditions. It has long been known that various thermodynamic anomalies exist in water-alcohol mixtures at low compositions, and while there have been various discussions on this topic in the past, our current findings offer a new perspective on these discussions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述“We applied a dynamic fluctuation measurement method”，并给出实验测量结果。；研究对象：水-甲醇、水-乙醇、水-甘油混合液体体系中的介观尺度动态涨落（即液体中的异质性程度），重点关注低醇浓度和低温条件下的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 混合液的动态涨落强度随醇浓度降低和温度降低而增强；该趋势在三种醇-水混合物中一致。作者认为涨落的起源来自纯水的低温（过冷）区域，而加入醇会消除这些动态涨落，这一结论与水的液-液相变假说框架一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：混合液的动态涨落强度随醇浓度降低和温度降低而增强；该趋势在三种醇-水混合物中一致。作者认为涨落的起源来自纯水的低温（过冷）区域，而加入醇会消除这些动态涨落，这一结论与水的液-液相变假说框架一致。；创新点：首次将动态涨落测量方法系统应用于水-醇混合体系，在宽组分和温度范围内给出介观异质性的定量趋势，并为水-醇混合物低浓度区的热力学反常提供了基于动态涨落的新视角。摘要未突出说明与传统静态结构测量或理论模拟的对比。
papers.method_zh: 动态涨落测量方法，结合超声和非弹性X射线散射技术，通过声波探测液体中介观尺度的异质性（即动态涨落强度）。该方法为作者近年来自行发展。

papers.title: Tunable Pathway Selection in Coupled Multistable Snap-Through Systems
papers.abstract: Multistable mechanical systems can store and release elastic energy through snap-through instabilities, but controlling transition pathways between stable states remains challenging when multiple routes are accessible. Here, we introduce a two-mass von Mises truss as a general model for studying pathway selection governed by coupled saddle-node bifurcations. The system consists of two coupled snap-through units with geometric imperfections, giving rise to four stable configurations: a fully inverted state, a fully natural state, and two intermediate mixed states. We show that the coupling stiffness reorganizes the quasi-static bifurcation structure and selects among three transition pathways under release: sequential snapping through one mixed state, direct cooperative snapping, or sequential snapping through the other mixed state. Using pseudo-arclength continuation, we track the relevant saddle-node bifurcations and identify the parameter regimes associated with each quasi-static pathway. We then demonstrate that dynamic bifurcation delay provides an additional rate-dependent mechanism for pathway selection. Even when the quasi-static bifurcation structure favours a unique sequential pathway, finite-rate loading delays snap-through beyond the corresponding static saddle-node points and can reorder the snapping sequence of the two units. A local reduction of the coupled dynamics near each saddle-node yields normal forms with coupling-dependent critical points and coefficients. The resulting theory identifies distinct rate-dependent delay laws in the inertia-dominated and overdamped regimes and predicts the critical rate at which the snapping order reverses. These results establish a general mechanics framework for tuning transition pathways in multistable systems through elastic coupling and loading-rate control.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“pseudo-arclength continuation”（伪弧长延拓）、“normal forms”（规范形）等理论分析与数值计算方法，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：耦合多稳态机械系统，具体为双质量 von Mises 桁架（two-mass von Mises truss），由两个带几何缺陷的耦合 snap-through（突跳）单元组成，具有四个稳定构型（完全倒置态、完全自然态及两个中间混合态）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节耦合刚度可重组准静态分岔结构，从而在三种释放路径（经某一混合态的依次突跳、直接协同突跳、经另一混合态的依次突跳）中选择；此外，动态分岔延迟提供了依赖加载速率的额外路径选择机制，可在有限速率下改变两个单元的突跳顺序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节耦合刚度可重组准静态分岔结构，从而在三种释放路径（经某一混合态的依次突跳、直接协同突跳、经另一混合态的依次突跳）中选择；此外，动态分岔延迟提供了依赖加载速率的额外路径选择机制，可在有限速率下改变两个单元的突跳顺序。；创新点：建立了通过弹性耦合与加载速率控制多稳态系统转变路径的通用力学框架，特别是揭示了动态分岔延迟可超越准静态分岔结构偏好、重新排列突跳顺序这一速率依赖机制。
papers.method_zh: 伪弧长延拓（pseudo-arclength continuation）跟踪鞍-结分岔；对每个鞍-结点附近的耦合动力学进行局部约化，推导含耦合依赖临界点与系数的规范形（normal forms）；分别分析惯性主导与过阻尼区间的速率依赖延迟规律，并预测突跳顺序反转的临界速率。

papers.title: Libron-phonon coupling and hydrogen-bond dynamics in the vacancy-ordered perovskite (NH4)2SnCl6: a temperature- and pressure-dependent Raman study
papers.abstract: Vacancy-ordered perovskites R2MX6 combine a rigid inorganic framework with a molecular A-site cation, but how the cation dynamics couples to the lattice phonons under external perturbation remains largely unexplored. The librational motion of NH4+ in (NH4)2SnCl6 is strictly Raman-silent by symmetry, which is why it has been probed almost exclusively by neutron scattering, NMR and NQR. We show that it is nevertheless accessible to Raman spectroscopy, through the renormalization it imposes on the allowed [SnCl6]2- modes. Combining single-crystal X-ray diffraction with Raman scattering between 10 and 300 K and up to 10.1 GPa, we find that the average cubic structure varies smoothly with no anomaly, while below ~100 K the [SnCl6]2- modes acquire a libron-phonon renormalization (E_eff ~ 4.7 meV) and a symmetry-selective line asymmetry, and the N-H stretch passes through a minimum near 120 K (E_eff ~ 9.3 meV); both track the classical-to-quantum crossover of the ammonium rotor. The two effective energies lie below the bare librational transition of 13.4 meV measured by neutrons, as expected for a self-energy scale. The ammonium linewidths, by contrast, are governed by pure dephasing rather than by anharmonic decay and carry no crossover signature. Under pressure the octahedral modes stiffen smoothly, whereas the cavity responds twice: the translational F2g mode of NH4+ gains Raman intensity above 1.3 GPa, and the N-H stretch inverts its pressure slope near 1.7 GPa, with no change of space group and full recovery on decompression. The rigid octahedral framework is thus essentially decoupled from a dynamically active NH4+ subsystem that carries the response to both perturbations, offering a route to tune cation-phonon coupling independently of the octahedral network.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Raman study”“single-crystal X-ray diffraction”“Raman scattering”等实验手段。；研究对象：空位有序钙钛矿（NH₄）₂SnCl₆，具体研究其NH₄⁺阳离子的平动/转动动力学与[SnCl₆]²⁻八面体框架声子之间的耦合，以及该耦合在温度和压力下的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尽管NH₄⁺的平动模式在对称性上严格拉曼静默，但其动力学可通过重整化[SnCl₆]²⁻允许模式而被拉曼光谱间接探测；低温下（~100 K以下）观测到libron-phonon重整化（E_eff ~ 4.7 meV）和N-H伸缩振动频率极小值（E_eff ~ 9.3 meV），两者均追踪铵转子从经典到量子行为的交叉。压力下八面体框架平滑硬化，而NH₄⁺子系统在1.3 GPa和1.7 GPa附近出现两次响应，表明刚性八面体框架与动态活跃的NH₄⁺子系统基本退耦。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尽管NH₄⁺的平动模式在对称性上严格拉曼静默，但其动力学可通过重整化[SnCl₆]²⁻允许模式而被拉曼光谱间接探测；低温下（~100 K以下）观测到libron-phonon重整化（E_eff ~ 4.7 meV）和N-H伸缩振动频率极小值（E_eff ~ 9.3 meV），两者均追踪铵转子从经典到量子行为的交叉。压力下八面体框架平滑硬化，而NH₄⁺子系统在1.3 GPa和1.7 GPa附近出现两次响应，表明刚性八面体框架与动态活跃的NH₄⁺子系统基本退耦。；创新点：首次证明对称性静默的NH₄⁺平动模式可通过其对允许的[SnCl₆]²⁻模式的重整化效应在拉曼光谱中被间接观测，从而将拉曼光谱扩展到此前只能依赖中子散射、NMR和NQR探测的阳离子动力学领域；同时揭示了阳离子-声子耦合与八面体框架在外部扰动下的独立响应特性。
papers.method_zh: 单晶X射线衍射（10–300 K）、变温拉曼散射（10–300 K）、高压拉曼散射（最高10.1 GPa，采用金刚石压砧），并结合中子散射测得的裸平动跃迁能量（13.4 meV）进行对比分析。

papers.title: Chemical potentials from structure factors: II. Charged multi-component mixtures
papers.abstract: The chemical potentials of charged multi-component mixtures are central to electrolyte thermo- dynamics, but remain difficult to compute from atomistic simulations. The S0 method enables computing chemical potentials of mixtures from equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations. Here we extend the S0 method to charged mixtures by combining the composition-space framework developed in Part I: Neutral Multi-component Mixtures with a Coulombic treatment of the small- wavenumber limits of static structure factors.
