This approach separates thermodynamically relevant neutral composition fluctuations from forbidden macroscopic charge fluctuations, and further ac- counts for charge-neutrality constraints. We use the method to compute the chemical potentials of multiple-halide aqueous salt solutions, elucidating the ion-specific thermodynamic effects. We also calculate the mixing free energies of molten salt mixtures, demonstrating the importance of correctly describing long-wavelength electrostatic correlations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations”（平衡分子动力学模拟）、“static structure factors”（静态结构因子）等计算与理论方法。；研究对象：带电多组分混合物，具体包括多卤化物水盐溶液（multiple-halide aqueous salt solutions）和熔盐混合物（molten salt mixtures），关注其化学势、混合自由能及离子特异性热力学效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将S0方法扩展到带电混合物，通过分离中性组分涨落与宏观电荷涨落并考虑电荷中性约束，成功计算了多卤化物水盐溶液的化学势和熔盐混合物的混合自由能，揭示了长波静电关联的正确描述对热力学性质的重要性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将S0方法扩展到带电混合物，通过分离中性组分涨落与宏观电荷涨落并考虑电荷中性约束，成功计算了多卤化物水盐溶液的化学势和熔盐混合物的混合自由能，揭示了长波静电关联的正确描述对热力学性质的重要性。；创新点：将S0方法从中性混合物推广至带电混合物，通过组分空间框架与库仑处理的结合，实现了对带电体系中热力学相关的中性涨落与禁止的宏观电荷涨落的分离，并显式纳入电荷中性约束。
papers.method_zh: 基于平衡分子动力学模拟的S0方法，结合第一部分（中性多组分混合物）建立的组分空间框架，并对静态结构因子的小波数极限进行库仑处理，以处理电荷中性约束。

papers.title: A unified geometric design framework for kirigami structures
papers.abstract: In recent years, kirigami metamaterials have been widely studied and applied in science and engineering. While various two- and three-dimensional kirigami design methods have been developed, most of them are only applicable to a limited class of kirigami structures. In this work, we develop a unified framework for kirigami design that encompasses a wide range of 2D-to-2D, 2D-to-3D, and 3D-to-3D shape-morphing effects, as well as additional geometric and physical properties such as compact reconfigurability and rigid deployability. In particular, by reformulating the design task as a length-based constrained optimization problem and solving it simultaneously for multiple target states of the kirigami structure, our unified design framework enables greater design flexibility and stronger theoretical support. Experimental results with a wide range of shape-morphing effects are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework. We further present a rigorous theoretical analysis of several key aspects of kirigami design, covering inertia transposition, aspect-ratio law, and angle defects, thereby elucidating important design rules and limitations. Altogether, our work paves a new way for the design of shape-morphing mechanical metamaterials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论+实验）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“constrained optimization problem”（理论/计算框架）与“Experimental results”（实验验证）。；研究对象：剪纸（kirigami）超材料，具体研究其二维到二维、二维到三维、三维到三维的形状变形（shape-morphing）结构设计。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一个统一的剪纸结构几何设计框架，通过将设计任务转化为基于长度的约束优化问题并同时求解多个目标构型，可涵盖多种形状变形效应，并兼具紧凑可重构性与刚性可展开性等几何物理性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一个统一的剪纸结构几何设计框架，通过将设计任务转化为基于长度的约束优化问题并同时求解多个目标构型，可涵盖多种形状变形效应，并兼具紧凑可重构性与刚性可展开性等几何物理性质。；创新点：相较于已有仅适用于有限类别剪纸结构的设计方法，该框架统一涵盖了2D-to-2D、2D-to-3D、3D-to-3D等多种变形类型，并同时优化多个目标状态，提供了更强的设计灵活性和理论支撑。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于长度的约束优化方法（length-based constrained optimization），对剪纸结构的多目标状态进行同步求解；实验上展示了多种形状变形效果以验证框架有效性；理论上对惯性转置（inertia transposition）、长宽比定律（aspect-ratio law）和角缺陷（angle defects）进行了严格分析。

papers.title: Twist-Tunable Paramagnetic Superconductivity in $d$-wave Altermagnet/Superconductor Heterostructures
papers.abstract: The interplay between twist-angle engineering and unconventional magnetism provides a powerful new route to control quantum phenomena. We theoretically investigate a heterostructure comprising a $d$-wave superconductor proximitized by a two-dimensional $d$-wave altermagnet. We reveal that the momentum-space mismatch between the superconducting gap nodes and the altermagnetic spin-splitting nodes generates a robust, twist-tunable odd-frequency spin-triplet pairing. Consequently, the macroscopic electromagnetic response of the system can be tuned from a conventional diamagnetic Meissner state to an anomalous paramagnetic Meissner effect driven entirely by the interfacial twist angle. For a $d_{x^2-y^2}$ altermagnet, the paramagnetic response is maximized at perfect alignment ($φ=0$) and completely suppressed at a maximal twist of $φ=π/4$, while a $d_{xy}$ altermagnet exhibits the exact complementary behavior. Our results establish twisted altermagnetic heterostructures as a versatile platform for engineering odd-frequency pairing and macroscopic superconducting phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“We theoretically investigate”，属于理论计算/模型研究。；研究对象：由二维 d 波交变磁体（altermagnet）与 d 波超导体构成的异质结，重点研究界面转角（twist angle）调控下的超导配对对称性与宏观电磁响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超导能隙节点与交变磁自旋劈裂节点在动量空间中的失配可产生鲁棒的、可随转角调控的奇频自旋三重态配对；该配对使系统宏观电磁响应可从常规抗磁Meissner态转变为完全由界面转角驱动的顺磁Meissner效应。对于 d_{x²-y²} 交变磁体，顺磁响应在完美对齐（φ=0）时最大，在最大转角 φ=π/4 时完全抑制；而 d_{xy} 交变磁体表现出完全互补的行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超导能隙节点与交变磁自旋劈裂节点在动量空间中的失配可产生鲁棒的、可随转角调控的奇频自旋三重态配对；该配对使系统宏观电磁响应可从常规抗磁Meissner态转变为完全由界面转角驱动的顺磁Meissner效应。对于 d_{x²-y²} 交变磁体，顺磁响应在完美对齐（φ=0）时最大，在最大转角 φ=π/4 时完全抑制；而 d_{xy} 交变磁体表现出完全互补的行为。；创新点：首次提出将转角工程与交变磁体结合，利用动量空间节点失配实现奇频自旋三重态配对的转角可调性，并展示由此可宏观调控Meissner响应的符号（抗磁→顺磁），为奇频配对和宏观超导相的设计提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 理论模型分析，基于动量空间对称性匹配分析（超导能隙节点与交变磁自旋劈裂节点的失配），结合异质结邻近效应框架推导配对振幅与电磁响应。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如是否使用自洽BdG方程或格林函数方法）。

papers.title: Chiral-symmetry breaking and degeneracy in Koch fractal geometries
papers.abstract: Fractal geometries provide a distinctive platform for controlling quantum interference, topology, and localization. We investigate the Su--Schrieffer--Heeger (SSH) model constructed on the Koch curve, where a triangular geometry enables additional same-sublattice hoppings that break chiral symmetry and modify the conventional topological behavior captured by a real-space local marker. Destructive interference within the triangular units produces a highly degenerate flat level at $E=-t$. Although this level originates from the local geometry, its degeneracy and spectral weight are controlled by the self-similar connectivity of the Koch curve. The hierarchy reduces the number of independent flat states and reorganizes the spectrum into an intricate distribution of energy levels. Our results reveal complementary roles for local triangular interference and global fractal connectivity in shaping the electronic properties of geometrically modified SSH chains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“investigate”“real-space local marker”“spectrum”等理论分析与数值计算相关表述，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：基于Koch曲线的Su–Schrieffer–Heeger（SSH）模型，即一维SSH链的几何分形修饰体系，重点研究三角单元结构引入的同子格跳跃对手征对称性、拓扑行为及电子能谱的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Koch分形几何中三角单元内的破坏性干涉在E=-t处产生高度简并的平带，该平带的简并度与谱权重由Koch曲线的自相似连通性控制；局域三角干涉与全局分形连通性共同塑造了修饰SSH链的电子性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Koch分形几何中三角单元内的破坏性干涉在E=-t处产生高度简并的平带，该平带的简并度与谱权重由Koch曲线的自相似连通性控制；局域三角干涉与全局分形连通性共同塑造了修饰SSH链的电子性质。；创新点：揭示了局域三角几何干涉与全局分形自相似连通性在调控电子态中的互补作用，特别是分形层级结构对平带简并度的非平凡控制——这是对传统SSH链拓扑与平带物理的重要扩展。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值分析：构建Koch曲线上的SSH模型，引入同子格跳跃项，采用实空间局域拓扑标记（real-space local marker）表征拓扑行为，并通过能谱分析研究平带简并度与谱权重。

papers.title: Chemical Perspectives on Cuprate Superconductivity: Hole-Protected Spin Dimers as d Wave Cooper Pairs
papers.abstract: The observation that the coherence lengths in cuprate superconductors are extremely small motivated us to search for its real-space structure by examining the consequence of hole-doping in CuO4 units in cuprates. We analyzed aggregates of hole-doped CuO4 units that phase-separate from hole-doped CuO2 layers in terms of their segregation-pressure indices defined in this work. Our search suggests that each d-wave Cooper pair is an antiferromagnetically coupled spin dimer protected in an antiferromagnetic hole dimer (AHD), and that the antiferromagnetic chains of AHDs provide channels through which such spin dimers can move collectively without perturbation. Based on these suggestions and their implications, we examined the causes for several seemingly puzzling observations on cuprate superconductors to find that they are naturally explained by the suggestions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“motivated us to search”“We analyzed”“Our search suggests”等表述，属于理论分析与模型构建，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：铜氧化物高温超导体（cuprate superconductors），具体聚焦于CuO4单元中空穴掺杂后的聚集行为及其与d波超导配对的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出每个d波库珀对本质上是一个被“反铁磁空穴二聚体”（AHD）保护的反铁磁耦合自旋二聚体，且AHD的反铁磁链为这些自旋二聚体提供了可集体无扰动的移动通道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出每个d波库珀对本质上是一个被“反铁磁空穴二聚体”（AHD）保护的反铁磁耦合自旋二聚体，且AHD的反铁磁链为这些自旋二聚体提供了可集体无扰动的移动通道。；创新点：从化学视角出发，将d波库珀对与空穴掺杂CuO4单元中形成的自旋二聚体结构直接关联，并提出AHD链作为超导载流子集体运动的通道，以此统一解释多个看似矛盾的铜氧化物超导实验现象。摘要未突出说明与已有理论（如自旋涨落机制、共振价键理论等）的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体计算或理论框架（如DFT、模型哈密顿量等），仅提及定义了“segregation-pressure indices”（分离压力指数）来分析空穴掺杂CuO4单元的聚集与相分离行为。具体方法细节摘要未给出。

papers.title: Van Hove singularities at the $L$-face of the lutetium nitride phonon dispersion
papers.abstract: We report the structural and vibrational properties of the prototypical 4$f$-filled nonmagnetic member LuN of the lanthanide nitrides, \textit{Ln}N, with elastic and inelastic neutron scattering data at $4$~K. We find a peak in the generalized density of states which, through input from a DFT+$U$ computation, we ascribe to a van Hove singularity on the fourfold-degenerate $L$-face of the Brillouin zone. This work advances the understanding of phonon dynamics in \textit{Ln}N beyond the $Γ$-point.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与计算混合类型。判断依据：使用了弹性及非弹性中子散射实验数据，并结合 DFT+$U$ 计算进行解释。；研究对象：镧系氮化物 \textit{Ln}N 中的原型非磁性成员——氮化镥（LuN），具体研究其声子色散与振动态密度，尤其是布里渊区 $L$ 面上的范霍夫奇点。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 LuN 的广义声子态密度中观测到一个峰，该峰被归因于布里渊区四重简并 $L$ 面上的范霍夫奇点。该工作将 \textit{Ln}N 声子动力学的研究从 $Γ$ 点拓展到了 $L$ 面。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 LuN 的广义声子态密度中观测到一个峰，该峰被归因于布里渊区四重简并 $L$ 面上的范霍夫奇点。该工作将 \textit{Ln}N 声子动力学的研究从 $Γ$ 点拓展到了 $L$ 面。；创新点：首次在 \textit{Ln}N 体系中明确指认 $L$ 面上的范霍夫奇点对声子态密度的贡献，突破了以往仅关注 $Γ$ 点声子行为的局限。
papers.method_zh: 低温（4 K）弹性与非弹性中子散射实验，用于测定结构及振动性质；DFT+$U$ 计算用于解释实验态密度峰并指认其来源。

papers.title: Asymmetry-controlled resonant transport in a Brownian flashing ratchet
papers.abstract: We investigate directed transport in a one-dimensional Brownian flashing ratchet with a piecewise-linear asymmetric periodic potential. Numerical solutions of the Fokker--Planck equation and Brownian dynamics simulations reveal a nonmonotonic dependence of the stationary current on the switching frequency, with a resonant maximum whose position depends on the potential asymmetry $δ$ and barrier height $Δ$. For moderate asymmetry, $|δ|<0.5$, the current obeys a scaling form that separates the dependence on the potential parameters from a common frequency dependence, resulting in a data collapse upon appropriate scaling of the current and frequency. The current amplitude varies linearly with $δ$, while the resonance frequency follows $ν(δ,Δ)=ν_0(Δ)/ [1-b_0\, δ^2]$. We interpret the resulting $(1-δ^2)^{-1}$ scaling in terms of coupled relaxation along the two branches of the asymmetric potential, which provides a physical basis for the observed dependence of the resonant frequency on the potential asymmetry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要提及“Fokker--Planck方程数值求解”和“布朗动力学模拟”，属于理论建模与数值计算研究。；研究对象：一维布朗闪烁棘轮（Brownian flashing ratchet）中的定向输运现象，具体涉及分段线性非对称周期势场中的粒子输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 稳态电流随开关频率呈非单调变化，存在共振极大值；该共振频率随势垒不对称度δ和势垒高度Δ变化，且电流幅度与δ呈线性关系，共振频率满足ν(δ,Δ)=ν₀(Δ)/[1−b₀δ²]的标度形式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：稳态电流随开关频率呈非单调变化，存在共振极大值；该共振频率随势垒不对称度δ和势垒高度Δ变化，且电流幅度与δ呈线性关系，共振频率满足ν(δ,Δ)=ν₀(Δ)/[1−b₀δ²]的标度形式。；创新点：发现电流与频率的标度分离形式，并给出共振频率随不对称度变化的(1−δ²)⁻¹标度律，将其物理起源解释为不对称势两分支上的耦合弛豫过程。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的关联。
papers.method_zh: 数值求解Fokker–Planck方程，并结合布朗动力学（Brownian dynamics）模拟；通过标度分析（数据塌缩）提取电流与频率的普适关系。

papers.title: Symmetry-Enforced Topological Structures in Quantum Phase Diagrams
papers.abstract: We study the topological structure of the quantum phase diagram of gapped systems by identifying the noncontractibility of loops, so-called $S^1$-families, within the gapped phase diagram in which many-body Hamiltonians can have nontrivial ground-state degeneracy. We manifest the role of symmetries in such $S^1$-family classifications by the exotic symmetry interplay: (i) nontrivial mixed anomalies, (ii) semi-direct product relation between the spontaneously broken and the unbroken symmetries, and (iii) symmetry with noninvertible operators. We find that such structures lead to the novel $S^1$-family classifications inaccessible by earlier classifications based on ``independent'' symmetries. Furthermore, we construct lattice realizations of these $S^1$-families and explicitly demonstrate their novel algebraic structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We study the topological structure”“classifications”“construct lattice realizations”等理论分析关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：有能隙量子多体系统的量子相图，具体关注相图中不可收缩的S¹环路（即S¹-族）所承载的拓扑结构，以及对称性（混合反常、半直积关系、非可逆对称算子）对这些结构的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对称性之间的非平凡相互作用（混合反常、自发破缺与未破缺对称性的半直积关系、非可逆对称算子）可以产生此前基于“独立”对称性分类无法触及的新型S¹-族拓扑分类，并已在格点模型中实现验证。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对称性之间的非平凡相互作用（混合反常、自发破缺与未破缺对称性的半直积关系、非可逆对称算子）可以产生此前基于“独立”对称性分类无法触及的新型S¹-族拓扑分类，并已在格点模型中实现验证。；创新点：突破了以往仅考虑“独立”对称性的S¹-族分类框架，首次系统展示了对称性之间非平凡相互作用（混合反常、半直积、非可逆算子）如何丰富量子相图的拓扑分类，并给出了具体的格点实现。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为对称性保护的拓扑分类，具体包括：S¹-族（环路）的非可缩性分析、混合反常分析、半直积对称群结构分析、非可逆对称算子分析，以及格点模型的显式构造。

papers.title: Cesium Clustering and Fluoroberyllate Network Disruption in FLiBe: A Total Scattering and Molecular Dynamics Study
papers.abstract: Several next-generation fission reactor designs employ molten salts such as FLiBe (2LiF-BeF$_2$), with some concepts using fuel dissolved directly in the salt. During operation, fission products such as cesium will accumulate in the salt mixture, potentially leading to an evolution of the thermophysical properties underpinned by the atomic structure. To understand the structural perturbations in FLiBe with 5 mol% CsF, we conducted X-ray and neutron diffraction measurements, refined empirical potential structure refinement (EPSR) models against the experimental data, and compared the resulting structure with neural network molecular dynamics (NNMD) simulations. Comparisons of the EPSR and NNMD structures distinguishes features constrained by the scattering data from those that remain model dependent. The new Cs-bearing correlations account for the changes in the total structure factor and pair-distribution function, while the FLiBe correlations remain minimally altered. We find that Cs slightly disrupts the intermediate-range fluoroberyllate network, increasing the fraction of free fluorine ions, while the local coordination remains largely unchanged. The Cs ions within FLiBe cluster extensively, with BeF$_4^{2-}$ tetrahedra bridging neighboring cesium environments. In contrast to the minor structural perturbations in the liquid, the addition of 5 mol% CsF suppressed the formation of the crystalline Li2BeF4 phase at room temperature, with the phase appearing only above 180C upon heating. These experimentally constrained structural features provide a benchmark for atomistic models used to predict the behavior and properties of fission-product-containing FLiBe.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：X射线/中子衍射实验、EPSR建模、神经网络分子动力学（NNMD）模拟。；研究对象：FLiBe（2LiF-BeF₂）熔盐中添加5 mol% CsF后的原子结构，重点研究铯（Cs）聚集行为、氟铍酸盐网络结构扰动，以及Cs对结晶相形成的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Cs在FLiBe中显著聚集，轻微破坏中程氟铍酸盐网络并增加自由氟离子比例，但局域配位基本不变；5 mol% CsF抑制室温下Li₂BeF₄晶相的形成，该相仅在加热至180°C以上才出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Cs在FLiBe中显著聚集，轻微破坏中程氟铍酸盐网络并增加自由氟离子比例，但局域配位基本不变；5 mol% CsF抑制室温下Li₂BeF₄晶相的形成，该相仅在加热至180°C以上才出现。；创新点：首次将散射数据约束的EPSR模型与NNMD模拟相结合，区分了由实验数据确定的结构特征与依赖模型的结构特征，为含裂变产物的FLiBe原子级模拟提供了实验基准。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: X射线衍射和中子衍射实验；经验势结构精修（EPSR）建模；神经网络分子动力学（NNMD）模拟；EPSR与NNMD结构对比分析。

papers.title: Chiral superconductors and competing states across a Lifshitz transition in rhombohedral pentalayer graphene
papers.abstract: Rhombohedral multilayer graphene hosts a distinctive low-energy electronic structure in which strong Coulomb interactions and nontrivial quantum geometry intertwine to generate exotic quantum states. Recent experiments reported signatures of chiral superconductivity in electron-doped rhombohedral multilayer graphene within the spin- and valley-polarized regime. Here we map the normal-state fermiology surrounding chiral superconductivity in rhombohedral pentalayer graphene. Quantum oscillation measurements reveal an electrically controlled Lifshitz transition between a simply-connected circular quarter-metal Fermi surface and an annular quarter-metal Fermi surface. The Lifshitz boundary itself shifts with perpendicular magnetic field, consistent with the strongly momentum-dependent orbital magnetic moment of the low-energy band. Approaching the transition from either side, the electron effective mass becomes strongly enhanced, implying the formation of a nearly dispersionless band bottom and a strongly reduced kinetic-energy scale. This singular electronic structure produces a regime of exceptionally strong instability in which chiral superconductivity competes with Wigner crystalline phases and reentrant quantum Hall states. In particular, two superconducting regions with signatures of orbital time-reversal-symmetry breaking lie on opposite sides of the Lifshitz boundary and have comparable transition temperatures, yet the annular-side state is suppressed by a substantially smaller perpendicular magnetic field. Our calculation finds comparable chiral pairing tendencies on the two parent Fermi surfaces while producing a much lower orbital-Zeeman pair-breaking scale and an additional finite-momentum pairing tendency for the annular state. These results identify Fermi-surface topology as a key control parameter for chiral superconductivity in rhombohedral graphene.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Quantum oscillation measurements”（量子振荡测量）为实验手段，同时“Our calculation finds...”表明包含理论计算。；研究对象：菱方五层石墨烯（rhombohedral pentalayer graphene）中的手性超导电性，以及其正常态费米面在Lifshitz转变附近的拓扑演化与竞争态（维格纳晶体、回旋量子霍尔态）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在菱方五层石墨烯中，通过电场调控可实现简单连通圆形费米面与环形费米面之间的Lifshitz转变；该转变边界随垂直磁场移动，且两侧均出现手性超导，但环形费米面侧的超导态被显著更小的垂直磁场抑制，表明费米面拓扑是调控手性超导的关键参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在菱方五层石墨烯中，通过电场调控可实现简单连通圆形费米面与环形费米面之间的Lifshitz转变；该转变边界随垂直磁场移动，且两侧均出现手性超导，但环形费米面侧的超导态被显著更小的垂直磁场抑制，表明费米面拓扑是调控手性超导的关键参数。；创新点：首次将菱方多层石墨烯中手性超导性与Lifshitz转变（费米面拓扑变化）直接关联，并揭示环形费米面侧超导态具有更低的轨道Zeeman对破坏能标和额外的有限动量配对倾向。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用量子振荡测量（quantum oscillation）表征正常态费米面拓扑和电子有效质量；理论上通过计算对比两种母体费米面上的手性配对倾向、轨道Zeeman对破坏能标以及有限动量配对趋势。

papers.title: Birefringent-colored optical profiling of wood presenting the 3D cellulose microfibril architecture
papers.abstract: Wood slices under a polarized optical microscope show a spectrum of interference colors, such as cyan, blue, magenta, yellow, and bluish gray because of the birefringent cellulose in the microfibrils. An optical model is established to simulate the birefringent-colored micrograph of wood. Five typical cell wall architectures, line, helix, ring, crossed helix, and twisted helix, are considered. With a retardation wave plate to distinguish fibrils of different orientations, each structure displays its unique birefringent-colored texture, presenting its underlying 3D structure with the vivid colors. Cross sections of the trunk and twig of Eucalyptus grandis presented birefringent-colored profiles. Three identification methods were compared: visible fibril trends, birefringent-colored optical textures, and the simulated look-up library. The three methods gave consistent results, proving that the birefringent-color tags are efficient and accurate. Electron and atomic force microscopy are unable to resolve cellulose microfibrils embedded in the lignin and hemicellulose matrix. Polarized optical microscopy overcomes this by selectively detecting birefringent cellulose, enabling accurate identification of complex helical structures. This method enables statistical and spatial analysis of complex biomaterial compositions. Capable of profiling dozens of cells simultaneously, this high-throughput optical method provides a potentially fully automated analysis framework for plant science, biomechanics, and bioinspired cellulose materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与建模混合类型。判断依据关键词：polarized optical microscope（实验观测）、optical model is established（光学建模/模拟）。；研究对象：木材切片中纤维素微纤丝的三维排列结构，具体涉及五种典型细胞壁构型（直线、螺旋、环状、交叉螺旋、扭转螺旋）以及巨桉（Eucalyptus grandis）树干和枝条横截面的双折射彩色成像。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过偏振光学显微镜结合延迟波片，木材切片中不同取向的纤维素微纤丝会呈现独特的双折射干涉颜色纹理，这些颜色标签能够准确、高效地识别并三维呈现复杂的螺旋状细胞壁结构，且与电子显微镜和原子力显微镜相比，该方法可穿透木质素-半纤维素基质选择性探测纤维素。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过偏振光学显微镜结合延迟波片，木材切片中不同取向的纤维素微纤丝会呈现独特的双折射干涉颜色纹理，这些颜色标签能够准确、高效地识别并三维呈现复杂的螺旋状细胞壁结构，且与电子显微镜和原子力显微镜相比，该方法可穿透木质素-半纤维素基质选择性探测纤维素。；创新点：利用双折射干涉颜色作为“标签”实现对嵌入木质素-半纤维素基质中的纤维素微纤丝三维构型的高通量、非破坏性光学识别，可同时分析数十个细胞，为植物科学和生物力学提供潜在的全自动分析框架。摘要未突出说明与以往偏振光木材研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 偏振光学显微镜（polarized optical microscopy）结合延迟波片（retardation wave plate）进行双折射彩色成像；建立了光学模型模拟双折射彩色显微图像；对比了三种识别方法（可见微纤丝走向、双折射彩色纹理、模拟查找库）；并与电子显微镜和原子力显微镜进行对照。

papers.title: Spin-textured orbitals in altermagnetic artificial atoms
papers.abstract: Artificial atoms provide a versatile platform for engineering atomic-like orbitals, yet spin generally remains a passive degree of freedom in their orbital structure. Here, we introduce the concept of altermagnetic artificial atoms formed by confining electrons with momentum-dependent spin splitting. We show that altermagnetism reconstructs conventional confined orbitals into spin-textured orbitals, with spatially distinct distributions of opposite spin components. The resulting confined spectrum retains a twofold degeneracy protected by the combined $C_{4z}\mathcal{T}$ symmetry. These spin textures persist in higher-energy states, where additional radial structures combine with the characteristic angular spin pattern. Furthermore, strain resolves the degenerate orbital pairs into spin-polarized states, and continuously tunes their energy splitting. Our results establish altermagnetic artificial atoms as a route to engineering spin-dependent orbital structures in quantum-confined systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中“introduce the concept”“We show that”“Our results establish”等表述，以及未提及任何实验手段，属于理论建模与数值分析。；研究对象：交变磁（altermagnetic）人工原子——即通过将具有动量依赖自旋劈裂的电子限制在量子点/人工势阱中形成的类原子体系，研究其轨道结构中的自旋纹理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 交变磁序将传统受限轨道重构为“自旋纹理轨道”，其中相反自旋分量在空间上分离分布；受限能谱在 $C_{4z}\mathcal{T}$ 联合对称性下保持二重简并，而应变可解除该简并并连续调控自旋极化态的能量劈裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：交变磁序将传统受限轨道重构为“自旋纹理轨道”，其中相反自旋分量在空间上分离分布；受限能谱在 $C_{4z}\mathcal{T}$ 联合对称性下保持二重简并，而应变可解除该简并并连续调控自旋极化态的能量劈裂。；创新点：首次提出“交变磁人工原子”概念，将交变磁序引入量子受限体系，实现轨道波函数的自旋纹理化，为在人工原子中工程化自旋依赖的轨道结构提供了新途径。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论模型与对称性分析：基于动量依赖自旋劈裂的受限电子模型，利用 $C_{4z}\mathcal{T}$ 联合对称性分析能谱简并性，并通过引入应变作为微扰研究简并解除与能级调谐。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如紧束缚、连续模型或第一性原理）。

papers.title: Chiral cellulose fibril organization in a plant cell wall as liquid crystal confined in a cylindrical boundary
papers.abstract: The order of cellulose microfibrils in xylem cell walls is identified using polarized optical microscopy. The line, helix, ring, crossed helix, and twisted helix organizations in a cylindrical shell are the equilibrium states of balanced elastic deformation and surface anchoring. A computational model of the five organizations is established to simulate their birefringent-colored profiles. These five textures present unique optical textures, which are clearly recognized in the cross sections of Eucalyptus grandis. The libriform fiber cell for support has a twisted helical cell wall. The vessel cell for high-speed water uptake consists of a helical layer covered by a layer of vortex array. The ray cell for radial transportation is crossed helical. The microfibril angles versus the radius of the cell wall were measured utilizing the distribution of birefringence colors. In fiber cell walls, the MFA is significantly correlated with the curvature, bending, and surface anchoring, respectively. In vessel cell walls, the vortex array includes focal conic domains of chiral order and topological defects of nematic order, suggesting that the phase transition of cellulose fibrils leads to pattern formation. Liquid crystal phases and patterns in the cell walls reveal how the cell wall thickens and how cells differentiate. Out of the frustration of long, stiff, twisting fibrils packed in slender tubes, trees generate the helical channel networks, transforming the brittle lamina into an elastic, tear-resistant, self-healing tissue.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验 + 计算模拟）。判断依据：摘要中同时提到“利用偏振光学显微镜识别”（实验观测）和“建立五种组织的计算模型以模拟其双折射彩色剖面”（计算建模）。；研究对象：植物细胞壁中纤维素微纤丝的手性液晶有序组织，具体涉及桉树（Eucalyptus grandis）木质部细胞（纤维细胞、导管细胞、射线细胞）的圆柱壳层内纤维素微纤丝的取向结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纤维素微纤丝在圆柱形边界约束下，通过弹性形变与表面锚定的平衡，可形成线状、螺旋、环状、交叉螺旋和扭曲螺旋五种液晶组织，这些组织对应不同细胞类型的功能分化，并揭示了树木如何通过液晶相变与拓扑缺陷形成螺旋通道网络，使脆性薄层转变为弹性、抗撕裂、自修复的组织。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纤维素微纤丝在圆柱形边界约束下，通过弹性形变与表面锚定的平衡，可形成线状、螺旋、环状、交叉螺旋和扭曲螺旋五种液晶组织，这些组织对应不同细胞类型的功能分化，并揭示了树木如何通过液晶相变与拓扑缺陷形成螺旋通道网络，使脆性薄层转变为弹性、抗撕裂、自修复的组织。；创新点：首次将植物细胞壁中纤维素微纤丝的有序结构明确归类为圆柱边界约束下的手性液晶平衡态，并系统建立了五种液晶组织的计算模型，将液晶物理（焦锥畴、向列拓扑缺陷）与植物细胞分化及细胞壁增厚机制直接关联。摘要未突出说明与以往植物细胞壁模型（如传统多层螺旋模型）的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 偏振光学显微镜（POM）用于识别细胞壁中微纤丝取向；计算模型用于模拟五种液晶组织的双折射彩色剖面；利用双折射颜色分布测量微纤丝角（MFA）随细胞壁半径的变化；对纤维细胞壁进行MFA与曲率、弯曲、表面锚定的相关性分析。

papers.title: Superheating Field of Extreme Type-II Superconductors Calculated from the Eliashberg Theory
papers.abstract: We calculate the superheating field $H_s$ of a type-II superconductor with a large Ginzburg-Landau parameter from the isotropic Eliashberg theory. It is shown that the temperature dependencies of $H_s(T)$ can be obtained from a thermodynamic approach for different scattering parameters $p=\hbar/2πτ_Nk_BT_c$ in a wide range of the nonmagnetic impurity scattering times $τ_N$ ranging from the clean $(p\ll 1)$ to the dirty $(p\gg 1)$ limits. Specific calculations were done for Nb and Nb$_3$Sn using their electron-phonon spectral functions extracted from tunneling measurements. We show that the ratio $H_s(T,p)/H_c(T)$ calculated from the Eliashberg theory exceeds that of the weak coupling BCS model, where $H_c$ is the thermodynamic magnetic field. We also show that, even though nonmagnetic impurities are pairbreakers in the current-carrying state, $H_s(0,p)$ for Nb$_3$Sn at $T=0$ has a maximum at $p\approx 0.2$ at which the ratio $H_s/H_c$ is about $6\%$ higher than that in the BCS clean limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Eliashberg理论”进行计算，属于强耦合超导理论框架下的数值计算研究。；研究对象：极端第二类超导体（大Ginzburg-Landau参数）的过热场 \(H_s\)，具体材料为Nb和Nb\(_3\)Sn，并考察非磁性杂质散射对 \(H_s\) 的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从Eliashberg理论计算的 \(H_s(T,p)/H_c(T)\) 比值高于弱耦合BCS模型的结果；对于Nb\(_3\)Sn，在 \(T=0\) 时 \(H_s(0,p)\) 在 \(p\approx 0.2\) 处出现极大值，该处 \(H_s/H_c\) 比BCS清洁极限高约6%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从Eliashberg理论计算的 \(H_s(T,p)/H_c(T)\) 比值高于弱耦合BCS模型的结果；对于Nb\(_3\)Sn，在 \(T=0\) 时 \(H_s(0,p)\) 在 \(p\approx 0.2\) 处出现极大值，该处 \(H_s/H_c\) 比BCS清洁极限高约6%。；创新点：首次在Eliashberg强耦合框架下系统计算极端第二类超导体的过热场随温度和杂质散射参数的变化，并揭示非磁性杂质在载流态下作为配对破坏因素时，\(H_s(0,p)\) 在有限 \(p\) 处存在非单调极大值——这一行为超出弱耦合BCS预期。
papers.method_zh: 基于各向同性Eliashberg理论，采用热力学方法计算过热场 \(H_s(T)\)，覆盖从清洁极限（\(p\ll 1\)）到脏极限（\(p\gg 1\)）的宽杂质散射范围；电子-声子谱函数取自隧道测量数据，用于Nb和Nb\(_3\)Sn的具体计算。

papers.title: Floquet Topological Spin-Valley-Layertronics on a Layered Dice Lattice
papers.abstract: The recent discovery of long-sought dice flat band in layered YCl electride has opened up rich possibilities of correlation and topological physics in dice lattice systems [Nature Communications 17, 2213 (2026), arXiv:2509.05958]. Here, we reveal a plethora of distinctive correlated topological phases in a generic layered dice lattice system at band filling of $ν=4$ under on-site Hubbard interactions: (i) the system is an intrinsic sublattice anti-ferromagnetic (AFM) quantum spin-valley Hall insulator; (ii) a circularly polarized light (CPL) drives the AFM spin-valley insulator into a Floquet odd-parity $f$-wave altermagnet(AM) insulator; (iii) a vertical displacement field turns the Floquet $f$-wave AM insulator into a spin-valley-layer-polarized Chern insulator, with the sign of spin, valley and Chern number all controlled by the direction of the displacement field. Our results not only establish the layered dice lattice as a versatile platform for electrically switchable magnetic and topological phases, but also provide an all-electrical scheme for integrated spin-valley-layertronics for non-volatile information storage and processing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“on-site Hubbard interactions”“Floquet”“Chern insulator”等理论模型与拓扑相概念，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：层状骰子晶格（layered dice lattice）体系，具体以层状YCl电子化物中发现的骰子平带为背景，研究其在填充数ν=4、在位Hubbard相互作用下的关联拓扑相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在层状骰子晶格中，ν=4填充下系统呈现三种可调控的关联拓扑相：本征亚晶格反铁磁量子自旋谷霍尔绝缘体；圆偏振光驱动下转变为Floquet奇宇称f波交错磁（altermagnet）绝缘体；垂直位移场进一步将其转变为自旋-谷-层极化的Chern绝缘体，且自旋、谷和Chern数的符号均可由位移场方向控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在层状骰子晶格中，ν=4填充下系统呈现三种可调控的关联拓扑相：本征亚晶格反铁磁量子自旋谷霍尔绝缘体；圆偏振光驱动下转变为Floquet奇宇称f波交错磁（altermagnet）绝缘体；垂直位移场进一步将其转变为自旋-谷-层极化的Chern绝缘体，且自旋、谷和Chern数的符号均可由位移场方向控制。；创新点：首次在层状骰子晶格中建立电学可切换的磁性（反铁磁→交错磁）与拓扑（量子自旋谷霍尔→Chern绝缘体）相变方案，并提出全电学调控的自旋-谷-层电子学（spin-valley-layertronics）集成方案，用于非易失性信息存储与处理。摘要未突出说明与已有骰子晶格研究的其他具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论模型分析：基于在位Hubbard相互作用的关联模型，结合Floquet工程（圆偏振光驱动）和垂直位移场调控，分析不同参数下的拓扑与磁性相。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如DFT+U、精确对角化或量子蒙特卡洛等）。

papers.title: Ballistic-to-Localized Dynamics as Signature of Quantum Phase Transition in Josephson Junction
papers.abstract: Using state-of-the-art numerical techniques, we investigate how quantum phase fluctuations and quasiparticle tunneling shape the behavior of a small-capacitance Josephson junction across Ohmic, sub-Ohmic, and super-Ohmic dissipation regimes. We show that increasing the Ohmic dissipation strength drives a Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless quantum phase transition at thermodynamic equilibrium. Deviations from Ohmic behavior profoundly alter this scenario: the super-Ohmic regime exhibits no phase transition, whereas the sub-Ohmic regime displays a continuous second-order transition, consistent with the universality classes of the spin-boson model. Within the Ohmic regime, real-frequency linear-response calculations reveal that the phase particle does not undergo the commonly assumed diffusive-to-localized crossover. Instead, finite resistance progressively suppresses the singular zero-frequency response, producing a ballistic-to-localized change in the dynamics. At finite frequencies, coupling to the environment generates a long-lived excitation in the charge response, which evolves into a resonance as the subgap and shunt resistances are reduced.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“state-of-the-art numerical techniques”（先进数值技术）以及“real-frequency linear-response calculations”（实频线性响应计算）。；研究对象：小电容约瑟夫森结，重点研究其在欧姆、亚欧姆和超欧姆三种耗散环境下的量子相变与动力学行为，涉及量子相位涨落和准粒子隧穿效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在欧姆耗散下，增大耗散强度驱动体系发生Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless（BKT）量子相变；相粒子动力学并非常见的扩散-局域化转变，而是随有限电阻增大呈现弹道-局域化的动力学变化。亚欧姆耗散对应连续二级相变，超欧姆耗散则无相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在欧姆耗散下，增大耗散强度驱动体系发生Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless（BKT）量子相变；相粒子动力学并非常见的扩散-局域化转变，而是随有限电阻增大呈现弹道-局域化的动力学变化。亚欧姆耗散对应连续二级相变，超欧姆耗散则无相变。；创新点：揭示了欧姆耗散下约瑟夫森结相粒子动力学并非传统的扩散-局域化转变，而是弹道-局域化转变；并系统对比了欧姆、亚欧姆和超欧姆三种耗散下的相变普适类，与自旋-玻色子模型的普适类一致。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用先进数值技术（摘要未具体说明算法名称，如DMRG或QMC等未提及），结合实频线性响应计算，分析不同耗散强度下的电荷响应与动力学行为。

papers.title: Interplay of Excitonic Charge Density Wave and Superconductivity in Transition Metal Dichalcogenides
papers.abstract: Motivated by the unique characteristics of the phase diagram of 1T-TiSe2, we investigated the complex interplay of excitonic charge density wave (CDW) and superconductivity (SC) on a two-dimensional triangular lattice, each site accommodating two orbitals. In response to various tuning parameters, such as intercalation, pressure, substitution, and gating, these materials exhibit a generic and gradual waning of CDW, followed by the emergence of SC. Intriguingly, the nature of CDW changes from commensurate to incommensurate with the appearance of SC. Setting up a minimal model based on observed excitonic CDW and electron and hole pockets in the Fermi surface, and analyzing it within a simple mean-field framework, we can comprehend some salient experimental features. We also found that the qualitative phase diagram remains insensitive to details of the band structure. These results offer crucial insights into the nature of the interplay between CDW and SC in transition-metal dichalcogenides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Setting up a minimal model”“analyzing it within a simple mean-field framework”，属于模型构建与平均场理论分析。；研究对象：1T-TiSe2 及其相关过渡金属二硫化物（TMDs）中的激子型电荷密度波（excitonic CDW）与超导（SC）的相互作用。具体体系为二维三角晶格上每个格点含两个轨道的模型，对应具有电子和空穴费米口袋的激子CDW态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在CDW逐渐减弱并伴随超导出现的调控过程中，CDW的序性质会从公度（commensurate）转变为非公度（incommensurate）；该定性相图对能带结构细节不敏感，能解释若干关键实验特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在CDW逐渐减弱并伴随超导出现的调控过程中，CDW的序性质会从公度（commensurate）转变为非公度（incommensurate）；该定性相图对能带结构细节不敏感，能解释若干关键实验特征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可看出其新意在于：首次在同时包含激子CDW与超导的三角晶格双轨道模型中，系统揭示了CDW公度-非公度转变与超导出现的关联，并论证了相图的普适性（对能带细节不敏感）。
papers.method_zh: 基于观测到的激子CDW及费米面上电子/空穴口袋构建最小模型（minimal model），并在平均场（mean-field）框架下进行自洽求解分析。

papers.title: Pseudo Entropy in Quantum Spin Chains: from Integrability to Chaos
papers.abstract: In this work, we study pseudo entropy and spectral dynamics in quantum spin chains (Heisenberg XXZ model and the mixed-field Ising model) to investigate whether they can serve as diagnostics of quantum chaos. First, we derive an exact relation between the real part of the thermal pseudo entropy and the spectral form factor. This provided evidence that pseudo entropy could exhibit the characteristic dip, logarithmic ramp, and plateau, implying the precise manner in which pseudo entropy probes chaos. We found that the imaginary part, while it does not diagnose chaos, can still provide crucial information about Fisher zeros that is not available in the real counterpart. For spatial pseudo entropy in the XXZ chain, we find that the logarithmic critical scaling persists in both integrable and chaotic regimes, and that the non-positivity conjecture holds. Finally, we derive an exact connection between pseudo entropy, relative pseudo entropy, and spectral complexity with a potential connection to holography.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“derive an exact relation”“we derive an exact connection”等理论推导表述，且涉及量子自旋链模型（Heisenberg XXZ模型、混合场Ising模型）的解析与数值分析，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：量子自旋链中的赝熵（pseudo entropy）与谱动力学，具体体系为可积的Heisenberg XXZ模型和混沌的混合场Ising模型，关注赝熵能否作为量子混沌的诊断工具。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 热赝熵的实部与谱形状因子存在精确关系，可呈现混沌特征性的“凹陷-对数斜坡-平台”结构，从而作为混沌探针；赝熵虚部虽不诊断混沌，但能提供Fisher零点的关键信息。此外，XXZ链中空间赝熵的对数临界标度在可积与混沌区均成立，且非正性猜想成立。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：热赝熵的实部与谱形状因子存在精确关系，可呈现混沌特征性的“凹陷-对数斜坡-平台”结构，从而作为混沌探针；赝熵虚部虽不诊断混沌，但能提供Fisher零点的关键信息。此外，XXZ链中空间赝熵的对数临界标度在可积与混沌区均成立，且非正性猜想成立。；创新点：首次建立热赝熵实部与谱形状因子之间的精确解析关系，从而将赝熵与混沌诊断的“凹陷-斜坡-平台”特征直接关联；同时揭示赝熵虚部作为Fisher零点信息载体的独特作用，并建立赝熵与谱复杂度及全息对偶的潜在联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与解析计算：推导热赝熵实部与谱形状因子的精确关系；分析赝熵虚部与Fisher零点的联系；研究空间赝熵的临界标度行为；建立赝熵、相对赝熵与谱复杂度之间的精确联系。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如DMRG或精确对角化）。

papers.title: Branching stochastic mechanics. I. Clustering and connected correlations within a branching-process representation of the Schrödinger equation
papers.abstract: Can finite-range correlations hide in the statistics of an extended quantum state? The Schrödinger-Nagasawa transform represents the wave function by positive forward and backward diffusion fields whose product is the Born density. We promote them to branching superprocesses, \(Φ_F\) and \(Φ_B\): diffusion samples stochastic paths, whereas Bohm/Fisher-controlled branching generates genealogies of alternative continuations. With rates evaluated on the prescribed Born density, their means reproduce Schrödinger dynamics exactly. The connected sector exhibits supercritical, critical, and subcritical clustering in confinement and has critical dimension \(d_c=2\) in free space. Stationary eigenmodes remain extended; subcritical clusters acquire the reduced de~Broglie scale. We then let the branching rate respond to the fluctuating product \(Φ_FΦ_B\). In the reciprocal basis, the fields equal a smooth reference \(R\) plus centered fluctuations \(ψ_F,ψ_B\), defining the signed kernel \(C_{\rm FB}(x,y)=\mathbb E_ω[ψ_F(x)ψ_B(y)]\). On the anticorrelated branch, \(ρ_{\rm BSM}(x)=-C_{\rm FB}(x,x)\) is the positive paired density. Stationary recovery requires its diagonal to match the Born profile, while off-diagonal decay defines the correlation range. The pair equation splits into collective and relative sectors: spectral cancellation selects the Born collective mode, while suppression of the leading density fluctuation selects the anticorrelated source channel. With relative diffusivity \(D_{\rm eff}\) and positive relaxation rate \(μ_{\rm FB}\), correlations have screening length \(ξ_{\rm FB}=\sqrt{D_{\rm eff}/μ_{\rm FB}}\). Thus an extended Born density and a finite correlation range can coexist in one stochastic kernel, suggesting particle-like organization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：branching superprocesses、stochastic mechanics、Schrödinger-Nagasawa transform、theoretical framework。；研究对象：量子力学中薛定谔方程的随机表示，具体为通过正反向扩散场与分支过程构造的随机力学模型，研究扩展量子态统计中有限程关联（聚类）的涌现及其与玻恩密度共存的机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在一个随机核中，扩展的玻恩密度与有限关联长度可以共存：通过分支随机力学构造的配对密度在满足玻恩分布的同时，其关联函数具有屏蔽长度 ξ_FB = √(D_eff/μ_FB)，从而呈现类粒子组织。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在一个随机核中，扩展的玻恩密度与有限关联长度可以共存：通过分支随机力学构造的配对密度在满足玻恩分布的同时，其关联函数具有屏蔽长度 ξ_FB = √(D_eff/μ_FB)，从而呈现类粒子组织。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其新意在于将分支过程引入薛定谔方程的随机表示，并证明扩展态统计中可隐藏有限程关联，且关联长度由有效扩散率与弛豫率之比决定，为量子态的粒子性组织提供了随机动力学机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为薛定谔-长泽变换（Schrödinger-Nagasawa transform），将波函数分解为正反向扩散场，并将其提升为分支超过程（branching superprocesses）。分析包括：分支率由玻恩密度决定时的均值动力学与连通关联的聚类行为（超临界/临界/亚临界），以及分支率响应于涨落乘积 Φ_FΦ_B 时的配对方程，通过谱消去与密度涨落抑制选择集体模与反关联源通道。

papers.title: Thermal Hall Signatures of Distinct Schwinger-Boson Flux Sectors on the Honeycomb Lattice
papers.abstract: Thermal transport offers a bulk probe of charge-neutral excitations in frustrated magnets. It remains challenging, however, to determine whether such transport can distinguish different parton mean-field structures of the same spin system. This question is particularly relevant on the honeycomb lattice, where distinct $0$-flux, $π$-flux, and chiral $π/2$-flux sectors have been proposed. In this paper, we compare self-consistent saddle-point solutions in these three sectors for a frustrated $J_1-J_2$ Heisenberg model with a next-nearest-neighbor Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction and a perpendicular magnetic field. Using finite-temperature Schwinger-boson mean-field theory and the Kubo formula for bosonic Bogoliubov-de Gennes systems, we evaluate the intrinsic spinon thermal Hall conductivity. At a common parameter point where all three branches remain gapped, the $0$-flux response is positive and the $π$-flux response is negative for $D>0$ and $h>0$ under the sign conventions used in this paper, whereas the $π/2$-flux response changes sign with increasing temperature. We further show that a projective symmetry combining a sixfold rotation with time reversal forces the zero-field response of a fixed chiral $π/2$-flux domain to vanish. Within the mean-field regime examined in this paper, the sign and temperature dependence of $κ_{xy}/T$ therefore provide a flux-sensitive transport signature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“self-consistent saddle-point solutions”“finite-temperature Schwinger-boson mean-field theory”“Kubo formula”等理论计算方法，无实验手段描述。；研究对象：蜂窝晶格上受挫的J₁-J₂海森堡模型，含次近邻Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用及垂直磁场。具体研究该自旋系统中三种不同的Schwinger玻色子通量扇区（0-通量、π-通量、手性π/2-通量）的热霍尔输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三个分支均保持有能隙的共同参数点，0-通量扇区的热霍尔响应为正，π-通量扇区为负（在D>0、h>0及本文符号约定下），而π/2-通量扇区的响应随温度升高改变符号。因此κ_xy/T的符号和温度依赖可作为区分不同通量扇区的输运特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三个分支均保持有能隙的共同参数点，0-通量扇区的热霍尔响应为正，π-通量扇区为负（在D>0、h>0及本文符号约定下），而π/2-通量扇区的响应随温度升高改变符号。因此κ_xy/T的符号和温度依赖可作为区分不同通量扇区的输运特征。；创新点：首次系统比较同一自旋模型（蜂窝晶格J₁-J₂-DM-磁场）中三种不同通量扇区的热霍尔响应，证明热输运可以区分同一自旋系统的不同部分子平均场结构；并发现六重旋转与时间反演组合的投影对称性会强制零场下固定手性π/2-通量畴的响应为零。
papers.method_zh: 有限温度Schwinger-玻色子平均场理论（自洽鞍点求解），结合适用于玻色Bogoliubov-de Gennes系统的Kubo公式，计算内禀自旋子热霍尔电导率κ_xy。

papers.title: Josephson-Phase Reversal of Non-Bloch Andreev Propagation
papers.abstract: Non-Hermitian control is difficult in solid-state systems due to fixed dissipation. Here, we show that in a spin-orbit-coupled planar Josephson junction, changing only the Josephson phase reverses the non-Bloch propagation of a low-energy Andreev band and switches its boundary accumulation between junction edges. The phase reshapes the band's spin and electron-hole composition, causing a fixed reservoir to unequally attenuate counterpropagating modes. Weak-loss theory links this phase-controlled loss imbalance to boundary-selected complex momenta, offering an in situ route to reconfigurable non-Hermitian transport in superconducting platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We show that”“Weak-loss theory links”等理论推导性表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：自旋-轨道耦合的平面约瑟夫森结中的非厄米安德烈夫能带传播与边界累积现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅通过改变约瑟夫森相位，即可反转低能安德烈夫能带的非布洛赫传播方向，并使其边界累积在结的两个边缘之间切换。该相位调控通过改变能带的自旋与电子-空穴组成，使固定耗散源对反向传播模式产生不等衰减，从而实现非厄米输运的原位可重构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅通过改变约瑟夫森相位，即可反转低能安德烈夫能带的非布洛赫传播方向，并使其边界累积在结的两个边缘之间切换。该相位调控通过改变能带的自旋与电子-空穴组成，使固定耗散源对反向传播模式产生不等衰减，从而实现非厄米输运的原位可重构。；创新点：首次提出在固态超导体系中，仅用约瑟夫森相位（而非改变耗散或外场）即可原位调控非厄米传播方向与边界态累积，为可重构非厄米输运提供了无需改变固定耗散的超导平台实现路径。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，具体包括：非布洛赫能带理论（non-Bloch band theory）与弱损耗理论（weak-loss theory），结合自旋-轨道耦合平面约瑟夫森结的模型计算，分析复动量（complex momenta）与边界选择的关系。

papers.title: Valley-Enabled Intrinsic Dresselhaus Spin-Orbit Coupling in Silicon
papers.abstract: We develop a symmetry-based theory of spin-orbit-valley coupling in silicon that reveals an intrinsic source of Dresselhaus spin-orbit coupling independent of interfaces or external electric fields. Treating the valley degree of freedom as a symmetry-carrying quantum degree of freedom, we show that the Dresselhaus interaction is necessarily valley off-diagonal and that a bulk contribution proportional to the valley Pauli matrix $τ_1$ is symmetry allowed. Tight-binding calculations yield a bulk coupling more than an order of magnitude larger than typical interface-induced spin-orbit coupling; achieving the same energy scale through the interface-induced mechanism would require electric fields roughly 50 times larger than typical fields. We further derive the symmetry-allowed spin-valley couplings generated by magnetic-field gradients and show how they account for the valley-dependent Zeeman splitting observed in micromagnet experiments. A slight tilt of the background magnetic field out of the plane produces an additional isotropic contribution linear in $B_z$, providing an experimentally accessible signature of the corresponding coupling constant. Finally, we predict a spin-independent micromagnet-induced valley splitting in the $τ_3$ channel, which is distinct from the $τ_{1,2}$ channels generated by alloy disorder and therefore remains robust against disorder-induced cancellation. These results establish valley symmetry as a fundamental ingredient in the spin-orbit physics of silicon and provide new mechanisms for controlling and probing spin and valley degrees of freedom in silicon quantum devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“symmetry-based theory”（对称性理论）、“Tight-binding calculations”（紧束缚计算），未提及实验测量手段。；研究对象：硅（Silicon）中的自旋-轨道-谷耦合物理，具体为体相硅中内禀Dresselhaus自旋轨道耦合，以及磁场梯度诱导的自旋-谷耦合和谷劈裂现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 硅中谷自由度可作为携带对称性的量子自由度，允许一种与界面或外电场无关的体相内禀Dresselhaus自旋轨道耦合（正比于谷Pauli矩阵τ₁），其强度比典型界面诱导的自旋轨道耦合大一个数量级以上；此外还预言了磁场梯度导致的谷依赖Zeeman劈裂和自旋无关的微磁体诱导谷劈裂（τ₃通道）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：硅中谷自由度可作为携带对称性的量子自由度，允许一种与界面或外电场无关的体相内禀Dresselhaus自旋轨道耦合（正比于谷Pauli矩阵τ₁），其强度比典型界面诱导的自旋轨道耦合大一个数量级以上；此外还预言了磁场梯度导致的谷依赖Zeeman劈裂和自旋无关的微磁体诱导谷劈裂（τ₃通道）。；创新点：首次将谷自由度视为携带对称性的量子自由度，揭示了硅中无需界面或外电场的内禀Dresselhaus自旋轨道耦合来源；预言了τ₃通道的自旋无关微磁体诱导谷劈裂，该通道与合金无序产生的τ₁,₂通道不同，对无序引起的抵消效应具有鲁棒性。
papers.method_zh: 对称性分析（基于群论的自旋-轨道-谷耦合理论框架）结合紧束缚（tight-binding）计算；推导了磁场梯度下对称性允许的自旋-谷耦合形式，并分析了倾斜磁场下的各向同性贡献。

papers.title: Phonon-Localization-Driven Decoupling of Dual-Channel Transport for Record-Low Intrinsic Lattice Thermal Conductivity
papers.abstract: A fundamental bottleneck in pushing the intrinsic lattice thermal conductivity of inorganic crystalline solids to its lowest limit arises from the inherent competition between the particle-like propagation (\(κ_{\mathrm{L}}^{\mathrm{P}}\)) and wave-like tunneling (\(κ_{\mathrm{L}}^{\mathrm{C}}\)) channels. Herein, we demonstrate that phonon localization provides a robust pathway to decouple the dual-channel transport, achieving record-low \(κ_{\mathrm{L}}\) in quasi-1D ternary helical crystals. Despite the structural complexity leading to densely populated phonon branches and thus inducing abundant coherent phonons, the weak interchain interactions and heavy elements compress numerous branches into highly localized, nearly dispersionless flat bands. Such strong localization simultaneously suppresses both the diagonal and off-diagonal components of the group velocity, thereby synergistically suppressing \(κ_{\mathrm{L}}^{\mathrm{P}}\) and \(κ_{\mathrm{L}}^{\mathrm{C}}\). Taking InSeI as an example, the interchain room-temperature \(κ_{\mathrm{L}}^{\mathrm{P}}\) and \(κ_{\mathrm{L}}^{\mathrm{C}}\) are 0.145 and 0.053 W/mK, respectively, yielding an ultralow total \(κ_{\mathrm{L}}\) of 0.198 W/mK. Weaker interchain interactions further drive the room-temperature \(κ_{\mathrm{L}}\) of GaSeI and AlSeI to record lows of 0.086 and 0.089 W/mK, respectively; these values even drop to 0.058 and 0.059 W/mK at 900 K. These findings provide useful insights into exploring the thermal conductivity limit in crystals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“demonstrate”（演示/证明）、“provide a robust pathway”（提供稳健路径）等理论推导性词汇，并给出了具体的计算数值（如0.145 W/mK），未提及任何实验合成或测量手段。；研究对象：准一维（quasi-1D）三元螺旋晶体，具体包括InSeI、GaSeI和AlSeI。核心物理现象是声子局域化（phonon localization）对晶格热导率（\(κ_{\mathrm{L}}\)）中粒子传播通道（\(κ_{\mathrm{L}}^{\mathrm{P}}\)）和波隧穿通道（\(κ_{\mathrm{L}}^{\mathrm{C}}\)）的双通道输运解耦机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 声子局域化能够有效解耦晶格热输运的双通道（粒子传播与波隧穿），同时抑制群速度的对角和非对角分量，从而协同降低两种通道的贡献，在准一维三元螺旋晶体中实现了创纪录的低本征晶格热导率（如GaSeI室温下总\(κ_{\mathrm{L}}\)低至0.086 W/mK）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：声子局域化能够有效解耦晶格热输运的双通道（粒子传播与波隧穿），同时抑制群速度的对角和非对角分量，从而协同降低两种通道的贡献，在准一维三元螺旋晶体中实现了创纪录的低本征晶格热导率（如GaSeI室温下总\(κ_{\mathrm{L}}\)低至0.086 W/mK）。；创新点：提出“声子局域化”作为解耦双通道输运（粒子传播与波隧穿）的通用策略，打破了以往认为结构复杂导致相干声子增多会增强波隧穿通道（\(κ_{\mathrm{L}}^{\mathrm{C}}\)）的传统认知，证明强局域化可同时压制两个通道，为探索晶体热导率极限提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理计算（具体泛函类型摘要未明确说明），结合声子玻尔兹曼输运方程（BTE）对粒子通道（\(κ_{\mathrm{L}}^{\mathrm{P}}\)）和相干隧穿通道（\(κ_{\mathrm{L}}^{\mathrm{C}}\)）进行分解计算。通过分析声子色散关系（平带特征）和群速度分量来揭示局域化机制。

papers.title: Representation Transitions Reveal Predictive Structure in Complex Systems: A Trajectory-Level Reconstruction in a Critical System
papers.abstract: Trajectories in complex systems often contain structure that is not captured by the population-averaged, scalar statistics traditionally used to describe them. Here we reconstruct, through independent numerical re-simulation rather than literature review, a systematic search across representational forms - from single scalar statistics, through two independent discrete multi-feature classification attempts, to a trajectory-level structural representation and a diagnostic surrogate test, to a continuous low-dimensional compression - applied to the same underlying trajectory ensemble in a critical complex system. Predictive failure is not explained by insufficient correlation: one discrete representation's own strongest individual feature correlates with the target more strongly ($r=0.588$) than the eventual successful representation's own headline statistic ($r=0.540$), yet fails to separate the ensemble's two most consequential cases - while the continuous representation succeeds, robustly, across eight independent scale-removal folds ($r=0.677$-$0.717$, all $p<0.001$). The determining factor was not correlation strength but whether the representation preserved the structure relevant to prediction. These results indicate that the choice of representation determines whether predictive structure in complex systems becomes accessible - a scientific variable in its own right, not a downstream analysis choice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数值模拟文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“independent numerical re-simulation”（独立数值重模拟），以及“eight independent scale-removal folds”（八次独立尺度移除交叉验证）等数值实验手段。；研究对象：一个临界复杂系统（critical complex system）中的轨迹系综（trajectory ensemble）。摘要未明确说明具体是何种物理体系（如自旋系统、流体、网络等），仅强调其“临界”属性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在复杂系统中，预测成功与否的决定性因素不是表征与目标之间的相关强度，而是表征是否保留了与预测相关的结构信息。即使某个离散表征的单个最强特征与目标的相关性（r=0.588）高于最终成功表征的头号统计量（r=0.540），它仍无法区分系综中两个最关键的案例；而连续低维表征则在八次独立尺度移除折叠中稳健成功（r=0.677–0.717，p<0.001）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在复杂系统中，预测成功与否的决定性因素不是表征与目标之间的相关强度，而是表征是否保留了与预测相关的结构信息。即使某个离散表征的单个最强特征与目标的相关性（r=0.588）高于最终成功表征的头号统计量（r=0.540），它仍无法区分系综中两个最关键的案例；而连续低维表征则在八次独立尺度移除折叠中稳健成功（r=0.677–0.717，p<0.001）。；创新点：将“表征选择”本身提升为影响复杂系统预测可及性的科学变量，而非下游分析选择。通过在同一轨迹系综上的系统对比，直接证明预测失败并非源于相关性不足，而是源于表征未能保留预测所需的结构信息。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 系统性地对同一轨迹系综进行多种表征形式的对比搜索，包括：单一标量统计量、两种独立的离散多特征分类尝试、轨迹级结构表征及诊断性替代测试（surrogate test）、连续低维压缩。通过独立数值重模拟（而非文献综述）进行重建，并采用八次独立尺度移除交叉验证评估预测稳健性。

papers.title: Magnetic contacts on freestanding superconducting LaAlO$_3$/SrTiO$_3$ micromembranes
papers.abstract: The superconducting two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG) at the LaAlO$_3$/SrTiO$_3$ (LAO-STO) interface is a promising platform for superconducting spintronics, however, integrating ferromagnetic contacts with the superconducting 2DEG remains challenging. Here, we realize superconducting LAO-STO micromembrane devices contacted by ferromagnetic nickel contacts through a side-contact geometry. Low-temperature transport measurements demonstrate that superconductivity is preserved in the presence of the ferromagnetic contacts. We show that the superconducting state is strongly influenced by the magnetic history of the nickel contacts, which generates a tunable effective magnetic field in the 2DEG. Through an effective field model, the magnetization of the contacts can be inferred from the maximum superconducting response. Our results establish ferromagnetically contacted LAO-STO as a platform for future investigations of spin injection into oxide superconductors and provide a route towards superconducting spintronic devices based on complex oxide interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Low-temperature transport measurements”（低温输运测量），属于实验手段。；研究对象：LaAlO₃/SrTiO₃（LAO-STO）界面处的超导二维电子气（2DEG），以及通过侧向接触方式集成的铁磁镍（Ni）接触。研究聚焦于超导2DEG与铁磁接触的复合体系及其超导态行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在铁磁镍接触下，LAO-STO微米膜的超导性得以保持，且超导态强烈受镍接触的磁历史影响，镍的磁化会在2DEG中产生可调的有效磁场，从而调控超导响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在铁磁镍接触下，LAO-STO微米膜的超导性得以保持，且超导态强烈受镍接触的磁历史影响，镍的磁化会在2DEG中产生可调的有效磁场，从而调控超导响应。；创新点：首次在LAO-STO超导微米膜上实现铁磁镍接触并保持超导性，建立了铁磁接触的LAO-STO平台，为未来向氧化物超导体注入自旋以及基于复杂氧化物界面的超导自旋电子学器件提供了可行路径。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异细节。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用侧向接触（side-contact）几何结构制备铁磁镍接触的超导LAO-STO微米膜器件，并进行低温输运测量。理论上通过有效磁场模型（effective field model）从最大超导响应推断接触的磁化强度。

papers.title: Localized orbitals and tunnel couplings from general confinement potentials in gate-defined quantum-dot arrays
papers.abstract: Efficient simulation of dense gate-defined multi-quantum-dot arrays requires accurate and scalable modeling methods, compatible with asymmetries and imperfections of realistic voltage-controlled confinement potentials. We present a numerical localization procedure that rotates the eigenbasis of a general one-particle effective orbital Hamiltonian into $s$-, $p$-, $d$-, $\ldots$-shells of localized orbital wavefunctions associated with individual quantum dots. The pairwise tunnel couplings between such states are computed directly as matrix elements of the Hamiltonian. We demonstrate this procedure on a 2D triangular Si-MOS triple-quantum-dot array by obtaining the voltage dependencies of the tunnel couplings and their distributions in the presence of disorder. We discuss the implications of this evaluation method on the many-body calculations, and relate it to the experimental tunnel coupling measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：numerical localization procedure、simulation、modeling methods。；研究对象：栅极定义的多量子点阵列，具体为二维三角形 Si-MOS 三量子点阵列中的局域轨道和隧穿耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种数值局域化方法，可将一般约束势下的一粒子有效轨道哈密顿量的本征基旋转为与单个量子点关联的 s、p、d…壳层局域轨道波函数，并直接以哈密顿量矩阵元计算态间隧穿耦合，从而在存在无序时获得隧穿耦合的电压依赖性和分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种数值局域化方法，可将一般约束势下的一粒子有效轨道哈密顿量的本征基旋转为与单个量子点关联的 s、p、d…壳层局域轨道波函数，并直接以哈密顿量矩阵元计算态间隧穿耦合，从而在存在无序时获得隧穿耦合的电压依赖性和分布。；创新点：该方法兼容真实电压控制约束势中的不对称性和缺陷，可扩展用于密集栅极定义多量子点阵列的高效模拟，并可直接关联多体计算与实验隧穿耦合测量。摘要未突出说明与既有局域化方案（如 Pipek-Mezey 或 Boys 局域化）的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 数值局域化方法：对一般一粒子有效轨道哈密顿量的本征基进行旋转（酉变换），得到各量子点的壳层局域轨道；隧穿耦合直接取为哈密顿量在这些局域态之间的矩阵元。演示体系为二维三角形 Si-MOS 三量子点阵列，并考虑了无序效应。

papers.title: Emergent Pair Density Wave and Incoherent Metallic State in a Strongly Correlated Doped System
papers.abstract: We investigate the dynamical emergence of a state driven by the interplay between antiferromagnetism (AFM) and singlet $d$-wave superconductivity (SC) within a slave-rotor mean-field framework. By decomposing the electron into charge and spin degrees of freedom, the formalism captures strong-correlation effects beyond conventional mean-field approaches. A PDW order is found to emerge dynamically in the coexistence region of AFM and SC. The AFM-SC coexistence region is significantly modified with correlation, leading to a systematic shift of the tetra-critical point. The doping and temperature evolution of the AFM, SC, and PDW order parameters, together with the rotor condensate amplitude $φ$, which characterizes charge coherence, shows a crossover from a coherent to an incoherent metal with the suppression of coherent quasi-particle spectral weight. Moreover, in the AFM + $(φ\neq 0)$ region, coherent quasi-particle bands coexist with incoherent Hubbard-like excitations, whereas only incoherent spectral features survive in the AFM + $(φ= 0)$ regime. The SC phase exhibits nodal quasi-particles consistent with $d$-wave pairing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“slave-rotor mean-field framework”（奴隶转子平均场框架）、“decomposing the electron into charge and spin degrees of freedom”（将电子分解为电荷和自旋自由度）等理论方法，属于强关联电子系统的解析/半解析理论建模。；研究对象：强关联掺杂系统中反铁磁（AFM）与单态d波超导（SC）共存区域内的物理现象，特别是动态涌现的配对密度波（PDW）态以及金属态相干性的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在反铁磁与d波超导的共存区域内，系统会动态涌现出配对密度波（PDW）序；同时，随着关联效应增强，系统表现出从相干金属到非相干金属的渡越，伴随准粒子谱权重的抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在反铁磁与d波超导的共存区域内，系统会动态涌现出配对密度波（PDW）序；同时，随着关联效应增强，系统表现出从相干金属到非相干金属的渡越，伴随准粒子谱权重的抑制。；创新点：在奴隶转子框架下，首次动态（而非人为预设）地揭示了AFM与SC共存区内PDW序的涌现，并系统展示了强关联效应如何显著修正AFM-SC共存相图及四临界点的位置。此外，该工作明确区分了AFM+（φ≠0）区域中相干准粒子带与非相干Hubbard类激发的共存，以及AFM+（φ=0）区域中仅存非相干谱特征的物理图像。
papers.method_zh: 采用奴隶转子平均场理论（slave-rotor mean-field theory）。该方法将电子算符分解为电荷（转子）和自旋（自旋子）自由度，从而在平均场层面捕获超出常规平均场近似的强关联效应。具体分析了AFM、SC、PDW序参量以及转子凝聚振幅φ（表征电荷相干性）随掺杂和温度的变化。

papers.title: Active embracement enables autonomous tweezing in active star polymers
papers.abstract: The capacity for autonomous structural reconfiguration is a defining trait of living systems, yet it remains elusive in artificial active matter. Here, we report the discovery of active embracement, a non-equilibrium phenomenon where active star polymers, comprising a central core and self-propelled monomeric arms, transition from open configurations to tightly collapsed, ``hugging'' states. By combining polymer experiments using connected vibrobots with simulations, we demonstrate that internal self-propulsion fundamentally overrides the steric repulsion that keeps passive polymers dispersed. This active drive enables a suite of behaviors unattainable in equilibrium systems: individual star polymers undergo a globular-like self-collapse, multiple star polymers mutually intertwine and mutually embrace, and can spontaneously embrace and capture surrounding passive particles. Our findings reveal that active embracement is a distinct kinetic phase that allows star polymers to function as autonomous tweezers. By bridging the gap between macroscopic robotic collectives and microscopic polymer physics, this work provides a versatile blueprint for the design of smart materials capable of targeted cargo capture and self-directed assembly in complex environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“combining polymer experiments using connected vibrobots with simulations”。；研究对象：活性星形聚合物（active star polymers），即由中心核心和自驱动单体臂组成的聚合物体系，以及其非平衡“活性拥抱”（active embracement）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性星形聚合物在内部自驱动作用下，会从开放构型转变为紧密塌缩的“拥抱”态，并能够自发相互缠绕、拥抱，甚至捕获周围被动粒子，从而充当自主“光学镊子”式的智能抓手。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性星形聚合物在内部自驱动作用下，会从开放构型转变为紧密塌缩的“拥抱”态，并能够自发相互缠绕、拥抱，甚至捕获周围被动粒子，从而充当自主“光学镊子”式的智能抓手。；创新点：首次发现并命名“活性拥抱”（active embracement）这一非平衡动力学相，证明内部自推进可克服被动聚合物中维持分散的位阻排斥，实现平衡态无法达到的自塌缩、互缠和自主捕获被动粒子等功能，为设计可定向货物捕获和自组装智能材料提供了新原理。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用连接式振动机器人（connected vibrobots）构建宏观聚合物模型；数值上采用模拟方法（摘要未明确说明具体模拟技术，如分子动力学或布朗动力学）。两者结合研究活性聚合物的构象转变与集体行为。

papers.title: Harnessing the skyrmion Hall effect for low-power skyrmion transport in a tubular synthetic antiferromagnet
papers.abstract: We show that optimal control can turn the skyrmion Hall effect from a source of typically unwanted transverse motion into a mechanism for reducing Ohmic losses in skyrmion transport. We consider a pair of antiferromagnetically coupled skyrmions confined to a tubular geometry, where their relative transverse displacement becomes a periodic internal coordinate. The skyrmion Hall effect drives this coordinate, while finite interlayer coupling makes the resulting relation between applied current and longitudinal velocity nonlinear, allowing different current protocols to produce the same prescribed average velocity. We determine which of these protocols minimizes Joule heating. Depending on the interlayer coupling and spin-transfer-torque parameters, the optimal current is either constant, with the skyrmion pair maintaining a fixed relative position, or time dependent, with the pair undergoing periodic relative motion around the tube. In either case, the additional internal degree of freedom created by the skyrmion Hall effect and interlayer coupling enables skyrmion transport at a lower power than in the uncoupled limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“optimal control”“show that”“determine which protocols”等理论分析与优化计算表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：管状合成反铁磁（tubular synthetic antiferromagnet）中一对反铁磁耦合的斯格明子（skyrmion pair），以及由斯格明子霍尔效应驱动的输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过最优控制，可将斯格明子霍尔效应从通常导致横向漂移的有害效应转变为降低焦耳热损耗的机制：在管状几何中，相对横向位移成为周期性内禀坐标，层间耦合使电流-速度关系非线性化，从而存在多种电流协议可实现同一平均速度，其中最优协议（恒定或时变）能以比无耦合极限更低的功率驱动斯格明子输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过最优控制，可将斯格明子霍尔效应从通常导致横向漂移的有害效应转变为降低焦耳热损耗的机制：在管状几何中，相对横向位移成为周期性内禀坐标，层间耦合使电流-速度关系非线性化，从而存在多种电流协议可实现同一平均速度，其中最优协议（恒定或时变）能以比无耦合极限更低的功率驱动斯格明子输运。；创新点：将斯格明子霍尔效应从“需要抑制的横向运动”重新定义为可利用的内禀自由度，结合管状几何与层间耦合，实现低功耗输运。摘要未突出说明与具体材料体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与最优控制分析。具体包括：考虑反铁磁层间耦合的斯格明子对在管状几何中的动力学方程，引入自旋转移力矩（spin-transfer-torque）参数，对电流协议进行变分/优化以最小化焦耳热（Joule heating），并比较恒定电流与时变电流两种方案。

papers.title: High-Field Terahertz Spin Resonance in Cr$_2$O$_3$ above the Spin-Flop Transition
papers.abstract: We report single-shot terahertz time-domain spectroscopy of Cr$_2$O$_3$ in pulsed magnetic fields up to 30 T. Well above the spin-flop field, in the 20-30 T range, the resonance frequency exhibits a nearly linear field dependence with a slope of ~22 GHz/T, smaller than the 28 GHz/T reported from low-field measurements. This reduction is insensitive to temperature and to a 15° field tilt, suggesting an intrinsic high-field property.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“单发太赫兹时域光谱”“脉冲磁场”等实验手段。；研究对象：Cr₂O₃（铬氧化物）在自旋翻转转变以上的高场太赫兹自旋共振行为，具体涉及20–30 T脉冲磁场下的自旋动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在20–30 T高场区间（远高于自旋翻转场），Cr₂O₃的自旋共振频率随磁场近似线性增加，斜率为~22 GHz/T，明显低于低场测量报道的28 GHz/T；该斜率降低对温度和15°磁场倾斜不敏感，表明其是材料固有的高场性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在20–30 T高场区间（远高于自旋翻转场），Cr₂O₃的自旋共振频率随磁场近似线性增加，斜率为~22 GHz/T，明显低于低场测量报道的28 GHz/T；该斜率降低对温度和15°磁场倾斜不敏感，表明其是材料固有的高场性质。；创新点：首次在远高于自旋翻转场的脉冲高场区间（20–30 T）直接测量Cr₂O₃的自旋共振，发现共振斜率从低场的28 GHz/T降至~22 GHz/T，且该变化具有温度与倾斜角不敏感性，揭示了一种此前未报道的高场固有特性。
papers.method_zh: 单发太赫兹时域光谱（single-shot terahertz time-domain spectroscopy），结合最高达30 T的脉冲磁场，并进行了变温和磁场倾斜角（15°）的对照实验。

papers.title: Phase Diagram and Critical Behaviour of the Two-Dimensional Potts Model with Long-Range Quenched Disorder
papers.abstract: We study the phase diagram and critical properties of the $q = 3$ and $q = 8$ Potts models with spatially correlated disorder governed by a power-law decay with exponent $a$. Building on the phase diagram proposed by Chippari et al. [3], where a transition from finite-disorder to infinite-disorder fixed points was identified as a function of a, we refine this picture by using wrapping probabilities of Fortuin-Kasteleyn clusters. Furthermore, using magnetic observables, we clarify the physical origin of the double-peak structure in the magnetic susceptibility and establish the validity of the hyper-scaling relation across all investigated regimes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“wrapping probabilities of Fortuin-Kasteleyn clusters”（数值模拟中的渗流观测量）以及“magnetic observables”（磁学观测量），属于蒙特卡洛数值模拟与标度分析。；研究对象：二维 q=3 和 q=8 Potts 模型，并引入具有幂律衰减（指数 a）的空间关联淬火无序。研究体系为经典统计力学中的自旋模型，关注其相图与临界行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作细化了 Chippari 等人提出的相图，明确了随无序关联指数 a 变化时从有限无序固定点到无限无序固定点的转变；同时通过磁学观测量澄清了磁化率双峰结构的物理起源，并验证了在所有研究参数区间内超标度关系的有效性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作细化了 Chippari 等人提出的相图，明确了随无序关联指数 a 变化时从有限无序固定点到无限无序固定点的转变；同时通过磁学观测量澄清了磁化率双峰结构的物理起源，并验证了在所有研究参数区间内超标度关系的有效性。；创新点：在已有相图框架（Chippari 等人提出）基础上，利用包裹概率这一几何观测量对相图进行了更精细的刻画；首次（或更明确地）从磁学观测量角度解释了磁化率双峰结构的物理来源，并系统验证了超标度关系在无序 Potts 模型中的普适性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟方法，具体为基于 Fortuin-Kasteleyn 团簇的包裹概率（wrapping probabilities）分析，以及磁学观测量（如磁化率）的有限尺寸标度分析。摘要未明确说明具体算法（如 Wolff 簇算法或 Sweeny 算法），但属于蒙特卡洛框架。

papers.title: Magnetic Field-Tunable Repulsive Exciton-Exciton Interaction in the van der Waals Antiferromagnet NiPS$_3$
papers.abstract: Two ultra-narrow absorption peaks around 1.5 eV, which are widely believed to originate from a transition from a spin-orbital entangled triplet to a singlet state, in the two-dimensional van der Waals crystal NiPS$_3$, have attracted considerable attention because of their pronounced spin-dependent character. An interesting question is whether ultrahigh magnetic fields modify an interaction-driven hybridization between those two peaks. In this work we perform systematic magneto-optical measurements of NiPS$_3$ in pulsed magnetic fields of up to 178 T and observe a pronounced mutual repulsion between the two sharp exciton peaks accompanied by a redistribution of oscillator strength, while the band edge shows no detectable field-induced shift within our experimental resolution. We construct a minimal two-level interaction model and compare it semi-quantitatively with the experimental data. Our results reveal a magnetic-field-tunable exciton-exciton coupling as the dominant high-field response of NiPS$_3$, and clarify this material as a new experimental platform for exploring strongly correlated exciton physics in magnetic van der Waals insulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“magneto-optical measurements”“pulsed magnetic fields”“experimental data”等实验关键词，并辅以理论建模对比。；研究对象：二维范德华反铁磁材料 NiPS₃，具体研究其约 1.5 eV 处两个超窄吸收峰（自旋-轨道纠缠三重态到单重态的跃迁）在超高磁场下的行为，以及激子-激子相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高达 178 T 的脉冲磁场下，NiPS₃ 中两个尖锐激子峰之间出现显著的相互排斥（mutual repulsion），并伴随振子强度的重新分布，而带边在实验分辨率内无场致移动。这表明磁场可调谐的激子-激子耦合是该材料在高场下的主导响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高达 178 T 的脉冲磁场下，NiPS₃ 中两个尖锐激子峰之间出现显著的相互排斥（mutual repulsion），并伴随振子强度的重新分布，而带边在实验分辨率内无场致移动。这表明磁场可调谐的激子-激子耦合是该材料在高场下的主导响应。；创新点：首次在超高磁场（178 T）下揭示 NiPS₃ 中激子峰之间的磁场可调谐排斥性相互作用，并将该材料确立为研究磁性范德华绝缘体中强关联激子物理的新实验平台。摘要未突出说明与以往更低场实验的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 系统性的磁光测量（magneto-optical measurements），使用脉冲磁场最高达 178 T；同时构建了一个最小二能级相互作用模型（minimal two-level interaction model），并与实验数据进行半定量比较。

papers.title: Competition between on-site and off-site pairing phases and surface spectra in superconducting wallpaper fermion systems
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate the competition between on-site and off-site pairings in superconducting topological crystalline insulators hosting wallpaper fermions, a class of surface states protected by nonsymmorphic symmetries. In-plane nearest-neighbor pair hopping stabilizes the $\mathrm{A_{1u}}$ phase, while off-site pairing channels yield additional dominant phases with $\mathrm{B_{2u}}$ and $\mathrm{E_u}$ representations. We further show that the $\mathrm{B_{2u}}$ pairing state supports the hybridization between wallpaper-fermion spectra themselves, whereas a representative time-reversal-invariant nematic $\mathrm{E_u}$ state exhibits spectral hybridization between wallpaper fermion and double Majorana Kramers pairs, yielding twisted surface energy spectra. These results demonstrate that the twisted dispersions arising from hybridization phenomena persist in the presence of off-site pairing interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“theoretically investigate”“We further show”等理论分析表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：超导拓扑晶体绝缘体中的壁纸费米子表面态，具体研究其超导配对通道（on-site与off-site配对）之间的竞争，以及由此产生的表面能谱结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 面内最近邻配对跳跃稳定A₁ᵤ相，而off-site配对通道可产生B₂ᵤ和Eᵤ表示的主导相；B₂ᵤ配对态支持壁纸费米子谱之间的杂化，而时间反演不变的向列Eᵤ态则导致壁纸费米子与双Majorana Kramers对之间的谱杂化，形成扭曲的表面能谱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：面内最近邻配对跳跃稳定A₁ᵤ相，而off-site配对通道可产生B₂ᵤ和Eᵤ表示的主导相；B₂ᵤ配对态支持壁纸费米子谱之间的杂化，而时间反演不变的向列Eᵤ态则导致壁纸费米子与双Majorana Kramers对之间的谱杂化，形成扭曲的表面能谱。；创新点：首次揭示off-site配对通道在壁纸费米子体系中可稳定B₂ᵤ和Eᵤ等非常规配对相，并证明由杂化引起的扭曲色散在存在off-site配对相互作用时依然存在。摘要未突出说明与具体材料体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于非对称空间群保护的壁纸费米子表面态，结合超导配对对称性分类（A₁ᵤ、B₂ᵤ、Eᵤ等不可约表示）和配对通道竞争分析，研究表面谱的杂化行为。

papers.title: From Freezing to Terminal Packing: A Puzzle and a Paradox
papers.abstract: A density-functional theory developed for equilibrium freezing also produces a high-density endpoint close to terminal packing. We revisit the nonlinear Ramakrishnan--Yussouff bifurcation framework and distinguish the first crystalline fold, thermodynamic coexistence, and terminal marginality. At the terminal point, the grand-potential curvature vanishes along the principal finite-wavevector density mode, exactly when the nonlinear self-consistency equation loses stiffness. The construction gives exact close packing for one-dimensional hard rods, a terminal hard-disk packing fraction near 0.8407, and a hard-sphere value near 0.629, close to random close packing. These results identify a finite-wavevector thermodynamic marginality of a metastable liquid continuation, rather than equilibrium freezing or mechanical jamming, and expose a persistent puzzle: why should liquid-state correlations encode the approach to terminal disordered packing across different physical dimensions and systems?
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“density-functional theory”（密度泛函理论）、“bifurcation framework”（分岔框架）以及“self-consistency equation”（自洽方程），属于纯理论推导与数值求解。；研究对象：经典液体的结晶与终端堆积（terminal packing）问题，具体体系包括一维硬杆、二维硬圆盘和三维硬球，关注从平衡凝固到无序密堆积（如随机密堆积）的过渡行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该密度泛函理论在终端堆积点处，大势（grand potential）沿有限波矢密度模式的曲率消失，且非线性自洽方程失去刚度，表明终端堆积对应亚稳液体延续的有限波矢热力学边缘性（marginality），而非平衡凝固或力学堵塞。硬圆盘终端堆积分数约为0.8407，硬球约为0.629（接近随机密堆积）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该密度泛函理论在终端堆积点处，大势（grand potential）沿有限波矢密度模式的曲率消失，且非线性自洽方程失去刚度，表明终端堆积对应亚稳液体延续的有限波矢热力学边缘性（marginality），而非平衡凝固或力学堵塞。硬圆盘终端堆积分数约为0.8407，硬球约为0.629（接近随机密堆积）。；创新点：首次将终端无序堆积识别为有限波矢热力学边缘性（而非机械堵塞），并揭示液体态关联函数编码跨维度、跨体系接近终端无序堆积的普适性——这一“谜题”是摘要强调的核心新视角。
papers.method_zh: 采用Ramakrishnan–Yussouff非线性分岔框架，重新审视平衡凝固的密度泛函理论，区分第一结晶折叠、热力学共存与终端边缘性；通过求解非线性自洽方程获得终端堆积密度，并对一维硬杆给出精确结果。

papers.title: Evaluating a 4B open-weights local LLM for agentic DFT workflows: a literature reproducibility audit
papers.abstract: Agentic workflows in materials science relying on hosted commercial models face severe reproducibility, economic, and data-privacy constraints. To explore fully local agentic science, this work evaluates an open-weights Qwen3:4B model executing an autonomous scientific pipeline across varying hardware constraints. Applied to pentagonal two-dimensional materials, the system extracts parameters from unstructured text, translates them into density functional theory (DFT) inputs, and drives simulations to convergence under a strict neurosymbolic architecture where agents propose and deterministic code disposes. The workflow is guarded by verbatim text grounding and multi-pass inference unions to counteract hardware-induced structural collapse. Evaluated against 201 expert judgements, the extractor achieves 95.7% precision (95% CI 90.3-98.1%) and 67.3% recall (59.8-74.0%), ensuring extracted parameters are strictly factual. However, precision identifying absent parameters does not exceed 47.0%, establishing that the measured omission rate constitutes a loose upper bound on true literature incompleteness. Across three hardware configurations, complete GPU residency governs extraction quality more fundamentally than weight or cache precision, raising Matthews correlation from 0.414 to 0.530 at fixed quantisation and to 0.560 with an unquantised cache. A corpus-scale audit indicates only 19 (33.3%) of the 57 studies are reproducible in principle, reporting every method parameter needed to re-initialise the calculation. Driven to convergence, the workflow reproduces published lattice constants with a mean absolute relative error of 2.3% where the relaxed structure retains its prototype, establishing that lightweight open-weights models can reliably drive autonomous agentic workflows when bounded by deterministic code gates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法学文章。关键词：agentic workflows、density functional theory (DFT) inputs、drives simulations to convergence、neurosymbolic architecture。；研究对象：五边形二维材料（pentagonal two-dimensional materials），以及基于开放权重大语言模型（Qwen3:4B）的自主材料科学工作流本身。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在严格神经符号架构（智能体提议、确定性代码裁决）约束下，轻量级开放权重模型（4B参数）可可靠驱动DFT自主工作流；参数提取精度达95.7%，但召回率仅67.3%；对57篇文献的审计表明仅33.3%的研究在原则上可复现，且可复现案例中晶格常数的平均绝对相对误差为2.3%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在严格神经符号架构（智能体提议、确定性代码裁决）约束下，轻量级开放权重模型（4B参数）可可靠驱动DFT自主工作流；参数提取精度达95.7%，但召回率仅67.3%；对57篇文献的审计表明仅33.3%的研究在原则上可复现，且可复现案例中晶格常数的平均绝对相对误差为2.3%。；创新点：首次系统评估超轻量级（4B参数）开放权重本地LLM在完全本地化（无商业API依赖）条件下执行端到端DFT自主工作流的可行性与可复现性，并揭示硬件配置（GPU完全驻留）比权重/缓存精度更根本地决定提取质量。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用Qwen3:4B开放权重模型执行自主科学管线：从非结构化文本提取参数→转换为DFT输入→驱动模拟至收敛。架构为神经符号混合（agents propose, deterministic code disposes），辅以逐字文本锚定（verbatim text grounding）和多遍推理并集（multi-pass inference unions）以对抗硬件引起的结构坍缩。评估基于201个专家判断，并在三种硬件配置下对比量化/缓存精度对提取质量的影响。

papers.title: Solid and Quasi-Solid Electrolytes for Zinc Batteries: Balancing Water Activity, Ion Transport, and Interfaces
papers.abstract: Zinc batteries offer a compelling route to safe and low-cost energy storage, yet their reliance on aqueous electrolytes promotes hydrogen evolution, corrosion, cathode dissolution, and non-uniform zinc deposition. Replacing the liquid with a solid or quasi-solid electrolyte can suppress these processes, but it also removes the medium that enables rapid Zn2+ transport and conformal electrode contact. This tension, the price of removing water, has been obscured by inconsistent use of the term solid state and by comparisons based largely on bulk ionic conductivity. Here we critically examine zinc electrolytes across a continuum from water-rich hydrogels to dry polymers, solvated crystals, and inorganic conductors. We distinguish water content from thermodynamic water activity and classify these materials according to phase state, mobile-solvent fraction, and dominant transport mechanism. We show that neither high conductivity nor nominally water-free composition reliably predicts cell performance: electrolyte thickness, Zn2+ transference, interfacial resistance, and evolving contact often determine the practical outcome. Controlled-solvation and hybrid electrolytes therefore provide the most credible near-term path, whereas genuinely solvent-free Zn2+ conductors remain a longer-term scientific target. Progress will require transparent reporting of solvent state and validation using thin electrolytes, realistic electrode loadings, limited zinc excess, and calendar-life testing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（综述/批判性评述文章）。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“critically examine”“classify”“show”等表述，属于对已有研究体系的系统分析与观点性总结，而非单一实验或计算研究。；研究对象：锌电池中的固态与准固态电解质，具体涵盖水凝胶、干态聚合物、溶剂化晶体、无机导体等材料体系，核心物理现象为水活度、离子输运、界面行为及其对电池性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高离子电导率或标称无水组成并不能可靠预测锌电池实际性能；电解质厚度、Zn²⁺迁移数、界面电阻及接触演化往往决定最终结果。可控溶剂化与杂化电解质是近期最可行的路径，而真正无溶剂的Zn²⁺导体仍是长期科学目标。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高离子电导率或标称无水组成并不能可靠预测锌电池实际性能；电解质厚度、Zn²⁺迁移数、界面电阻及接触演化往往决定最终结果。可控溶剂化与杂化电解质是近期最可行的路径，而真正无溶剂的Zn²⁺导体仍是长期科学目标。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可看出其新意在于：明确区分“水含量”与“热力学水活度”两个概念，并指出当前“固态”术语使用不一致及仅以体相离子电导率作为比较标准的误区，提出以实际电池工况（薄电解质、真实电极负载、有限锌过量、日历寿命测试）为验证基准。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段或计算框架，属于对已有文献数据的批判性分析与分类整理，依据相态、可移动溶剂分数、主导输运机制等维度对电解质体系进行系统分类。

papers.title: Extreme Polarization of the Optical Gap and High-Energy Exciton Landscape in CrSBr
papers.abstract: We reveal a strongly anisotropic excitonic landscape in monolayer and bulk-like CrSBr using optical absorption spectroscopy and $GW$-Bethe-Salpeter equation $\textit{ab initio}$ calculations. The direct absorptive determination of the lowest bright optical onsets i.e. $X_0^a$ and $X_0^b$ excitons for the two in-plane polarization eigenaxes yield an in-plane optical gap anisotropy of $470 \pm 15$ meV. This is the highest observed value for any material in the near-infrared-to-visible spectral region to the best of our knowledge. Energetically above, we identify multiple strongly polarized excitons spanning $1.25$ eV to $3.1$ eV selectively aligned along the two orthogonal axes. A resonance $X^-$, located $24$ meV below the $X_0^b$ progressively transfers oscillator strength to $X_b^0$, a behavior consistent with a coupled trion (Fermi-polarion)/exciton pair. Our experiments also provide polarization-resolved broadband dielectric functions of CrSBr. These results establish CrSBr as a strongly polarization-selective excitonic system and highlight its potential for polarization-selective optoelectronics enabled with its large optical-gap anisotropy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时提到“optical absorption spectroscopy”（实验手段）和“$GW$-Bethe-Salpeter equation $\textit{ab initio}$ calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：层状磁性半导体CrSBr（单层及类体相），具体研究其激子（exciton）的各向异性光学响应，包括光学带隙、高能激子能级以及激子-三子耦合行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CrSBr在面内两个正交偏振方向上表现出高达470 ± 15 meV的光学带隙各向异性，这是近红外至可见光波段已知材料中的最高值；同时，在1.25 eV至3.1 eV能量范围内存在多个强偏振选择的激子态，并观察到与Fermi-polaron行为一致的三子/激子耦合共振。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CrSBr在面内两个正交偏振方向上表现出高达470 ± 15 meV的光学带隙各向异性，这是近红外至可见光波段已知材料中的最高值；同时，在1.25 eV至3.1 eV能量范围内存在多个强偏振选择的激子态，并观察到与Fermi-polaron行为一致的三子/激子耦合共振。；创新点：首次直接通过吸收光谱确定了CrSBr两个面内偏振本征轴对应的最低亮激子（$X_0^a$和$X_0^b$），并揭示了其创纪录的面内光学带隙各向异性（470 meV量级），同时系统表征了高能区多个强偏振激子态及三子/激子耦合行为，确立了CrSBr作为强偏振选择性激子体系的地位。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用偏振分辨的光学吸收光谱（polarization-resolved optical absorption spectroscopy），并提取了宽带介电函数；理论上采用$GW$近似结合Bethe-Salpeter方程（$GW$-BSE）的第一性原理计算方法。

papers.title: Vibrational Origin of the Barocaloric Effect in the Spin-Crossover Complex Fe(pap-5NO2)2: A Combined DFT and Mean-Field Study
papers.abstract: Despite the barocaloric performance recently reported for the spin-crossover complex Fe(pap-5NO2)2, the microscopic origin of its pressure-induced entropy change remains poorly understood. In particular, the relative contributions of vibrational, configurational, and spin degrees of freedom to the barocaloric response have not yet been quantitatively established. Here, we develop a theoretical framework that combines density functional theory (DFT) calculations with an effective mean field Hamiltonian to investigate the barocaloric effect in this spin-crossover complex. Vibrational frequencies of the low-spin (S = 0) and high-spin (S = 2) states obtained from first-principles calculations are incorporated into a thermodynamic model that explicitly accounts for configurational, spin, and lattice entropy contributions. By establishing a correspondence between the vibrational spectra of both spin states through displacement-vector overlap analysis, we identify low and mid frequency metal-ligand vibrations as the primary microscopic origin of the vibrational entropy change. The proposed model quantitatively reproduces the experimentally reported barocaloric entropy change for a pressure variation of 2 kbar, corresponding to a maximum reversible entropy change of approximately 70 J kg-1 K-1, and predicts a spin-crossover temperature of T_1/2 = 313 K under ambient pressure, in excellent agreement with the experimental value of 308 K. Analysis of the entropy components reveals that lattice entropy associated with molecular vibrations accounts for approximately 84% of the total barocaloric response, whereas configurational and spin contributions are comparatively small.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合型文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“combines density functional theory (DFT) calculations with an effective mean field Hamiltonian”，属于第一性原理计算加理论建模。；研究对象：自旋交叉配合物 Fe(pap-5NO2)2 的压卡效应（barocaloric effect），具体关注其压力诱导熵变的微观起源，以及振动、构型与自旋自由度对压卡响应的相对贡献。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该配合物压卡效应的主要微观来源是低、中频金属-配体振动模式，晶格振动熵贡献约占压卡总响应的84%；模型定量复现了2 kbar压力变化下约70 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹的最大可逆熵变，并预测环境压力下自旋交叉温度 T₁/₂ = 313 K，与实验值308 K高度吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该配合物压卡效应的主要微观来源是低、中频金属-配体振动模式，晶格振动熵贡献约占压卡总响应的84%；模型定量复现了2 kbar压力变化下约70 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹的最大可逆熵变，并预测环境压力下自旋交叉温度 T₁/₂ = 313 K，与实验值308 K高度吻合。；创新点：首次定量区分了振动、构型和自旋自由度对 Fe(pap-5NO2)2 压卡效应的相对贡献，并利用位移矢量重叠分析从微观振动谱层面识别出压卡效应的振动起源，建立了从第一性原理振动数据到宏观压卡热力学量的定量桥梁。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算获得低自旋（S=0）和高自旋（S=2）态的振动频率；通过位移矢量重叠分析建立两自旋态振动谱的对应关系；将第一性原理振动数据嵌入包含构型熵、自旋熵和晶格熵的有效平均场哈密顿量热力学模型。

papers.title: PINN-Phase: A physics-informed neural network for curvature-driven multiphase-field evolution
papers.abstract: Phase-field simulation of polycrystalline microstructures becomes costly when many related cases must be evolved over long times. We introduce PINN-Phase, a physics-informed neural time integrator that advances the full multiphase field from its initial condition and enforces phase bounds and unit sum at every step; on the reported explicit multiphase-field benchmarks, post-initial-condition reference states serve only for evaluation. Without case-specific tuning, a single trained 25-grain model meets all predefined criteria in seven of eight unseen microstructures fixed before evaluation and in both stress cases, with 0.94-3.71% terminal grain-label disagreement across the ten cases. Each 12,000-step rollout takes about 5.2 min on a single GPU and reaches nearly three times the temporal horizon represented during training. A pre-registered 64-grain model reaches 6.09% disagreement, retaining all 21 reference survivors plus one additional grain; a post-evaluation continuation with a doubled training horizon and 25 additional epochs reaches 3.97% and the exact survivor set. In three dimensions, one trained 16-grain 96^3 model recovers the exact terminal active set and all three extinction identities in six of six unseen microstructures, five of which meet the complete predefined qualification. These results demonstrate structurally admissible long-horizon prediction and prospective initial-condition transfer within fixed benchmark families.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：physics-informed neural network、neural time integrator、multiphase-field simulation。；研究对象：多晶微结构的多相场（multiphase-field）演化，具体涉及二维（25晶粒、64晶粒）和三维（16晶粒，96³网格）多晶体系，以及应力作用下的晶粒演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: PINN-Phase 神经网络时间积分器能够在无需逐案例调参的情况下，对未见过的初始微结构进行长时程多相场演化预测，在二维和三维基准测试中均能准确恢复终态活性晶粒集合及灭绝事件，且外推时间跨度接近训练时程的三倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：PINN-Phase 神经网络时间积分器能够在无需逐案例调参的情况下，对未见过的初始微结构进行长时程多相场演化预测，在二维和三维基准测试中均能准确恢复终态活性晶粒集合及灭绝事件，且外推时间跨度接近训练时程的三倍。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与传统数值求解器或已有 PINN 方案的具体差异，但明确体现了以下新意：无需案例特定调参即可实现跨初始条件的迁移预测；通过硬约束保证每一步的结构可容许性（相界与单位总和）；在三维体系中实现了精确的灭绝身份恢复和终态活性集预测。
