papers.method_zh: 物理信息神经网络（PINN）时间积分器，在每一步强制满足相场的有界性（phase bounds）和单位总和约束（unit sum）；训练后直接用于从初始条件推进完整多相场，参考态仅用于评估。训练在单个 GPU 上进行，12,000 步 rollout 约需 5.2 分钟。

papers.title: Controlling Intertwined Electronic Orders in FeSe with Exfoliation
papers.abstract: Controlling intertwined electronic orders in two-dimensional superconductors offers an effective route to answering fundamental questions and engineering new quantum devices. However, tuning the balance between competing orders typically requires complex chemistry, strain, or interface engineering. Here, we show that a pristine alternative is the dimensional reduction of the unconventional superconductor FeSe. Exfoliation suppresses the bulk electronic nematic response and switches the superconducting symmetry from bulk s-wave to d-wave-dominant. Transport, electron microscopy, and Raman spectroscopy establish the substantial weakening of nematic order in thin flakes. To probe superconductivity, we perform angle-dependent Andreev reflection spectroscopy on pristine crystal edges. As the junction's orientation is rotated, the spectra evolve from zero-energy bound states to coherence peaks. The injection angle, field, and temperature dependence, along with theoretical modeling, confirm that exfoliation switches the superconducting symmetry. Our results suggest a versatile superconducting platform for engineering quantum orders and provide fresh insights into the underlying pairing mechanisms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到 transport（输运）、electron microscopy（电子显微镜）、Raman spectroscopy（拉曼光谱）、Andreev reflection spectroscopy（安德烈夫反射谱）等实验手段，并结合理论建模。；研究对象：二维超导体 FeSe（铁硒）薄片，具体研究其剥离（exfoliation）后电子向列序（nematic order）与超导配对对称性之间的相互关联与调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过机械剥离实现 FeSe 的维度降低，可显著抑制体相电子向列响应，并将超导配对对称性从体相的 s 波转变为 d 波主导。这一发现提供了一种无需化学掺杂、应变或界面工程即可调控竞争电子序的“纯净”途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过机械剥离实现 FeSe 的维度降低，可显著抑制体相电子向列响应，并将超导配对对称性从体相的 s 波转变为 d 波主导。这一发现提供了一种无需化学掺杂、应变或界面工程即可调控竞争电子序的“纯净”途径。；创新点：提出“维度降低”（dimensional reduction）作为一种无需复杂化学或应变工程即可调控二维超导体中相互交织电子序的通用策略，并首次在 FeSe 中通过剥离实现超导对称性从 s 波到 d 波主导的切换。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 输运测量（transport）、电子显微镜（electron microscopy）、拉曼光谱（Raman spectroscopy）用于表征向列序的减弱；角度依赖的安德烈夫反射谱（angle-dependent Andreev reflection spectroscopy）在 pristine 晶体边缘进行，结合注入角、磁场和温度依赖的测量以及理论建模，确定超导配对对称性。

papers.title: Dynamical backaction in nanoscale superfluid electromechanics
papers.abstract: Nanofluidic acoustic resonators employing superfluid $^4$He can be used to study quantized vortices from collective behavior in two-dimensional superfluid turbulence down to few individual vortices created by rotation. In order to improve sensitivity to the level needed for probing individual quantized vortices, readout mechanisms employing optomechanical or optomechanics-inspired approaches seem to be promising in this regard. In this work, we develop an electromechanical system, which couples a 4$^\mathrm{th}$ sound acoustic resonance to a superconducting LC tank circuit in a sideband-resolved regime. Using this system, we demonstrate electromechanically induced transparency (EMIT), optical spring effect and optomechanical sideband damping and amplification. Furthermore, by rotating the cryostat, we demonstrate sensitivity to quantized vortices, which can become trapped and released in avalanche-like process inside the nanofluidic volume.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了搭建系统、演示效应（EMIT、光学弹簧效应、边带阻尼与放大）以及旋转低温恒温器进行测量，属于实验工作。；研究对象：纳米流体超流⁴He声学谐振器与超导LC谐振回路耦合的电机系统；具体物理现象包括第四声学声子与微波腔的边带耦合、超流氦中量子涡旋的俘获与雪崩式释放。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在边带可分辨区域实现了超流⁴He纳米流体声学谐振器与超导LC电路的机电耦合，演示了机电诱导透明、光学弹簧效应以及边带阻尼/放大；并通过旋转实验展示了该系统对量子涡旋的灵敏度，观察到涡旋在纳米流道内以雪崩过程俘获和释放。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在边带可分辨区域实现了超流⁴He纳米流体声学谐振器与超导LC电路的机电耦合，演示了机电诱导透明、光学弹簧效应以及边带阻尼/放大；并通过旋转实验展示了该系统对量子涡旋的灵敏度，观察到涡旋在纳米流道内以雪崩过程俘获和释放。；创新点：将光力学（optomechanics）启发的边带读出方案应用于超流⁴He纳米流体声学系统，实现了对单个或少量量子涡旋敏感的电机械读出，为探测单个量子涡旋提供了新途径。（摘要未突出说明其他创新点）
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用超流⁴He第四声学声子谐振器与超导LC谐振回路耦合，工作在边带可分辨区域；通过透射谱测量演示EMIT和边带效应；利用旋转低温恒温器引入涡旋，监测涡旋俘获/释放过程。

papers.title: Elastic properties of amorphous LiTaCl$_6$ solid-state electrolyte
papers.abstract: Amorphous solid-state electrolytes are attractive candidates for safe, high-energy-density all-solid-state batteries, yet their mechanical properties remain poorly understood from a computational perspective. Here, we investigate the elastic behavior of the recently discovered amorphous superionic Li-ion conductor LiTaCl$_6$ using density-functional-theory (DFT)-based methods, including unrelaxed static, relaxed static, and strain fluctuations from molecular dynamics (MD) simulations in the isobaric--isothermal (NPT) ensemble with DFT-trained machine-learning force fields (MLFFs). While the unrelaxed static method predicts a Young's modulus an order of magnitude higher than the experiment, the relaxed static method---commonly applied to crystalline electrolytes---still overestimates the modulus by more than 170%. In contrast, the MD approach using MLFFs yields a Young's modulus of $2.84 \pm 0.26$ GPa, which quantitatively agrees with the experimental value of $2.91 \pm 0.32$ GPa. Using the MLFF-MD approach, we further predict bulk modulus (4.44 GPa), shear modulus (1.02 GPa), and Poisson's ratio (0.39) for amorphous LiTaCl$_6$ and conclude that elastically it behaves like a soft polymer or gel. These results demonstrate that amorphous superionic materials possess some unique elastic properties and that, among the methods examined, only the MLFF-MD approach yields quantitative agreement with experiment, highlighting the necessity of a dynamical treatment to simulate their elastic response, consistent with recent findings for crystalline superionic conductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用密度泛函理论（DFT）、机器学习力场（MLFF）和分子动力学（MD）模拟，无实验数据采集过程（实验值仅用于对比）。；研究对象：非晶固态电解质 LiTaCl₆（一种新发现的非晶超离子锂离子导体）的弹性性质，包括杨氏模量、体模量、剪切模量和泊松比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非晶 LiTaCl₆ 的弹性行为类似软聚合物或凝胶（杨氏模量约 2.84 GPa，泊松比 0.39），且只有基于机器学习力场的分子动力学（MLFF-MD）方法才能定量复现实验值，静态方法（未弛豫和弛豫）均严重高估其模量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非晶 LiTaCl₆ 的弹性行为类似软聚合物或凝胶（杨氏模量约 2.84 GPa，泊松比 0.39），且只有基于机器学习力场的分子动力学（MLFF-MD）方法才能定量复现实验值，静态方法（未弛豫和弛豫）均严重高估其模量。；创新点：首次对非晶超离子导体 LiTaCl₆ 的弹性性质进行系统计算研究，并明确指出静态方法（即使包含弛豫）无法正确描述非晶超离子导体的力学响应，必须采用含动力学效应的 MLFF-MD 方法，这与近期晶体超离子导体的研究结论一致。
papers.method_zh: 基于 DFT 的三种计算方法对比：(1) 未弛豫静态计算；(2) 弛豫静态计算（常用于晶体电解质）；(3) 等温等压（NPT）系综下的分子动力学模拟，结合 DFT 训练的机器学习力场（MLFF），通过应变涨落提取弹性常数。

papers.title: "Ultra-weak" First-Order Phase Transition in Biaxial Liquid Crystals
papers.abstract: We report high-resolution Monte Carlo evidence characterizing the hierarchy of transition strengths in biaxial nematogens. By employing multiple histogram reweighting on large lattices, we demonstrate that while the isotropic-to-uniaxial ($I \to N_U$) transition is symmetry-enforced first-order, the uniaxial-to-biaxial ($N_U \to N_B$) transition in the region between the tricritical point and the triple point ($λ= 0.26$) is proximity-driven and more than an order of magnitude smaller for large system sizes. Such a class of ultra-weak first-order transitions could be a new pathway for future investigations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：Monte Carlo evidence、multiple histogram reweighting、large lattices。；研究对象：双轴液晶（biaxial nematogens）中的各向同性—单轴（I→N_U）与单轴—双轴（N_U→N_B）相变，特别是三临界点与三相点之间区域（λ=0.26）的相变强度层级。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: I→N_U 相变是对称性强制的弱一级相变，而 N_U→N_B 相变在特定参数区间内是邻近效应驱动的一级相变，其强度比前者小一个数量级以上，属于“超弱一级相变”。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：I→N_U 相变是对称性强制的弱一级相变，而 N_U→N_B 相变在特定参数区间内是邻近效应驱动的一级相变，其强度比前者小一个数量级以上，属于“超弱一级相变”。；创新点：首次系统量化了双轴液晶中不同相变强度的层级关系，并揭示了一种由邻近效应（proximity-driven）导致的“超弱一级相变”新类别，为后续研究提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 高分辨率蒙特卡洛模拟，结合多重直方图重加权（multiple histogram reweighting）技术，在大尺寸格点上进行精确的相变强度分析。

papers.title: Strain-Driven Electronic and Catalytic Modulation of g-C3N4/GeS van der Waals heterostructure for Photocatalytic Water Splitting
papers.abstract: Photocatalytic water splitting offers a viable pathway for sustainable hydrogen production. In this study, first-principles density functional theory calculations were performed to explore the strain-dependent photocatalytic behaviour of a two-dimensional g-C3N4/GeS heterostructure. The heterostructure shows type-II band alignment with an indirect band gap of 2.17 eV, smaller than those of the individual g-C3N4 (2.81 eV) and GeS (3.31 eV) monolayers. Biaxial tensile strain up to 3% effectively modulates the band gap and band edge positions, allowing suitable alignment with water redox potentials. The calculated Gibbs free energy for the hydrogen evolution reaction (ΔGHER) is 0.2 eV for the pristine heterostructure and approaches near-thermoneutral values (-/+ 0.1 eV) under +1% and +2% strain. Meanwhile, the OER overpotential decreases from 2.17 V to 0.97 V with increasing strain. AIMD simulations and optical absorption in the visible region confirm the thermodynamic stability and promising photocatalytic potential of the heterostructure for hydrogen generation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要明确提到“first-principles density functional theory calculations”（第一性原理密度泛函理论计算），以及AIMD模拟。；研究对象：二维g-C3N4/GeS范德华异质结，及其在光催化水分解中的应变调控行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该异质结具有type-II能带排列，带隙为2.17 eV；施加双轴拉伸应变（最高3%）可有效调控带隙和能带边缘位置，使其与水的氧化还原电位匹配，同时显著降低析氧反应过电位（从2.17 V降至0.97 V），并使其析氢反应吉布斯自由能接近热中性（±0.1 eV）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该异质结具有type-II能带排列，带隙为2.17 eV；施加双轴拉伸应变（最高3%）可有效调控带隙和能带边缘位置，使其与水的氧化还原电位匹配，同时显著降低析氧反应过电位（从2.17 V降至0.97 V），并使其析氢反应吉布斯自由能接近热中性（±0.1 eV）。；创新点：首次系统研究了应变对g-C3N4/GeS范德华异质结光催化水分解性能的调控作用，特别是发现应变可将OER过电位大幅降低（2.17 V→0.97 V），并实现HER近热中性自由能，为二维异质结光催化剂设计提供了应变工程策略。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算；双轴拉伸应变模拟；吉布斯自由能计算（用于HER和OER）；AIMD（从头算分子动力学）模拟用于热力学稳定性验证；光学吸收谱计算。

papers.title: Analogue Phase Change Computational Memory with High Precision Reads and Energy Efficient Writes
papers.abstract: Resistive memory technologies offer a compelling advantage for in-memory computing. However, realizing a device architecture that simultaneously achieves high computational precision, efficiency, and density has remained elusive due to inherent trade-offs among these performance metrics. Here, we introduce a com- pact phase-change memory device architecture that combines an ultra-confined active switching volume for enhanced electro-thermal efficiency with a non-insulating thin film that suppresses temporal conductance fluctuations. We analytically model and back-end integrate these devices into crossbar arrays. Even with conventional, undoped phase-change materials, the device architecture enables a computational precision approaching 6 bits, low conductance values below 50 μS with an adequate conductance window, and a viable pathway toward sub-100 μA programming currents under nominal operating voltages.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与器件集成混合类型。判断依据：摘要提及“analytically model and back-end integrate these devices into crossbar arrays”，包含器件制备（实验）与建模分析。；研究对象：相变存储（phase-change memory）器件，具体为一种具有超受限活性开关体积与非绝缘薄膜的紧凑型器件架构，用于电阻式存储与存内计算。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该器件架构在采用常规未掺杂相变材料时，可实现接近6比特的计算精度、低于50 μS的低电导值（且具有足够的电导窗口），并具备在标称工作电压下实现亚100 μA编程电流的可行路径，从而同时改善精度、效率与密度之间的权衡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该器件架构在采用常规未掺杂相变材料时，可实现接近6比特的计算精度、低于50 μS的低电导值（且具有足够的电导窗口），并具备在标称工作电压下实现亚100 μA编程电流的可行路径，从而同时改善精度、效率与密度之间的权衡。；创新点：通过将超受限活性开关体积（提升电热效率）与非绝缘薄膜（抑制时间电导涨落）结合在同一紧凑器件架构中，在常规相变材料条件下同时实现高精度、低电导与低编程电流，突破了以往精度、效率与密度之间的固有取舍。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如材料沉积方法、表征技术等），仅提及对器件进行解析建模（analytical modeling）并完成后端集成（back-end integration）至交叉阵列（crossbar arrays）。具体制备与表征技术摘要未给出。

papers.title: Collinear and noncollinear antiferromagnetic ordering in a highly frustrated decorated square kagomé lattice antiferromagnets of the nabokoite family
papers.abstract: Nabokoite family compounds ACu$_7$(TeO$_4$)(SO4)$_5$X (A=Na, K, Rb, Cs; X=Cl, Br) host frustrated 2D square kagom'{e} lattice layers decorated by additional inter-layer magnetic ions. We study magnetic order in nabokoites with multi-frequency electron spin resonance spectroscopy and thermodynamic measurement (specific heat, magnetization and dielectric permittivity). Our study reveals that the choice of the low-temperature ground state is qualitatively different in light-alkali-ion (K, Na) and heavy-alkali-ion (Rb, Cs) compounds. Heavy-alkali-ion nabokoites order in conventional collinear antiferromagnetic pattern with easy-axis anisotropy. The parameters of the ordered antiferromagnetic state are very close for all heavy-alkali-ion subfamily. Light-alkali-ion members of nabokoite family demonstrate much more complicated route to the ordered state: firstly, a ferroelectric transition at 25-90K lifts the frustration and thus pre-cooks the low-temperature ordering; secondly, an unusual noncollinear magnetic order develops via two-step phase transition with first transition temperature $T_{c1}\simeq 5-6$K and the second transition at $T_{c2}\simeq 3-4$K. Noncollinear order is evidenced by observation of characteristic non-Larmor antiferromagnetic resonance mode. Spin dynamics of light-alkali-ion nabokoites is characterized by three zero-field magnon gaps and two spin-reorientation fields, the values of magnon gaps and critical fields are quite different for different compounds. The finite-size cluster modeling of pyramidal structural block of nabokoite structure combined suggests that the critical closeness of the nabokoite exchange coupling parameters to the border-line between the different quantum ground state of pyramidal building block of nabokoite structure could be the clue to the choice of qualitatively different ordered state in light- and heavy-alkali-ion nabokoites.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合了有限尺寸团簇建模，但主体为实验研究）。判断依据：多频电子自旋共振谱、热力学测量（比热、磁化率、介电常数）等实验手段。；研究对象：Nabokoite 家族化合物 ACu₇(TeO₄)(SO₄)₅X（A=Na, K, Rb, Cs；X=Cl, Br），一种高度阻挫的二维方形 kagomé 晶格反铁磁体，其层间还额外装饰有磁性离子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 轻碱金属（K、Na）与重碱金属（Rb、Cs）的 nabokoite 化合物在低温下呈现性质截然不同的基态：重碱金属体系为常规共线反铁磁序（易轴各向异性），而轻碱金属体系先经历铁电相变解除阻挫，再通过两步相变进入非常规非共线磁有序态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：轻碱金属（K、Na）与重碱金属（Rb、Cs）的 nabokoite 化合物在低温下呈现性质截然不同的基态：重碱金属体系为常规共线反铁磁序（易轴各向异性），而轻碱金属体系先经历铁电相变解除阻挫，再通过两步相变进入非常规非共线磁有序态。；创新点：首次系统揭示同一家族中碱金属离子种类（轻/重）对磁基态选择的决定性影响，并指出交换耦合参数接近金字塔结构单元不同量子基态之间的临界边界可能是导致轻/重碱金属体系磁有序类型截然不同的关键机制。
papers.method_zh: 多频电子自旋共振（multi-frequency ESR）谱学；热力学测量（比热、磁化率、介电常数）；有限尺寸团簇（finite-size cluster）建模分析金字塔形结构单元。

papers.title: Heavy-Hole--Light-Hole Mixing and Spin--Photon Coupling in Germanium Flopping-Mode Qubits
papers.abstract: Intrinsic spin--orbit interaction in germanium provides electrically active flopping-mode qubits without requiring magnetic-field gradients to generate spin--charge hybridization. We study double quantum dots (DQDs) with a multiband Luttinger--Kohn framework that retains heavy-hole (HH) and light-hole (LH) states on equal footing. Modeling vertical confinement with a finite confinement potential along the growth direction brings selected subbands into a regime of appreciable HH--LH mixing. This admixture activates electric-dipole spin-coupling through LH--LH and LH--HH transitions, complementing the conventional HH--HH pseudospin-flip resonance. For the parameter sets considered, these additional channels can produce larger spin--photon figures of merit than the HH--HH transition. HH--LH mixing thus supplies a tunable ingredient for qubit--cavity coupling in germanium hole-spin qubits and extends the operating regimes available to circuit-QED architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要提及“multiband Luttinger–Kohn framework”（多带Luttinger–Kohn框架）、“modeling”（建模）以及“parameter sets”（参数集），属于理论建模与数值计算研究。；研究对象：锗（Germanium）空穴自旋量子点中的flopping-mode量子比特，具体为双量子点（DQDs）体系，关注重空穴（HH）与轻空穴（LH）混合效应以及自旋–光子耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在锗flopping-mode量子比特中，有限垂直限制势引起的HH–LH混合可激活额外的电偶极自旋耦合通道（LH–LH和LH–HH跃迁），在部分参数下这些通道产生的自旋–光子耦合品质因子可超过传统的HH–HH赝自旋翻转跃迁，从而为量子比特–腔耦合提供可调谐的新机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在锗flopping-mode量子比特中，有限垂直限制势引起的HH–LH混合可激活额外的电偶极自旋耦合通道（LH–LH和LH–HH跃迁），在部分参数下这些通道产生的自旋–光子耦合品质因子可超过传统的HH–HH赝自旋翻转跃迁，从而为量子比特–腔耦合提供可调谐的新机制。；创新点：无需外加磁场梯度即可实现自旋–电荷杂化（利用锗内禀自旋–轨道耦合），并首次系统展示了HH–LH混合作为额外耦合通道对flopping-mode量子比特自旋–光子耦合的增强作用，扩展了电路QED架构在锗空穴自旋量子比特中的工作区间。
papers.method_zh: 采用多带Luttinger–Kohn理论框架，将重空穴（HH）和轻空穴（LH）态平等地纳入计算；沿生长方向使用有限限制势（finite confinement potential）建模垂直约束，从而获得具有显著HH–LH混合的子带；在此基础上计算电偶极自旋耦合强度及自旋–光子品质因子。

papers.title: Experimental observation of decoupled spin subsystems in decorated square kagomé lattice magnets of the nabokoite family
papers.abstract: The square kagomé lattice (SKL) offers a model platform for investigating geometric frustration in 2D systems. Nabokoite-family compounds \nabok{A}{X} (A=Na, K, Cs, Rb and X=Cl, Br) extend this physics to a 3D network, where 2D SKL layers are decorated by interlayer spins. Using electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR), we demonstrate a dramatic splitting of this complex exchange network into two virtually decoupled spin subsystems: absolute calibration of the electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) absorption reveals that only a fraction of all copper spins in nabokoites is EPR-active and this fraction of the spins orders at the Néel point. Comparison of the EPR absorption and static susceptibility indicates that contribution of the EPR-silent spin subsystem to total magnetic susceptibility decreases on cooling. This direct observation of coexisting magnetic order and possible spin-liquid dynamics within a single compound challenges conventional models of unified exchange networks in decorated frustrated lattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Using electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR)”，并涉及“absolute calibration of the EPR absorption”等实验测量。；研究对象：纳博科矿家族化合物 nabok{A}{X}（A=Na, K, Cs, Rb；X=Cl, Br），具体研究其装饰型方 Kagomé 晶格（SKL）三维网络中的磁性行为，特别是铜自旋的交换耦合与磁有序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过 EPR 测量发现，该复杂交换网络可分裂为两个几乎退耦的自旋子系统：仅部分铜自旋具有 EPR 活性并在 Néel 点发生磁有序，而 EPR 沉默的自旋子系统对总磁化率的贡献随降温而减小。这一共存现象挑战了传统统一交换网络模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过 EPR 测量发现，该复杂交换网络可分裂为两个几乎退耦的自旋子系统：仅部分铜自旋具有 EPR 活性并在 Néel 点发生磁有序，而 EPR 沉默的自旋子系统对总磁化率的贡献随降温而减小。这一共存现象挑战了传统统一交换网络模型。；创新点：首次在实验上直接观察到同一化合物中磁有序与可能的自旋液体动力学共存，并证明装饰型阻挫晶格中自旋子系统可近乎完全退耦，突破了以往将整个交换网络视为统一整体的理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 电子顺磁共振（EPR）谱学，包括 EPR 吸收的绝对标定；结合静态磁化率测量进行对比分析。

papers.title: Evaluating LLM-based AI agents integrated with materials synthesis tools: the case of atomic layer deposition
papers.abstract: This work provides an overview of the different strategies that can be used to evaluate the performance of AI models and agents based on large language models (LLMs) for materials synthesis. After providing a brief overview of the key technologies behind the current generation of AI agents based on LLMs, we summarize the different approaches to evaluating these models in the context of materials science and in particular on materials synthesis, with a specific emphasis on scenarios in which the models are directly integrated with experimental tools. We discuss evaluation strategies spanning knowledge and reasoning benchmarks, tool-use benchmarks, and closed loop benchmarks involving the interaction with experimental systems or realistic virtual tools. We use atomic layer deposition (ALD) as a case study, emphasizing how existing approaches in the literature both build from general approaches used beyond materials science and can be generalized to other materials synthesis techniques. Finally, we provide a practical evaluation framework to evaluate LLMs in the context of materials synthesis
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（综述/方法论文章，涉及AI模型评估框架的构建，非传统实验或计算物理研究）。判断依据关键词：overview、evaluation strategies、practical evaluation framework。；研究对象：研究对象并非特定材料或物理体系，而是**基于大语言模型（LLM）的AI智能体在材料合成（特别是原子层沉积，ALD）中的应用与评估**。属于AI for Materials Science交叉领域。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确给出单一物理结论，核心主张是：针对LLM驱动的材料合成智能体，需要建立分层评估策略（知识/推理基准、工具使用基准、闭环实验交互基准），并以ALD为案例提出了一个实用评估框架，该框架可推广至其他材料合成技术。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确给出单一物理结论，核心主张是：针对LLM驱动的材料合成智能体，需要建立分层评估策略（知识/推理基准、工具使用基准、闭环实验交互基准），并以ALD为案例提出了一个实用评估框架，该框架可推广至其他材料合成技术。；创新点：将通用AI智能体评估方法系统性地引入材料合成领域，并以ALD为具体案例提出可推广的实用评估框架，强调与实验工具直接集成的场景。摘要未突出说明与传统凝聚态物理研究方法的对比创新。
papers.method_zh: 本文为方法论综述，具体手段包括：梳理LLM智能体关键技术、总结材料科学（尤其材料合成）中的三类评估基准（知识推理、工具使用、闭环实验/虚拟工具交互），并以ALD为案例构建评估框架。未涉及具体实验或计算模拟手段。

papers.title: Crystal electric field excitations and an effective-spin-$1/2$ ground doublet in the hyperkagome magnet Yb$_3$Sc$_2$Ga$_3$O$_{12}$
papers.abstract: We use inelastic neutron scattering (INS) to determine the crystal electric field (CEF) excitations of Yb$^{3+}$ in the rare-earth hyperkagome magnet Yb$_3$Sc$_2$Ga$_3$O$_{12}$. Three nearly dispersionless magnetic excitations are observed near 58, 68, and 74~meV, corresponding to transitions from the ground-state Kramers doublet to the three excited doublets of the $J=7/2$ multiplet. A Stevens-operator analysis constrained by the local $222$ ($D_2$) symmetry reproduces the excitation energies and spectral weights and yields an Ising-type ground-state $g$ tensor. The first excited doublet lies approximately 58~meV above the ground state, establishing a well-isolated effective $J_{\mathrm{eff}}=1/2$ degree of freedom over the low-temperature regime relevant to collective magnetism. Notably, the directly measured CEF spectrum substantially revises the level scheme previously inferred from bulk measurements, while preserving the essential low-energy pseudospin description. Two independent fitting protocols give consistent excitation energies, ground-doublet wave functions, and $g$ tensors, despite the nonuniqueness of the individual CEF parameters. The resulting single-ion model also reproduces the characteristic susceptibility, magnetization, and field evolution of the Schottky anomaly in specific heat. These results establish the microscopic single-ion basis needed to construct an effective exchange Hamiltonian and to interpret future measurements of low-energy collective excitations in Yb$_3$Sc$_2$Ga$_3$O$_{12}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用非弹性中子散射（inelastic neutron scattering, INS）进行测量，并结合 Stevens 算符分析。；研究对象：稀土超kagome磁体 Yb₃Sc₂Ga₃O₁₂ 中 Yb³⁺ 离子的晶格电场（CEF）激发，以及由此确定的基态有效自旋-1/2 自由度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过非弹性中子散射直接测定了 Yb³⁺ 的 CEF 能级：在约 58、68 和 74 meV 处观察到三个近无色散的磁激发，对应从基态 Kramers 二重态到三个激发二重态的跃迁。第一激发态距基态约 58 meV，确立了低温下良好隔离的有效 J_eff = 1/2 自由度；该直接测量的 CEF 能谱显著修正了此前由体测量推断的能级方案，但保留了基本的低能赝自旋描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过非弹性中子散射直接测定了 Yb³⁺ 的 CEF 能级：在约 58、68 和 74 meV 处观察到三个近无色散的磁激发，对应从基态 Kramers 二重态到三个激发二重态的跃迁。第一激发态距基态约 58 meV，确立了低温下良好隔离的有效 J_eff = 1/2 自由度；该直接测量的 CEF 能谱显著修正了此前由体测量推断的能级方案，但保留了基本的低能赝自旋描述。；创新点：首次直接测量了该材料的 CEF 能谱，修正了此前仅由体测量推断的能级方案，同时确认了低能有效自旋-1/2 描述的适用性，为构建有效交换哈密顿量提供了微观单离子基础。
papers.method_zh: 非弹性中子散射（INS）测量 CEF 激发；Stevens 算符分析（受局域 222 (D₂) 对称性约束）拟合激发能量与谱权重；两种独立拟合方案交叉验证；单离子模型用于复现磁化率、磁化强度及比热中 Schottky 异常的场演化。

papers.title: Single-pulse strain-induced precessional dynamics of magnetization in Co-doped iron garnet
papers.abstract: Ultrafast control of magnetization through lattice excitation provides a route to manipulating magnetic order on short timescales, yet the role of transient strain in driving magnetization dynamics remains poorly understood. Here, single-shot pump-probe magneto-optical microscopy is used to resolve the structural and magnetic responses of cobalt-doped yttrium iron garnet to individual 5-ps mid-infrared pulses. The excitation generates a localized strain field together with an outward-propagating elastic wave. Concurrently, the magnetic contrast decreases following excitation and subsequently reverses on a timescale of approximately 1.5-2 ns before recovering to its initial state. The structural and magnetic responses exhibit closely correlated wavelength and pulse-energy dependences, indicating a common excitation pathway. Micromagnetic simulations incorporating transient strain reproduce the precessional reorientation of the magnetization within individual domains while largely preserving the labyrinthine domain morphology. These results identify transient lattice deformation as the link between single-pulse mid-infrared excitation and reversible precessional magnetization dynamics in Co-doped yttrium iron garnet.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“单发泵浦-探测磁光显微术”（single-shot pump-probe magneto-optical microscopy）作为主要实验手段，同时包含“微磁模拟”（micromagnetic simulations）作为辅助验证，属于实验为主、模拟为辅的混合类型。；研究对象：钴掺杂钇铁石榴石（Co-doped yttrium iron garnet）薄膜中的超快磁化动力学，具体关注单脉冲中红外激发产生的瞬态应变场与磁化进动（precessional dynamics）之间的耦合关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单脉冲中红外激发在钴掺杂钇铁石榴石中产生局域应变场及向外传播的弹性波，同时驱动磁化在约1.5–2 ns时间尺度上发生可逆的进动重取向，且结构响应与磁响应具有高度关联的波长和脉冲能量依赖性，表明瞬态晶格形变是连接光激发与磁化进动的关键物理机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单脉冲中红外激发在钴掺杂钇铁石榴石中产生局域应变场及向外传播的弹性波，同时驱动磁化在约1.5–2 ns时间尺度上发生可逆的进动重取向，且结构响应与磁响应具有高度关联的波长和脉冲能量依赖性，表明瞬态晶格形变是连接光激发与磁化进动的关键物理机制。；创新点：首次在单脉冲（非重复泵浦）条件下，将瞬态晶格应变场与磁化进动重取向直接关联起来，并通过波长和脉冲能量依赖性的对比证明二者共享同一激发路径，明确了瞬态晶格形变在单脉冲中红外激发驱动可逆磁化动力学中的桥梁作用。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用单发（single-shot）泵浦-探测磁光显微术，使用5皮秒中红外单脉冲激发，同时解析结构响应（应变场/弹性波）与磁响应（磁对比度变化）；理论上采用包含瞬态应变项的微磁模拟（micromagnetic simulations）来复现磁化进动行为。

papers.title: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Process Driven by Multiple Dichotomous Noises
papers.abstract: We study a generalized Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process driven by a superposition of $K$ independent dichotomous noises with arbitrary fixed amplitudes and switching rates. Unlike the classical Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process driven by equilibrium Gaussian white noise, the present system is governed by bounded nonequilibrium fluctuations with finite correlation times. We obtain exact expressions for the stationary position distribution and all cumulants, and show that the stationary state possesses an unexpectedly rich structure, including compact support, algebraic branch-point singularities, edge divergences, and multiple extrema. We establish a mapping onto a heterogeneous random-flight process with bounded jumps, yielding a transparent probabilistic interpretation of the stationary measure. We further analyze several limiting regimes, including the crossover to Gaussian statistics for large numbers of noise sources. For ensembles with exponentially-distributed quenched amplitudes, we derive exact disorder-averaged stationary distributions and show that disorder fundamentally alters the stationary state, producing exponential tails decorated by algebraic prefactors with non-trivial exponents.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We obtain exact expressions”“We establish a mapping”“We derive”等表述，属于解析理论推导，无实验或数值模拟关键词。；研究对象：广义Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程，具体为受K个独立二值（dichotomous）噪声叠加驱动的随机动力学系统。该体系属于非平衡统计物理中的随机过程，而非特定凝聚态材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该非平衡系统（受有界、有限关联时间噪声驱动）的稳态位置分布具有丰富结构，包括紧支撑、代数支点奇异性、边界发散及多极值；且当噪声源数目增大时，系统交叉到高斯统计。对于淬火指数分布振幅的系综，无序会根本性地改变稳态，产生带非平凡代数指数前因子的指数尾巴。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该非平衡系统（受有界、有限关联时间噪声驱动）的稳态位置分布具有丰富结构，包括紧支撑、代数支点奇异性、边界发散及多极值；且当噪声源数目增大时，系统交叉到高斯统计。对于淬火指数分布振幅的系综，无序会根本性地改变稳态，产生带非平凡代数指数前因子的指数尾巴。；创新点：首次对多二值噪声叠加驱动的广义Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程给出精确稳态解，揭示了非平衡有界噪声下稳态分布的意外复杂结构（紧支撑、奇异性、边界发散等），并建立了与随机飞行过程的映射；同时首次展示了淬火无序对稳态统计的定性改变（指数尾巴+代数前因子）。摘要未突出说明与具体凝聚态实验体系的关联。
papers.method_zh: 解析求解方法：利用二值噪声的叠加性质，精确推导稳态位置分布函数及所有累积量；建立到异质随机飞行（random-flight）过程的映射以获得概率论解释；对淬火无序系综进行精确的系综平均（disorder-averaged）计算。

papers.title: Quantitative Disentanglement of Terahertz Spin and Orbital Pumping in 3d Ferromagnetic Heterostructures
papers.abstract: Spin and orbital pumping - the injection of spin and orbital angular momentum from a driven ferromagnet into an adjacent nonmagnetic layer - are fundamental processes underlying angular-momentum generation and transport in magnetic heterostructures. Femtosecond optical excitation extends these phenomena into the ultrafast regime, where spintronic terahertz emission spectroscopy (STES) detects picosecond angular-momentum currents in a contact-free manner through spin-to-charge and orbital-to-charge conversion. Microscopic theory predicts that orbital-pumping efficiency increases from Fe to Ni across the 3d series, yet whether these predictions hold under ultrafast excitation remains unclear. A central challenge is that spin and orbital currents are generated simultaneously and contribute additively to the same terahertz emission, preventing their quantitative separation. Here, we overcome this limitation by combining STES with wedge-sample thickness control in heterostructures whose nonmagnetic layers (Ta, W, and Nb) have spin Hall and orbital Hall angles of opposite signs. The two angular-momentum channels therefore exhibit distinct emission polarities and thickness dependences, enabling their quantitative decomposition. Systematic measurements on Fe, Co, and Ni heterostructures reveal that the orbital-pumping contribution increases progressively toward Ni, reaching several tens of percent of the spin-current contribution - far exceeding theoretical predictions. Even Fe generates a non-negligible orbital current that becomes essential in the thin-nonmagnetic-layer regime. The extracted orbital diffusion lengths are consistently shorter than spin diffusion lengths and increase with decreasing spin-orbit coupling strength of the nonmagnetic layer. These results establish a quantitative framework for ultrafast spin and orbital pumping in magnetic heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“systematic measurements”“STES”“wedge-sample thickness control”等实验手段，并结合微观理论对比。；研究对象：3d铁磁金属（Fe、Co、Ni）与非磁层（Ta、W、Nb）构成的异质结构，研究超快时间尺度下的自旋泵浦与轨道泵浦现象，以及太赫兹发射的定量分离。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Fe、Co、Ni异质结构中，轨道泵浦贡献随元素从Fe到Ni逐渐增强，最高可达自旋电流贡献的百分之几十，远超理论预期；即使Fe也产生不可忽略的轨道电流，且轨道扩散长度普遍短于自旋扩散长度，并随非磁层自旋-轨道耦合强度减弱而增大。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Fe、Co、Ni异质结构中，轨道泵浦贡献随元素从Fe到Ni逐渐增强，最高可达自旋电流贡献的百分之几十，远超理论预期；即使Fe也产生不可忽略的轨道电流，且轨道扩散长度普遍短于自旋扩散长度，并随非磁层自旋-轨道耦合强度减弱而增大。；创新点：首次实现了超快激发条件下自旋泵浦与轨道泵浦电流的定量分离，克服了二者同时产生且对太赫兹发射加性贡献的难题，并建立了3d铁磁异质结构中超快自旋/轨道泵浦的定量分析框架。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用自旋太赫兹发射谱学（STES）结合楔形样品厚度控制，利用非磁层（Ta、W、Nb）自旋霍尔角和轨道霍尔角符号相反的特性，通过发射极性和厚度依赖关系定量分解自旋与轨道电流贡献。

papers.title: Topological pair density waves in kagome superconductors
papers.abstract: The pair density wave (PDW) is an unconventional superconducting state exhibiting periodic pairing modulations due to pairing with finite momentum Q. In two dimensions, multiple Q components of the PDW can have a non-trivial relative phase, breaking time-reversal symmetry and resulting in a topological electronic structure. Here we review progress on exploring such topological PDWs (TPDWs) and discuss their potential realization in kagome superconductors. We first introduce the concept of a TPDW starting from the Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) state and examine the challenges toward its realization. We then discuss the possibility of a TPDW in the kagome lattice, which intertwines with chiral superconductivity and loop currents, thus connecting to models describing the quantum anomalous Hall effect. Furthermore, we review the experimental signatures of a TPDW in AV3Sb5 (A = Cs, Rb, K) superconductors and highlight related quantum effects, including switchable chiral pairing modulations, Bogoliubov Fermi states, the superconducting diode effect, and the anomalous thermal Hall effect. Finally, we project the future research opportunities of this correlated topological quantum phase and discuss its broad implications for finite-momentum pairing, topological matter, and chiral superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/综述型文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“review progress”“discuss”“introduce the concept”“project future research opportunities”等综述性表述，同时涉及理论概念（FFLO态、拓扑电子结构）与实验现象讨论，属于理论与实验结合的综述文章。；研究对象：Kagome超导体中的拓扑配对密度波（TPDW），具体材料体系为AV₃Sb₅（A = Cs, Rb, K）超导体，以及与之相关的有限动量配对、手性超导、环电流和量子反常霍尔效应等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维体系中，配对密度波（PDW）的多个动量分量之间可具有非平凡相对相位，从而破坏时间反演对称性并产生拓扑电子结构；在kagome超导体中，这种拓扑PDW与手性超导和环电流相互交织，并可通过可切换的手性配对调制、Bogoliubov费米态、超导二极管效应和反常热霍尔效应等实验信号加以探测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维体系中，配对密度波（PDW）的多个动量分量之间可具有非平凡相对相位，从而破坏时间反演对称性并产生拓扑电子结构；在kagome超导体中，这种拓扑PDW与手性超导和环电流相互交织，并可通过可切换的手性配对调制、Bogoliubov费米态、超导二极管效应和反常热霍尔效应等实验信号加以探测。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该综述的核心贡献在于系统梳理了拓扑PDW的概念从FFLO态出发的演化路径，并首次将TPDW与kagome超导体中的手性超导、环电流及量子反常霍尔效应联系起来，提出该体系中TPDW的可观测实验特征及其与多种量子效应的关联。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体计算方法或实验技术，但涉及理论框架包括：Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov（FFLO）态理论、拓扑能带理论、量子反常霍尔效应模型；实验方面提及对AV₃Sb₅超导体的实验观测，但未给出具体实验手段（如ARPES、STM等）。

papers.title: Evolving charge order in the CDW state of AV$_3$Sb$_5$ metals
papers.abstract: AV$_3$Sb$_5$ kagome metals are characterized by intertwined electronic and structural orders, which motivated extensive studies in recent years. Yet the details of the electronic state preceding the superconducting phase remain poorly understood. Here we extend our previous investigation [Phys. Rev. Research 7, L032046 (2025)] of RbV$_3$Sb$_5$ using avoided level crossing (ALC) muon-spin spectroscopy to the $A$ = Cs and K systems. Consistent with our previous study, we identify a second transition whose origin cannot be attributed solely to an internal magnetic field, indicating the involvement of an additional electronic mechanism that subtly modifies the charge distribution within the V plane. In particular, the ALC results point towards an additional charge modulation taking place within the charge density wave (CDW) phase and occurring at $T^{*}<T_{CDW}$ for $A$ = Cs and Rb, or in the vicinity of $T_{CDW}$ for $A$ = K.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到使用 muon-spin spectroscopy（μ子自旋谱学）进行测量，并对比了不同材料体系的实验结果。；研究对象：AV₃Sb₅ 笼目金属（A = Cs、Rb、K），具体研究其电荷密度波（CDW）态内部的电子有序演化，以及进入超导相之前的电子态细节。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 AV₃Sb₅ 体系中，CDW 相内部存在第二个转变，该转变不能仅由内磁场解释，而是涉及额外的电子机制，导致 V 平面内电荷分布的微妙修改。该额外电荷调制发生在 T* < T_CDW（A = Cs、Rb）或接近 T_CDW（A = K）的温度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 AV₃Sb₅ 体系中，CDW 相内部存在第二个转变，该转变不能仅由内磁场解释，而是涉及额外的电子机制，导致 V 平面内电荷分布的微妙修改。该额外电荷调制发生在 T* < T_CDW（A = Cs、Rb）或接近 T_CDW（A = K）的温度。；创新点：将此前仅针对 RbV₃Sb₅ 的 ALC-μSR 研究扩展至 Cs 和 K 体系，系统性地揭示了 CDW 相内部额外电荷调制的普适性及其随 A 位离子变化的温度行为差异。
papers.method_zh: 避免能级交叉（ALC）μ子自旋谱学（avoided level crossing muon-spin spectroscopy），并与此前对 RbV₃Sb₅ 的研究结果进行对比分析。

papers.title: Directional commensurability stabilizes structural superlubricity in patterned mesoscale interfaces
papers.abstract: Structural superlubricity, arising from lattice incommensurability, offers a promising route to eliminate friction and associated energy losses in mechanical systems. In real-world systems, roughness and wear currently pose severe limitations on its robustness and especially the contact size. Here, we consider patterned surfaces as a possible route to overcome some of these limitations. We show that the simplest choice of patterning, contacts made up of two incommensurate triangular-triangular patterns, fails at elevated loads because of the small number of load-bearing contacts, causing the maximum local contact pressure to exceed the strength of the superlubric coating. We introduce a square-triangular patterned interface that increases the number of load-bearing contacts and organizes them into continuous contact lines. When sliding along specific directions relative to these lines, superlubricity is maintained at significantly higher loads by reducing pressure-induced coating failure while also remaining somewhat tolerant to surface imperfections. These findings establish a mechanism for stabilizing structural superlubricity against coating failure and a design principle for engineering low-friction interfaces with enhanced load-bearing capacity and defect tolerance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we consider”“we show”“we introduce”等表述，且未提及实验手段，属于理论建模与数值模拟研究。；研究对象：结构超润滑（structural superlubricity）现象，具体研究图案化介观尺度界面（patterned mesoscale interfaces）中两种不同图案组合——三角-三角（triangular-triangular）与方-三角（square-triangular）接触界面的摩擦行为与承载能力。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三角-三角图案化接触在高载荷下因承载接触点数量少、局部接触压力超过超润滑涂层强度而失效；方-三角图案化界面可将承载接触点组织为连续接触线，沿特定方向滑动时能在显著更高的载荷下维持超润滑，并具有一定缺陷容忍度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：三角-三角图案化接触在高载荷下因承载接触点数量少、局部接触压力超过超润滑涂层强度而失效；方-三角图案化界面可将承载接触点组织为连续接触线，沿特定方向滑动时能在显著更高的载荷下维持超润滑，并具有一定缺陷容忍度。；创新点：提出方-三角图案化界面作为一种新的界面设计策略，通过将离散承载点转化为连续接触线，同时提升超润滑界面的承载能力和缺陷容忍度，为工程化低摩擦界面提供了设计原理。摘要未突出说明与已有图案化超润滑研究的定量对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值模拟，具体方法摘要未明确说明（未提及具体计算技术如分子动力学、有限元或第一性原理等）。

papers.title: A route to the thermodynamics of colloid-polymer mixtures from structural information
papers.abstract: Liquid-state theory provides a fundamental connection between microscopic structure and macroscopic thermodynamic behaviour. Here, we develop a framework for predicting thermodynamics and phase behaviour directly from structural correlations, using either radial distribution functions or static structure factors as input. The approach constructs a free-energy functional from structural information obtained at a single thermodynamic state point, without requiring explicit knowledge of the underlying interaction potentials. This circumvents a central difficulty in modelling complex fluids, for which effective interactions are often unknown or rely on approximations. We demonstrate the framework for a range of model fluids, including colloidal and colloid--polymer systems, with predictions in good agreement with molecular simulation data. The results show that structural information at a single state point can provide sufficient information to predict the broader thermodynamic response of a system. This establishes a route toward inferring phase behaviour directly from experimentally measured structure, even when the microscopic interactions are not known a priori.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a framework”“constructs a free-energy functional”“predictions in good agreement with molecular simulation data”，属于液体态理论与模拟验证相结合的理论计算工作。；研究对象：胶体-聚合物混合体系（colloid–polymer mixtures）以及多种模型流体（model fluids），关注其热力学性质与相行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅凭单一热力学状态点的结构信息（径向分布函数或静态结构因子）即可构建自由能泛函，从而预测体系更广泛的热力学响应和相行为，无需预先知道微观相互作用势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅凭单一热力学状态点的结构信息（径向分布函数或静态结构因子）即可构建自由能泛函，从而预测体系更广泛的热力学响应和相行为，无需预先知道微观相互作用势。；创新点：绕过了复杂流体建模中有效相互作用势未知或需近似这一核心困难，建立了直接从实验可测结构信息推断相行为的通用路径。摘要未突出说明与已有结构-热力学关联方法（如经典密度泛函理论或热力学微扰途径）的具体对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 基于液体态理论（liquid-state theory）构建自由能泛函，输入为径向分布函数（radial distribution functions）或静态结构因子（static structure factors），在单一状态点获取结构信息后直接推导热力学性质；通过与分子模拟（molecular simulation）数据对比验证预测准确性。

papers.title: Light-induced nonconservative static forces in many-body systems
papers.abstract: In a quantum many-body system, a periodic drive can often generate effective static forces on the slow collective degrees of freedom. We study the static forces generated by light on electronic order parameters in solid-state systems. We show that the forces can have nonconservative components that originate from dissipation, i.e., optical absorption. This effect is demonstrated in two nontrivial examples. In excitonic insulators, via interband excitations, the light field generates a nonconservative force on the phase of the excitonic order parameter. This force leads to an acceleration of the phase, which manifests as a shift of the photon emission peak from an exciton condensate. In materials with an incommensurate charge density wave, a propagating light field generates a nonconservative force on the phase of its order parameter. It drives the charge density wave into sliding motion, leading to a DC electric current via topological Thouless pumping.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We study”“We show”“This effect is demonstrated”等表述，且讨论的是光对电子有序参量产生的有效静态力，属于理论分析框架，未提及实验或数值计算细节。；研究对象：固态量子多体系统中的电子有序参量，具体包括两类体系：激子绝缘体（excitonic insulator）和非公度电荷密度波（incommensurate charge density wave）材料。研究的是光场对这些有序参量相位产生的静态力及其动力学后果。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 光场在耗散（即光吸收）存在时，可以对电子有序参量产生非保守静态力。在激子绝缘体中，该力加速激子有序参量的相位，导致激子凝聚体光子发射峰发生位移；在非公度电荷密度波材料中，传播光场驱动电荷密度波进入滑动运动，并通过拓扑Thouless泵浦产生直流电流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：光场在耗散（即光吸收）存在时，可以对电子有序参量产生非保守静态力。在激子绝缘体中，该力加速激子有序参量的相位，导致激子凝聚体光子发射峰发生位移；在非公度电荷密度波材料中，传播光场驱动电荷密度波进入滑动运动，并通过拓扑Thouless泵浦产生直流电流。；创新点：首次指出光诱导的静态力可以包含非保守分量，且该非保守性源于光学吸收（耗散），并展示了这一效应在激子绝缘体和电荷密度波体系中的可观测物理后果（光子发射峰位移和直流电流产生）。摘要未突出说明与以往光诱导力研究的其他区别。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体理论工具（如量子主方程、Keldysh formalism、线性响应理论等），仅表明是在量子多体框架下研究周期驱动产生的有效静态力，并通过两个具体模型体系进行论证。具体方法细节摘要未提供。

papers.title: Electronic phase separation and emergence of a nondimerized insulating phase in VO$_2$ $(110)_{\mathit{R}}$ ultrathin films
papers.abstract: Using in situ photoemission spectroscopy and x-ray absorption spectroscopy, we investigated the thickness dependence of the electronic structure and V-V dimerization in VO$_2$/TiO$_2$ (110) ultrathin films, in which the one-dimensional V-V chains along the $c_{\mathit{R}}$ axis lie in the film plane. In VO$_2$ $(110)_{\mathit{R}}$ films, the reduction in dimensionality along the surface-normal direction is not expected to impose a geometric constraint on V-V dimerization, unlike in VO$_2$ $(001)_{\mathit{R}}$ films. Nevertheless, the characteristic spectral changes associated with the temperature-driven metal-insulator transition observed in thick films persist down to 1.5 nm, whereas at 1 nm an insulating electronic phase is observed without V-V dimerization. This behavior is highly similar to that reported for VO$_2$ $(001)_{\mathit{R}}$, suggesting that the enhancement of Mott instability resulting from reduced dimensionality is a common and essential driving force for the emergence of the nondimerized insulating phase in VO$_2$ ultrathin films. Meanwhile, unlike in VO$_2$ $(001)_{\mathit{R}}$, the nondimerized insulating phase in VO$_2$ $(110)_{\mathit{R}}$ coexists with the phase exhibiting the temperature-driven metal-insulator transition. Its fraction increases exponentially with decreasing thickness and becomes dominant at 1 nm. The corresponding effective critical thickness is estimated to be 2.2 nm. These results imply that the geometric orientation of the V-V chains dictates the spatial evolution of electronic phase separation via strain-mediated phase competition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“使用原位光电子能谱和X射线吸收谱”（in situ photoemission spectroscopy and x-ray absorption spectroscopy）进行测量。；研究对象：VO₂/TiO₂ (110) 超薄膜，具体研究其电子结构、V-V二聚化以及厚度依赖的金属-绝缘体转变（MIT）和电子相分离行为。关注的是沿面内c_R轴方向的一维V-V链体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在VO₂ (110)_R超薄膜中，当厚度降至1 nm时，出现了一种无V-V二聚化的绝缘电子相，且该相与具有温度驱动MIT的相共存并随厚度减小呈指数增长；这表明维度降低导致的Mott不稳定性增强是VO₂超薄膜中无二聚化绝缘相出现的共同驱动力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在VO₂ (110)_R超薄膜中，当厚度降至1 nm时，出现了一种无V-V二聚化的绝缘电子相，且该相与具有温度驱动MIT的相共存并随厚度减小呈指数增长；这表明维度降低导致的Mott不稳定性增强是VO₂超薄膜中无二聚化绝缘相出现的共同驱动力。；创新点：揭示了在VO₂ (110)_R取向（V-V链位于膜面内，不施加几何约束）中，无二聚化绝缘相仍能出现，且与(001)_R取向不同，该相与MIT相共存并发生电子相分离；进一步指出V-V链的几何取向通过应变介导的相竞争决定了电子相分离的空间演化。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 原位光电子能谱（in situ photoemission spectroscopy）和X射线吸收谱（X-ray absorption spectroscopy），用于表征不同厚度薄膜的电子结构和V-V二聚化程度。

papers.title: Doping-driven evolution of pairing symmetry in pressurized La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$
papers.abstract: We investigate the superconducting pairing symmetry and its doping evolution in pressurized La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$. For the undoped compound, the most favorable pairing state is found to be $s_{\pm}$-wave, characterized by sign reversal of the gap functions between the Fermi pockets. A detailed analysis of the pairing interactions reveals that this unconventional state originates from repulsive interactions mediated by the magnetic odd modes of the bilayer nickelate. Upon hole doping, the $γ$ Fermi pocket expands, which amplifies the intrapocket repulsions on this pocket. These repulsions, driven by the magnetic even modes, gradually dominates the pairing interactions and ultimately drive a transition in pairing symmetry from $s_{\pm}$-wave to $d_{xy}$-wave in the heavily hole-doped regime. In stark contrast, the $s_{\pm}$-wave pairing persists under electron doping, even deep into the heavily electron-doped regime where a Lifshitz transition occurs. This finding suggests that the $γ$ Fermi pocket is not essential for the emergence of superconductivity in bilayer nickelates. In fact, the $s_{\pm}$-wave pairing becomes more robust in the absence of the $γ$ pocket, as spin fluctuations are strongly enhanced by the favorable nesting between the $α$ and $β$ pockets --- a condition guaranteed by Luttinger's theorem and the Fermi surface topology. We believe that exploring the doping evolution of superconducting pairing will open a new realm for testing the pairing mechanism in pressurized La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“investigate”“found to be”“analysis of the pairing interactions”等理论分析表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：加压双层镍氧化物La₃Ni₂O₇中的超导配对对称性及其随掺杂（空穴掺杂与电子掺杂）的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 未掺杂的加压La₃Ni₂O₇最有利配对态为s±波（费米口袋间符号反转）；空穴掺杂会驱动配对对称性从s±波转变为dxy波，而电子掺杂（即使发生Lifshitz转变）仍保持s±波配对，且γ口袋缺失时s±波反而更稳健。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：未掺杂的加压La₃Ni₂O₇最有利配对态为s±波（费米口袋间符号反转）；空穴掺杂会驱动配对对称性从s±波转变为dxy波，而电子掺杂（即使发生Lifshitz转变）仍保持s±波配对，且γ口袋缺失时s±波反而更稳健。；创新点：揭示了空穴掺杂与电子掺杂对配对对称性的不对称影响，并提出γ费米口袋并非双层镍酸盐超导电性出现的必要条件——s±波配对在γ口袋缺失时因α-β口袋间良好嵌套而增强。这一掺杂演化图像为实验检验配对机制提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于配对相互作用的详细分析，结合费米面拓扑、Luttinger定理以及自旋涨落（磁奇/偶模）介导的排斥相互作用机制，讨论配对对称性的掺杂演化。

papers.title: Real-space manifestation of ferroic multipoles in altermagnetic MnF$_2$
papers.abstract: Altermagnets are unconventional spin split magnets arising from the zero spin-orbit coupled limit. They host a magnetic multipolar order parameter yet direct real-space observation of these multipoles has remained elusive. Here we use polarized-neutron diffraction to reconstruct the three-dimensional magnetization density of the prototypical altermagnet MnF$_2$. By exploiting symmetry-selective magnetic reflections, we separate the dominant spherical Mn$^{2+}$ contribution from the much weaker anisotropic Mn magnetization and the covalent spin polarization of the fluorine ligands. The reconstructed spin density reveals a finite fluorine ion moment together with an anisotropic Mn magnetization consistent with the symmetry-allowed altermagnetic rank-5 magnetic multipole $O_{52}$(magnetic triacontadipole). These results provide direct real-space evidence of ferroic multipolar order in an altermagnet and establish polarized-neutron diffraction as a powerful probe of hidden magnetic multipoles in quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“polarized-neutron diffraction”（极化中子衍射）进行测量与重构，属于实验手段。；研究对象：典型交错磁体（altermagnet）MnF₂，具体研究其三维磁化密度分布、Mn²⁺与F⁻离子的磁矩及磁多极序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过极化中子衍射重构出MnF₂的实空间自旋密度，直接观察到有限氟离子磁矩和各向异性Mn磁化，其对称性符合交错磁体允许的秩5磁多极O₅₂（磁三十二极子），首次在实空间证实了交错磁体中的铁性多极序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过极化中子衍射重构出MnF₂的实空间自旋密度，直接观察到有限氟离子磁矩和各向异性Mn磁化，其对称性符合交错磁体允许的秩5磁多极O₅₂（磁三十二极子），首次在实空间证实了交错磁体中的铁性多极序。；创新点：首次在实空间直接观测到交错磁体中的磁多极序（铁性多极），并确立极化中子衍射作为探测量子材料中隐藏磁多极的有力工具。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 极化中子衍射（polarized-neutron diffraction），利用对称性选择的磁反射将球形Mn²⁺贡献与较弱的各向异性Mn磁化及F配体共价自旋极化分离，进而重构三维磁化密度。

papers.title: Duality Between Twist-Angle Disorder and Non-Hermitian Disorder
papers.abstract: We propose and study a model of moire heterobilayer systems where the twist angle remains uniform and well defined only within a finite range, but deforms randomly at larger distances. The local twist angle is then subject to a certain probability distribution that penalizes large fluctuations around its mean value. Within the framework of the replica trick, we show that disorder averaging produces a nontrivial correlation with alternating sign between replicas, maximized only close the boundary of each local domain and along certain directions. We show that for the low-energy moire bands, exactly the same correlation can be generated in a dual model where fermions are coupled to non-Hermitian disorder, which can evade Anderson localization dynamically. This duality provides a new perspective to investigate twist-angle disorder in moire systems, and unveils some of the essential differences between twist-angle disorder and conventional disorder.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“replica trick”（复制技巧）、“disorder averaging”（无序平均）等理论方法，并构建了“dual model”（对偶模型），未涉及具体实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：莫尔异质双层体系（moire heterobilayer systems）中的扭转角无序（twist-angle disorder）现象，以及该无序对低能莫尔能带和安德森局域化的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 扭转角无序在复制技巧框架下会产生一种特殊的、在局部畴边界附近最大化的交替符号关联；这种关联可以精确地由一个耦合非厄米无序的对偶模型来生成，后者能动态地规避安德森局域化。该对偶关系揭示了扭转角无序与传统无序之间的本质区别。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：扭转角无序在复制技巧框架下会产生一种特殊的、在局部畴边界附近最大化的交替符号关联；这种关联可以精确地由一个耦合非厄米无序的对偶模型来生成，后者能动态地规避安德森局域化。该对偶关系揭示了扭转角无序与传统无序之间的本质区别。；创新点：首次提出了扭转角无序与非厄米无序之间的对偶关系，为研究莫尔系统中的扭转角无序提供了全新视角，并明确指出扭转角无序不同于传统无序的独特物理后果（如规避安德森局域化）。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，具体采用复制技巧（replica trick）对扭转角无序进行系综平均，并构建了一个费米子耦合非厄米无序的对偶模型来等价描述低能莫尔能带。

papers.title: Enhanced Diffusion from Twist-Angle Disorder
papers.abstract: We consider the effect of twist-angle disorder on the single-particle properties of twisted bilayer systems. These materials are a natural playground for studying how tiny, uncontrolled spatial variations may become unusually consequential; a local change in the twist geometry can give rise to spatially-correlated alterations of the parent Hamiltonian, which in turn affect the coarse-grained properties of the substrate such as transport and ordering tendencies. In analogy to electrodynamics, where the magnetic field is given by the curl of the vector potential, we model the twist angle as the curl of the relative displacement between the two bilayers. We find that geometric scattering constraints imposed here by the twist structure substantially suppress momentum relaxation relative to mean-rate-matched white noise. We quantify these effects and show that the problem can be mapped onto a non-linear sigma model (NLSM).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We consider”“We model”“We find”“can be mapped onto”等理论推导与建模表述，未提及实验或数值计算手段。；研究对象：扭转双层体系（twisted bilayer systems）中由扭转角无序（twist-angle disorder）引起的单粒子性质变化，特别是其对动量弛豫、输运和有序化趋势等粗粒化性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 扭转角无序导致的几何散射约束会显著抑制动量弛豫，其抑制程度远强于具有相同平均速率的白噪声无序；该问题可映射为一个非线性sigma模型（NLSM）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：扭转角无序导致的几何散射约束会显著抑制动量弛豫，其抑制程度远强于具有相同平均速率的白噪声无序；该问题可映射为一个非线性sigma模型（NLSM）。；创新点：首次将扭转角无序的几何效应类比为电动力学中的磁场-矢势关系，并揭示其几何约束对动量弛豫的强烈抑制效应，同时建立与非线性sigma模型的映射关系。（摘要未突出说明与具体实验或数值方法的对比）
papers.method_zh: 采用类比电动力学的理论建模：将扭转角类比为磁场（即两层间相对位移的旋度），构建扭转角无序的几何描述；通过分析几何散射约束下的动量弛豫，并与均值匹配的白噪声对比，最终将问题映射到非线性sigma模型（NLSM）框架。

papers.title: Probing spin order via magnon transmission across quantum Hall ferromagnet heterojunctions
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional material platforms now host a remarkable array of exotic correlated phases, from unconventional superconductivity to fractional Chern insulators. Probing magnetic order in these systems is essential for understanding their underlying physics, yet dilute spin densities render conventional magnetic probes ineffective. Spin waves, or magnons, in quantum Hall ferromagnets (QHFM) have proven effective for probing the magnetic order in various symmetry-broken quantum Hall (QH) phases in graphene systems, but previous works have been limited to homojunction configurations within a single material. Here, we demonstrate magnon transmission across a monolayer-bilayer graphene quantum Hall ferromagnet heterojunction - the first magnon transmission across quantum Hall ferromagnet heterojunctions, using one material as a magnon source to probe magnetic order in a distinct material. Generating magnons in monolayer graphene (MLG) at $ν$ = 1, we detect their transmission through bilayer graphene (BLG) via nonlocal voltage measurements, revealing spin order in BLG symmetry-broken quantum Hall states. The transmission exhibits hallmark magnon signatures: a sharp onset at the Zeeman energy and systematic variation with Landau level filling, including suppression at $ν$ = 4 and 8 where spin polarization vanishes. Our findings establish heterojunction magnon transmission as a powerful, modular probe of magnetic order, opening new avenues for investigating exotic quantum states across the rapidly expanding family of two-dimensional materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“nonlocal voltage measurements”（非局域电压测量）等实验手段，并描述了实际观测到的输运信号特征。；研究对象：单层-双层石墨烯（MLG-BLG）量子霍尔铁磁异质结中的磁子（自旋波）输运，以及双层石墨烯中对称性破缺量子霍尔态的自旋序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次实现了跨量子霍尔铁磁异质结的磁子传输：在单层石墨烯ν=1态产生磁子，穿过双层石墨烯后被探测到，揭示了双层石墨烯对称性破缺量子霍尔态中的自旋序；磁子传输在ν=4和8处（自旋极化消失）被抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次实现了跨量子霍尔铁磁异质结的磁子传输：在单层石墨烯ν=1态产生磁子，穿过双层石墨烯后被探测到，揭示了双层石墨烯对称性破缺量子霍尔态中的自旋序；磁子传输在ν=4和8处（自旋极化消失）被抑制。；创新点：此前磁子探测仅限于单一材料内的同质结构型，本工作首次实现跨异质结（单层-双层石墨烯）的磁子传输，将一种材料作为磁子源来探测另一种不同材料的磁序，建立了异质结磁子传输这一模块化磁序探测手段。
papers.method_zh: 非局域电压测量（nonlocal voltage measurements）：在单层石墨烯中于ν=1态产生磁子，通过双层石墨烯传输后测量非局域电压信号；通过改变朗道能级填充因子系统研究磁子传输行为。

papers.title: Fractional Impurity Entropy from Potential Scattering in a Free Electron Gas
papers.abstract: Fractional changes in entropy are often associated with strong electron correlations or non-Abelian anyons in topological systems. We show that neither condition is necessary -- a system of free electrons on a ring scattering off a repulsive point-like impurity undergoes a $k_B\ln\sqrt 2$ entropy change as the impurity strength is increased. This effect arises from a shift of allowed single-particle momenta from integer quantization to half-integer quantization, induced by the impurity. We show that this fractional entropy change is universal across a broad class of single-particle dispersions, demonstrating that such signatures can arise without strong correlations or topological order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中描述的是对自由电子气模型的解析分析，涉及单粒子动量量子化条件的改变，未提及实验或数值计算方法。；研究对象：一维环上自由电子气与一个排斥性点状杂质（势散射）构成的量子系统，重点研究杂质强度变化引起的熵变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在自由电子气中，仅通过增强一个点状排斥杂质的散射强度，即可使系统产生 \( k_B\ln\sqrt 2 \) 的分数熵变，该效应源于单粒子允许动量从整数量子化转变为半整数量子化，且此分数熵变对多种单粒子色散关系具有普适性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在自由电子气中，仅通过增强一个点状排斥杂质的散射强度，即可使系统产生 \( k_B\ln\sqrt 2 \) 的分数熵变，该效应源于单粒子允许动量从整数量子化转变为半整数量子化，且此分数熵变对多种单粒子色散关系具有普适性。；创新点：打破了“分数熵变必然源于强关联或非阿贝尔任意子/拓扑序”的普遍认知，证明仅靠无相互作用的自由电子气中的势散射即可产生分数熵变，为分数熵信号提供了一种无需强关联或拓扑序的极简微观机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析分析：基于一维环上自由电子气的单粒子本征态求解，考察杂质势强度变化对动量量子化条件（整数→半整数）的影响，并计算相应的热力学熵变；同时推广到不同单粒子色散关系以验证普适性。

papers.title: Can a Spin Liquid State Persist as the Ground State in the Presence of Competing Interactions and Disorder?
papers.abstract: In this report, we have shown that, in an otherwise geometrically frustrated lattice, the underlying interactions compete to stabilize different magnetic phases. In conjunction with fluctuations, these interactions may lead to the formation of unusual ordered phases, providing a pathway for understanding the fluctuation-driven order-by-disorder phenomenon. This competition is further modified by the presence of inherent structural disorder in a frustrated two-dimensional lattice. Furthermore, due to the local nature of the additional structural disorder, the majority of the samples evolve toward glassy dynamics, which can not only mimic spin-liquid-like behavior but also make it difficult to identify genuine spin-liquid candidates experimentally.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/分析型文章。判断依据：摘要中强调“interactions compete”“fluctuations”“order-by-disorder phenomenon”等理论概念，未提及任何具体实验手段或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：几何阻挫二维晶格中的自旋液体基态，以及竞争相互作用与结构无序对其稳定性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在几何阻挫晶格中，相互竞争的相互作用与涨落协同可导致“序由无序”（order-by-disorder）驱动的非常规有序相；而局域结构无序的引入会使大多数样品演化为玻璃态动力学，该动力学可模拟自旋液体行为，从而在实验上混淆对真实自旋液体候选材料的识别。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在几何阻挫晶格中，相互竞争的相互作用与涨落协同可导致“序由无序”（order-by-disorder）驱动的非常规有序相；而局域结构无序的引入会使大多数样品演化为玻璃态动力学，该动力学可模拟自旋液体行为，从而在实验上混淆对真实自旋液体候选材料的识别。；创新点：揭示了局域结构无序对阻挫体系中自旋液体与玻璃态之间界限的模糊作用，指出玻璃态动力学可能被误认为自旋液体，为实验鉴别真实自旋液体候选材料提出了新的判据挑战。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体理论框架或计算方法（如是否采用蒙特卡洛、自旋波理论、重整化群等），仅提及基于相互作用竞争与涨落的理论分析。

papers.title: Orbital occupation selects structural dimensionality in binary transition-metal oxides
papers.abstract: Orbital-lattice coupling in transition-metal oxides is usually discussed within a given bonding framework, where orbital occupation is intertwined with local coordination, strain, or symmetry breaking. Here, we show that orbital occupation can also select the bonding framework itself, thereby determining structural dimensionality. Using first-principles calculations, we identify CrO as a prototype in which the single active $3d\,e_g$ electron of high-spin Cr$^{2+}$ gives rise to two competing orbital-structure states. The $d_{x^2-y^2}$ occupation favors a three-dimensionally connected covalent phase, whereas the $d_{z^2}$ occupation stabilizes a weakly coupled layered phase. Constrained-occupation calculations show that increasing the $d_{z^2}$ filling continuously contracts the in-plane lattice while expanding the structure along the layer normal. The two phases exhibit distinct magnetic ground states and ferroelastic responses. Moreover, the layered phase is robust against exchange-correlation functional and on-site ($U$) variations, remains dynamically stable down to the monolayer limit, and has a low exfoliation energy of 46 meV/Angstrom^2. Extending the analysis across related $3d$ binary oxides reveals a filling-dependence relation between accessible orbital filling and the preference for 2D or 3D connected bonding motifs, providing a microscopic basis for exploring low-dimensional oxide materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）和“constrained-occupation calculations”（约束占据计算）。；研究对象：二元过渡金属氧化物CrO，以及更广泛的3d过渡金属二元氧化物体系。具体物理现象是轨道占据如何决定结构维度（三维共价相 vs 二维层状相）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CrO中高自旋Cr²⁺的单个活性3d e_g电子，其轨道占据方式（d_{x²-y²} vs d_{z²}）直接选择不同的成键框架：前者稳定三维连通共价相，后者稳定弱耦合层状相，从而轨道占据本身决定了结构维度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CrO中高自旋Cr²⁺的单个活性3d e_g电子，其轨道占据方式（d_{x²-y²} vs d_{z²}）直接选择不同的成键框架：前者稳定三维连通共价相，后者稳定弱耦合层状相，从而轨道占据本身决定了结构维度。；创新点：以往轨道-晶格耦合研究均假设给定成键框架内讨论，本工作首次展示轨道占据可以主动选择成键框架本身，从而决定结构维度；并建立了3d二元氧化物中轨道填充与2D/3D成键偏好之间的普适填充依赖关系。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（DFT），包括约束占据计算（constrained-occupation calculations）；测试了不同交换关联泛函和Hubbard U值的影响；计算了剥离能（46 meV/Å²）和动态稳定性（声子计算，至单层极限）。

papers.title: Electronic state of vortices at twin boundaries in a nematic superconductor
papers.abstract: Local electronic states of vortices in an s $\pm$ d wave nematic superconductor are studied both in the absence and presence of twin boundaries. The Bogoliubov-de Gennes theory for a tight-binding model is used with its nematicity represented by the anisotropy in the transfer integrals and attractive interactions between the nearest-neighbor sites. We evaluate s and d wave components of the pair potentials and the local density of states, and analyze the effects of nematicity on the vortex core structures with/without twin boundaries. We find that a single vortex trapped at the twin boundary is composed of a bound pair of fractional vortices accompanied by weakly-induced s $\pm$ id wave components, despite that such s $\pm$ id wave components do not appear in a zero magnetic field. The calculated spatial structures of the local electronic states are compared with the vortex image measured by STM experiments in an iron-based superconductor FeSe.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Bogoliubov-de Gennes theory for a tight-binding model”进行数值计算，并与实验对比。；研究对象：s±d波向列超导体中的涡旋电子态，具体关注孪晶界（twin boundaries）处涡旋的局域电子结构，并与铁基超导体FeSe的STM实验图像对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在孪晶界处俘获的单个涡旋由一对分数涡旋束缚对组成，并伴随弱诱导的s±id波分量；尽管零磁场下并不出现s±id波分量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在孪晶界处俘获的单个涡旋由一对分数涡旋束缚对组成，并伴随弱诱导的s±id波分量；尽管零磁场下并不出现s±id波分量。；创新点：首次揭示孪晶界俘获涡旋可自发形成分数涡旋束缚对并诱导出零场下不存在的s±id波分量，为理解FeSe中涡旋的STM图像提供了新的理论图像。
papers.method_zh: 基于紧束缚模型的Bogoliubov-de Gennes（BdG）理论计算。向列性通过转移积分的各向异性及最近邻位点间的吸引相互作用来表征。计算了s波和d波配对势分量及局域态密度（LDOS），并分析有无孪晶界时向列性对涡旋芯结构的影响。

papers.title: Surface-mediated frequency aging beyond quality-factor saturation in an AlScN-on-silicon resonator
papers.abstract: Vacuum package integrity in micro- and nanoelectromechanical resonators is commonly assessed through the quality factor Q, although Q probes residual-gas damping rather than the surface-state evolution that can govern frequency aging. Here, we disentangle the pressure responses of Q and the resonance frequency f0 in a 64.21 MHz Al0.7Sc0.3N-on-silicon cross-sectional Lamé-mode resonator between 0.01 to 760 Torr. Measurements at 25 °C and at the 68.8°C frequency turnover, where first-order thermal sensitivity is suppressed, reveal widely separated equilibration timescales. Following each pressure step, Q reaches a reversible, history-independent steady value on the pressure-control timescale and approaches a fitted pressure-independent ceiling of 8.5e4 below approximately 1 Torr. By contrast, f0 responds measurably down to 1e-5 Torr and remains history-dependent, relaxing for hours at fixed pressure. The transients follow stretched-exponential kinetics, consistent with a broad distribution of surface relaxation rates, and individual pressure steps produce fractional frequency shifts as large as 1.9 ppm. Ten-hour phase-locked measurements show a common short-term time-deviation floor near 1e-10 s from 0.01 to 100 Torr, whereas residual deterministic relaxation dominates at long averaging times; at 760 Torr, gas damping degrades short-term tracking through the reduced Q. These results establish gas-damping equilibrium and frequency equilibrium as distinct states. Quality-factor saturation alone is therefore insufficient to qualify vacuum packaging for precision mechanical frequency references; package specifications must also constrain surface-mediated frequency aging.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体测量（压力响应测量、相位锁定测量），并给出实验数据（如Q值、频率漂移、时间偏差等）。；研究对象：Al₀.₇Sc₀.₃N-on-silicon（氮化铝钪/硅）截面Lamé模式谐振器，具体研究其品质因数Q与谐振频率f₀在0.01至760 Torr压力范围内的响应差异，以及表面介导的频率老化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Q与f₀对压力的响应是相互独立的：Q在约1 Torr以下达到与压力无关的饱和值（8.5×10⁴），而f₀在低至10⁻⁵ Torr仍可测量到响应，且呈现持续数小时的历史依赖弛豫行为。因此，Q饱和不足以判定真空封装质量，必须同时约束表面介导的频率老化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Q与f₀对压力的响应是相互独立的：Q在约1 Torr以下达到与压力无关的饱和值（8.5×10⁴），而f₀在低至10⁻⁵ Torr仍可测量到响应，且呈现持续数小时的历史依赖弛豫行为。因此，Q饱和不足以判定真空封装质量，必须同时约束表面介导的频率老化。；创新点：首次将气体阻尼平衡与频率平衡区分为两个独立状态，明确指出Q饱和不能作为精密频率参考器件真空封装合格性的充分判据，并定量揭示了表面弛豫速率分布对频率老化的主导作用。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量：在25 °C和68.8 °C频率转折点（一阶热灵敏度被抑制）下，对谐振器施加阶跃压力（0.01–760 Torr），测量Q和f₀的瞬态响应；采用拉伸指数动力学拟合频率弛豫；进行10小时相位锁定测量以评估短期时间偏差（Allan偏差类分析）。

papers.title: Symmetry-Preserving Phase Transitions in $AM_2$Al$_9$ Materials under Pressure
papers.abstract: External parameters such as temperature, pressure, and chemical doping can induce structural phase transitions in materials. Although such transitions usually involve a change in symmetry, an uncommon exception is the isostructural phase transition, which is first order yet preserves the symmetry of the parent structure. Using first-principles calculations, we show that $AM_2$Al$_9$ compounds ($A$ = Ba, Ca, Sr, or Eu; $M$ = Fe, Co, or Ni) undergo pressure-induced isostructural phase transitions. At the transition pressure, these systems exhibit a pronounced volume collapse while retaining the same crystal symmetry and space group ($P6/mmm$). Bonding analysis based on the integrated crystal orbital Hamilton population (ICOHP) shows that the transition is driven by a redistribution of bonding character between intralayer and interlayer atomic bonds. Because isostructural transitions are rare in single crystals, $AM_2$Al$_9$ provides a promising platform for investigating critical phenomena under pressure and for deepening our understanding of symmetry-preserving structural transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“使用第一性原理计算”（first-principles calculations）。；研究对象：$AM_2$Al$_9$ 系列化合物（$A$ = Ba, Ca, Sr, Eu；$M$ = Fe, Co, Ni），具体研究其在压力下的等结构相变（isostructural phase transition）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: $AM_2$Al$_9$ 化合物在压力下发生一级等结构相变：在相变压力处体积发生显著塌缩，但晶体对称性和空间群（$P6/mmm$）保持不变。该相变由层内与层间原子键之间成键特征的重新分配驱动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：$AM_2$Al$_9$ 化合物在压力下发生一级等结构相变：在相变压力处体积发生显著塌缩，但晶体对称性和空间群（$P6/mmm$）保持不变。该相变由层内与层间原子键之间成键特征的重新分配驱动。；创新点：在单晶材料中，等结构相变极为罕见，$AM_2$Al$_9$ 体系为研究压力下的临界现象以及对称性保持的结构相变提供了一个有前景的平台。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（DFT）；基于积分晶体轨道哈密顿布居数（ICOHP）的成键分析。

papers.title: Coherent phononic frequency combs in ferroelectric CMOS oxides
papers.abstract: Modern electronic systems require tens of clock and carrier frequencies, each synthesized by a dedicated phase-locked loop from a shared reference, imposing routing, power and synchronization burdens that grow with every domain. Optical frequency combs solved this problem in photonics, whereas electronics has lacked an equivalent source in its native radiofrequency domain. Here we report broadband phononic frequency combs in ferroelectric hafnia-zirconia nanoelectromechanical resonators built from complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) oxides. Lithographically defined detuning of a 2:1 internal resonance selects the generation mechanism: two-tone-seeded wave mixing yields more than 170 lines distributed over two octaves, with mutual coherence verified for representative pump and generated lines, whereas an autonomous Hopf route yields hierarchical combs of more than 200 lines through torus and period-doubling dynamics, in agreement with slow-flow bifurcation theory. Geometric scaling extends comb generation across 0.44 GHz to 2.1 GHz. Heterodyne measurements, analyzed using the modified Allan deviation (MDEV), establish a two-timescale law. The mechanism governs short-term stability: seeded combs inherit the white-phase-noise scaling of their pumps, whereas autonomous combs acquire the phase diffusion of a free-running oscillator, with the one-second MDEV increasing from 1e-11 to 1e-8. The material governs long-term stability: in air and without active thermal control, the temperature-compensated stack suppresses the random-walk drift that dominates uncompensated resonators. These results establish mechanism- and material-level design rules for operating a single resonator as chip-scale frequency infrastructure, from multi-clock generation to radiofrequency parallel processing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的器件制备（“lithographically defined”）、测量手段（“heterodyne measurements”）以及实验现象观测（“more than 170 lines”、“more than 200 lines”），并结合了理论对比（“in agreement with slow-flow bifurcation theory”），属于实验为主、理论验证的混合类型。；研究对象：基于铁电氧化铪-氧化锆（hafnia-zirconia）的纳米机电谐振器，该材料体系为CMOS兼容氧化物。研究的物理现象为声子频率梳（phononic frequency combs）的产生及其相干性、稳定性特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在铁电CMOS氧化物纳米机电谐振器中实现了宽带声子频率梳，通过2:1内共振的失谐调控可选择两种产生机制（双音注入波混频和自治Hopf分岔），分别产生超过170条和200条的梳齿线，并建立了由机制（短期）和材料（长期）共同决定的双时间尺度稳定性规律。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在铁电CMOS氧化物纳米机电谐振器中实现了宽带声子频率梳，通过2:1内共振的失谐调控可选择两种产生机制（双音注入波混频和自治Hopf分岔），分别产生超过170条和200条的梳齿线，并建立了由机制（短期）和材料（长期）共同决定的双时间尺度稳定性规律。；创新点：首次在CMOS兼容的铁电氧化物中实现宽带声子频率梳，并系统揭示了机制层面（种子注入 vs. 自治振荡）和材料层面（温度补偿堆叠）对频率梳短期与长期稳定性的独立调控规律，为单谐振器作为芯片级频率基础设施（多时钟生成、射频并行处理）提供了设计准则。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用微纳加工制备纳米机电谐振器，通过光刻定义2:1内共振失谐量；利用双音注入波混频和自治振荡（Hopf分岔路径）激发频率梳；采用外差测量（heterodyne measurements）并利用修正阿伦偏差（MDEV）分析频率稳定性；理论上与慢流分岔理论（slow-flow bifurcation theory）进行对比验证。

papers.title: Giant staggered Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya vectors emerged in synthetic antiferromagnets with spatially alternating stress
papers.abstract: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interaction is a source of chiral magnetic physics, and it manifests microstructural symmetry which could link to exotic magnetic and electronic properties such as altermagnetism. For a new paradigm in magnetism and spintronics, it is crucial to have control on the DM interaction as well as ordering of the DM vectors which characterize the DM interaction. Here, we report on a strong interlayer DM interaction emerged in Co/Ru magnetic superlattices whose structural symmetry is unambiguously broken by alternating mechanical strains developed using the peculiar technique of our stress mechanism. Moreover, theoretical analyses reveal that our magnetic superlattices host a staggered order of the DM vectors. Our results indicate that the spatially varying strains with our breakthrough technique are quite effective in breaking the symmetry of the system and prove that it can control the DM interaction strength as well as the DM vector order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合理论分析）。判断依据：摘要提及“we report on”“developed using the peculiar technique of our stress mechanism”等实验表述，同时包含“theoretical analyses reveal”表明有理论分析支撑。；研究对象：Co/Ru 磁性超晶格（synthetic antiferromagnets）中由空间交替应力诱导产生的层间 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya（DM）相互作用及其 DM 矢量交错有序排列。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Co/Ru 磁性超晶格中，通过空间交替机械应变打破结构对称性，实现了强层间 DM 相互作用，并发现 DM 矢量呈现交错（staggered）有序排列。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Co/Ru 磁性超晶格中，通过空间交替机械应变打破结构对称性，实现了强层间 DM 相互作用，并发现 DM 矢量呈现交错（staggered）有序排列。；创新点：首次在合成反铁磁超晶格中利用空间变化的应变（而非传统界面工程或元素掺杂）有效控制 DM 相互作用的强度及 DM 矢量的有序排列，实现了 DM 矢量的交错序，为关联交错磁性与手性磁物理提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用作者自研的“应力机制”（stress mechanism）技术，对 Co/Ru 超晶格施加空间交替的机械应变以破坏结构对称性；理论上通过分析揭示 DM 矢量的交错有序性。摘要未明确说明具体表征手段（如磁光克尔效应、布里渊光散射等）或理论计算方法（如第一性原理计算等）。

papers.title: Chiral Tubular Magnonic Crystals with Periodic Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya Interaction
papers.abstract: We introduce a chiral tubular magnonic crystal formed by a ferromagnetic nanotube with a periodically modulated interfacial Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction (DMI). Using a plane-wave formalism adapted to the cylindrical geometry, we calculate the spin-wave band structure including exchange, nonlocal dipolar coupling, and interfacial DMI. We show that the tubular geometry qualitatively modifies the role of periodic DMI compared with planar chiral magnonic crystals. Besides producing the usual nonreciprocal frequency shift, curvature converts part of the interfacial DMI into an effective anisotropy-like internal field. This creates a sign-dependent frequency landscape along the tube, so that DMI-covered regions can act either as potential wells or barriers for the lowest-frequency modes. As a result, flat and weakly dispersive bands appear in both Damon--Eshbach-like and backward-volume-like configurations, with the latter having no direct counterpart in planar systems. Our results identify periodically engineered DMI in nanotubes as a route for controlling nonreciprocal spin waves, localized modes, and flat magnonic bands in curved architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。依据：摘要提到“使用平面波形式”“计算自旋波能带结构”，属于理论建模与数值计算。；研究对象：具有周期性界面Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya相互作用（DMI）调制的铁磁纳米管，即手性管状磁子晶体。研究其自旋波能带、非互易传播及局域模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 管状几何将部分界面DMI转化为类似各向异性的有效内场，使DMI覆盖区域对低频模式表现为势阱或势垒，从而在Damon–Eshbach型和backward-volume型构型中均产生平坦弱色散能带，后者在平面体系中无直接对应物。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：管状几何将部分界面DMI转化为类似各向异性的有效内场，使DMI覆盖区域对低频模式表现为势阱或势垒，从而在Damon–Eshbach型和backward-volume型构型中均产生平坦弱色散能带，后者在平面体系中无直接对应物。；创新点：首次提出并研究周期性DMI调制的管状磁子晶体，揭示曲率对周期性DMI作用的定性改变——将界面DMI转化为有效各向异性场，并实现平面体系无法获得的平坦能带与局域模式。
papers.method_zh: 采用适用于圆柱几何的平面波形式方法，计算包含交换作用、非局域偶极耦合和界面DMI的自旋波能带结构。

papers.title: Energy landscape and dissipation of sliding magnetic rotor arrays
papers.abstract: Magnetically coupled damped rotational degrees of freedom can give rise to tribological loss when excited by a relative sliding motion, linking friction to the dynamics of magnetic moments. We analytically investigate such magnetic friction by studying a recently introduced simplified model for a rigid magnetic rotor array sliding over a commensurate magnetic substrate. Here, the array rotors can rotate about an axis perpendicular to the sliding direction and are damped by microscopic shaft friction, while the substrate magnets have a fixed in-plane orientation. The simplified model reduces the collective rotor dynamics of this setup to a set of coupled nonlinear differential equations, which can be studied by the corresponding energy landscape in the quasi-static regime. We find that the parameter plane spanned by layer separation and time can be divided into distinct chambers, in which the structure of the energy landscape remains invariant. Using these chambers, we identify the layer separation intervals corresponding to different dynamical states and recover the emergence of a regime where the moment alignment alternates globally while exhibiting peak dissipation. Additionally, we derive the leading nontrivial orders of the collective magnetic friction in the regimes of small and large gaps between the array and the substrate. For the alternating regime, we find that friction can be computed by tracking energy jumps from unstable to stable critical points at the chamber boundaries. These results provide an analytical foundation for the observed dynamics and dissipation in sliding rotor arrays. Because the simplified model is scale-free, our conclusions transfer across a broad range of microscopic and macroscopic length scales.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“analytically investigate”“simplified model”“coupled nonlinear differential equations”“energy landscape”等关键词，属于解析理论研究。；研究对象：刚性磁转子阵列在共度磁性基底上滑动时的磁摩擦现象。具体体系为：转子可绕垂直于滑动方向的轴旋转，受微观轴摩擦阻尼；基底磁矩具有固定的面内取向。该模型为无标度简化模型，结论可跨微观至宏观尺度迁移。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在层间距与时间构成的参数平面中，能量景观结构可划分为若干不变“腔室”，据此识别出不同的动力学状态区间，并发现一种全局磁矩交替排列且耗散达到峰值的特殊 regime。在小间距和大间距极限下，推导了集体磁摩擦的前导非平凡阶；在交替 regime 中，摩擦可通过追踪腔室边界处从不稳定到稳定临界点的能量跳变来计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在层间距与时间构成的参数平面中，能量景观结构可划分为若干不变“腔室”，据此识别出不同的动力学状态区间，并发现一种全局磁矩交替排列且耗散达到峰值的特殊 regime。在小间距和大间距极限下，推导了集体磁摩擦的前导非平凡阶；在交替 regime 中，摩擦可通过追踪腔室边界处从不稳定到稳定临界点的能量跳变来计算。；创新点：首次对滑动磁转子阵列的摩擦行为给出解析层面的完整描述，特别是通过能量景观腔室划分系统性地识别不同动力学状态，并揭示了交替排列 regime 中摩擦与能量跳变的定量联系。摘要未突出说明与具体实验或数值模拟的对比。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论分析：将刚性磁转子阵列的集体动力学约化为耦合非线性微分方程组，在准静态极限下通过能量景观的拓扑结构（临界点、腔室划分）进行研究，并分别在小间距与大间距极限下做微扰展开求摩擦力的解析表达式。

papers.title: Design and Modeling of the Charge Readout of a SiMOS Quantum Dot with a Single Electron Transistor and CryoCMOS
papers.abstract: Single electron spin qubits trapped in SiMOS quantum dots are a promising technology for scaling to thousand- or million-qubit systems due to their compatibility with mature CMOS manufacturing processes. A readout system that combines a single electron transistor with a custom cryogenic CMOS amplification and digitization chain offers key advantages by avoiding the use of bulky RF components or room-temperature interconnects. We present design techniques and simulation results for an optimized qubit-SET cryoCMOS interface, culminating in the design of the QNDR1 ASIC, the first cryogenic readout ASIC designed under the Quandarum project, which targets the development of a many-channel spin qubit based detector for use in high energy physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：工程设计/仿真类文章（关键词：design techniques, simulation results, ASIC design）。属于应用型工程研究，非纯实验或纯理论。；研究对象：SiMOS量子点中的单电子自旋量子比特，及其与单电子晶体管（SET）和低温CMOS（cryoCMOS）放大/数字化链路的集成读出系统。具体物理对象为量子点电荷态读出接口。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过优化量子比特-SET-cryoCMOS接口设计，成功实现了QNDR1 ASIC——Quandarum项目下首款低温读出专用集成电路，面向多通道自旋量子比特探测器（用于高能物理）的电荷读出需求。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过优化量子比特-SET-cryoCMOS接口设计，成功实现了QNDR1 ASIC——Quandarum项目下首款低温读出专用集成电路，面向多通道自旋量子比特探测器（用于高能物理）的电荷读出需求。；创新点：避免了传统方案中笨重的射频元件或室温互连，将SET读出与定制低温CMOS放大/数字化链路线下集成于单一ASIC中，首次在Quandarum项目框架下实现多通道兼容CMOS工艺的低温读出芯片。摘要未突出说明与现有低温读出ASIC在性能指标上的具体对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 电路设计技术与仿真模拟。具体包括：量子点-SET耦合接口的电路级优化设计，低温CMOS放大与数字化链路的仿真验证，以及ASIC版图级实现（QNDR1）。

papers.title: Revealing low-energy surfaces of multinary compounds by controlling surface coordination environments
papers.abstract: When modeling surfaces of multinary compounds, conventional cleavage planes often cut through strongly bonded polyhedra, resulting in unphysical surface energies. Here, we introduce SALAMI (Symmetric Atomic Layers for Arbitrary Multinary Interfaces), a Python package that generates symmetric, charge-neutral, dipole-free, and low-energy slab models for multinary compounds. SALAMI performs combinatorial searches to selectively remove surface atoms and generate corrugated terminations that preserve optimal coordination environments. We applied this workflow to all symmetrically inequivalent crystallographic orientations with Miller indices up to 2 for two prototypical structures: the solid-state electrolyte Li3PS4 and the transparent conducting oxide ZnSb2O6. Density functional theory calculations reveal that Li3PS4 must preserve all PS4 units to achieve the minimum surface energy. For ZnSb2O6, low-energy surfaces are achieved by partial undercoordination of surface Sb atoms to SbO5 or SbO4 from the bulk SbO6, depending on the surface orientations. Compared to surface models generated with unconstrained coordination, applying constraints to achieve optimal local coordination environments significantly lowers surface energies, shrinking the volume of the predicted Wulff shape by approximately 20%. Our results demonstrate that meticulous control of local coordination environments is necessary for accurately predicting the surface energetics of multinary compounds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Density functional theory calculations”（密度泛函理论计算），并介绍了Python包开发与表面能计算。；研究对象：多组分化合物（multinary compounds）的低能表面，具体以固态电解质Li₃PS₄和透明导电氧化物ZnSb₂O₆为原型体系，研究其不同晶体学取向的表面稳定性与原子配位环境的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过控制表面原子的局部配位环境（如Li₃PS₄必须完整保留所有PS₄四面体单元，ZnSb₂O₆表面Sb原子允许部分欠配位形成SbO₅或SbO₄），可以显著降低多组分化合物的表面能；与无约束生成的表面模型相比，施加最优配位约束可使预测的Wulff形状体积缩小约20%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过控制表面原子的局部配位环境（如Li₃PS₄必须完整保留所有PS₄四面体单元，ZnSb₂O₆表面Sb原子允许部分欠配位形成SbO₅或SbO₄），可以显著降低多组分化合物的表面能；与无约束生成的表面模型相比，施加最优配位约束可使预测的Wulff形状体积缩小约20%。；创新点：提出了一种系统生成多组分化合物低能表面模型的自动化方法（SALAMI），首次将“局部配位环境优化”作为表面建模的显式约束条件，解决了传统解理面切断强键合多面体导致非物理表面能的问题。
papers.method_zh: 开发了Python软件包SALAMI（Symmetric Atomic Layers for Arbitrary Multinary Interfaces），通过组合搜索选择性移除表面原子，生成对称、电荷中性、无偶极且具有波纹状（corrugated）终止面的slab模型；对所有Miller指数≤2的对称不等价晶面进行系统搜索，并结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算表面能。

papers.title: Phase stability, charge ordering, and charge-liquid formation in the Falicov-Kimball model on triangular and kagome lattices
papers.abstract: We present a systematic investigation of the stability of the phase diagram of the spinless Falicov-Kimball model on two-dimensional non-bipartite lattices, the triangular and kagome lattices, using Markov-chain Monte Carlo simulations. Three filling or chemical potential conditions are examined: fixed chemical potentials ($μ_f = μ_c = U/2$), "generalized" half-filling ($\bar{n}_f = 1/3$, $\bar{n}_c = 2/3$), and conventional half-filling ($\bar{n}_f = \bar{n}_c = 1/2$). For each condition, the effects of a perturbatively small next-nearest-neighbor hopping are studied. On the triangular lattice, Anderson insulator, Mott insulator, and charge-density wave (CDW) phases are found in all cases, with the CDW driven by Coulomb-interaction-mediated nesting. Evidence for a charge-liquid regime is found in the region between the weakly correlated regime and the CDW, characterized by competing charge-ordering wavevectors and the absence of universal scaling behavior, whose extent shrinks progressively from the grand-canonical to the conventional half-filling condition. On the kagome lattice, the CDW phase is completely absent; instead, an insulating ground state, plausibly of the Mott type, is found, with signatures of a possible quantum phase transition at zero temperature. Our results establish the crucial role of lattice geometry and particle-hole symmetry breaking in shaping the phase diagram of correlated electron systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用Markov-chain Monte Carlo模拟进行系统性研究。；研究对象：二维非二分格点（三角格与kagome格）上的无自旋Falicov-Kimball模型，重点关注相稳定性、电荷有序及电荷液体形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三角格上，所有填充条件下均出现Anderson绝缘体、Mott绝缘体和电荷密度波（CDW）相，并在弱关联区与CDW之间发现电荷液体态证据；在kagome格上CDW完全缺失，代之以Mott型绝缘基态，并存在零温量子相变的迹象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三角格上，所有填充条件下均出现Anderson绝缘体、Mott绝缘体和电荷密度波（CDW）相，并在弱关联区与CDW之间发现电荷液体态证据；在kagome格上CDW完全缺失，代之以Mott型绝缘基态，并存在零温量子相变的迹象。；创新点：系统揭示了晶格几何（三角格 vs. kagome格）和粒子-空穴对称性破缺对关联电子体系相图的决定性作用，首次在三角格Falicov-Kimball模型中给出电荷液体态存在的数值证据，并发现kagome格上CDW的完全缺失这一几何效应。
papers.method_zh: 采用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（Markov-chain Monte Carlo）模拟，考察三种填充/化学势条件（固定化学势μf=μc=U/2、广义半填充n̄f=1/3, n̄c=2/3、常规半填充n̄f=n̄c=1/2），并研究微扰性次近邻跳跃的影响。

papers.title: Regularization of Vortex Core Size in Photon BECs due to Harmonic Trap: An Analytical Approach
papers.abstract: Quantized vortices are a hallmark of superfluidity. However, in a photon Bose--Einstein condensate, the photon-photon interaction is so weak that in a homogeneous system the healing length exceeds the experimentally achievable size of the condensate itself. Here we show that a harmonic confinement regularizes the vortex size to experimentally achievable scales. Moreover, such an external confinement closely resembles the standard experimental setup of a pumped dye-filled microcavity. We model the condensate via a complex Gross--Pitaevskii equation and obtain an approximate dynamical single-vortex solution by applying the recently proposed projection optimization method.
