The latter generalizes the variational approach of closed systems to open-dissipative systems without assuming a specific form for the condensate phase. The radial photon flow, which is characteristic for driven-dissipative systems, yields a definition of the vortex core size based on the competition of gain and loss. However, this condition reproduces the heuristic closed system definition now based on physical grounds. A subsequent linear stability analysis shows that interaction, as well as pumping and loss can drive the system to an unstable regime. In this way one can fundamentally distinguish between closed and open-dissipative systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytical approach、model、complex Gross–Pitaevskii equation、projection optimization method、linear stability analysis。；研究对象：光子玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚体（photon BEC）中的量子化涡旋，特别是谐波囚禁势下涡旋核心尺寸的调控，以及开放耗散体系（泵浦染料填充微腔）中的涡旋动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 谐波囚禁势可将光子BEC中原本超过体系尺寸的涡旋核心（愈合长度）正则化到实验可观测的尺度；基于增益与损耗竞争可定义涡旋核心尺寸，且该定义在物理上复现了闭系统启发式定义，但相互作用、泵浦和损耗可导致系统进入不稳定区，从而在原理上区分闭系统与开放耗散系统。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：谐波囚禁势可将光子BEC中原本超过体系尺寸的涡旋核心（愈合长度）正则化到实验可观测的尺度；基于增益与损耗竞争可定义涡旋核心尺寸，且该定义在物理上复现了闭系统启发式定义，但相互作用、泵浦和损耗可导致系统进入不稳定区，从而在原理上区分闭系统与开放耗散系统。；创新点：将投影优化方法首次应用于光子BEC涡旋问题，在不预设相位形式的前提下获得开放耗散系统的近似涡旋解；从增益–损耗竞争出发给出涡旋核心尺寸的物理定义，并揭示闭系统与开放耗散系统在稳定性行为上的根本区别。
papers.method_zh: 采用复Gross–Pitaevskii方程描述凝聚体，应用最近提出的投影优化方法（projection optimization method）获得近似的动力学单涡旋解，该方法将闭系统的变分方法推广到开放耗散系统且无需预设凝聚体相位形式；随后进行线性稳定性分析。

papers.title: Engineering Excitons through Polymorphism and Dimensional Confinement in Low-Dimensional Tellurium
papers.abstract: The interplay between dimensionality, band-edge electronic structure, and electron-hole interactions governs the optical response of low-dimensional tellurium, yet the microscopic origin of its excitonic behavior remains largely unexplored. Here, we investigate the quasiparticle, excitonic, and optical properties of two-dimensional tellurium polymorphs and one-dimensional helical nanowires using many-body GW and the Bethe--Salpeter equation. Our results reveal a strong dependence of the excitonic response on band-edge dispersion, crystal symmetry, and dimensional confinement. $α$-tellurene exhibits comparatively weak and spatially extended electron-hole correlations, whereas the SOC-induced quasi-flat band-edge states of $β$-tellurene give rise to a strongly bound and anisotropic near-infrared exciton. Momentum-resolved BSE eigenvectors and real-space exciton wave functions directly reveal the contrasting localization and anisotropy of these excitonic states. Remarkably, hydrogen-passivated hexagonal tellurene, previously identified as a quantum spin Hall phase with $Z_2=1$, supports an even larger direct exciton binding energy of 0.51 eV together with a compact and nearly isotropic in-plane excitonic distribution. This demonstrates that strong electron-hole correlations are fully compatible with nontrivial band topology, while the binding strength and spatial character of the exciton remain strongly dependent on the underlying band-edge electronic structure and crystal symmetry. The one-dimensional helical nanowire represents the strong-confinement limit, exhibiting a direct high exciton binding energy and a pronounced shift of the optical response toward the ultraviolet.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到使用“many-body GW and the Bethe–Salpeter equation”（多体GW方法及Bethe–Salpeter方程）进行第一性原理计算。；研究对象：低维碲（tellurium）体系，包括二维碲的多晶型（α-碲烯、β-碲烯、氢钝化六方碲烯）以及一维螺旋纳米线，重点研究其激子（exciton）行为、能带边缘电子结构、维度限制与光学响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 低维碲的激子性质强烈依赖于能带边缘色散、晶体对称性和维度限制：α-碲烯中电子-空穴关联较弱且空间延展，β-碲烯中自旋-轨道耦合诱导的准平带边缘态产生强束缚且各向异性的近红外激子，而氢钝化六方碲烯（具有Z₂=1量子自旋霍尔相）表现出高达0.51 eV的直接激子束缚能及紧凑近各向同性的面内激子分布，证明强电子-空穴关联与非平庸能带拓扑可共存。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：低维碲的激子性质强烈依赖于能带边缘色散、晶体对称性和维度限制：α-碲烯中电子-空穴关联较弱且空间延展，β-碲烯中自旋-轨道耦合诱导的准平带边缘态产生强束缚且各向异性的近红外激子，而氢钝化六方碲烯（具有Z₂=1量子自旋霍尔相）表现出高达0.51 eV的直接激子束缚能及紧凑近各向同性的面内激子分布，证明强电子-空穴关联与非平庸能带拓扑可共存。；创新点：首次系统揭示了低维碲不同晶型及维度限制下激子行为的微观起源，特别是发现拓扑非平庸的氢钝化六方碲烯同时具有强激子束缚能，将强电子-空穴关联与非平庸能带拓扑联系起来，并阐明了SOC诱导准平带对激子束缚的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 基于多体微扰理论的第一性原理计算：GW近似（用于准粒子能带结构）结合Bethe–Salpeter方程（用于激子态和光学性质），并利用动量分辨的BSE本征矢量和实空间激子波函数分析激子的局域化与各向异性。

papers.title: Superconductivity and Magnetism in Bi-Ni System: From Bulk to Heterostructures
papers.abstract: Unconventional superconductivity with ingredients of magnetism such as time reversal breaking, triplet pairing and proximity effects has been a long time pursued topic in physics and material science as a new source of innovative phenomena and effects to drive further scientific advances and technologies. The Bi-Ni system has emerged as a convenient candidate for the investigation of such phenomenology. Strictly speaking, the term Bi-Ni system refers to two different schemes, first to the NiBi$_{3}$ intermetallic compound, a 4 K superconductor in which a complex magnetism seems to govern electrical properties in the normal phase, but without implication in the superconducting properties. The second Bi-Ni system is not quite a material but a heterostructure formed by a bilayer of Bi and Ni. Here the superconducting phase has to steal the spotlight by showing strong evidence of time-reversal breaking and triplet pairing featuring a complex unconventional state. The ease of preparing the samples, compared to other candidates for such unconventionality, usually Uranium-based compounds, has accelerated the research in this system. Here, we went through a detailed review of the main results about the electronic properties of these two systems as well as a discussion of the main open questions to be solved in order to reach the complete understanding in this topic.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章（Review）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“we went through a detailed review of the main results”。；研究对象：Bi-Ni 体系中的超导电性与磁性，具体包括两种方案：(1) NiBi₃ 金属间化合物（4 K 超导体，正常态存在复杂磁性）；(2) Bi/Ni 双层异质结构（表现出时间反演对称性破缺和自旋三重态配对迹象）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Bi-Ni 体系为研究非常规超导电性（如时间反演对称性破缺、三重态配对、邻近效应）提供了便捷平台：NiBi₃ 中磁性仅影响正常态电输运而不参与超导；Bi/Ni 异质结则表现出强的时间反演对称性破缺与三重态配对证据，呈现复杂非常规超导态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Bi-Ni 体系为研究非常规超导电性（如时间反演对称性破缺、三重态配对、邻近效应）提供了便捷平台：NiBi₃ 中磁性仅影响正常态电输运而不参与超导；Bi/Ni 异质结则表现出强的时间反演对称性破缺与三重态配对证据，呈现复杂非常规超导态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但指出该体系相较于其他非常规超导候选材料（通常为铀基化合物）具有制备简便的优势，从而加速了相关研究进展。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验或计算手段，仅提及“电子性质”的综述性讨论，以及样品制备相对铀基化合物更简便。具体方法（如输运测量、极化中子反射、点接触谱等）摘要未给出。

papers.title: Direct Evidence of Unconventional Superconductivity in Doped Kagome system RV$_3$Sb$_5$
papers.abstract: The superconducting pairing symmetry of kagome metals remains a central unresolved question largely because phase-sensitive experiments capable of distinguishing between different possible order parameters have been difficult to implement. The spatial and energetic characteristics of impurity bound states measured by spectroscopic-imaging scanning tunneling microscopy encode information on the superconducting order parameter. Here, we use impurity-bound state spectroscopy to investigate optimally doped RbV$_3$Sb$_{5}$ where the charge-density wave instability is fully suppressed. We find that the superconducting state is fully gapped and exhibits two distinct energy scales, consistent with a multiband order parameter. Atomic-scale spectroscopy around nonmagnetic defects reveals pronounced particle-hole asymmetric bound states. Comparison with theoretical calculations demonstrates that these bound states are incompatible with conventional $s$-wave and sign-changing $s^{\pm}$ pairing. Our calculations also show that the data are fully consistent with a chiral order parameter. Our results establish impurity-bound-state spectroscopy as a powerful phase-sensitive probe of superconductivity in kagome materials and provide strong evidence that optimally doped RbV$_3$Sb$_{5}$ realizes a fully gapped chiral superconducting state.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“spectroscopic-imaging scanning tunneling microscopy”（光谱成像扫描隧道显微镜）和“impurity-bound state spectroscopy”（杂质束缚态谱学），属于实验测量手段。；研究对象：掺杂Kagome体系RbV₃Sb₅（最优掺杂），具体研究其超导态中的配对对称性，以及电荷密度波被完全抑制后的超导性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 最优掺杂RbV₃Sb₅的超导态是全能隙的，且具有两个不同的能量尺度，表明是多带超导序参量。非磁性缺陷周围出现明显的粒子-空穴不对称束缚态，与常规s波和符号变化的s±配对不相容，但与手性序参量完全一致，表明该体系实现的是全开隙手性超导态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：最优掺杂RbV₃Sb₅的超导态是全能隙的，且具有两个不同的能量尺度，表明是多带超导序参量。非磁性缺陷周围出现明显的粒子-空穴不对称束缚态，与常规s波和符号变化的s±配对不相容，但与手性序参量完全一致，表明该体系实现的是全开隙手性超导态。；创新点：首次将杂质束缚态谱学确立为Kagome材料中超导配对对称性的相位敏感探针，并提供了最优掺杂RbV₃Sb₅实现全开隙手性超导态的直接实验证据。
papers.method_zh: 光谱成像扫描隧道显微镜（spectroscopic-imaging STM），用于测量杂质束缚态的空间和能量特征；并结合理论计算对比束缚态谱学数据。

papers.title: Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy of graphene nanogaps
papers.abstract: Graphene nanogaps represent an emerging platform for nanoscale electrochemical and sensing devices, with potential applications in next-generation biomolecular sequencing. However, their interfacial behavior in aqueous environments remains poorly characterized, particularly with respect to frequency-dependent impedance and charge transport mechanisms at the graphene edge. We fabricate graphene nanogaps by controlled electrical breakdown in an inert atmosphere and study their electrochemical response. Upon exposure to ambient conditions, a surface contamination layer supports electrochemical activity within an adsorbed ultrathin conductive film between the graphene edges. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy reveals distinct frequency-dependent responses consistent with a Warburg element associated with diffusion in this confined interfacial film. The impedance evolves systematically with liquid $\mathrm{p}H$, reflecting changes in electrochemical reaction-diffusion processes at the graphene edges. A quantitative equivalent-circuit model captures these effects and enables extraction of an effective nanogap length scale from impedance spectra, providing information complementary to that obtained from tunneling measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：fabricate、electrochemical impedance spectroscopy、electrical breakdown、equivalent-circuit model。；研究对象：石墨烯纳米间隙（graphene nanogaps）及其在水溶液环境中的界面电化学行为，特别是石墨烯边缘处的频率依赖阻抗和电荷传输机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 石墨烯纳米间隙在暴露于环境后，其边缘间会形成一层吸附的超薄导电膜，该膜内的扩散过程产生与Warburg元件一致的频率依赖阻抗响应；阻抗随液体pH值系统演化，且可通过等效电路模型提取有效纳米间隙长度尺度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：石墨烯纳米间隙在暴露于环境后，其边缘间会形成一层吸附的超薄导电膜，该膜内的扩散过程产生与Warburg元件一致的频率依赖阻抗响应；阻抗随液体pH值系统演化，且可通过等效电路模型提取有效纳米间隙长度尺度。；创新点：首次对石墨烯纳米间隙在水环境中的电化学阻抗行为进行系统表征，揭示了受限界面膜中的扩散主导的Warburg型响应，并建立了从阻抗谱提取纳米间隙几何长度尺度的新方法，与隧穿测量形成互补。
papers.method_zh: 在惰性气氛中通过受控电击穿（controlled electrical breakdown）制备石墨烯纳米间隙；使用电化学阻抗谱（EIS）测量频率依赖响应；结合定量等效电路模型（equivalent-circuit model）拟合阻抗谱并提取物理参数。

papers.title: Domain walls with alternating magnetic order in a model with dipolar coupling
papers.abstract: A model for a one-dimensional chain of elongated nano-scale magnetic islands with dipole interactions is analyzed here for the properties of its static domain walls with site-by-site alternating order. The anisotropic magnetic islands on a nonmagnetic substrate have their longer axes oriented transverse ($y$-direction) to the chain direction ($x$-direction), in a transverse applied magnetic field. The islands' magnetic dipoles $\vecμ_n$ are represented as macrospins of fixed length $μ$. The nearest-neighbor (NN) dipole interactions drive transverse alternating order, allowing for doubly-degenerate, uniform, static, $y$-alternating states, where the dipoles alternately point transverse to the chain direction, as in $\vecμ_n = \pm(-1)^n μ\hat{y}$. Assuming only NN interactions, the domain walls connecting these two alternating states are found with numerical relaxation simulations and analyzed in a two-sublattice continuum theory. As the uniaxial anisotropy constant $K_1$ descends from larger values until it closely approaches the NN dipolar coupling constant $D$, the domain wall width grows indefinitely, and the large-$x$ continuum solutions closely approach the lattice numerical solutions. The applied field produces a very slight canting of the dipoles towards the field, maximum in the center of the domain wall. The dipoles on the two sublattices are found to rotate in {\em opposite senses} as one scans along the lattice, resulting in a large longitudinal magnetic moment of the domain wall. A much smaller transverse magnetic moment has a topological contribution that depends on whether the chain length is odd or even.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：模型分析、数值弛豫模拟、连续统理论。；研究对象：一维链状排列的纳米尺度细长磁性岛（宏观自旋链），具有偶极相互作用，在横向外场下呈现逐位交替磁序的静态畴壁。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在仅考虑最近邻偶极相互作用时，连接两种交替磁序态的畴壁宽度随单轴各向异性常数K₁趋近最近邻偶极耦合常数D而无限增大；畴壁中两套子晶格的自旋沿链方向扫描时反向旋转，产生较大的纵向磁矩，而较小的横向磁矩具有依赖于链长奇偶性的拓扑贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在仅考虑最近邻偶极相互作用时，连接两种交替磁序态的畴壁宽度随单轴各向异性常数K₁趋近最近邻偶极耦合常数D而无限增大；畴壁中两套子晶格的自旋沿链方向扫描时反向旋转，产生较大的纵向磁矩，而较小的横向磁矩具有依赖于链长奇偶性的拓扑贡献。；创新点：摘要未突出说明（但可指出：揭示了偶极相互作用驱动的交替磁序体系中畴壁宽度发散行为及畴壁磁矩的拓扑奇偶效应）。
papers.method_zh: 数值弛豫模拟（求解晶格模型静态畴壁结构）结合两子晶格连续统理论分析；模型为固定长度宏自旋μ的偶极链，仅保留最近邻偶极相互作用，外加横向磁场。

papers.title: Benchtop Momentum-Resolved Phonon Spectroscopy: Unlocking Lattice Dynamics via X-ray Diffuse Scattering
papers.abstract: Momentum-resolved phonon spectroscopy is essential for understanding the thermal, electronic, and structural properties of materials, yet it traditionally necessitates access to large-scale synchrotron or neutron facilities. We report a paradigm shift by demonstrating the accurate measurement and quantitative analysis of Thermal Diffuse Scattering (TDS) patterns using a commercially available benchtop Small/Wide-Angle X-ray Scattering (SAXS/WAXS) instrument. By utilizing a low-energy (8 keV) X-ray source and a custom-integrated vacuum geometry, we acquired characteristic TDS patterns in silicon (111) and (100) slabs. We demonstrate that these benchtop images contain sufficient information to extract interatomic force constants (IFCs) through global optimization algorithms, achieving a fitting accuracy comparable to those obtained from simulated data with statistical noise. Crucially, this capability provides access to phonon information across the entire Brillouin Zone, a critical component of lattice dynamics unavailable via standard laboratory techniques like first-order Raman spectroscopy. This low-barrier approach makes synchrotron-level lattice dynamics characterization accessible to virtually any research laboratory, enabling new avenues for the study of intrinsic strain and anisotropic lattice dynamics in emerging material systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了使用商用台式SAXS/WAXS仪器进行实际测量，并强调“accurate measurement and quantitative analysis”。；研究对象：硅（Si）的（111）和（100）晶面薄片中的热漫散射（TDS）图案，即晶格动力学（声子色散）信息。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用商用台式X射线散射仪器，通过测量热漫散射并结合全局优化算法，能够提取与模拟数据（含统计噪声）精度相当的原子间力常数（IFCs），从而在无需同步辐射或中子源的情况下获得全布里渊区的声子信息。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用商用台式X射线散射仪器，通过测量热漫散射并结合全局优化算法，能够提取与模拟数据（含统计噪声）精度相当的原子间力常数（IFCs），从而在无需同步辐射或中子源的情况下获得全布里渊区的声子信息。；创新点：将动量分辨声子谱学从大型同步辐射/中子设施“降维”到普通实验室台式设备，实现了对整个布里渊区晶格动力学的低门槛表征，突破了传统实验室技术（如一阶拉曼光谱）无法覆盖全布里渊区的限制。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用低能（8 keV）X射线源和定制集成真空几何的商用台式小角/广角X射线散射（SAXS/WAXS）仪器；数据分析上使用全局优化算法从TDS图案中提取原子间力常数（IFCs）。

papers.title: Floquet engineering of competing antiferromagnetism and $d$-wave superconductivity on the square lattice
papers.abstract: We propose a driven Lieb--Hubbard quantum simulator whose prethermal dynamics realize a square-lattice spin-1/2 fermion model with independently tunable repulsive on-site and attractive bond interactions. Periodically modulating the charge-transfer offset between the site ($d$) and bond ($p$) orbitals of the Lieb lattice brings a $p$-orbital doublon energetically close to a pair in the $d$ manifold while keeping all $p$-orbital singlons off resonance, thereby creating a synthetic ``negative-$U$'' center on a Lieb-lattice bond site. Two controlled eliminations then generate a compact bond attraction in the reduced $d$-only model on the square lattice, despite the microscopic repulsion in the $p$ orbital. The resulting interaction $J$ is tunable independently of the Hubbard repulsion $U_d$ on the $d$ orbitals, while interference between photon-assisted paths provides access to an intermediate-coupling regime in which $J$ and $U_d$ are both comparable to the effective hopping. At half filling, a mean-field calculation in this regime finds adjacent antiferromagnetic and $d$-wave superconducting phases, as well as narrow coexistence regions, suggesting close competition between these orders. We discuss the branch-preparation, prethermal, and higher-band conditions required to translate the formal construction into an optical-lattice protocol. More broadly, our work identifies a structural similarity between Floquet systems and electron-phonon problems that may guide the design of novel quantum-simulation protocols.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提出理论模型（driven Lieb–Hubbard quantum simulator）、进行形式化推导（controlled eliminations）并采用平均场计算（mean-field calculation），未涉及实验数据。；研究对象：方形晶格上自旋-1/2费米子模型，具体为Lieb晶格中d轨道与p轨道间的电荷转移调制，研究反铁磁序与d波超导序的竞争关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过周期性驱动Lieb-Hubbard系统，可在方形晶格上实现独立可调的排斥型Hubbard相互作用U_d与吸引型键相互作用J，在中间耦合区（J与U_d均与有效跳跃同量级）平均场计算显示相邻的反铁磁相和d波超导相，以及窄的共存区域，表明两种序之间存在紧密竞争。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过周期性驱动Lieb-Hubbard系统，可在方形晶格上实现独立可调的排斥型Hubbard相互作用U_d与吸引型键相互作用J，在中间耦合区（J与U_d均与有效跳跃同量级）平均场计算显示相邻的反铁磁相和d波超导相，以及窄的共存区域，表明两种序之间存在紧密竞争。；创新点：提出了一种在微观排斥相互作用下通过Floquet驱动合成“负U”中心的方法，使键吸引J与Hubbard排斥U_d可独立调节，并首次指出Floquet系统与电子-声子问题之间存在结构性相似性，可用于指导新型量子模拟协议设计。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：Floquet工程（周期性调制电荷转移偏移）结合两次受控消除（controlled eliminations）推导有效模型；平均场计算用于半填充下的相图分析；讨论了分支制备、预热（prethermal）及高带条件以评估光学晶格实验可行性。

papers.title: Determinant Quantum-Quantum Monte Carlo: Coherent Auxiliary-Field Sampling
papers.abstract: We introduce determinant quantum-quantum Monte Carlo (DQ$^2$MC), a quantum algorithm that lifts the auxiliary-field sampling and averaging at the operational core of determinant quantum Monte Carlo onto a quantum computer. A determinant oracle synthesizes the DQMC amplitudes directly from a block encoding of the single-particle action matrix via quantum singular value transformations, so that the exponentially many Hubbard-Stratonovich weights are never enumerated, precomputed, or stored. Since the fermions are free for fixed auxiliary fields, the construction operates entirely at the single-particle level, requiring $O(\log N_{\mathrm{st}})$ system qubits and no Jordan-Wigner or Bravyi-Kitaev encoding, where $N_{\mathrm{st}}$ is the space-time volume. A full-quantum protocol makes observables interference amplitudes, eliminating the Markov chain and its autocorrelation time altogether; a hybrid quantum-classical protocol retains a constant-size active block of qubits and replaces the Metropolis-Hastings acceptance step with an exact heat-bath draw, so that cluster updates of any size are rejection-free, and passes only classical information between updates, admitting parallel tempering and distributed execution across quantum processors. The circuit-depth scales more favorably with spatial volume than classical DQMC, at the price of a post-selection overhead determined exactly by the largest target probability --- polynomial for smooth distributions, exponential for sharply peaked ones. Finally, the reweighting estimator underlying the fermion sign problem maps exactly onto a quantum weak value, placing the exponential cost of sign-problematic DQMC in precise correspondence with the post-selection overhead of weak-value extraction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/算法文章。关键词：quantum algorithm、quantum singular value transformations、protocol。；研究对象：量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）算法在量子计算机上的实现，具体针对行列式量子蒙特卡洛（DQMC）中的辅助场采样与平均过程，以及费米符号问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为行列式量子-量子蒙特卡洛（DQ$^2$MC）的量子算法，将DQMC的辅助场采样与平均过程完全提升到量子计算机上执行，无需枚举或存储指数多个Hubbard-Stratonovich权重，并消除了马尔可夫链及其自相关时间。该算法还揭示了费米符号问题的重加权估计器与量子弱值之间的精确对应关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为行列式量子-量子蒙特卡洛（DQ$^2$MC）的量子算法，将DQMC的辅助场采样与平均过程完全提升到量子计算机上执行，无需枚举或存储指数多个Hubbard-Stratonovich权重，并消除了马尔可夫链及其自相关时间。该算法还揭示了费米符号问题的重加权估计器与量子弱值之间的精确对应关系。；创新点：首次将DQMC的辅助场采样与平均过程整体映射到量子计算机上，仅需$O(\log N_{\mathrm{st}})$个系统量子比特且无需Jordan-Wigner或Bravyi-Kitaev编码；实现了无拒绝的任意大小簇更新，支持并行回火与跨量子处理器分布式执行；将费米符号问题的指数开销精确对应到弱值提取的后选择开销上。
papers.method_zh: 利用量子奇异值变换（QSVT）从单粒子作用量矩阵的块编码（block encoding）中直接合成DQMC振幅（行列式预言机）；构建了全量子协议和混合量子-经典协议；采用热浴（heat-bath）抽样替代Metropolis-Hastings接受步骤；通过后选择（post-selection）实现测量，并分析了电路深度与后选择开销的标度。

papers.title: Fractal Confinement and Magnetic Self-sabotage of Current Flow: Electrons Near the Metal-insulator Crossover in a 2D $δ$-layer
papers.abstract: We study low-$T$ transport and itinerant magnetism in 2D $δ$-doped semiconductors. Large-scale Hartree-Fock calculations with random hoppings and repulsion $U_0$ reveal two transport regimes near a critical density. The conductivity $σ(T)$ initially increases as $T$ drops below $U_0 / 10$. However, at $T \sim U_0/100$, a tiny density of magnetic moments forms, driving an insulating downturn. Fractal wavefunctions locally amplify magnetic interactions, initially concentrating currents into branched filaments, but ultimately choking them off via dynamic SU(2) symmetry breaking.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Large-scale Hartree-Fock calculations with random hoppings and repulsion \(U_0\)”，属于大规模数值计算研究。；研究对象：二维δ掺杂半导体（2D \(δ\)-doped semiconductors）中的低温柔性输运与巡游磁性，重点研究金属-绝缘体临界密度附近的电子行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在临界密度附近存在两个输运区域：当温度降至 \(U_0/10\) 以下时电导率 \(\sigma(T)\) 先随降温而增大；但当温度降至 \(U_0/100\) 附近时，极低密度的磁矩形成，驱动系统进入绝缘性下降（downturn）。分形波函数局域放大磁相互作用，使电流先汇聚成分支状细丝，最终通过动态SU(2)对称性破缺将电流完全阻断。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在临界密度附近存在两个输运区域：当温度降至 \(U_0/10\) 以下时电导率 \(\sigma(T)\) 先随降温而增大；但当温度降至 \(U_0/100\) 附近时，极低密度的磁矩形成，驱动系统进入绝缘性下降（downturn）。分形波函数局域放大磁相互作用，使电流先汇聚成分支状细丝，最终通过动态SU(2)对称性破缺将电流完全阻断。；创新点：揭示了分形波函数与磁相互作用之间的耦合如何导致电流从“分形约束”下的丝状传导演化为“磁性自毁”式的绝缘转变，提出了动态SU(2)对称性破缺作为电流阻断的微观机制。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 大规模Hartree-Fock计算，包含随机跳跃（random hoppings）和库仑排斥项 \(U_0\)，在有限温度下计算电导率与磁性。

papers.title: Statistical Properties of a Fluctuation-Driven Nanomechanical Duffing Resonator
papers.abstract: We investigate the fluctuating nonlinear dynamics of multiple modes of a nanomechanical doubly clamped beam resonator. Each mode is driven by Gaussian force noise centered around the resonance; the mode response is monitored while the force magnitude is increased, inducing a transition from harmonic to the nonlinear Duffing regime. To characterize the dynamics, we introduce an effective temperature based on the mode fluctuation amplitude. As the nonlinearity becomes prominent at large amplitudes, we observe a reduction in the effective thermal energy and a crossover in response statistics from Gaussian to platykurtic, consistent with the dynamics expected in a Duffing potential.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了对纳米机械谐振器的实际驱动与监测（“mode response is monitored while the force magnitude is increased”），属于实验测量。；研究对象：双端固支纳米机械梁谐振器的多个振动模式，在随机力噪声驱动下的非线性（Duffing）动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着驱动力增大，系统从谐波响应过渡到非线性Duffing区，有效热能量降低，响应统计从高斯分布转变为尖峰态（platykurtic）分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着驱动力增大，系统从谐波响应过渡到非线性Duffing区，有效热能量降低，响应统计从高斯分布转变为尖峰态（platykurtic）分布。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上对每个模式施加中心频率附近的Gaussian力噪声，逐步增大噪声幅度并监测模式响应；引入基于模式涨落幅度的有效温度来表征动力学。

papers.title: Emergent hydrodynamic response and dynamical backreaction: Magnon bound-state propagation in a Bose-Hubbard fluid
papers.abstract: We study the nonequilibrium response of a one-dimensional Bose-Hubbard medium to a two-magnon bound state propagating along an attractive XXZ chain. A Holstein-type displacement coupling makes the magnon density act both as a local chemical-potential perturbation and as a source of bosons. We derive a long-wavelength hydrodynamic description of the density and phase fluctuations and test it against matrix-product-state simulations of the full coupled dynamics. The theory predicts a comoving near-field deformation together with retarded density waves confined to a sound cone. In the Mott regime, the deformation remains localized around the moving pair. In the compressible regime, two counterpropagating fronts detach and approach the semiclassical sound velocity, recovered from the equilibrium density with no fitted parameters. The coupling also induces a dynamical backreaction that slows the bound state and broadens its magnon-density profile. The comparison delimits where hydrodynamics stays quantitative once the probe reacts back on the medium.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：hydrodynamic description（流体力学描述）、matrix-product-state simulations（矩阵乘积态模拟）、derived、predicts。；研究对象：一维Bose-Hubbard介质中沿吸引性XXZ链传播的双磁振子束缚态的非平衡响应，以及磁振子密度与玻色子之间的Holstein型位移耦合效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该耦合体系在长波长极限下表现出流体力学响应：束缚态周围形成共动近场形变，并伴随限制在声锥内的延迟密度波；在可压缩区，两个反向传播的前沿以无拟合参数恢复的半经典声速分离。同时，耦合引起的动力学反作用会减慢束缚态并展宽其磁振子密度分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该耦合体系在长波长极限下表现出流体力学响应：束缚态周围形成共动近场形变，并伴随限制在声锥内的延迟密度波；在可压缩区，两个反向传播的前沿以无拟合参数恢复的半经典声速分离。同时，耦合引起的动力学反作用会减慢束缚态并展宽其磁振子密度分布。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其新意在于：将流体力学描述推广到包含探针（磁振子束缚态）对介质产生动力学反作用的场景，并定量界定了在反作用不可忽略时流体力学描述仍保持定量有效的范围。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导长波长流体力学描述（密度和相位涨落），并用矩阵乘积态（MPS）模拟对完整耦合动力学进行数值验证。

papers.title: Charge-State Dependence of Electronic Excitations in keV Ions Transmitted Through Solids Probed by Ion-Photon Coincidence Measurements
papers.abstract: Investigating the electronic excitations caused by light keV ions in matter contributes to a better understanding of materials modification such as space weathering or plasma-wall interactions in fusion reactors as well as improved materials analysis methods such as low or medium energy ion scattering. This study investigates the dependence of specific excitations in keV He projectiles, the most common projectile employed in these analytical methods, on the kinetic energy of the ion. We report on photon emission at energies >10eV emitted by projectiles excited upon transmission through different sample systems. We separate exit charge states and report on measurements of ion-photon pairs in coincidence, i.e. we can link a photon to the specific ion emitting it. From these measurements we extracted charge state resolved photon yields and obtained a deep insight into the electronic excitation occurring. Our results show that the electronic excitation of the helium projectile is largely material independent and rising strongly with the kinetic energy of the projectile. The photon yields are in good agreement with a common excitation model initially developed for beam foil spectroscopy. We hence extend the validity of this model to higher photon energies and different sample materials. We further provide a detailed analysis of the employed coincidence approach and necessary corrections to the raw data, as the methodology has a broad applicability in fundamental research and materials analysis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“ion-photon coincidence measurements”（离子-光子符合测量）、“photon emission”等实验测量手段。；研究对象：keV能量范围内氦（He）离子在穿过不同固体样品时引发的电子激发过程，具体关注入射离子动能对激发行为的影响，以及出射电荷态与光子发射的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氦离子在固体中穿行时产生的电子激发基本不依赖于样品材料，且随入射离子动能增加而显著增强；测得的光子产额与最初为束箔光谱学发展的通用激发模型高度吻合，将该模型的适用性扩展到了更高光子能量和多种样品材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氦离子在固体中穿行时产生的电子激发基本不依赖于样品材料，且随入射离子动能增加而显著增强；测得的光子产额与最初为束箔光谱学发展的通用激发模型高度吻合，将该模型的适用性扩展到了更高光子能量和多种样品材料。；创新点：首次在keV离子透射固体实验中实现电荷态分辨的离子-光子符合测量，将束箔光谱学激发模型的验证范围从传统条件扩展到更高光子能量和不同样品材料，并系统阐述了该符合方法在基础研究和材料分析中的广泛适用性及数据修正流程。
papers.method_zh: 采用离子-光子符合测量技术：将透射离子按出射电荷态分离，并同时探测其发射的>10 eV光子，通过符合关联将每个光子归属到发射它的特定离子，从而获得电荷态分辨的光子产额。此外，对符合方法本身及原始数据的必要修正进行了详细分析。

papers.title: Closed-form hard-sphere thermodynamics under nanoscale confinement: from equations of state to unmixing forces
papers.abstract: Equations of state accurately describe hard-sphere thermodynamics but are generally considered to fail under nanoscale confinement. We show that this failure is geometric rather than thermodynamic: a closed-form, parameter-free mapping from apparent to effective packing fraction restores the accuracy of the Carnahan-Starling equation of state and, with it, the entire analytical thermodynamic framework, including free energies, wall pressures, chemical potentials, and the large-cavity surface response. Applied to overlapping anchored hard-sphere droplets, a geometry inherent to biomolecular force generation, it yields unmixing free energies and full distance-dependent force profiles in quantitative agreement with simulations from the dilute regime to above the bulk freezing transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“closed-form, parameter-free mapping”“analytical thermodynamic framework”以及“in quantitative agreement with simulations”，表明以理论推导为主，辅以模拟验证。；研究对象：硬球体系在纳米尺度受限下的热力学性质，具体包括受限硬球流体、以及重叠锚定硬球液滴（overlapping anchored hard-sphere droplets）这一与生物分子力产生相关的几何构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 硬球状态方程在纳米受限下的“失效”本质上是几何效应而非热力学失效：通过一个闭合形式、无自由参数的映射，将表观堆积分数转换为有效堆积分数，即可恢复Carnahan-Starling状态方程的准确性，并由此重建完整的热力学框架（自由能、壁压、化学势、大空腔表面响应）。将该方法应用于重叠锚定硬球液滴，得到的去混合自由能和距离依赖的力曲线与模拟定量一致，适用范围从稀溶液区延伸至体相冻结转变以上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：硬球状态方程在纳米受限下的“失效”本质上是几何效应而非热力学失效：通过一个闭合形式、无自由参数的映射，将表观堆积分数转换为有效堆积分数，即可恢复Carnahan-Starling状态方程的准确性，并由此重建完整的热力学框架（自由能、壁压、化学势、大空腔表面响应）。将该方法应用于重叠锚定硬球液滴，得到的去混合自由能和距离依赖的力曲线与模拟定量一致，适用范围从稀溶液区延伸至体相冻结转变以上。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其新意在于：首次以纯几何映射方式统一修复受限条件下硬球状态方程的失效问题，并成功将该解析框架推广到生物相关的重叠锚定液滴体系，覆盖从稀溶液到过冷/冻结区间的宽密度范围。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：提出从表观堆积分数到有效堆积分数的闭合形式无参数映射，并基于Carnahan-Starling状态方程重建受限硬球热力学；数值验证：与模拟结果进行定量对比，验证去混合自由能和力曲线的准确性。

papers.title: Carrier-Resolved Attosecond Valley Polarimetry of Monolayer MoS$_2$
papers.abstract: In recent years, all-optical writing and switching of valley polarization in two-dimensional semiconductors has been demonstrated on femtosecond timescales. Reading this polarization out on the same timescale, carrier by carrier, has so far remained out of reach. Employing semiconductor Bloch equation simulations of monolayer MoS$_2$, we show that attosecond transient absorption closes this gap by turning the Mo $4p$ semicore edge into a quantitative valley polarimeter. We find that pump-enabled core-to-valence absorption probes the holes while core-to-conduction bleaching probes the electrons, so that a single spectrum identifies each carrier by its photoabsorption energy. The hole channel, Pauli-blocked in equilibrium, emerges background-free. Its circular dichroism reverses sign with the pump helicity, and its normalized magnitude is proportional to the valley polarization. Finally, we show that scanning the probe delay clocks the few-femtosecond write in real time. Thus, attosecond core-level dichroism is a carrier-sensitive, quantitative probe of the creation and evolution of valley polarization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Employing semiconductor Bloch equation simulations”（采用半导体布洛赫方程模拟）。；研究对象：单层二硫化钼（monolayer MoS₂）中的谷极化（valley polarization）超快动力学，具体关注价带空穴与导带电子的载流子分辨超快读出。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用阿秒瞬态吸收谱可将Mo 4p半芯能级转变为定量谷偏振计，实现逐载流子分辨的谷极化读出：芯-价跃迁探测空穴，芯-导带漂白探测电子，且圆二色信号大小正比于谷极化度，并能实时记录数飞秒尺度的谷极化写入过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用阿秒瞬态吸收谱可将Mo 4p半芯能级转变为定量谷偏振计，实现逐载流子分辨的谷极化读出：芯-价跃迁探测空穴，芯-导带漂白探测电子，且圆二色信号大小正比于谷极化度，并能实时记录数飞秒尺度的谷极化写入过程。；创新点：首次提出利用阿秒瞬态吸收实现载流子分辨（空穴与电子分别探测）的谷极化定量读出，克服了此前无法在飞秒时间尺度上逐载流子读取谷极化的限制；空穴通道在平衡态下被泡利阻塞，因此信号无背景干扰。
papers.method_zh: 半导体布洛赫方程（Semiconductor Bloch Equations, SBE）数值模拟，模拟单层MoS₂的阿秒瞬态吸收光谱，分析泵浦诱导的芯-价带与芯-导带跃迁的圆二色性。

papers.title: Superfluid memory effect
papers.abstract: We identify a memory effect produced by phonon scattering in a superfluid: a localized scattering event generates a far-field pressure pulse with vanishing time integral but a nonzero first temporal moment, corresponding to a permanent shift in a prepotential for the far-field velocity. The effect is controlled by the soft factor for phonon emission, including corrections from nonlinear dispersion. In superfluid $^4$He, scattering macroscopic phonon wave packets produces a signal whose estimated magnitude may lie within experimental reach, thereby providing a laboratory analogue of electromagnetic and gravitational memory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中“We identify a memory effect”“corresponding to a permanent shift”等表述，以及“providing a laboratory analogue”表明为理论预言与估算，未涉及实验数据或数值模拟。；研究对象：超流体（具体为超流⁴He）中声子散射产生的远场压力脉冲及其记忆效应，属于量子流体动力学与场论类比（电磁/引力记忆效应）范畴。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超流体中局域散射事件会产生一个时间积分为零但一阶时间矩非零的远场压力脉冲，对应远场速度的“预势”发生永久性位移，即超流记忆效应；该效应由声子发射的软因子控制，并包含非线性色散修正。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超流体中局域散射事件会产生一个时间积分为零但一阶时间矩非零的远场压力脉冲，对应远场速度的“预势”发生永久性位移，即超流记忆效应；该效应由声子发射的软因子控制，并包含非线性色散修正。；创新点：首次在超流体系统中识别出与电磁和引力记忆效应相类比的“超流记忆效应”，并指出其信号在超流⁴He中可能达到实验可探测量级，为实验室模拟引力/电磁记忆效应提供了新途径。摘要未突出说明与已有超流输运或声子散射研究的其他差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于声子散射的软因子（soft factor）展开，考虑非线性色散修正，对超流⁴He中宏观声子波包散射产生的信号幅度进行估算。

papers.title: Efficient search for excitable zero-modes in constrained systems
papers.abstract: Kinetically constrained systems, such as those representing Rydberg atom arrays in the blockade regime, have gathered considerable attention due to the presence of atypical eigenstates in their spectrum. The latter manifests itself through the presence of quantum many-body scars as well as unusually large zero-mode (ZM) subspaces which contain analytically tractable eigenstates with various entanglement scalings. In particular, some of the latter are excitable zero-modes (EZMs), meaning that they can be promoted to a non-zero energy for open boundary conditions. In this work, I present an efficient protocol for finding analytical expressions for translation-invariant EZMs in constrained systems, based on the eigendecomposition of the local unconstrained Hamiltonian. I demonstrate the power of this method on a decorated Rydberg chain. In that model, my protocol directly produces a continuous matrix-product-state manifold located entirely in the zero-energy eigenspace for periodic boundary conditions. The span of that manifold grows exponentially with the system, and for odd system sizes it covers the entire zero-momentum eigenspace with zero energy. I then show how the physical structure of the manifold, which is tied to the local eigenbasis, also allows one to derive analytical expressions for ZMs at non-zero momentum and for a polynomial number of exact scars at $E=\pm\sqrt{3}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytical expressions、eigendecomposition、protocol、manifold。；研究对象：动力学约束系统（kinetically constrained systems），具体以 blockade 机制下的 Rydberg 原子阵列（Rydberg atom arrays）为代表，并在一维装饰 Rydberg 链（decorated Rydberg chain）上演示方法。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种高效协议，可直接构造约束系统中平移不变的可激发零模（EZM）的解析表达式；在装饰 Rydberg 链中，该协议产生一个完全位于零能本征空间的连续矩阵乘积态流形，其跨度随系统尺寸指数增长，且在奇数尺寸下覆盖整个零动量零能本征空间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种高效协议，可直接构造约束系统中平移不变的可激发零模（EZM）的解析表达式；在装饰 Rydberg 链中，该协议产生一个完全位于零能本征空间的连续矩阵乘积态流形，其跨度随系统尺寸指数增长，且在奇数尺寸下覆盖整个零动量零能本征空间。；创新点：提出了一种通用的、基于局域本征分解的解析零模搜索协议，避免了数值对角化或猜测构造；该协议不仅直接给出周期边界条件下的零模流形，还能进一步推导非零动量零模以及 E=±√3 处多项式数目的精确量子疤痕（scars）的解析表达式。
papers.method_zh: 基于局域无约束哈密顿量的本征分解（eigendecomposition of the local unconstrained Hamiltonian），结合平移不变性约束，系统性地搜索并构造零模的解析形式；利用矩阵乘积态（MPS）流形描述零能子空间结构。

papers.title: Engineering multi-photon dissipation with a dc-voltage-biased Josephson junction
papers.abstract: Multi-photon dissipation -- a key resource for bosonic qubits -- is usually realized by parametrically pumping a Josephson coupler at the cost of spurious nonlinear terms. Here we instead engineer it using a dc-voltage-biased SQUID, such that these parasitic terms average out. We activate the conversion of one, two, or four photons of a high-Q mode into a single photon of a lossy mode. We characterize the two-photon dissipation by Wigner tomography, establishing dc-biased junctions as a resource for reservoir engineering and a viable route to cat-qubit stabilization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/实验混合类型。判断依据：摘要中既有理论设计（“engineer it using a dc-voltage-biased SQUID”），也有实验表征（“We characterize the two-photon dissipation by Wigner tomography”）。；研究对象：超导电路中的玻色子模式（高Q值微波腔），具体研究通过直流电压偏置的SQUID（超导量子干涉器）来工程化多光子耗散过程，用于玻色子量子比特（如猫量子比特）的稳定化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用直流电压偏置的SQUID可以激活高Q模式向有损模式的单光子转换（涉及一、二或四光子过程），从而有效实现多光子耗散，且避免了参数泵浦方案中固有的杂散非线性项。通过Wigner断层扫描证实了双光子耗散过程，表明该方案是可行的储层工程资源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用直流电压偏置的SQUID可以激活高Q模式向有损模式的单光子转换（涉及一、二或四光子过程），从而有效实现多光子耗散，且避免了参数泵浦方案中固有的杂散非线性项。通过Wigner断层扫描证实了双光子耗散过程，表明该方案是可行的储层工程资源。；创新点：相较于传统使用参数泵浦约瑟夫森耦合器实现多光子耗散的方法（会引入杂散非线性项），本工作采用直流电压偏置的SQUID，使寄生项自然平均消除，为猫量子比特的稳定化提供了一条更简洁、可行的技术路线。
papers.method_zh: 理论设计结合实验表征。理论部分：利用直流电压偏置的SQUID实现多光子转换，使寄生项在时间平均中抵消。实验部分：对高Q模式进行Wigner断层扫描（量子态层析成像），以表征双光子耗散特性。

papers.title: The large $N$ vector model with angular velocity
papers.abstract: We study the free energy of the critical $O(N)$ vector model at large $N$ on $S^{1}\times S^{2}$ with an angular velocity $\hatμ$ without the singlet constraint. The leading high-temperature behaviour is determined analytically both as an expansion about $\hatμr=0$ and $\hatμ^{2}r^{2}=1$ where $r$ is the radius of the sphere. We supplement the analytic results with a numerical analysis that agrees with both the analytical expansions in their respective regimes and smoothly interpolates between them. The leading high-temperature contribution to the free energy develops a pole at $\hatμ^{2}r^{2}=1$, in agreement with expectations from the thermal effective field theory. Its residue coincides with that of the massless free theory. Sub-leading terms, however, exhibit non-analytic dependence on the angular velocity and distinguish the critical fixed-point result from the free theory answer. The residue at the pole can also be obtained by placing the $O(N)$ model on the pp-wave geometry. We show that the residue agrees with that obtained from the direct computation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“We study the free energy”“determined analytically”“numerical analysis”，属于解析与数值计算相结合的理论研究。；研究对象：临界O(N)矢量模型在S¹×S²几何上、带角速度（化学势）且不施加单态约束的大N极限下的自由能行为。具体物理体系为有限温度、有限旋转下的临界标量场理论。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高温极限下自由能的主导贡献在角速度满足μ̂²r²=1处出现极点，其留数与无质量自由理论一致；但次领头项对角速度具有非解析依赖，从而将临界不动点结果与自由理论区分开来。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高温极限下自由能的主导贡献在角速度满足μ̂²r²=1处出现极点，其留数与无质量自由理论一致；但次领头项对角速度具有非解析依赖，从而将临界不动点结果与自由理论区分开来。；创新点：首次在大N临界O(N)矢量模型中系统研究了角速度对高温自由能的影响，揭示了极点留数与自由理论的一致性以及次领头项的非解析行为，并通过pp-wave几何提供了交叉验证。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 解析方法：在μ̂r=0和μ̂²r²=1两个极限附近做高温展开；数值方法：对两个解析展开区域进行数值计算验证，并平滑插值连接两个区域。此外，通过将O(N)模型置于pp-wave几何上独立验证极点留数。

papers.title: Colorful Exponential Random Graph Models
papers.abstract: In this paper, we initiate the study of colored exponential random graph models (ERGMs), a class of exponential-family models for networks with multiple types of edge relations. Using the framework of probability graphons, we first derive a variational representation for the limiting free energy, whose maximizers determine the asymptotic structure of typical samples from the model. Then we identify several general families of colored ERGMs exhibiting replica symmetry, where the variational problem has constant maximizers and the model asymptotically concentrates on product colorings with independent edges. For general colored ERGMs, we derive Euler-Lagrange fixed-point equations for the variational maximizers, which in turn yield a general high-temperature uniqueness criterion. In the complementary zero-temperature regime, we establish a two-level selection principle: the leading energy term determines the ground states, while the lower-order energy terms, combined with entropy, act as a tie-breaker to determine the asymptotic zero-temperature structure of the model. We illustrate this principle through the induced wedge and rainbow triangle ERGMs. Both models have natural interpretations in multitype networks, and their zero-temperature limits exhibit interesting structures that connect to well-known results in extremal combinatorics. We further establish finite-temperature symmetry breaking for both these models and complement the rigorous results with numerical experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：variational representation、Euler-Lagrange fixed-point equations、replica symmetry、zero-temperature regime。；研究对象：彩色指数随机图模型（colored ERGMs），即具有多种边关系类型的网络系综，属于统计物理与网络科学交叉的随机图模型体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该文建立了彩色ERGMs的变分自由能表示，证明了一类模型具有复制对称性（典型样本集中于独立边的乘积染色），并揭示了零温极限下的两级选择原理：能量主导项决定基态，低阶能量项与熵共同打破简并，从而确定零温渐近结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该文建立了彩色ERGMs的变分自由能表示，证明了一类模型具有复制对称性（典型样本集中于独立边的乘积染色），并揭示了零温极限下的两级选择原理：能量主导项决定基态，低阶能量项与熵共同打破简并，从而确定零温渐近结构。；创新点：首次系统研究彩色ERGMs的统计力学性质，将零温极限与极值组合学中的经典结果（如诱导楔形图、彩虹三角形）建立联系，并给出有限温对称破缺的严格证明。
papers.method_zh: 采用概率图限（probability graphons）框架推导自由能的变分表示；利用复制对称性分析简化变分问题；通过Euler-Lagrange不动点方程建立高温唯一性判据；在零温区运用两级选择原理，并结合数值实验验证有限温对称破缺。

papers.title: Boundary Quantum Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov Equations and Integrability of Quantum Field Theories with Time-Dependent Bulk and Boundary Coupling Strengths
papers.abstract: The generalized Bethe ansatz framework formulated in [P. R. Pasnoori, Phys. Rev. B 112, L060409 (2025)] provides a unified framework to find exact solutions to quantum many-body systems with time-dependent coupling strengths with periodic boundary conditions. In this work we extend this framework to the case of open boundary conditions where in addition to the time-dependent interactions in the bulk, the boundary conditions are explicitly time-dependent. We show that for integrable time-dependent bulk coupling strengths, the generalized Bethe ansatz framework provides the time-dependent boundary conditions compatible with integrability and reduces the time-dependent Schrodinger equation to a set of matrix difference equations called the boundary quantum Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov (BqKZ) equations. The solution to the BqKZ equations provides the explicit form of the exact wavefunction. We further show that the RG invariants of the corresponding static model identify with the dynamical invariants in the time-dependent model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“广义Bethe ansatz框架”“量子Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov方程”“可积性”等理论构造与求解方法，未涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：具有时间依赖的体耦合强度与时间依赖边界条件的量子多体系统，特别是开放边界条件下的可积量子场论模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作将广义Bethe ansatz框架从周期边界条件推广到开放边界条件，证明在时间依赖体耦合强度下，该框架能给出与可积性相容的时间依赖边界条件，并将含时薛定谔方程约化为边界量子Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov（BqKZ）矩阵差分方程；其解给出精确波函数的显式形式。此外，静态模型的RG不变量与时间依赖模型中的动力学不变量一一对应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作将广义Bethe ansatz框架从周期边界条件推广到开放边界条件，证明在时间依赖体耦合强度下，该框架能给出与可积性相容的时间依赖边界条件，并将含时薛定谔方程约化为边界量子Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov（BqKZ）矩阵差分方程；其解给出精确波函数的显式形式。此外，静态模型的RG不变量与时间依赖模型中的动力学不变量一一对应。；创新点：首次将广义Bethe ansatz框架推广到同时具有时间依赖体耦合和时间依赖边界条件的开放边界系统，并建立了BqKZ方程与可积性条件之间的直接联系。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 广义Bethe ansatz框架（基于P. R. Pasnoori在Phys. Rev. B 112, L060409 (2025)中提出的统一框架），结合边界量子Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov方程求解含时薛定谔方程，并利用RG不变量与动力学不变量的对应关系。

papers.title: Work Extraction Across a Thermodynamic Hierarchy in Quantum Many-Body Systems
papers.abstract: Thermodynamics is operational in the sense that the very concept of thermal equilibrium depends crucially on the choice of observables, while the amount of extractable work is defined relative to the allowed operations. Here we show that isolated quantum many-body states admit a thermodynamic hierarchical structure of observables and allowed operations, where the same state can be thermal at one level of the hierarchy and athermal at another. Enlarging the set of allowed operations therefore renders such hidden athermality a potential resource for work extraction; the resulting work gain is bounded in terms of the difference between the entropy densities of the two levels. This entropy difference takes the form of the mutual-information density. We establish the bounds for three extensions of operational access: increased spatial resolution, increased duration of control, and nonlocal connectivity, which provide access to position-state Holevo information, correlations between neighboring regions and spatially nonlocal correlations, respectively. Thus the difference between entropies at different levels of the thermodynamic hierarchy governs the bound on the work gain associated with moving to a less restricted level.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：thermodynamics is operational、we show、establish the bounds（理论推导与概念分析）。；研究对象：孤立量子多体系统中的热力学层级结构，以及不同观测层级（空间分辨率、控制时长、非局域连接性）下功提取的资源理论。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 同一量子多体态可以在某一热力学层级上表现为热态，而在另一层级上表现为非热态；扩大允许操作集合可将这种“隐藏的非热性”转化为功提取资源，功增益上限由两个层级的熵密度差（即互信息密度）决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：同一量子多体态可以在某一热力学层级上表现为热态，而在另一层级上表现为非热态；扩大允许操作集合可将这种“隐藏的非热性”转化为功提取资源，功增益上限由两个层级的熵密度差（即互信息密度）决定。；创新点：摘要未突出说明（但可看出其新意在于将热力学层级结构与互信息密度联系起来，并统一处理三种不同操作扩展下的功提取边界）。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架，基于热力学操作化定义（observables与allowed operations的选择），推导功提取上界；针对三种操作扩展（提高空间分辨率、延长控制时间、引入非局域连接）分别建立边界，并关联到位置态Holevo信息、邻近区域关联及空间非局域关联。

papers.title: Quantum Dot Colloidosomes as Triggerable Microlasers
papers.abstract: Quantum dot (QD) supraparticle lasers are promising platforms for microscale light sources and photonic labeling, yet their optical properties are set during assembly. Here we introduce QD colloidosomes, liquid-core/solid-shell supraparticles that combine whispering-gallery-mode optical feedback with stimulus-triggered structural collapse. Intact QD colloidosomes show cavity-defined lasing with fluence thresholds of ~2.8 mJ/cm2 and linewidths of 2.2-3.7 nm, demonstrating efficient light trapping without a solid core. We identify shell continuity as a critical determinant for whispering-gallery feedback and lasing by exploring a morphological continuum of suprastructures comprising solid supraparticles, colloidosomes, and microporous hollow shells. Intact colloidosomes support narrow cavity modes, whereas porous shells remain broadband even at high pump fluence. We show that colloidosomes can be driven to rupture and release payload through well-defined pathways, including meniscus-driven capillary failure, uniform heating, and localized near-infrared activation, thereby reconfiguring their optical response from cavity-defined lasing to broadband emission. These results establish QD colloidosomes as reconfigurable microlasers that couple optical-state switching and triggered release within a single self-assembled platform.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了对量子点胶体囊的制备、光学表征（激光阈值、线宽测量）以及触发破裂实验，属于实验研究。；研究对象：量子点胶体囊（QD colloidosomes），即液核/固壳超粒子结构，结合回音壁模式光学反馈与刺激响应性结构坍塌，研究其作为可触发微激光器的光学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 完整的量子点胶体囊可实现腔模定义的激光发射（阈值约2.8 mJ/cm²，线宽2.2–3.7 nm），而通过特定路径触发结构破裂后，其光学响应可从腔模激光转变为宽带发射，实现光学状态切换与载荷释放的耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：完整的量子点胶体囊可实现腔模定义的激光发射（阈值约2.8 mJ/cm²，线宽2.2–3.7 nm），而通过特定路径触发结构破裂后，其光学响应可从腔模激光转变为宽带发射，实现光学状态切换与载荷释放的耦合。；创新点：首次将量子点胶体囊（液核/固壳）作为可重构微激光器，在单一自组装平台中同时实现光学状态切换（腔模激光→宽带发射）与触发式载荷释放，且证明无需实心核即可实现高效回音壁模式光限制。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体制备方法和表征仪器，但涉及：超粒子形态学调控（实心超粒子、胶体囊、微孔空心壳的连续形态谱）、激光泵浦下的发射光谱测量（阈值和线宽）、以及三种触发破裂路径（弯月面驱动毛细失效、均匀加热、近红外局部激活）。具体实验技术细节（如合成方法、激光系统类型）摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: A Truncated Majorana
papers.abstract: We investigate the quantum field dynamics of truncating a Majorana wave packet via a time-dependent channel shutter. Modeling truncation as a controlled modification of chiral propagation rather than a literal spatial cut, we analyze a $1+1$D massless Majorana field subjected to a time-dependent rotation between its chiral components. We demonstrate that this protocol manifests two complementary physical limits. Globally, a mismatch between early- and late-time channel identifications induces a fermionic Bogoliubov transformation. We prove this asymptotic change universally generates an infrared soft-mode memory, $β(ω, ν) \propto (ω+ν)^{-1}$, leading to a logarithmic divergence in the Hilbert--Schmidt norm. This orthogonality-catastrophe-like obstruction persists even under infinitely smooth switching in the massless limit. Conversely, in the number-conserving regime where pair production vanishes, the shutter acts as a purely causal filter. We establish exact local field identities showing that, restricted to the even local observable algebra, the retained sector is exactly equivalent to a single-particle state while the discarded sector reduces to the vacuum. Ultimately, we show that global infrared memory and local causal truncation are complementary diagnostics of the same dynamical operation. These results provide a rigorous field-theoretic foundation for time-dependent control in topological platforms, cleanly separating effective operational benchmarks from microscopic boundary dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quantum field dynamics、modeling、we analyze、we prove、exact local field identities。；研究对象：1+1维无质量Majorana场在时间依赖通道快门（channel shutter）作用下的截断动力学，即通过手征分量间的时间依赖旋转实现Majorana波包的受控截断。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该截断协议在全局上等价于一个费米型Bogoliubov变换，必然产生红外软模记忆β(ω,ν)∝(ω+ν)^{-1}，导致Hilbert–Schmidt范数对数发散（正交性灾难型阻碍）；在局域粒子数守恒区，截断则表现为纯因果滤波器，保留区精确等价于单粒子态，丢弃区约化为真空。全局红外记忆与局域因果截断是同一动力学操作的互补诊断。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该截断协议在全局上等价于一个费米型Bogoliubov变换，必然产生红外软模记忆β(ω,ν)∝(ω+ν)^{-1}，导致Hilbert–Schmidt范数对数发散（正交性灾难型阻碍）；在局域粒子数守恒区，截断则表现为纯因果滤波器，保留区精确等价于单粒子态，丢弃区约化为真空。全局红外记忆与局域因果截断是同一动力学操作的互补诊断。；创新点：将“截断”建模为受控的手征传播修正而非字面空间切割，严格证明了全局红外记忆与局域因果截断的互补性，为拓扑平台中的时间依赖操控提供了场论级基础，并清晰区分了有效操作基准与微观边界动力学。摘要未突出说明与具体拓扑材料平台的直接对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 解析量子场论方法：对1+1维无质量Majorana场施加时间依赖的手征分量旋转，分析其渐近Bogoliubov变换、红外软模结构、Hilbert–Schmidt范数发散行为，并建立局域可观测代数上的精确场恒等式。

papers.title: Towards an effective medium theory for in-vivo Magnetic Resonance: Characterizing Admissible Magnetization Dynamics
papers.abstract: The classical Bloch equation forms the foundation of magnetic resonance theory but may be insufficient to capture the complex effective dynamics observed in heterogeneous materials such as biological tissue. Here an effective-medium strategy is proposed to describe magnetic resonance dynamics from observations at macro-scale (order 1 mm$^3$). In this framework, the classical Larmor torque is retained while the relaxation term is replaced by a general nonlinear field (i.e. the effective medium term). This field is required to preserve key physical properties, including rotational symmetry, global stability of thermal equilibrium, and dissipativity. These requirements lead to a complete characterization of admissible relaxation fields and provide a constructive framework for generating nonlinear relaxation models. The resulting theory recovers classical Bloch dynamics as a special case and provides a principled foundation for effective-medium descriptions of magnetic resonance phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“effective-medium strategy is proposed”“complete characterization”“constructive framework”等理论构建性表述，未涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：生物组织等异质材料中的磁共振（Magnetic Resonance）有效动力学，具体为宏观尺度（约1 mm³）下磁化强度矢量的弛豫行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过要求弛豫项满足旋转对称性、热平衡全局稳定性与耗散性，完整刻画了所有允许的有效介质弛豫场形式，并证明经典Bloch方程是该理论的一个特例。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过要求弛豫项满足旋转对称性、热平衡全局稳定性与耗散性，完整刻画了所有允许的有效介质弛豫场形式，并证明经典Bloch方程是该理论的一个特例。；创新点：首次为体内磁共振的有效介质描述提供了公理化基础，将经典Bloch方程推广为非线性弛豫模型的一般框架，而非针对特定材料的唯象修正。摘要未突出说明与具体实验数据的对比验证。
papers.method_zh: 有效介质理论框架：保留经典Larmor进动项，将线性弛豫项替换为一般非线性场（有效介质项），并基于物理约束（旋转对称、全局稳定、耗散性）进行数学分类与构造。

papers.title: Coexisting chaos and order in micro-textured elastic flows
authors: Ricardo Arturo Lopez de la Cruz
papers.abstract: Viscoelastic fluid flows over micro-textured surfaces - densely covered by slender protrusions like cilia lining the body airways or villi covering the intestinal epithelium - underpin essential biological processes including transport, mixing, and absorption. Despite their ubiquity, the dynamics generated by the interplay between fluid elasticity and these complex geometries remain largely unexplored. Here we combine fully resolved numerical simulations with microfluidic experiments to reveal the flow dynamics established above dense arrays of microscopic pillars (canopies) immersed in the low-Reynolds-number flow of a viscoelastic liquid. We observe that the flow above the canopy tips spontaneously develops elastic turbulence. Remarkably, the chaotic state coexists with elastic waves emerging from the coupling between fluid elasticity and the heterogeneous shear induced by the canopy geometry. These ordered fluid motions persist across a broad range of flow conditions and canopy configurations. Our results demonstrate that coherent wave propagation and elastic turbulence are complementary manifestations of viscoelastic fluid flow. Beyond their fundamental significance, these mechanisms have broad implications for transport in biological and engineered environments, and reveal how structured geometries can harness the spontaneous dynamics of viscoelastic liquids to manipulate complex flows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“fully resolved numerical simulations”（全解析数值模拟）与“microfluidic experiments”（微流控实验）相结合。；研究对象：微纹理弹性流动。具体指：在低雷诺数粘弹性液体中，流经密集排列的微观柱状阵列（微柱“冠层”，类似纤毛或绒毛结构）上方时形成的复杂流体动力学现象，包括弹性湍流与弹性波的共存。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在微柱冠层上方的粘弹性流体中，自发形成了弹性湍流（混沌态），且该混沌态与由流体弹性与冠层几何诱导的非均匀剪切耦合产生的弹性波（有序态）共存。这表明相干波传播与弹性湍流是粘弹性流体流动的互补表现形式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在微柱冠层上方的粘弹性流体中，自发形成了弹性湍流（混沌态），且该混沌态与由流体弹性与冠层几何诱导的非均匀剪切耦合产生的弹性波（有序态）共存。这表明相干波传播与弹性湍流是粘弹性流体流动的互补表现形式。；创新点：首次揭示了在微纹理几何（密集柱状冠层）诱导的复杂剪切场中，弹性湍流与弹性波（有序运动）可以同时稳定共存，并证明这种共存现象在广泛的流动条件和冠层构型下均存在。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异点。
papers.method_zh: 1. 全解析数值模拟（fully resolved numerical simulations）；2. 微流控实验（microfluidic experiments）。两者结合用于观测低雷诺数下粘弹性液体在微柱阵列上方的流动状态。

papers.title: Local connectivity balance shapes population dynamics in random recurrent networks
papers.abstract: Disordered dynamical systems comprising many interacting units, from ecological communities to neural circuits, are ubiquitous, and understanding how connectivity shapes their collective behavior is a central theoretical challenge. One long-recognized feature of neural circuits is local connectivity balance, in which the excitatory and inhibitory weights converging onto each unit approximately cancel. Although local connectivity balance has been proposed to serve functions such as gating incoming signals, its effect on collective network dynamics remains unclear. Here we analytically study randomly connected recurrent networks with varying degrees of local connectivity balance. We show that this balance leaves the connectivity spectrum unchanged yet drastically reshapes the dynamics in a manner that depends critically on the single-unit nonlinearity. Local balance suppresses unbounded growth of the network state and stabilizes network dynamics when the activation function scales linearly or faster, whereas it drives the network into chaos when the activation function is sub-linear or saturating. Importantly, these effects vanish for odd activation functions, which are commonly assumed in previous work. We further find that, for saturating nonlinearities, the effective dimension of the dynamics varies nonmonotonically with the degree of balance. We show that all these phenomena arise from a unifying mechanism: the suppression of a self-generated feedback input by local connectivity balance. Our results identify local connectivity balance as a previously overlooked control parameter for collective dynamics in realistic disordered networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“analytically study”（解析研究）随机循环网络，属于理论分析。；研究对象：随机循环网络（random recurrent networks）的集体动力学，具体关注局部连接平衡（local connectivity balance）——即每个单元上兴奋性与抑制性突触权重近似抵消——对网络状态演化的影响。该体系可类比神经回路或生态群落等无序多体动力学系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 局部连接平衡不改变连接谱，但会显著重塑网络动力学：当激活函数线性或超线性时，平衡抑制状态无界增长并稳定动力学；当激活函数亚线性或饱和时，平衡反而驱动网络进入混沌。这些效应在奇函数激活函数下消失，且对饱和非线性，动力学有效维度随平衡程度非单调变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：局部连接平衡不改变连接谱，但会显著重塑网络动力学：当激活函数线性或超线性时，平衡抑制状态无界增长并稳定动力学；当激活函数亚线性或饱和时，平衡反而驱动网络进入混沌。这些效应在奇函数激活函数下消失，且对饱和非线性，动力学有效维度随平衡程度非单调变化。；创新点：首次将局部连接平衡识别为无序网络集体动力学的控制参数，并揭示其作用依赖于单单元非线性类型；提出统一机制——局部连接平衡抑制自生成反馈输入——来解释所有现象。摘要特别指出，以往工作普遍假设奇函数激活函数，导致该效应被遗漏。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论分析：对随机循环网络进行平均场或谱理论分析，考察连接谱（connectivity spectrum）与动力学稳定性/混沌转变的关系，并引入激活函数非线性类型（线性、超线性、亚线性、饱和、奇函数）作为关键参数。

papers.title: Symmetric Mass Generation for Domain-Wall Fermions
papers.abstract: We report the first numerical examination of symmetric mass generation (SMG) for domain-wall fermions. Our simulation on a two-dimensional Euclidean lattice computes the path-integral of the Fidkowski-Kitaev Majorana chain with two boundaries, corresponding to the two (physical and mirror) walls. We demonstrate by evaluating the lattice Dirac operator eigenvalue spectrum that the local four-Fermi interaction selectively gaps the edge fermions on the mirror wall while leaving the physical wall intact. We further identify a characteristic signature of SMG in the path-integral: the gap of the Dirac operator opens along the imaginary axis of the complex spectrum, in contrast to the standard mass shift in the real direction. The conventional hybrid Monte Carlo algorithm remains practical with reweighting the complex phase of the Pfaffian, which is found to be remarkably small throughout the simulation. These results provide a practical nonperturbative framework for interaction-induced mirror-fermion decoupling of lattice domain-wall fermions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“numerical examination”“simulation on a two-dimensional Euclidean lattice”“evaluating the lattice Dirac operator eigenvalue spectrum”以及“hybrid Monte Carlo algorithm”。；研究对象：二维欧几里得格点上的畴壁费米子（domain-wall fermions），具体为具有两个边界（物理壁和镜像壁）的Fidkowski-Kitaev Majorana链，研究其对称质量生成（SMG）机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 局域四费米相互作用可选择性地在镜像壁上打开能隙（使镜像壁费米子退耦），而物理壁保持无隙；SMG在路径积分中的特征性表现为狄拉克算子能隙沿复谱的虚轴打开，而非标准质量项沿实轴方向移动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：局域四费米相互作用可选择性地在镜像壁上打开能隙（使镜像壁费米子退耦），而物理壁保持无隙；SMG在路径积分中的特征性表现为狄拉克算子能隙沿复谱的虚轴打开，而非标准质量项沿实轴方向移动。；创新点：首次对畴壁费米子的对称质量生成进行数值检验，并识别出SMG在复谱中沿虚轴打开能隙这一区别于普通质量项的特征性信号；同时发现该模拟中Pfaffian复相位极小，使传统混合蒙特卡罗算法保持实用。
papers.method_zh: 二维欧几里得格点蒙特卡罗模拟，计算Fidkowski-Kitaev Majorana链的路径积分；通过评估格点狄拉克算子本征值谱来检验能隙行为；使用混合蒙特卡罗算法，并对Pfaffian的复相位进行reweighting处理。

papers.title: Equilibrium fluctuations of the weakly asymmetric inclusion process
papers.abstract: We prove that the stationary density fluctuation field of the one-dimensional weakly asymmetric simple inclusion process converges to the energy solution of the stochastic Burgers equation. The key technical ingredient is a second-order Boltzmann-Gibbs principle tailored to the microscopic current. As a consequence, we also obtain Ornstein-Uhlenbeck fluctuations for the symmetric inclusion process in a weakly condensing regime, a result of independent interest.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“prove”（证明）、“converges”（收敛）、“Boltzmann-Gibbs principle”（玻尔兹曼-吉布斯原理），属于严格数学证明的统计物理/概率论研究。；研究对象：一维弱不对称简单包含过程（weakly asymmetric simple inclusion process）的平衡态密度涨落，以及对称包含过程（symmetric inclusion process）在弱凝聚（weakly condensing）区间的涨落行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了该过程在平衡态下的密度涨落场在标度极限下收敛于随机Burgers方程的能量解；同时作为推论，得到了对称包含过程在弱凝聚区间的Ornstein-Uhlenbeck涨落。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了该过程在平衡态下的密度涨落场在标度极限下收敛于随机Burgers方程的能量解；同时作为推论，得到了对称包含过程在弱凝聚区间的Ornstein-Uhlenbeck涨落。；创新点：首次将二阶玻尔兹曼-吉布斯原理应用于包含过程（而非仅用于排斥过程），从而在弱不对称情形下严格建立了随机Burgers方程能量解的收敛性；此外，弱凝聚区间对称包含过程的Ornstein-Uhlenbeck涨落结果本身具有独立价值。
papers.method_zh: 采用概率论与统计物理的解析方法，核心工具是专门针对微观电流构造的二阶玻尔兹曼-吉布斯原理（second-order Boltzmann-Gibbs principle），用于控制非线性项的涨落并建立极限过程的唯一性。

papers.title: Exact Entanglement Swapping through Single-Occupancy Measurements in Gaussian Fermion States
papers.abstract: We determine the exact entanglement structure of the conditional state obtained by measuring $m$ corresponding rungs ($m\leq N/2$) in two identical copies of an arbitrary half-filled free fermion Gaussian state and post-selecting the same normalized single-fermion state ($|ψ\rangle = u|10\rangle+v|01\rangle$, where 0 and 1 denote the fermion occupancy on each sites) on each rung. For $m<N/2$, the conditional wavefunction generally depends on the initial state. Nevertheless, whenever the selected outcome has nonzero probability, the state on the unmeasured sites remains Gaussian and factorizes exactly into $N-m$ different orthogonal modes including $m$ inter-copy entangling modes and $N-2m$ spectator modes localized in one copy. Consequently, the entanglement entropy between the unmeasured parts of the two copies is $S=m h_2(|v|^2)$, independent of the initial state, where $h_2(x)=-x\ln x-(1-x)\ln(1-x)$. The success probability is given by $P_m=\det C_L\det(I_m-C_L)=\det(C_{LR}C_{RL})$, determined solely by the initial correlations and independent of ($u$,$v$). Equal-weight Bell post-selection serves as a special case that achieves the maximal entanglement swapping.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“exact entanglement structure”“conditional wavefunction”“entanglement entropy”等理论推导，且无实验或数值计算关键词。；研究对象：自由费米子高斯态（half-filled free fermion Gaussian state）中，通过单占据测量实现纠缠交换（entanglement swapping）的量子信息过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对两份相同的任意半填充自由费米子高斯态，在m个对应“横档”（rung）上后选择相同的归一化单费米子态后，未测量部分的态仍为高斯态，并精确分解为m个纠缠模和N-2m个旁观模；纠缠熵为S = m h₂(|v|²)，与初始态无关，仅由测量投影参数决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对两份相同的任意半填充自由费米子高斯态，在m个对应“横档”（rung）上后选择相同的归一化单费米子态后，未测量部分的态仍为高斯态，并精确分解为m个纠缠模和N-2m个旁观模；纠缠熵为S = m h₂(|v|²)，与初始态无关，仅由测量投影参数决定。；创新点：首次给出任意半填充自由费米子高斯态在单占据测量下纠缠交换的精确解析结果，证明纠缠熵的普适性（与初始态无关），并指出等权重Bell后选择是实现最大纠缠交换的特例。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论推导：利用高斯态的性质，分析m个rung上的单占据投影测量（post-selection）后的条件态结构，计算纠缠熵与成功概率P_m = det C_L det(I_m - C_L) = det(C_LR C_RL)。

papers.title: Local Density Approximation and Other Limit Regimes for a Homogeneous Bose Gas with Repulsive Three-Body Interactions in Low-Dimensional Space
papers.abstract: In the whole space of low spatial dimensions, namely $d \leq 2$, we study the minimizers of an energy functional with an attractive cubic nonlinearity and a repulsive quintic nonlinearity, which describes a quantum Bose gas with a two-body attraction and a three-body repulsion. We prove the existence of minimizers at fixed effective statistics parameter. In the limit of a large effective statistics parameter of the mass-critical nonlinearity (with respect to the kinetic energy), we derive an effective Thomas-Fermi-like model for the homogeneous Bose gas. We also consider other limit regimes depending on the mass-critical nonlinearity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：energy functional、minimizers、limit regimes、model。；研究对象：低维空间（d ≤ 2）中具有排斥性三体相互作用的均匀玻色气体，具体涉及两体吸引（三次非线性）与三体排斥（五次非线性）竞争下的量子体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在固定有效统计参数下证明了能量泛函极小值的存在性；在大有效统计参数极限下，推导出均匀玻色气体的有效Thomas-Fermi-like模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在固定有效统计参数下证明了能量泛函极小值的存在性；在大有效统计参数极限下，推导出均匀玻色气体的有效Thomas-Fermi-like模型。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其创新在于针对低维（d ≤ 2）均匀玻色气体，在吸引两体与排斥三体相互作用共存时，系统研究了质量临界非线性项的大参数极限及其它极限区域，并建立了相应的有效模型。
papers.method_zh: 变分法（能量泛函极小化分析），结合质量临界非线性项的极限分析，研究不同参数区域的渐近行为。

papers.title: Homogeneous attractive Bose-Einstein condensates with repulsive three-body interactions: the two-dimensional case
papers.abstract: We consider a homogeneous Bose gas composed of $N$ identical bosons occupying an infinite two-dimensional space. This gas exhibits both an attractive two-body interaction and a repulsive three-body interaction. Via the intermediate Hartree theory, we rigorously derive the homogeneous cubic-quintic nonlinear Schroedinger functional as the mean-field limit of the model. Our investigation focuses on the system's behavior in relation to the two-body interaction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“rigorously derive”“mean-field limit”“Hartree theory”等数学物理推导关键词。；研究对象：二维均匀玻色气体，体系同时具有吸引性两体相互作用和排斥性三体相互作用，重点研究该体系在两体相互作用影响下的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过中间哈特里（Hartree）理论，严格推导出该二维玻色气体的平均场极限为均匀三次-五次非线性薛定谔泛函，并系统分析了体系随两体相互作用强度变化的物理行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过中间哈特里（Hartree）理论，严格推导出该二维玻色气体的平均场极限为均匀三次-五次非线性薛定谔泛函，并系统分析了体系随两体相互作用强度变化的物理行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其新意在于将吸引两体+排斥三体相互作用的组合在二维情形下严格建立平均场极限，并聚焦两体相互作用对体系行为的影响（摘要未明确展开）。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为中间哈特里理论（intermediate Hartree theory），用于从多体量子模型严格推导平均场极限，得到均匀的立方-五次非线性薛定谔泛函（cubic-quintic nonlinear Schrödinger functional）。

papers.title: Homogeneous attractive Bose-Einstein condensates with repulsive three-body interactions: the one-dimensional case
papers.abstract: We investigate the behavior of a homogeneous one-dimensional Bose gas composed of $N$ identical bosons experiencing attractive two-body and repulsive three-body interactions. Utilizing intermediate Hartree theory, we rigorously derive the homogeneous cubic-quintic nonlinear Schrödinger functional as the mean-field limit of the many-body Hamiltonian. Particular attention is given to the impact of the repulsive three-body term on ground state energy estimates and mass concentration properties
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“rigorously derive”“mean-field limit”“Hartree theory”等理论推导关键词。；研究对象：一维均匀玻色气体，由N个全同玻色子组成，具有吸引性两体相互作用和排斥性三体相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过中间Hartree理论严格推导出多体哈密顿量的平均场极限为均匀三次-五次非线性薛定谔泛函；排斥性三体项对基态能量估计和质量集中性质有显著影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过中间Hartree理论严格推导出多体哈密顿量的平均场极限为均匀三次-五次非线性薛定谔泛函；排斥性三体项对基态能量估计和质量集中性质有显著影响。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其新意在于严格处理了吸引两体与排斥三体相互作用的竞争效应，并在一维情形下给出了平均场极限的严格数学推导。
papers.method_zh: 中间Hartree理论（intermediate Hartree theory），用于从多体哈密顿量严格推导平均场极限，并分析基态能量估计与质量集中性质。

papers.title: Controlling the Coupling Strengths in Nanophotonic Networks using Modified Yagi-Uda Nanoplasmonic Antennas
papers.abstract: On-chip communication in optical neural networks is commonly done via waveguides which results in large system footprints. A compact alternative is to broadcast light signals between nano-optoelectronic components in free space and tailor the light field distribution using sub-wavelength nanophotonics. We propose and simulate nanoplasmonic metal structures in combination with III-V nanowire emitters and receivers to create an optical network in which the shape and position of these nanostructures create varying weights between the nano-optoelectronic nodes. Using Finite Difference Time Domain modelling, we investigate systems of experimentally verified nanowire optoelectronics combined with nanoplasmonic structures that can be made in the same fabrication step as electrical contacts powering the nanowires. We investigate both individual nanowire/antenna devices as well as networks corresponding to two layers in a neural network. We show that directed communication from a nanowire node can be significantly altered using Yagi-Uda antennas. Modifying the antenna with an asymmetric director component enables the directing of light several different angular directions simultaneously. We find that highly variable complex weight distribution between the connections in two seven node layers can be achieved depending on the combined geometry of the antenna components. The possible weight distributions in compact layers of nanowire nodes could be used for creating a variety of neural networks with complex connectivity. The concepts can be generalized to other types of nanoscale emitter/receiver systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“We propose and simulate”“Using Finite Difference Time Domain modelling”，属于数值模拟研究。；研究对象：纳米光子网络中的纳米等离子体金属结构（改进型Yagi-Uda天线）与III-V族纳米线发射器/接收器组成的复合体系，用于自由空间光信号广播与神经形态光学网络。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过改变Yagi-Uda纳米等离子体天线的几何形状（特别是引入非对称引向器），可以同时将纳米线节点的光信号导向多个不同角度方向，从而在两层各含七个节点的网络之间实现高度可变的复权重分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过改变Yagi-Uda纳米等离子体天线的几何形状（特别是引入非对称引向器），可以同时将纳米线节点的光信号导向多个不同角度方向，从而在两层各含七个节点的网络之间实现高度可变的复权重分布。；创新点：提出利用Yagi-Uda天线的非对称引向器设计，实现单个纳米线节点向多个方向同时定向辐射，从而在紧凑的纳米线节点层间获得复杂可调的连接权重分布，为构建具有复杂连接性的光学神经网络提供了新方案。摘要未突出说明与已有纳米光子天线方案的系统性对比。
papers.method_zh: 时域有限差分（FDTD）数值模拟，研究对象为实验已验证的纳米线光电子器件与可在同一制备步骤中与纳米线电接触同时制造的纳米等离子体结构。

papers.title: Localization in microcavities revealed by phase-space non-Hermitian skin effect
papers.abstract: Contrary to the semiclassical expectation for fully chaotic systems, localization of resonances is found to be a common feature in open microcavities. In spiral-shaped dielectric microcavities, a substantial fraction of resonances localize on polygonal patterns in real space, are chiral, and their momentum distributions accumulate near the critical line for total internal reflection. Despite the extensive investigation, the physical mechanism responsible for their remarkable abundance has remained a long-standing question. Addressing this, we reveal a physical correspondence between an inhomogeneous-loss Hatano-Nelson model and the dielectric phase space of a spiral microcavity. We show that the combination of geometry-induced momentum drift and refractive escape yields a generalized non-Hermitian skin effect in the phase space momentum. We identify this mechanism as the origin of the critical-line localization of resonances in open chaotic spiral microcavities, extending the skin-effect concept beyond nonreciprocal lattices to phase space and to open chaotic wave systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“揭示物理对应”“提出广义非厄米趋肤效应机制”，属于理论建模与分析，未涉及实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：开放螺旋形介电微腔中的共振局域化现象，具体为相空间中的非厄米趋肤效应及其与临界线局域化的对应关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 螺旋微腔中几何诱导的动量漂移与折射逃逸共同产生相空间动量中的广义非厄米趋肤效应，该效应是开放混沌螺旋微腔中临界线共振局域化的物理起源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：螺旋微腔中几何诱导的动量漂移与折射逃逸共同产生相空间动量中的广义非厄米趋肤效应，该效应是开放混沌螺旋微腔中临界线共振局域化的物理起源。；创新点：将非厄米趋肤效应的概念从非互易晶格推广到相空间及开放混沌波系统，为长期未解的螺旋微腔中临界线局域化丰度问题提供了统一物理解释。
papers.method_zh: 理论对应分析：将具有非均匀损耗的Hatano-Nelson模型与螺旋微腔的介电相空间建立映射，通过相空间动量中的非厄米趋肤效应机制解释共振局域化。

papers.title: Parametric amplification in a Kerr Oscillator based on Ne FIB Nanobridges
papers.abstract: Superconducting circuits play a crucial role in the advancement of quantum computing and quantum sensing. Typically such circuits require the presence of a non-linear element, where the engineered anharmonicity (Kerr factor) and resonant linewidth determine the potential applications of the circuit. In this work we have fabricated Nb-based CPW resonators embedded with a DC SQUID incorporating Nb nanobridges as the weak links. We use two-tone spectroscopy to study the non-linear behaviour of the device at 15 mK up to a field of 2.48 mT. Under the application of a blue-detuned pump, the device shows a decrease in the resonant frequency which is used to estimate the Kerr factor. We further apply a red-detuned pump to go beyond the bifurcation threshold and observe the appearance of an additional idler mode with net gain. The gain of the device was maximized by further decreasing the pump frequency, showing a maximum amplification of 15 dB. Finally, we show agreement between the Kerr non-linear oscillator model and the measured transmission spectrum, and highlight further design modifications to improve the gain and bandwidth of such devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要描述了器件制备（fabricated）、低温测量（two-tone spectroscopy at 15 mT）以及实验观测（observed gain, measured transmission spectrum）。；研究对象：基于Nb纳米桥（nanobridges）嵌入DC SQUID的铌基共面波导（CPW）超导谐振器，研究其Kerr非线性效应及参量放大行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在蓝失谐泵浦下器件谐振频率降低，可用于估算Kerr因子；在红失谐泵浦下越过分岔阈值后出现具有净增益的额外闲频模，最大放大达15 dB，且实验透射谱与Kerr非线性振子模型吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在蓝失谐泵浦下器件谐振频率降低，可用于估算Kerr因子；在红失谐泵浦下越过分岔阈值后出现具有净增益的额外闲频模，最大放大达15 dB，且实验透射谱与Kerr非线性振子模型吻合。；创新点：利用聚焦离子束（FIB）制备的Nb纳米桥作为弱连接集成到DC SQUID中，在CPW谐振器结构中实现了可调Kerr非线性，并演示了基于该器件的参量放大（15 dB增益），同时验证了理论模型与实验的一致性。摘要未突出说明与已有器件的具体性能对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用双音谱（two-tone spectroscopy）在15 mK温度、最高2.48 mT磁场下表征器件非线性；通过蓝失谐泵浦测量谐振频移提取Kerr因子，红失谐泵浦驱动至分岔阈值以上观测闲频模增益；并与Kerr非线性振子模型的理论透射谱进行对比。

papers.title: Quantum optomechanics with arbitrary mirror displacement: nonlinear Langevin equation with non-Markovian back-action noises
papers.abstract: Quantum optomechanics (QOM) explores the interaction between a quantum field, often confined in a cavity, and the quantum motion of mirrors, membranes or material media, usually assumed slow enough with negligible particle production, which is the central concern of dynamical Casimir effects, and a drive laser field for effective control. This rapidly developing field has a wide range of applications, from quantum sensing to the detection of gravitational waves. Because the opto-mechanical coupling is nonlinear, most theoretical investigations assume that the amplitude of mirror motion $x$ remains small. Recent years saw several papers treating $x^2, x^3$ orders in the mirror displacement. In our work we take a different route, deploying the functional perturbative method presented in [1] and enriched in [2], applicable for sufficiently weak opto-mechanical couplings. With this we can treat arbitrary displacement of the mirror, not just at a higher order in a power series expansion in $x$. We first derive the influence action of the quantum field and its non-Markovian noises back-reacting on the moving mirror with self-consistency. From it we derive a nonlinear Langevin equation driven by these back-action noises from the quantum field. We then show how results from our general modeling and treatment can be linked with the models and the Langevin equations presented in the literature, starting with the popular radiation pressure $Nx$ coupling, with $N$ the photon number, up to the recent $x^3$ order results. We hope this new approach and the results presented here can provide useful theoretical support for high precision QOM experimentation in the future.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：functional perturbative method、derive、theoretical support。；研究对象：量子光力学（QOM）系统，具体为腔中量子场与可移动镜面之间的相互作用，关注镜面位移任意大（不限于小位移或低阶展开）时的非线性动力学及非马尔可夫反作用噪声。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过泛函微扰方法，推导出包含量子场非马尔可夫反作用噪声驱动的非线性朗之万方程，该方程适用于任意幅度的镜面位移，并可与文献中从辐射压Nx耦合到x³阶的结果建立联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过泛函微扰方法，推导出包含量子场非马尔可夫反作用噪声驱动的非线性朗之万方程，该方程适用于任意幅度的镜面位移，并可与文献中从辐射压Nx耦合到x³阶的结果建立联系。；创新点：不同于以往仅在镜面位移x的幂级数展开中处理x²、x³阶修正，本工作可在弱光-机耦合条件下处理任意大小的镜面位移，无需做高阶截断，并建立了与现有辐射压Nx及x³阶朗之万方程模型的统一联系。
papers.method_zh: 采用泛函微扰方法（基于文献[1]提出、[2]扩展的框架），先推导量子场的影响作用量及其对运动镜面的非马尔可夫噪声（含自洽性），再由此导出非线性朗之万方程。

papers.title: Algorithmic threshold for high-dimensional projection pursuit I: general theory
papers.abstract: We study a null model of high-dimensional projection pursuit: we are given $M$ points sampled i.i.d. from a standard gaussian in $N$ dimensions, where $M,N\to\infty$ with $M/N\toα\in(0,\infty)$. Our goal is to characterize the possible empirical distributions of these points' projections along a data-dependent direction $x$, which ranges over either the sphere $S_N=\sqrt{N}\mathbb{S}^{N-1}$ or cube $Σ_N=\{-1,+1\}^N$. We consider this problem in an algorithmic setting, where $x$ must be the output of an algorithm with dimension-free Lipschitz dependence on the input; this class of algorithms includes general gradient-based methods such as Langevin dynamics and approximate message passing (AMP). Our main result exactly characterizes the set of empirical distributions attainable by this class in terms of a one-dimensional stochastic control problem. As a consequence of our main result, we obtain exact algorithmic thresholds for optimizing the Hamiltonian of a spherical or Ising perceptron model with general bounded continuous activation. For the spherical problem, independent work of Montanari and Zhou (2024) characterized the empirical distributions attainable by a related two-stage AMP algorithm, also in terms of stochastic control. Our proof of hardness builds on the branching overlap gap property introduced in earlier work by the first two authors. Our main innovation is to develop stochastic control theory within the branching OGP framework, significantly expanding the settings in which it locates an exact algorithmic threshold. Notably, our methods apply even though the non-algorithmic problem of characterizing all feasible projections remains a major outstanding challenge. For the matching algorithmic result, we construct a new incremental AMP algorithm that acts on a Brownian-bridge revelation of the gaussian disorder and simulates the same family of controlled SDEs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确讨论“null model”“algorithmic setting”“stochastic control problem”“proof of hardness”等，属于数学与统计物理交叉的理论分析，无实验或数值模拟描述。；研究对象：高维投影寻踪（projection pursuit）的零模型：在N维标准高斯分布中独立采样M个点，M/N→α∈(0,∞)，研究数据依赖方向x（球面或立方体）上投影的经验分布。物理对应为球形或Ising感知器（perceptron）模型的哈密顿量优化问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 精确刻画了具有无维Lipschitz依赖性的算法类（含梯度方法、Langevin动力学、AMP）所能达到的投影经验分布集合，并由此得到球形/Ising感知器模型哈密顿量优化的精确算法阈值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：精确刻画了具有无维Lipschitz依赖性的算法类（含梯度方法、Langevin动力学、AMP）所能达到的投影经验分布集合，并由此得到球形/Ising感知器模型哈密顿量优化的精确算法阈值。；创新点：首次将随机控制理论引入分支OGP框架，显著扩展了该框架能定位精确算法阈值的适用范围；且该方法在非算法问题（刻画所有可行投影）仍悬而未决时依然有效。摘要未突出说明与Montanari-Zhou（2024）两阶段AMP工作的具体差异细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：①将可达经验分布集合等价转化为一维随机控制问题；②基于前作提出的“分支重叠间隙性质”（branching OGP）发展随机控制理论；③构造新的增量AMP算法，在布朗桥揭示高斯无序的框架下模拟受控SDE族，实现匹配的算法可达性结果。

papers.title: Quantum work extraction from partial information and with finite resources
papers.abstract: Information can be converted into work, but in quantum mechanics information about a state is not freely available: it must be inferred statistically from measurements on a finite number of copies. We study work extraction in this finite-resource setting by introducing a partial-information and finite-resources (PIFR) quantum Maxwell's demon. Given $N$ identical copies of a state with known Hamiltonian, the demon measures $M$ copies to estimate the state and the corresponding ergotropic unitary, which is then applied to the remaining $N-M$ copies. This protocol induces a trade-off between information acquisition, reconstruction accuracy, and thermodynamic yield, making the total extracted work normalized to the ideal ergotropic benchmark the relevant figure of merit. As our central result, we derive a universal closed-form trade-off bound that places this ergotropic efficiency between a Carnot-type ceiling $1-M/N$ and a floor controlled by a reconstruction precision rooted in finite-sample quantum estimation theory; optimizing the copy allocation yields $M^*\propto N^{2/3}$ and an $N^{-1/3}$ approach to the ideal limit, set by a conservative, worst-case reconstruction precision. By considering standard quantum state tomography, we numerically verify the presence of an optimal resource distribution, which also depends on the purity of the state under consideration. Our results identify finite-copy work extraction as a genuinely task-dependent inference problem, in which estimation strategies should be judged by thermodynamic performance rather than reconstruction fidelity alone.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要聚焦于量子热力学协议的理论推导、优化分析及数值验证，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：量子信息-功转换体系，具体为有限资源（有限拷贝数）下的量子麦克斯韦妖模型，涉及量子态估计、ergotropic 幺正变换与功提取过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出普适的闭式权衡界，将ergotropic效率限制在Carnot型上限1−M/N与由有限样本量子估计理论决定的重构精度下限之间；最优拷贝分配满足M*∝N^{2/3}，且效率以N^{−1/3}趋近理想极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出普适的闭式权衡界，将ergotropic效率限制在Carnot型上限1−M/N与由有限样本量子估计理论决定的重构精度下限之间；最优拷贝分配满足M*∝N^{2/3}，且效率以N^{−1/3}趋近理想极限。；创新点：将有限拷贝条件下的功提取明确刻画为任务依赖的推断问题，提出以热力学性能（而非单纯重构保真度）作为估计策略的评判标准，并给出闭式权衡界与最优资源分配标度律。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：部分信息与有限资源（PIFR）量子麦克斯韦妖协议；量子估计理论（有限样本重构精度）；标准量子态层析（数值验证）；优化分析（拷贝分配优化）。

papers.title: Convex conservation of von Neumann entropy implies unitarity or antiunitarity
papers.abstract: On the space of density matrices $D(H)$, Kadison's theorem establishes that all invertible convex transformations $K:D(H)\to D(H)$ are unitarity or antiunitary. For a finite Hilbert space, we propose a similar theorem which replaces the invertibility requirement with that of entropy conservation. Thus, we argue, the supposition of reversibility in quantum mechanics may be replaced with a principle of entropy conservation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要讨论数学定理（Kadison定理）及理论推论，无实验或计算关键词。；研究对象：量子力学中密度矩阵空间上的凸变换，具体为有限维希尔伯特空间上的密度矩阵集合 D(H)，关注其可逆性与熵守恒的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有限维希尔伯特空间上，若将 Kadison 定理中的“可逆性”条件替换为“冯·诺依曼熵守恒”，则所有凸变换仍只能是幺正或反幺正变换。因此，量子力学中的可逆性假设可被熵守恒原理替代。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限维希尔伯特空间上，若将 Kadison 定理中的“可逆性”条件替换为“冯·诺依曼熵守恒”，则所有凸变换仍只能是幺正或反幺正变换。因此，量子力学中的可逆性假设可被熵守恒原理替代。；创新点：将量子力学基本假设从“可逆性”推广为“熵守恒”，为量子力学公理化基础提供了新的等价表述。摘要未突出说明与已有熵相关定理（如 Wigner 定理变体）的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 数学证明与定理推导。基于 Kadison 定理，在有限维密度矩阵空间上构造新的定理，用熵守恒条件替代原定理中的可逆性条件。

papers.title: Anomalous Frequency Shift in Low-Loss Superconducting Granular Aluminum Resonators
papers.abstract: Superconducting high-kinetic inductance materials like granular aluminum (grAl) are a versatile part of the circuit quantum electrodynamics (cQED) toolbox, provided their losses at microwave frequencies are low enough. To further advance the use of grAl in quantum devices, it is indispensable to identify the dominant loss mechanisms. The standard approach pairs electromagnetic simulations of resonator geometry with measured temperature and power dependence of resonance frequency and loss rate.
