Most materials follow the phenomenological theory of two-level systems (TLSs) at low temperatures, resulting in an initial decrease of the resonance frequency with increasing temperature. In our work, we observe an opposite behavior at the lowest temperatures: The resonance frequency initially increases with both temperature and readout power, contradicting the standard TLS model predictions. We are able to explain a part of the data by an alternative mechanism associated with the effect of superconducting quasiparticles in a granular system with spatially-nonuniform gap. Yet, the observed change in the resonance frequency with temperature is not matched by a proportional change in the loss rate. We also observe anomalous positive frequency responses following high-energy events, characterized by several time scales. While anomalous behavior has been reported previously in grAl, the disagreement with standard models is particularly visible in our devices thanks to their exceptionally low loss rates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了对超导谐振器的测量（温度、功率依赖关系），并对比了电磁模拟与实验数据。；研究对象：低损耗超导颗粒铝（granular aluminum, grAl）微波谐振器，具体研究其谐振频率与损耗率在低温下的反常温度/功率依赖行为，以及高能事件后的频率响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在最低温度下，grAl谐振器的谐振频率随温度或读功率升高而**增加**，与标准二能级系统（TLS）模型预测的初始下降相反；该反常频率变化与损耗率变化不成比例，且高能事件后出现多时间尺度的正频率响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在最低温度下，grAl谐振器的谐振频率随温度或读功率升高而**增加**，与标准二能级系统（TLS）模型预测的初始下降相反；该反常频率变化与损耗率变化不成比例，且高能事件后出现多时间尺度的正频率响应。；创新点：在极低损耗grAl器件中清晰展示了与标准TLS模型定量不符的反常频率响应（正频移、频率-损耗失配、高能事件后多时间尺度响应），凸显了现有损耗机制模型的不足。摘要未明确说明是否提出完整新理论，仅指出准粒子机制可解释部分数据。
papers.method_zh: 电磁仿真（谐振器几何结构）结合谐振频率与损耗率的温度、功率依赖测量；用非均匀能隙颗粒系统中的超导准粒子效应解释部分数据；与TLS唯象理论对比。

papers.title: Probabilistic generation of two-mode binomial cat states using cross-Kerr interactions
papers.abstract: Superpositions of macroscopically distinct coherent states, or cat states, are a key resource for quantum technologies. In particular, two-mode binomial cat states can give rise to exact quantum error correction in continuous-variable quantum computing. However, their preparation typically requires non-Gaussian initial states, such as Fock or NOON states, which are challenging to realize experimentally. Here, we propose a protocol to generate two-mode binomial cat states where the only requirements are Gaussian initial states in combination with heralded heterodyne measurements. Our approach utilizes cross-Kerr interactions between bosonic modes commonly realizable in superconducting circuit architectures. We show that by adjusting the input state parameters, our protocol remains robust to dissipation under realistic experimental conditions. Our work provides a practical route to realizing multinomial cat states in current experimental platforms without requiring non-Gaussian initial resources, overcoming a key limitation of existing preparation schemes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/方案提出文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“propose a protocol”“our approach utilizes”“we show”等表述，属于理论方案设计，未涉及实验数据或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：连续变量量子光学体系中的双模二项式猫态（two-mode binomial cat states），基于玻色模之间的cross-Kerr相互作用，可在超导电路架构中实现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种仅需高斯初态和 heralded heterodyne 测量即可制备双模二项式猫态的协议，避免了现有方案对非高斯初态（如Fock态或NOON态）的依赖，并在实际耗散条件下保持鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种仅需高斯初态和 heralded heterodyne 测量即可制备双模二项式猫态的协议，避免了现有方案对非高斯初态（如Fock态或NOON态）的依赖，并在实际耗散条件下保持鲁棒性。；创新点：首次提出无需非高斯初态即可制备双模二项式猫态的实用方案，克服了现有制备方案对非高斯资源（Fock/NOON态）的关键限制，且对耗散具有鲁棒性。摘要未明确说明与具体已有协议的性能对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论协议设计：利用cross-Kerr相互作用（玻色模间非线性耦合），结合高斯初态与 heralded heterodyne 测量（条件测量方案）。摘要未给出具体数学形式或数值模拟细节。

papers.title: Exact Haar Statistics of Planar $k$-Purity in Multipartite Quantum Systems
papers.abstract: Planar $k$-uniform states have maximally mixed reductions on every $k$-site interval of a ring. We introduce planar $k$-purity---the mean purity of those intervals---as a faithful cost function for this simultaneous constraint. For a Haar-random pure state of $n$ parties with local dimension $p$, the joint purity of two intervals depends only on their overlap. An exhaustive four-replica calculation therefore yields the complete cyclic covariance kernel and a closed variance for every $1\le k\le\lfloor n/2\rfloor$. In the balanced qubit case, $k=\lfloor n/2\rfloor$ and $N=2^n$, the variance is asymptotic to $20/(3nN^2)$ for even $n$ and $6/(nN^2)$ for odd $n$. A site-factorized permutation representation gives all raw moments and permits exact finite-sum evaluation of the skewness. Fixed-seed simulations validate nonbalanced qubit and qutrit cases, while balanced-qubit simulations through $n=10$ validate the parity formulas and finite-size skewness. Balanced planar and absolute balanced purity have the same Haar mean but different fluctuations; the planar variance is approximately $2.83$ times larger at $n=10$. Thus subsystem incidence, although invisible to every one-cut marginal distribution, controls the collective fluctuations of geometrically related cuts. Together with universal attainability and a linear number of interval constraints at balance, this provides a geometry-aware benchmark for multipartite entanglement beyond AME existence regimes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“Haar-random pure state”、“four-replica calculation”、“permutation representation”等理论计算与统计方法，无实验或数值模拟为主的研究手段。；研究对象：多体量子系统中的平面k-均匀态（planar k-uniform states）及其纠缠结构，具体为n方、局域维度p的多体纯态中，环上任意k位点区间的约化密度矩阵纯度统计性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于Haar随机纯态，平面k-纯度（即所有k位点区间纯度的平均值）的方差在平衡量子比特情形下具有明确的奇偶依赖渐近形式：偶数n为20/(3nN²)，奇数n为6/(nN²)（N=2^n）。平面纯度与绝对平衡纯度具有相同的Haar均值但不同的涨落，平面方差在n=10时约为后者的2.83倍，表明子系统几何位置关系虽不改变单边约化分布的统计，却显著影响集体涨落。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于Haar随机纯态，平面k-纯度（即所有k位点区间纯度的平均值）的方差在平衡量子比特情形下具有明确的奇偶依赖渐近形式：偶数n为20/(3nN²)，奇数n为6/(nN²)（N=2^n）。平面纯度与绝对平衡纯度具有相同的Haar均值但不同的涨落，平面方差在n=10时约为后者的2.83倍，表明子系统几何位置关系虽不改变单边约化分布的统计，却显著影响集体涨落。；创新点：首次引入平面k-纯度作为平面k-均匀约束的忠实代价函数，并给出其完整的Haar统计（协方差核、方差、原始矩和偏度）；揭示了子系统几何重叠关系对多体纠缠集体涨落的控制作用，为超越绝对最大纠缠（AME）存在区域的纠缠提供几何敏感的基准。
papers.method_zh: 采用四副本（four-replica）计算方法推导两个区间纯度的联合分布，得到完整的循环协方差核；利用位点因子化的置换表示计算所有原始矩，并精确求有限和得到偏度；通过固定随机种子模拟验证非平衡量子比特和qutrit情形，以及平衡量子比特至n=10的奇偶公式和有限尺寸偏度。

papers.title: Active wetting transition in cell aggregates
papers.abstract: During many biological processes, cell aggregates spread on substrates in a process of active wetting. The existing models of tissue spreading, however, do not explicitly capture the state of partial wetting, in which the cell aggregate reaches a non-zero contact angle. Here, modeling cell aggregates as active polar liquid droplets, we predict a transition between partial and complete wetting. This transition emerges from the competition between tissue surface tension and active traction forces, which is captured in an active Young-Dupré equation. The active wetting transition is discontinuous, and it features a region of parameters in which both partial and complete wetting are possible. Unlike in passive wetting, the transition depends on dynamical parameters such as the tissue viscosity and substrate friction. Finally, adding contractile intercellular active stresses leads to higher contact angles and even full dewetting. Overall, our work predicts an active wetting transition for tissues and it captures the partial wetting states often seen in experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：modeling、predict、theoretical framework（active polar liquid droplets模型）。；研究对象：细胞聚集体的活性润湿现象，具体为细胞团在基底上铺展时的部分润湿与完全润湿之间的转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 细胞聚集体存在从部分润湿到完全润湿的活性润湿转变，该转变是不连续的（一级相变），并存在双稳参数区间；细胞间收缩性活性应力会增大接触角甚至导致完全去润湿。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：细胞聚集体存在从部分润湿到完全润湿的活性润湿转变，该转变是不连续的（一级相变），并存在双稳参数区间；细胞间收缩性活性应力会增大接触角甚至导致完全去润湿。；创新点：首次在组织铺展模型中显式捕捉部分润湿状态，并揭示了活性润湿转变与被动润湿的关键差异——转变依赖于动力学参数（组织黏度、基底摩擦），且具有不连续性和双稳性。
papers.method_zh: 将细胞聚集体建模为活性极性液滴，推导了活性Young-Dupré方程，通过分析表面张力与活性牵引力之间的竞争来研究润湿转变。

papers.title: Spin-spin effects from non-relativistic limit of Dirac-Pauli-Maxwell Lagrangian
papers.abstract: It is natural to expect that the electromagnetic spin-spin interaction has roots in a more fundamental theory: quantum electrodynamics in this case. To show this, we take the non-relativistic limit of the Dirac-Maxwell Lagrangian, using the Foldy-Wouthuysen transformation and derive the Breit interaction by an alternative approach. By adding the Pauli term (i.e., a higher-order interaction between spin and the electromagnetic field), we calculate the correction terms to electromagnetic spin-spin interactions in the non-relativistic limit. Finally, we study some of the physical effects of these terms regarding spin-spin interactions and spin-spin entanglements. Accordingly, we provide theoretical estimates that are not yet accessible with current experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：non-relativistic limit、Foldy-Wouthuysen transformation、Lagrangian、theoretical estimates。；研究对象：电磁自旋-自旋相互作用及其修正项，具体涉及Dirac-Pauli-Maxwell拉氏量的非相对论极限下的自旋相关物理效应，以及自旋-自旋纠缠。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Foldy-Wouthuysen变换从Dirac-Maxwell拉氏量的非相对论极限出发，以另一种途径推导出Breit相互作用；加入Pauli项后，得到了电磁自旋-自旋相互作用的修正项，并分析了这些修正项对自旋-自旋相互作用和自旋-自旋纠缠的物理影响，给出了当前实验尚无法达到的理论估计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Foldy-Wouthuysen变换从Dirac-Maxwell拉氏量的非相对论极限出发，以另一种途径推导出Breit相互作用；加入Pauli项后，得到了电磁自旋-自旋相互作用的修正项，并分析了这些修正项对自旋-自旋相互作用和自旋-自旋纠缠的物理影响，给出了当前实验尚无法达到的理论估计。；创新点：以拉氏量非相对论极限的替代途径重新推导了Breit相互作用，并系统引入了Pauli项带来的高阶修正，进而探讨这些修正对自旋-自旋纠缠等物理效应的理论预言。摘要未突出说明与其他工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：采用Foldy-Wouthuysen变换对Dirac-Maxwell拉氏量取非相对论极限，推导Breit相互作用；在此基础上加入Pauli项（自旋与电磁场的高阶相互作用），计算自旋-自旋相互作用的修正项。

papers.title: Strongly coupled quark matter in neutron stars and their mergers
papers.abstract: The discovery of the strongly-coupled quark-gluon plasma (sQGP) in high-energy heavy-ion collisions has revealed remarkable properties of matter at high temperature, with transport coefficients close to conjectured bounds from quantum field theory at strong coupling. The high sQGP collision rates imply very large energy uncertainties and the melting of quasiparticle structures. Deploying quantum many-body theory based on the self-consistent $T$-matrix approach for the sQGP at high temperature, we investigate its manifestation at high baryon density and low temperature, as present in neutron stars and their mergers. We constrain the chemical-potential dependence of the quark interaction kernel using first-principles information from Quantum Chromodynamics on baryon-number susceptibilities. Very large collisional widths persist at large density and are found to relegate superconducting phases to rather small temperatures. Instead, a strongly coupled diquark liquid prevails in the thermodynamics under the conditions relevant to neutron-star mergers. At lower densities, the diquarks take over from the single-quark contributions, suggesting a pathway toward hadronization. Our results are consistent with observational constraints on the equation of state of neutron stars, corroborating the presence of strongly coupled quark matter in the interior of these objects.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：quantum many-body theory、self-consistent T-matrix approach、constrain……using first-principles information。；研究对象：中子星及其并合过程内部的高重子密度、低温度条件下的强耦合夸克物质（strongly coupled quark matter），及其与高温强耦合夸克-胶子等离子体（sQGP）的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强耦合夸克物质中，非常大的碰撞宽度持续存在，将超导相压制到极低温度；在致密星并合相关条件下，热力学以强耦合双夸克（diquark）液体为主导，且该结果与中子星状态方程的观测约束一致，支持中子星内部存在强耦合夸克物质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强耦合夸克物质中，非常大的碰撞宽度持续存在，将超导相压制到极低温度；在致密星并合相关条件下，热力学以强耦合双夸克（diquark）液体为主导，且该结果与中子星状态方程的观测约束一致，支持中子星内部存在强耦合夸克物质。；创新点：将高温sQGP中验证的自洽T矩阵框架系统应用于中子星及并合环境的高密度低温条件，并首次揭示强耦合双夸克液体在该条件下的主导地位及其与强子化路径的衔接；摘要未突出说明与以往中子星物态方程模型的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于自洽T矩阵方法（self-consistent T-matrix approach）的量子多体理论，用于高温sQGP并推广到高密度低温区；利用QCD第一性原理给出的重子数磁化率（baryon-number susceptibilities）来约束夸克相互作用核的化学势依赖。

papers.title: Dissipation across the ultrastrong-coupling regime of nanomechanical quantum Rabi systems
papers.abstract: Mechanical resonators ultrastrongly coupled to quantum two-level systems provide a promising route towards mechanical qubits by introducing significant anharmonicity to the mechanical modes, particularly in the slow-oscillator regime. Although the resulting hybrid system is well described by the quantum Rabi model, a consistent treatment of dissipation remains challenging across the broad parameter space routinely probed in current nanotube electromechanical devices. Here, we investigate dissipation in the open quantum Rabi model using a Born-Markov framework based on the slowly varying bath spectrum approximation, yielding a Lindblad master equation applicable far beyond conventional descriptions while recovering them in their respective limits. Using this framework, we analyze experimentally accessible observables across this parameter space. As the secular approximation breaks down, phonon blockade progressively washes out. Our approach remains valid in this regime, enabling a quantitative description of the continuous evolution of phonon blockade with coupling strength and dissipation. At finite temperature, we find a suppression of the temperature-induced increase of coherence decay rate for weak anharmonicity. Under driving, our approach remains applicable to substantially stronger perturbations than conventional dressed-state master equations and shows that an apparently classical observable can coexist with Wigner negativity. We further capture the weakly anharmonic regime arising from finite detuning in the double-quantum dot. These results establish a unified description of dissipation from weakly anharmonic operating regimes to the strongly anharmonic mechanical-qubit regime and provide experimentally relevant predictions for ultrastrong electromechanical systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Born-Markov framework”“Lindblad master equation”等理论方法，且未提及实验数据或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：纳米管机电系统中与量子二能级系统超强耦合的机械谐振子，具体涉及开放量子Rabi模型中的耗散行为，以及声子阻塞、Wigner负性等量子现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作建立了一个适用于超强耦合宽参数空间的统一耗散描述，发现随着secular近似失效，声子阻塞逐渐被抹除；在有限温度下，弱非谐性会抑制温度引起的相干衰减率增加；在驱动下，表观经典可观测量可与Wigner负性共存。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作建立了一个适用于超强耦合宽参数空间的统一耗散描述，发现随着secular近似失效，声子阻塞逐渐被抹除；在有限温度下，弱非谐性会抑制温度引起的相干衰减率增加；在驱动下，表观经典可观测量可与Wigner负性共存。；创新点：提供了从弱非谐工作区到强非谐机械量子比特区的统一耗散描述，并给出了超强耦合机电系统的实验可测预言；其方法在驱动下比传统缀饰态主方程适用更强的微扰范围。
papers.method_zh: 基于慢变库谱近似的Born-Markov框架，推导出Lindblad主方程，该方程在常规描述失效的参数区间仍适用，并能在相应极限下恢复传统结果。分析对象包括实验可观测的物理量，并考虑了双量子点有限失谐导致的弱非谐区。

papers.title: Quantum synchronization of spin-1 system: Enhanced synchronization due to additive Lindblad operators
papers.abstract: We experimentally investigate quantum synchronization for one of the simplest possible quantum systems, namely an externally driven few-level system with equally spaced energy levels effectively acting as a spin-1 system. Coupling to excited auxiliary states, we realize additive effective Lindblad operators that are associated with non-conventional dissipative pathways, which are shown to enhance, in certain parameter regimes, quantum synchronization. The experimental set-up, which utilizes cold $^{87}$Rb atoms in a MOT, and associated synchronization extraction protocol are benchmarked carefully through dedicated simulations. Convincing agreement is found between experiment and simulations. The dissipation engineering approach established in our work can be readily extended to systems with more energy levels, such as effective spin-$3/2$ or spin-$2$ systems, and has implications for quantum synchronization studies in higher-spin systems as well as for a wide range of quantum science studies and technology applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合仿真模拟验证）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“experimentally investigate”“experimental set-up”“dedicated simulations”“agreement between experiment and simulations”。；研究对象：自旋-1 量子系统的量子同步现象。具体体系为冷⁸⁷Rb 原子（MOT 中），外驱动下能级等间距排列的有效自旋-1 系统，并通过耦合激发辅助态引入非传统耗散通道。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过耦合激发辅助态实现附加的 Lindblad 算符（非传统耗散路径），在特定参数区间内可增强量子同步；实验与仿真结果高度一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过耦合激发辅助态实现附加的 Lindblad 算符（非传统耗散路径），在特定参数区间内可增强量子同步；实验与仿真结果高度一致。；创新点：首次在实验上实现并验证了通过附加 Lindblad 算符（非传统耗散路径）增强自旋-1 系统量子同步的方案；该耗散工程方法可推广至更高自旋（如自旋-3/2、自旋-2）系统，为高自旋量子同步研究提供新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上利用磁光阱（MOT）中的冷⁸⁷Rb 原子构建有效自旋-1 系统，施加外部驱动，并通过耦合激发辅助态实现耗散工程（附加 Lindblad 算符）；同时建立同步提取协议，并通过专门设计的数值仿真对实验进行基准校验。

papers.title: Analysis of the Principal Components of Correlation Matrices of S&P 500 Financial Data from an Econophysics Perspective
papers.abstract: This thesis analyzes the collective dynamics of the S&P 500 from an econophysics perspective, treating the financial market as a complex system. Using daily logarithmic returns of 430 companies, time-dependent Pearson correlation matrices are constructed over sliding windows and their spectral structure is studied through the leading eigenvalues and eigenvectors. Market States (MS) are identified by applying k-Means clustering to several spectral quantities: the largest eigenvalue (interpreted as the State of the Market), the squared entries of the dominant eigenvector (read as a relative participation of each stock), and truncated matrix reconstructions C^l built from the l largest eigenpairs and normalized to retain a correlation-matrix interpretation. The stability of the resulting clusters is assessed, transition matrices and their stationary vectors are computed, and the inverse participation ratio is used to quantify how participation spreads across assets. The COVID-19 episode emerges as an atypical state in the full correlation matrices; reconstructing it requires more than one principal component, and the C^2 and C^3 constructions reproduce it, particularly for window length q=40 and k=5. During crisis periods the relative participation distributes over a larger number of assets, while the 2017-2018 interval contributes to the dynamics without appearing as an isolated regime. The analysis is descriptive rather than predictive, and provides conceptual and methodological tools relevant to portfolio design and trading strategies, with natural extensions to other international exchanges.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数据分析文章。判断依据：使用k-Means聚类、主成分分析、相关矩阵谱分析等计算统计方法，属于经济物理学的实证数据分析。；研究对象：S&P 500指数中430家公司的日对数收益率，金融市场作为复杂系统，研究其集体动力学与相关矩阵的谱结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: COVID-19时期在完整相关矩阵中表现为非典型状态，需多个主成分才能重构；危机期间股票相对参与度分散到更多资产上，而2017-2018区间虽影响动力学但未形成独立市场状态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：COVID-19时期在完整相关矩阵中表现为非典型状态，需多个主成分才能重构；危机期间股票相对参与度分散到更多资产上，而2017-2018区间虽影响动力学但未形成独立市场状态。；创新点：将市场状态识别与谱量聚类结合，并系统评估聚类稳定性；利用截断矩阵重构（C^2、C^3）揭示COVID-19异常状态的多分量本质。摘要未突出说明与传统经济物理学方法的对比性创新。
papers.method_zh: 滑动窗口构建时间依赖的Pearson相关矩阵；计算前导特征值与特征向量；对最大特征值、主导特征向量平方分量、截断矩阵重构C^l等谱量施加k-Means聚类；计算转移矩阵与平稳向量；使用逆参与率量化参与度分布。

papers.title: Propensity Straight-Through Gradients for Discrete Stochastic Systems
papers.abstract: Continuous-time Markov chains (CTMCs) provide the backbone for modeling discrete stochastic dynamics across applied, physical, and biological sciences. Their integration with modern gradient-based machine learning, however, is limited by the hard categorical event selection intrinsic to Gillespie-type simulation algorithms. We exploit the affine state update to obtain the exact one-step conditional-mean sensitivity by differentiating normalized reaction propensities. We pair this backward rule with exact forward trajectories to define the propensity straight-through (PST) estimator. At the trajectory level, we show that one-step sensitivities composed across events can depart from the exact multistep sensitivity. We derive the resulting per-step discrepancy in closed form and prove that it vanishes identically for affine downstream dependence. PST matches the accuracy of Gumbel-Softmax straight-through across all benchmarks: reversible dimerization (0.06% error), a genetic oscillator (1.7% error), a 50-task repressilator suite (0.17% median error), and patch-clamp ion-channel recordings ($R^2$ = 0.988). Under matched settings, PST converges 3.0-fold faster on the oscillator and 2.1-fold faster on the ion channel. At deep-learning scale, PST trains a 203,796-parameter stochastic reaction network with hard sampling, reaching 98.22% MNIST digit classification accuracy. By differentiating an exact conditional mean rather than a relaxed sample, PST offers a temperature- and Gumbel-free path to scalable gradient-based learning through exact stochastic trajectories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：gradient-based machine learning、estimator、backward rule、trajectory-level analysis、closed-form derivation。；研究对象：离散随机系统，具体为连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）描述的随机化学动力学，包括可逆二聚化、基因振荡器、抑制子（repressilator）套件、离子通道记录，以及一个大规模随机反应网络（用于MNIST分类）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为“倾向直通（PST）”的梯度估计器，通过精确微分归一化反应倾向获得单步条件均值灵敏度，在多个基准上达到与Gumbel-Softmax直通相当的精度，同时收敛速度显著更快（振荡器3.0倍、离子通道2.1倍），并能训练20万参数级随机反应网络达到98.22%的MNIST分类准确率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为“倾向直通（PST）”的梯度估计器，通过精确微分归一化反应倾向获得单步条件均值灵敏度，在多个基准上达到与Gumbel-Softmax直通相当的精度，同时收敛速度显著更快（振荡器3.0倍、离子通道2.1倍），并能训练20万参数级随机反应网络达到98.22%的MNIST分类准确率。；创新点：提出一种无需温度参数、无需Gumbel噪声的梯度估计方案，通过精确条件均值而非松弛样本进行微分，为通过精确随机轨迹进行可扩展的梯度学习提供了新路径。摘要还明确给出了轨迹层面单步灵敏度与精确多步灵敏度偏差的闭式表达式及其消失条件。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值模拟结合。具体包括：利用CTMC的仿射状态更新，对归一化反应倾向求导得到精确的单步条件均值灵敏度；将该反向规则与精确正向轨迹配对构成PST估计器；在轨迹层面推导每步误差的闭式表达式，并证明对仿射下游依赖该误差恒为零；与Gumbel-Softmax直通进行基准对比。

papers.title: Interaction corrections to topological density three-point functions in two-dimensional Fermi liquids: a coadjoint orbit perspective
papers.abstract: Density three-point correlations are known to probe the topology of the Fermi sea in two-dimensional noninteracting systems. Here, we study how these correlations are modified by interactions using the coadjoint-orbit effective field theory. A key advantage of the coadjoint-orbit formulation is that it provides a systematic way to incorporate generalized Landau interactions in terms of bosonized degrees of freedom, mapping fermionic loop contributions onto simpler tree-level diagrams. We show that, for a general isotropic dispersion $ε(p)$, even at linear order in the generalized Landau interaction, $\mathcal{O}(\mathcal{F}^{(2,0)})$, there exists a contribution proportional to the band curvature $ε''(p_F)$ that changes the nonanalytic structure of the free density three-point correlation function. This contribution introduces a distinct nonanalytic structure beyond that found in either the noninteracting case or an interacting Galilean-invariant system, showing that interaction effects can modify the topology-detecting density three-point correlation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“有效场论”“玻色化”“树级图”等理论工具，属于凝聚态理论/场论研究。；研究对象：二维费米液体中的密度三点关联函数，特别是其非解析结构如何受相互作用修正，以及这些修正对费米海拓扑探测的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在一般各向同性色散 ε(p) 下，即使在线性阶广义朗道相互作用 O(𝒪(𝒻⁽²,⁰⁾)) 下，也存在正比于能带曲率 ε″(p_F) 的贡献，会改变自由密度三点关联函数的非解析结构，引入不同于无相互作用或伽利略不变相互作用体系的新非解析行为，表明相互作用可修正用于探测拓扑的密度三点关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在一般各向同性色散 ε(p) 下，即使在线性阶广义朗道相互作用 O(𝒪(𝒻⁽²,⁰⁾)) 下，也存在正比于能带曲率 ε″(p_F) 的贡献，会改变自由密度三点关联函数的非解析结构，引入不同于无相互作用或伽利略不变相互作用体系的新非解析行为，表明相互作用可修正用于探测拓扑的密度三点关联。；创新点：首次在余伴随轨道形式下系统研究相互作用对密度三点关联拓扑探测信号的修正，发现能带曲率项在相互作用线性阶即可引入全新的非解析结构，突破了此前仅考虑无相互作用或伽利略不变情形的局限。
papers.method_zh: 采用余伴随轨道（coadjoint orbit）有效场论框架，将广义朗道相互作用系统地纳入玻色化自由度，将费米子圈贡献映射为更简单的树级图，并针对一般各向同性色散进行解析计算。

papers.title: Layer-Controlled Intermolecular Coupling and Many-Body Effects in C$_{60}$ Films
papers.abstract: Crystalline C$_{60}$ is a molecular solid whose electronic properties emerge from the interplay of intermolecular hopping, electron correlations, and electron-vibration coupling. Unlike moir$\rm\acute{e}$ van der Waals heterostructures, where interaction strength is commonly tuned by twist angle, molecular materials offer a complementary route in which layer number, molecular orientation, and substrate registry provide experimentally accessible control parameters. Here we present a systematic thickness-dependent angle-resolved photoemission study of C$_{60}$ films, spanning the monolayer to the bulk limit. The HOMO-derived band exhibits a non-monotonic evolution: the intermediate-thickness film shows larger bandwidth, reduced effective mass, and pronounced gap-like and sub-band features. The experimental trends, together with Holstein-model simulations, point to strengthened effective intermolecular electronic coupling and enhanced electron-phonon-induced spectral renormalization in the intermediate-thickness regime. These results identify a dimensional crossover in C$_{60}$ films and establish layer number as an effective knob for engineering electronic structure and many-body interactions in molecular thin films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合理论模拟）。关键词：角度分辨光电子能谱（angle-resolved photoemission）、Holstein模型模拟。；研究对象：C₆₀分子晶体薄膜，具体研究其从单层到体相极限的厚度依赖电子结构，以及层数调控的分子间耦合与多体效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: C₆₀薄膜的HOMO衍生能带随厚度呈非单调演化：中等厚度薄膜表现出更大的带宽、更小的有效质量，以及明显的类能隙和子带特征，表明该厚度区间存在增强的有效分子间电子耦合和电子-声子诱导的谱重整化，即维度交叉行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：C₆₀薄膜的HOMO衍生能带随厚度呈非单调演化：中等厚度薄膜表现出更大的带宽、更小的有效质量，以及明显的类能隙和子带特征，表明该厚度区间存在增强的有效分子间电子耦合和电子-声子诱导的谱重整化，即维度交叉行为。；创新点：不同于传统扭转角调控莫尔范德华异质结，该工作提出并验证了层数作为独立调控旋钮，用于工程化分子薄膜的电子结构和多体相互作用，并首次在C₆₀薄膜中识别出维度交叉现象。
papers.method_zh: 系统厚度依赖的角度分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）实验，覆盖从单层到体相极限；结合Holstein模型进行理论模拟以解释实验趋势。

papers.title: Solvable relaxation in discrete unitary systems: Ruelle-Pollicott resonances and CMV matrices
papers.abstract: Leading eigenvalues of the truncated propagator, known as Ruelle-Pollicott (RP) resonances, are an elegant way of addressing the dynamics of unitary many-body systems. We study unitary propagators in their canonical form, known in the mathematical literature as the CMV matrices, and obtain a number of exact results for RP resonances and the associated norm-diverging eigenvectors. For the simplest CMV class describing a unilateral shift with an impurity, motivated by operator dynamics in dual-unitary circuits, we obtain closed-form results and in particular show that the three independent ways of obtaining RP resonances -- the truncated propagator, analytic continuation of the resolvent, and the rigged Hilbert space approach -- all give the same results. In more realistic CMV matrices, in which shift-like operator dynamics characteristic of chaotic systems is only asymptotic, we rely on the rich theory of orthogonal polynomials on the unit circle and identify two phases. In the first phase, relaxation occurs due to local operators effectively evolving into increasingly nonlocal ones with negligible backflow. Especially interesting is the second phase, which, surprisingly, exhibits faster relaxation because of contributions from the backflow of large operators. Additionally, in the second phase, RP resonances are not equal to the eigenvalues of the truncated propagator, instead, they are ``hidden'' within a ring of ill-conditioned eigenvalues.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“exact results”“analytic continuation”“rigged Hilbert space approach”等纯理论推导关键词，未提及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：离散幺正系统中的弛豫动力学，具体为CMV矩阵（幺正传播子的正则形式）及其对应的Ruelle-Pollicott（RP）共振。物理背景包括dual-unitary电路中的算符动力学，以及更一般的混沌幺正多体系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于最简单的CMV类（带杂质的单侧移位），三种独立方法（截断传播子、解析延拓、rigged Hilbert空间）得到的RP共振完全一致；对于更现实的CMV矩阵，存在两个弛豫相：第一相中弛豫源于局域算符演化为非局域算符且回流可忽略，第二相中由于大算符回流的贡献反而弛豫更快，且此时RP共振不等于截断传播子的本征值，而是“隐藏”在病态本征值环中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于最简单的CMV类（带杂质的单侧移位），三种独立方法（截断传播子、解析延拓、rigged Hilbert空间）得到的RP共振完全一致；对于更现实的CMV矩阵，存在两个弛豫相：第一相中弛豫源于局域算符演化为非局域算符且回流可忽略，第二相中由于大算符回流的贡献反而弛豫更快，且此时RP共振不等于截断传播子的本征值，而是“隐藏”在病态本征值环中。；创新点：首次在CMV矩阵这一幺正系统正则形式中系统性地建立了RP共振的精确可解结果，并揭示了在更一般情形下RP共振与截断传播子本征值不等价的新机制（“隐藏”在病态本征值环中），同时发现了由大算符回流导致的异常加速弛豫相。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：CMV矩阵与正交多项式在单位圆上的理论（OPUC）、Ruelle-Pollicott共振分析、截断传播子本征值方法、预解式解析延拓、rigged Hilbert space方法。针对具体模型（带杂质的单侧移位）给出了闭式解。

papers.title: Super-resolution Control of Two-dimensional Quantum Emitters
papers.abstract: Localized interlayer excitons in semiconducting transition-metal dichalcogenide heterobilayers are quantum emitters with a static electric dipole moment, making them excellent nanoscale charge sensors to probe correlated quantum phases in a proximal layer. These emitters are electrically tunable and inherit spin-valley selection rules, yet their deterministic spatial control remains challenging due to subwavelength confinement. Here, we present a platform that combines cryogenic optical spectroscopy with scanning probe microscopy to investigate trapped interlayer excitons in WSe$_2$/MoSe$_2$ bilayers. By exploiting AFM-based local Stark shift, we achieve super-resolution localization of emitters separated by only a few tens of nanometers and demonstrate deterministic control of individual charge states, including trion formation, opening a path towards coherent inter-dot coupling. Time-resolved measurements reveal tip-induced modification of the electromagnetic vacuum around individual emitters, thus controlling their radiative emission. Our multi-point charge sensing platform with optical readout is particularly well-suited to study fractionalization and anyon dynamics in semiconducting FCIs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“cryogenic optical spectroscopy”“scanning probe microscopy”“AFM-based local Stark shift”“Time-resolved measurements”等实验手段。；研究对象：WSe₂/MoSe₂ 异质双层中的局域层间激子（量子发射体），以及利用其作为纳米尺度电荷传感器探测近邻层中的关联量子相（如分数量子霍尔态）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过原子力显微镜（AFM）针尖诱导的局域斯塔克位移，实现了对间距仅数十纳米的量子发射体的超分辨定位，并能确定性调控单个发射体的电荷态（包括三子形成），同时通过针尖改变局域电磁真空来控制其辐射发射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过原子力显微镜（AFM）针尖诱导的局域斯塔克位移，实现了对间距仅数十纳米的量子发射体的超分辨定位，并能确定性调控单个发射体的电荷态（包括三子形成），同时通过针尖改变局域电磁真空来控制其辐射发射。；创新点：实现了对亚波长尺度下二维量子发射体的确定性空间定位与电荷态操控，并展示了通过针尖调控辐射衰变速率的能力；该多点电荷传感平台特别适用于研究半导体分数量子霍尔态中的分数化现象和任意子动力学。
papers.method_zh: 低温光学光谱与扫描探针显微镜联用平台；基于AFM的局域斯塔克位移实现超分辨定位；时间分辨光学测量研究针尖对电磁真空的调控。

papers.title: A Three-Fluid Model of Dissipation at Surfaces in Superconducting Radiofrequency Cavities
papers.abstract: Experiments on superconducting cavities have found that under large RF fields the quality factor can improve with increasing field amplitude, a so-called ``anti-Q slope.'' We numerically solve the Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations at a superconducting surface in a parallel magnetic field, finding at large fields there are surface quasiparticle states with energies below the bulk superconducting gap that emerge and disappear as the field cycles. Modifying the standard two-fluid model, we introduce a ``three''-fluid model where we partition the normal fluid to consider continuum and surface quasiparticle states separately. We compute dissipation in a semi-classical theory of conductivity, where we provide physical estimates of elastic scattering times of Bogoliubov quasiparticles with point-like impurities having potential strengths informed from complementary \textit{ab initio} calculations of impurities in bulk niobium. We show, in this simple yet effective framework, how the relative scattering rates of surface and continuum quasiparticle states can play a role in producing an anti-Q slope while demonstrating how this model naturally includes a mechanism for turning the anti-Q slope on and off.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“numerically solve the Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations”“semi-classical theory of conductivity”“ab initio calculations”，属于数值求解与理论建模相结合的研究。；研究对象：超导射频腔（SRF cavities）表面在强射频磁场下的耗散行为，具体涉及铌（niobium）超导表面、表面准粒子态、以及“反Q斜率”（anti-Q slope）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强射频场下，超导表面会出现能量低于体超导能隙的表面准粒子态，这些态随场周期出现和消失；通过将正常流体划分为连续态和表面准粒子态两部分的三流体模型，发现表面态与连续态的相对散射率差异可以产生“反Q斜率”效应，且该模型天然包含开启/关闭该效应的机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强射频场下，超导表面会出现能量低于体超导能隙的表面准粒子态，这些态随场周期出现和消失；通过将正常流体划分为连续态和表面准粒子态两部分的三流体模型，发现表面态与连续态的相对散射率差异可以产生“反Q斜率”效应，且该模型天然包含开启/关闭该效应的机制。；创新点：首次将表面准粒子态与连续态在二流体框架中分开处理，提出三流体模型，并揭示表面态与连续态散射率之比是产生“反Q斜率”的关键因素，同时该模型能自然解释该效应的开关机制。
papers.method_zh: 数值求解 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 方程（平行磁场下的超导表面）；修改标准二流体模型，引入“三流体”模型；采用半经典电导理论计算耗散；结合点状杂质弹性散射时间的物理估计，杂质势强度参考铌体材料中杂质的 ab initio 计算结果。

papers.title: Machine learned designs of functional colloidal foldamers
papers.abstract: A protein's function follows from the structure it adopts, and which structure that is depends on the pathway taken. In programmable matter the target is fixed before assembly, and whatever else forms is treated as error. Here we show that pathways themselves form a design space. Using reinforcement learning, we fold model DNA-coated droplet chains into rigid two-dimensional geometries, uncovering two classes of pathways: downhill, in which bonds are only added, and detour, in which bonds are broken and remade before the target is reached: for some the only route that exists. Coarse-graining pathways by interactions gives experimentally realizable protocols. Some produce one geometry, others several: structures sharing a detour route can be cycled between, while those that coexist assemble into superstructures inaccessible to a uniform product. Function emerges from the pathways rather than being designed. Designing the process instead of the components could give colloidal materials that reconfigure and repair themselves on demand.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/模拟文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“using reinforcement learning”（使用强化学习）、“fold model DNA-coated droplet chains”（折叠模型DNA包被液滴链），属于计算模拟研究。；研究对象：DNA包被的液滴链（DNA-coated droplet chains）作为胶体折叠体（colloidal foldamers），研究其折叠路径（pathways）作为设计空间的可能性，以及由此产生的可重构、自修复胶体材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 折叠路径本身构成一个设计空间，可分为“下坡路径”（只添加键）和“绕行路径”（先断键再成键）两类，其中绕行路径是某些目标几何结构的唯一可行路线。功能（如多结构共存、超结构组装、可循环切换）源于路径而非预先设计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：折叠路径本身构成一个设计空间，可分为“下坡路径”（只添加键）和“绕行路径”（先断键再成键）两类，其中绕行路径是某些目标几何结构的唯一可行路线。功能（如多结构共存、超结构组装、可循环切换）源于路径而非预先设计。；创新点：将设计对象从“目标结构”转变为“折叠路径本身”，提出通过设计过程而非组分来实现胶体材料的按需重构与自修复。摘要未突出说明与已有折叠体设计工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 强化学习（reinforcement learning）用于折叠模型DNA包被液滴链；通过相互作用对路径进行粗粒化（coarse-graining）以获得实验上可实现的协议。

papers.title: Switchable chiral antiferromagnetism through nonlinear magnetic susceptibility
papers.abstract: Antiferromagnets (AFM) have attracted considerable attention in recent years because a number of nontrivial, technologically relevant properties associated with time-reversal symmetry (TRS) breaking are discovered in many materials. However, time-reversal (TR) partners of AFM states are generally challenging to be selected deterministically except in a few cases with nonzero net magnetization. Recently, it has been shown that the TR partners of the kagome spin ice ground state in HoAgGe with strictly zero net magnetization can be selected through a nonlinear magnetic susceptibility $χ^{(1)}$. In this work, we generalize this scenario to a broad class of chiral AFM with zero net magnetization but field-switchable ground states through $χ^{(1)}$. After a general discussion of $χ^{(1)}$ and its symmetry constraints, we first present a first-principles formalism for calculating it including both mean-field and self-consistent corrections, and then apply the approach to the noncollinear AFM family Mn$_3X$N ($X=$ Ni, Ag, Ga, Zn, Sn) in the $Γ_{5g}$ phase. An intuitive picture of the origin of $χ^{(1)}$ in similar noncollinear AFM is illustrated using 3-sublattice toy model. The model also predicts a nontrivial temperature dependence of $χ^{(1)}$ due to competitions between the longitudinal and transverse single-spin susceptibilities. Our work shows that nonlinear susceptibility can serve as a general protocol for accessing and switching TR partners in fully compensated AFM.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：first-principles formalism、toy model、mean-field and self-consistent corrections。；研究对象：具有零净磁化强度但可通过非线性磁化率χ^(1)实现场切换的手性反铁磁体；具体材料为Mn₃X N（X = Ni, Ag, Ga, Zn, Sn）家族中的Γ₅g相非共线反铁磁体，以及kagome自旋冰HoAgGe。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非线性磁化率χ^(1)可作为通用协议，在完全补偿（零净磁化）反铁磁体中确定性地选择和切换时间反演（TR）伙伴态，推广了此前仅在HoAgGe中展示的机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非线性磁化率χ^(1)可作为通用协议，在完全补偿（零净磁化）反铁磁体中确定性地选择和切换时间反演（TR）伙伴态，推广了此前仅在HoAgGe中展示的机制。；创新点：将非线性磁化率切换TR伙伴态的机制从特定材料（HoAgGe）推广到一大类零净磁化手性反铁磁体，并给出了第一性原理计算χ^(1)的完整形式体系；玩具模型还揭示了纵向与横向单自旋磁化率竞争导致的χ^(1)非平凡温度依赖。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算框架（包含平均场和自洽修正）用于计算χ^(1)；并构建3-子格玩具模型来直观解释χ^(1)的起源及其温度依赖行为。

papers.title: Hierarchical organization governs nonlinear mechanical reversibility in $ι$-carrageenan gels
papers.abstract: Carrageenan gels are thermoreversible polysaccharide networks whose mechanical properties emerge from ion-mediated helix association, yet how their molecular organization controls nonlinear deformation remains poorly understood. Here, we investigate the temperature-dependent rheology of $ι$-carrageenan gels formed in KCl solutions using linear and nonlinear oscillatory rheology combined with normal-force measurements. $ι$-carrageenan forms homogeneous and mechanically reversible gels whose elastic modulus increases continuously with quench depth. Deep quenches generate pronounced strain stiffening before yielding, associated with the development of internal stresses revealed by negative normal forces. Remarkably, large deformations preserve the small-strain elastic modulus while progressively suppressing strain stiffening, demonstrating a partial mechanical reversibility of the network. We interpret these observations using a hierarchical network picture in which a persistent intermolecular network controls linear elasticity, while a more fragile mesoscale organization enables cooperative alignment and stress amplification under deformation. Our results highlight that nonlinear mechanics of thermoreversible polysaccharide gels are governed not only by molecular connectivity, but also by the reversible formation and eventually destruction of mechanically adaptive hierarchical structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“rheology”（流变学）、“oscillatory rheology”（振荡流变）、“normal-force measurements”（法向力测量）等实验手段。；研究对象：ι-卡拉胶（ι-carrageenan）在KCl溶液中形成的热可逆多糖凝胶，重点研究其层级分子组织对非线性力学响应（应变硬化、屈服、力学可逆性）的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: ι-卡拉胶凝胶的弹性模量随淬火深度增加而连续增大；深淬火产生显著应变硬化并伴随负法向力（内应力发展）。大变形后小应变弹性模量保持不变，但应变硬化被逐步抑制，表明网络具有部分力学可逆性——持久分子间网络控制线性弹性，而更脆弱的介观组织控制非线性协同排列与应力放大。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：ι-卡拉胶凝胶的弹性模量随淬火深度增加而连续增大；深淬火产生显著应变硬化并伴随负法向力（内应力发展）。大变形后小应变弹性模量保持不变，但应变硬化被逐步抑制，表明网络具有部分力学可逆性——持久分子间网络控制线性弹性，而更脆弱的介观组织控制非线性协同排列与应力放大。；创新点：提出层级网络图像（hierarchical network picture）：将线性弹性归因于持久的分子间网络，将非线性应变硬化归因于可逆形成/破坏的介观组织，揭示热可逆多糖凝胶的非线性力学不仅由分子连接性决定，还由力学自适应层级结构的可逆形成与最终破坏所控制。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 线性与非线性振荡流变学（oscillatory rheology）结合法向力测量（normal-force measurements），研究温度依赖的流变行为。

papers.title: Modifying van der Waals Materials via Cavity Vacuum Fluctuations
papers.abstract: In the field of cavity quantum materials, vacuum fluctuations of optical cavities are used for modifying ground-state properties of quantum materials without external driving. Here, one example is the van der Waals (vdW)/dispersion interaction in layered 2D vdW materials, where non-additive long-range correlations can dominate the interlayer binding. While cavity-induced changes of such interactions have been predicted and described using ab initio methods for molecular systems, no efficient description exists yet for extended materials. In this Letter, we close this gap by introducing a periodic formulation of the photon many-body dispersion (pMBD) functional within quantum electrodynamical density-functional theory (QEDFT). Applying this method with efficient $\textbf{q}$-point sampling to bilayer hBN and graphene, we predict cavity-modified stacking, increased equilibrium interlayer distances, and softened layer breathing modes with increasing light-matter coupling strength. Our results establish cavity vacuum fluctuations as a tuning knob for the structural properties of vdW materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：functional、density-functional theory、ab initio、predict。；研究对象：范德华（vdW）层状二维材料，具体为双层六方氮化硼（bilayer hBN）和双层石墨烯（bilayer graphene），研究光学腔真空涨落对其层间结构性质（堆叠、层间距、层呼吸模式）的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着光-物质耦合强度增大，腔真空涨落可改变双层hBN和石墨烯的层间堆叠方式、增大平衡层间距，并软化层呼吸模式，从而将腔真空涨落确立为调控vdW材料结构性质的新手段。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着光-物质耦合强度增大，腔真空涨落可改变双层hBN和石墨烯的层间堆叠方式、增大平衡层间距，并软化层呼吸模式，从而将腔真空涨落确立为调控vdW材料结构性质的新手段。；创新点：首次为扩展材料（而非仅分子体系）提供了腔诱导vdW/色散相互作用的周期性高效描述（pMBD泛函），并预测了腔对实际二维vdW材料结构性质的可调效应。
papers.method_zh: 在量子电动力学密度泛函理论（QEDFT）框架内，引入周期性光子多体色散（pMBD）泛函，并结合高效的$\mathbf{q}$点采样进行第一性原理计算。

papers.title: Automated Dislocation Detection in Electron Channelling Contrast Imaging: A Comparative Study of Rule-Based, Neural Network, and Deep Learning Approaches
papers.abstract: Quantifying threading dislocations in semiconductor materials via electron channelling contrast imaging (ECCI) is heavily bottlenecked by slow manual analysis. This work benchmarks three automated detection pipelines on ECCI micrographs of gallium nitride (GaN) against a statistical ground truth. A classical rule-based computer vision approach proved unreliable due to extensive per-image tuning requirements, while a convolutional neural network (CNN)-based multi-stage classification and locator method achieved 87% accuracy but required significant time for a test image and was less efficient in high-density regions. By contrast, a unified single-stage you only look once (YOLOv8) architecture achieved a counting accuracy of 98.6%, alongside 98.7% precision and 98.7% recall across 7451 dislocations over multiple images, with rapid inference times. Successful deployment of YOLOv8 required addressing two domain-specific machine learning challenges. First, to mitigate the model's scale sensitivity, an adaptive gaussian tile-sizing algorithm was developed to optimise the field of view per image. Second, the deployed confidence threshold (0.025) differed substantially from the suggested inference default value for YOLOv8 (0.25), raising counting accuracy from 90.8% to 99.3% on a subsection of the benchmark image. In this case, low confidence scores represented physical signal strength rather than classification ambiguity. This unified, scale-adaptive approach demonstrates practical viability for high-throughput, quantitative semiconductor defect characterisation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验数据 + 计算方法/机器学习模型开发）。判断依据：使用ECCI实验显微图像作为数据，但核心工作是开发并对比自动化检测算法（规则法、CNN、YOLOv8），属于计算/算法研究。；研究对象：氮化镓（GaN）半导体材料中的穿透位错（threading dislocations），通过电子通道衬度成像（ECCI）显微图进行定量表征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 统一单阶段YOLOv8架构在GaN的ECCI图像位错计数中达到98.6%的计数准确率（7451个位错上精度98.7%、召回率98.7%），显著优于传统规则法（不可靠）和CNN多阶段方法（87%准确率且耗时）；通过自适应高斯分块算法和降低置信度阈值（0.025 vs 默认0.25）解决了尺度敏感性和低置信度物理信号问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：统一单阶段YOLOv8架构在GaN的ECCI图像位错计数中达到98.6%的计数准确率（7451个位错上精度98.7%、召回率98.7%），显著优于传统规则法（不可靠）和CNN多阶段方法（87%准确率且耗时）；通过自适应高斯分块算法和降低置信度阈值（0.025 vs 默认0.25）解决了尺度敏感性和低置信度物理信号问题。；创新点：首次系统对比规则法、CNN与YOLOv8在ECCI位错检测中的性能；提出自适应高斯分块算法解决模型尺度敏感性；发现并合理解释了低置信度阈值（0.025）在此物理场景中的必要性——低置信度代表物理信号强度而非分类模糊性，从而将计数准确率从90.8%提升至99.3%。
papers.method_zh: 对比三种自动化检测管线：①经典规则计算机视觉方法；②基于卷积神经网络（CNN）的多阶段分类与定位方法；③统一单阶段YOLOv8目标检测架构。针对YOLOv8开发了自适应高斯分块算法（优化每幅图像的视野）并调整置信度阈值。以统计真值（statistical ground truth）为基准评估。

papers.title: Wyckoff-Resolved Oxidation-State Atlas and Anion-Conditioned Priors for Materials Discovery
papers.abstract: We introduce a Wyckoff-resolved oxidation-state atlas and assignment utility for probabilityranked, charge-neutral assignment from compositions or Wyckoff grammars. The atlas is constructed from a May 2026 snapshot of 154,879 Materials Project-derived structures by staged exact-neutral enumeration over common and known nonzero oxidation states. The learned prior assigns 106,053 materials in composition mode and 114,403 in Wyckoff mode, compared with a broad MP all-integer possible species count of 108,642. A matched MP baseline requiring at least one charge-neutral assignment with exactly one nonzero integer oxidation state per element contains 89,374 materials; relative to this baseline, composition and Wyckoff modes increase coverage by 18.7% and 28.0%. Of the 14,665 materials recovered only in Wyckoff mode, 99.98% exhibit distinct formal oxidation states for the same element on different site tokens. The CSV/Python workflow provides a reproducible prior for structure decoration, generative crystal models, and symbolic Wyckoff-grammar workflows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数据驱动型文章。判断依据关键词：atlas（数据集）、assignment utility（工具）、Materials Project-derived structures（数据库）、prior（先验模型）、CSV/Python workflow（计算流程）。；研究对象：材料无机晶体结构中的氧化态分配问题，具体针对由Materials Project数据库导出的154,879个结构，涵盖组成（composition）和Wyckoff位点（Wyckoff grammar）两种模式下的电荷中性氧化态赋值。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作构建了一个Wyckoff位点分辨的氧化态图谱及分配工具，相比现有MP基线，在组成模式和Wyckoff模式下分别将可分配材料的覆盖率提升了18.7%和28.0%；在仅Wyckoff模式能恢复的14,665种材料中，99.98%具有同一元素在不同Wyckoff位点上呈现不同形式氧化态的特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作构建了一个Wyckoff位点分辨的氧化态图谱及分配工具，相比现有MP基线，在组成模式和Wyckoff模式下分别将可分配材料的覆盖率提升了18.7%和28.0%；在仅Wyckoff模式能恢复的14,665种材料中，99.98%具有同一元素在不同Wyckoff位点上呈现不同形式氧化态的特征。；创新点：首次将氧化态分配与Wyckoff位点信息显式关联，揭示了同一元素在不同晶体学位点上的氧化态分化现象，并提供了可嵌入生成式晶体模型和符号Wyckoff语法工作流的可复现先验工具。摘要未突出说明与传统氧化态分配方法（如键价和法）的具体性能对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用分阶段精确电中性枚举（staged exact-neutral enumeration）方法，基于2026年5月的Materials Project数据快照（154,879个结构），对常见及已知非零氧化态进行穷举匹配，构建概率排序的氧化态先验模型，并提供CSV/Python工作流用于可复现的分配。

papers.title: Gauge invariance, collective modes, and the justification of normal-state subtraction in Dirac superconductors
papers.abstract: In Dirac superconductors, the unbounded spectrum of low-energy Dirac models is known to give rise to unphysical interband contributions from deep-lying states to the electromagnetic response. To eliminate these contributions, normal-state subtraction (NSS), in which the normal-state response is subtracted from the superconducting-state response, has been widely employed. However, the relation between NSS and a gauge-invariant electromagnetic response, particularly the role of the vertex correction required by the Ward identity, has remained unclear. In this work, we consider a massive-Dirac model with $s$-wave pairing and analytically investigate the electromagnetic response at zero temperature by solving the Bethe--Salpeter equation and incorporating the collective-mode contribution to the electromagnetic vertex. We show that, in the static long-wavelength limit, the vertex correction exactly cancels the bare longitudinal response with NSS, yielding the vanishing longitudinal response required by gauge invariance. In contrast, the transverse component of the vertex correction vanishes in the long-wavelength limit, so that the gauge-invariant Meissner weight coincides with that obtained from the bare transverse response with NSS. Moreover, within the class of isotropic and analytic UV regularization terms, we show that gauge invariance uniquely fixes the regularization term in the static long-wavelength limit to the value prescribed by NSS. Our results thus provide a microscopic justification for NSS.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytically investigate、solving the Bethe–Salpeter equation、gauge invariance、vertex correction。；研究对象：具有s波配对的massive-Dirac超导体（Dirac超导体）中的电磁响应，特别是正常态扣除（NSS）方案与规范不变性之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在静态长波极限下，顶点修正恰好抵消了带NSS的裸纵向响应，从而给出规范不变所要求的零纵向响应；而横向分量在长波极限下为零，因此规范不变的Meissner权重与带NSS的裸横向响应一致。此外，在各向同性且解析的UV正则化项类别中，规范不变性唯一地将静态长波极限下的正则化项固定为NSS所规定的值，从而为NSS提供了微观依据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在静态长波极限下，顶点修正恰好抵消了带NSS的裸纵向响应，从而给出规范不变所要求的零纵向响应；而横向分量在长波极限下为零，因此规范不变的Meissner权重与带NSS的裸横向响应一致。此外，在各向同性且解析的UV正则化项类别中，规范不变性唯一地将静态长波极限下的正则化项固定为NSS所规定的值，从而为NSS提供了微观依据。；创新点：首次明确建立了NSS与规范不变电磁响应之间的严格联系，证明顶点修正在纵向和横向通道中的不同行为分别决定了NSS的适用性，并通过规范不变性唯一确定了UV正则化项的形式，为NSS提供了微观理论基础。
papers.method_zh: 解析求解Bethe–Salpeter方程，将集体模贡献纳入电磁顶点，在零温下对massive-Dirac模型（含s波配对）的电磁响应进行解析计算，并分析Ward恒等式所要求的顶点修正。

papers.title: ScatterWorks: A Python package for building and solving scattering network models
papers.abstract: Network models provide an efficient framework for studying non-interacting transport and wave-propagation phenomena in disordered and topological systems. We introduce ScatterWorks, an open-source Python package for building and solving network models. The package uses a compact network representation with composable transformation operations (tile, cut, relink, and union) to enable flexible construction of periodic and finite networks. Local scattering matrices on nodes can be assigned by node labels or explicit indexing, assembled into global scattering equations, and used to compute quasienergies and transport observables. The package supports sparse scattering matrices, allowing transport observables to be evaluated with Schur-based solvers. We demonstrate the package workflow on a symbolic Fabry-Perot interferometer and a numerical Chalker-Coddington model, recovering analytical expressions and the expected near-critical transport behavior of the quantum Hall transition. Plotting utilities with label-aware rendering are included to streamline debugging and reproducible setup for larger, custom network geometries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/软件工具开发文章。关键词：Python package、building and solving、numerical model。；研究对象：无序与拓扑系统中的非相互作用输运和波传播现象，具体演示了Fabry-Perot干涉仪和Chalker-Coddington模型（量子霍尔转变）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该软件包能够灵活构建周期性和有限尺寸网络模型，并准确恢复解析表达式及量子霍尔转变的近临界输运行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该软件包能够灵活构建周期性和有限尺寸网络模型，并准确恢复解析表达式及量子霍尔转变的近临界输运行为。；创新点：提供了紧凑的网络表示和可组合的几何操作，支持稀疏矩阵与Schur求解器，并包含标签感知的绘图工具，便于大型自定义网络几何的调试和可重复搭建。
papers.method_zh: 开发了开源Python包ScatterWorks，采用可组合的变换操作（tile、cut、relink、union）构建网络，通过节点标签或显式索引分配局部散射矩阵，组装全局散射方程，并使用基于Schur分解的求解器处理稀疏散射矩阵以计算准能量和输运观测量。

papers.title: Magnonic Combinatorial Memory based on a network of coupled active ring circuits
papers.abstract: Magnonic Combinatorial Memory (MCM) is a type of memory where the bits of information are encoded in the signal propagation paths in the network. In this work, we consider MCM based on the network of a coupled active ring circuit (ARC). Each circuit includes a broadband amplifier, a magnonic delay line, an adjustable frequency filter, an adjustable phase shifter, and a power detector. The coupling between the circuits is via spin waves propagating in the common delay line - ferrite film. There may or may not be auto-oscillations in the active ring circuits, depending on the combination of circuit parameters and circuit coupling. The address of MCM is defined as the combination of the states of the phase shifters and frequency filters, while the MCM state is defined as the presence/absence of the auto-oscillations. The coupling between the circuits is achieved by placing micromagnets on top of the ferrite film. The number of bits that can be encoded in the network increases quadratically with the number of coupled circuits. This scaling provides a fundamental advantage over conventional memory. We present experimental data obtained for three magnonic ARCs connected via a single-crystal yttrium iron garnet Y3Fe2(FeO4)3 (YIG) film. The data illustrate an example of encoding a 27-bit binary response pattern, corresponding to the 27 experimentally accessible phase combinations. The results demonstrate a robust operation of MCM with an On/Off ratio exceeding 30 dB at room temperature. The advantages and shortcomings of the proposed approach are discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“We present experimental data obtained for three magnonic ARCs”，并给出了室温下的On/Off比等实测结果。；研究对象：基于耦合有源环形电路（ARC）网络的Magnonic Combinatorial Memory（MCM），其中每个ARC包含宽带放大器、磁振子延迟线、可调频率滤波器、可调移相器和功率探测器，耦合通过共用延迟线（单晶钇铁石榴石YIG薄膜）中的自旋波实现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过三个磁振子ARC网络，成功实现了27位二进制响应模式的编码，室温下On/Off比超过30 dB，验证了MCM的稳健工作；且网络可编码的比特数随耦合电路数量呈二次方增长，优于传统存储器。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过三个磁振子ARC网络，成功实现了27位二进制响应模式的编码，室温下On/Off比超过30 dB，验证了MCM的稳健工作；且网络可编码的比特数随耦合电路数量呈二次方增长，优于传统存储器。；创新点：提出并实验验证了基于耦合有源环形电路网络的磁振子组合存储器（MCM），其编码容量随电路数量呈二次方增长，这一扩展性优势是相对传统存储器的根本性改进。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验构建了三个通过单晶YIG薄膜耦合的磁振子ARC网络；每个电路包含宽带放大器、磁振子延迟线、可调频率滤波器、可调移相器和功率探测器；耦合通过在YIG薄膜上放置微磁体实现；通过组合移相器和频率滤波器的状态定义MCM地址，以自激振荡的有无定义MCM状态，测量了27种相位组合对应的二进制响应模式。

papers.title: Quantum transport and unified scaling law in graphene with polyadic Cantor electrostatic barriers
papers.abstract: We study the quantum transport of Dirac electrons in graphene subjected to a polyadic Cantor-structured electrostatic potential. Using the superperiodic potential formalism, we obtain a closed-form expression for the transmission probability. As the Cantor stage increases, the transmission spectrum evolves from a sparse set of superlattice resonances to a near-transparent regime, with the polyadic order setting the rate of this evolution. The angular response depends on the doping configuration, showing distinct behavior in the $n$--$n$--$n$, $n$--$p$--$n$, and Dirac-point cases. In the near-transparent regime, the transmission follows double-logarithmic scaling laws with respect to four independent control parameters: the Cantor stage, the potential height, the initiator length, and the angle of incidence. By combining these individual scaling relations, we establish a unified scaling law governing quantum transport. These results show that the hierarchical self-similarity of the potential governs the transport properties of such systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We study”“formalism”“obtain a closed-form expression”等理论推导关键词，未涉及实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：石墨烯中受polyadic Cantor静电势调制的狄拉克电子量子输运，具体为Cantor分形静电势垒结构下的透射行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着Cantor级数增加，透射谱从稀疏超晶格共振演化为近透明区；在近透明区，透射率对四个独立控制参数（Cantor级数、势垒高度、初始长度、入射角）分别满足双对数标度律，并可统一为一个标度律，表明势垒的分形自相似性主导输运性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着Cantor级数增加，透射谱从稀疏超晶格共振演化为近透明区；在近透明区，透射率对四个独立控制参数（Cantor级数、势垒高度、初始长度、入射角）分别满足双对数标度律，并可统一为一个标度律，表明势垒的分形自相似性主导输运性质。；创新点：首次将polyadic Cantor分形势垒应用于石墨烯量子输运，并建立涵盖四个独立控制参数的双对数标度律及统一标度律，揭示分形层级自相似性对输运的调控作用。
papers.method_zh: 采用超周期势形式化方法（superperiodic potential formalism），推导出透射概率的闭式解析表达式，并分析不同掺杂构型（n–n–n、n–p–n、Dirac点）下的角度响应与标度行为。

papers.title: Electrically Tunable Two-Component Exciton Condensate in a Coulomb-Coupled Graphene Trilayer
papers.abstract: Multicomponent condensates possess internal phase degrees of freedom unavailable to a single-component condensate, yet their components are rarely controllable in solids. Here we realize a graphene trilayer with negligible interlayer tunnelling in which the layer-specific carrier densities are continuously tuned by electrostatic gating. Quantum-capacitance measurements demonstrate that charge-incompressible quantum Hall states at total filling factors 1 and 2 persist across the full range of layer-filling configurations and continuously connect the three bilayer exciton-condensate limits. This persistence provides evidence for a trilayer excitonic state. Static Hartree-Fock and time-dependent Hartree-Fock calculations yield two independent finite phase-stiffness eigenmodes and two linearly dispersing Goldstone modes, respectively, when all three layers are partially filled, whereas only one phase-stiffness eigenmode and one linear Goldstone mode remain when one layer is unfilled. The stiffness eigenmodes rotate continuously between the two adjacent-layer exciton bases as charge is transferred among the layers, revealing electrical control of the condensate-mode composition. Together, the experimental and theoretical results support the identification of a two-component exciton condensate with a continuously tunable internal structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“Quantum-capacitance measurements”（实验测量）和“Static Hartree-Fock and time-dependent Hartree-Fock calculations”（理论计算）。；研究对象：库仑耦合的石墨烯三层结构（Coulomb-coupled graphene trilayer），具体研究其中由层间库仑相互作用驱动的多组分激子凝聚（multicomponent exciton condensate）及其电学调控行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在层间隧穿可忽略的石墨烯三层中，总填充因子为1和2的电荷不可压缩量子霍尔态在所有层填充构型下持续存在，并连续连接三个双层激子凝聚极限，表明形成了三层的双组分激子凝聚态；理论计算进一步揭示该凝聚体具有两个独立的相位刚度本征模和两支线性色散的Goldstone模，且其模组成可通过静电门控连续旋转调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在层间隧穿可忽略的石墨烯三层中，总填充因子为1和2的电荷不可压缩量子霍尔态在所有层填充构型下持续存在，并连续连接三个双层激子凝聚极限，表明形成了三层的双组分激子凝聚态；理论计算进一步揭示该凝聚体具有两个独立的相位刚度本征模和两支线性色散的Goldstone模，且其模组成可通过静电门控连续旋转调控。；创新点：首次在固体中实现了组分可连续电学调控的多组分激子凝聚体——通过静电门控在层间转移电荷，使凝聚体的内部相位模式（刚度本征模）在相邻层激子基矢之间连续旋转，实现了对凝聚体内部结构的原位电学控制。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用静电门控连续调节各层载流子密度，并进行量子电容（quantum-capacitance）测量以探测电荷不可压缩态；理论上采用静态Hartree-Fock（计算相位刚度本征模）和含时Hartree-Fock（计算Goldstone模色散）方法。

papers.title: Nonholonomic collective flows: velocity--orientation locking in a continuum with microstructure
papers.abstract: We develop a continuum theory for a fluid of elongated particles that advance along their own axes. The same kinematics is ideally shared by flocks of sheep, self-propelled rods, vehicular traffic, and turning flocks of birds. Within the framework of continua with vectorial microstructure, in which each point also carries an orientation, we impose the no-side-slip (skate) condition $\vv=u\,\nn$ as an ideal, non-integrable internal constraint. We derive the pure equations of motion and the equation governing the constraint reaction from the principle of virtual power. Using a constitutive closure provided by the Ericksen-Leslie theory of nematic liquid crystals, we show how the constraint also shapes collective effects. It turns parabolic orientational diffusion into hyperbolic orientation-density waves and forbids any steady simple shear. It fixes the empirical Toner-Tu convective coefficient to the flow-alignment ratio measured in colloidal rollers, thereby providing a mechanical foundation for angular sound in micropolar active hydrodynamics. It also recovers the inertial spin model of bird flocks, with the addition of a banking force and a turn-density coupling. Finally, it recovers the classical macroscopic models of one-dimensional traffic flow, while describing steering, lateral tyre forces, and road geometry in two dimensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“develop a continuum theory”“derive the pure equations of motion”“principle of virtual power”等理论推导关键词。；研究对象：具有矢量微结构的连续介质——具体为沿自身轴向运动的细长粒子流体（如羊群、自驱动杆、车辆交通、转向鸟群），并施加无侧滑（滑冰）约束的动力学体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 无侧滑约束将抛物型取向扩散转变为双曲型取向-密度波，禁止稳态简单剪切；同时将Toner-Tu对流系数固定为流动取向比，为微极性活性流体中的角声学提供力学基础，并统一了鸟群惯性自旋模型与一维交通流模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：无侧滑约束将抛物型取向扩散转变为双曲型取向-密度波，禁止稳态简单剪切；同时将Toner-Tu对流系数固定为流动取向比，为微极性活性流体中的角声学提供力学基础，并统一了鸟群惯性自旋模型与一维交通流模型。；创新点：将非完整约束（滑冰条件）引入连续介质力学，统一解释了从活性向列流体、鸟群到交通流的多类集体动力学现象，并为Toner-Tu系数和角声学提供了微观力学起源。摘要未突出说明与已有非完整动力学连续介质理论的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 基于矢量微结构连续介质力学框架，将无侧滑条件作为理想非完整内约束，利用虚功率原理推导纯运动方程与约束反力方程；采用Ericksen-Leslie向列液晶本构理论进行闭合。

papers.title: Topological Signatures of Hardness and Structural Order in Network-Forming Materials
papers.abstract: Understanding how the topology of network forming materials influences their physical properties remains a longstanding challenge. Here, we investigate the topology of experimentally compatible atomistic models of amorphous silica together with the crystalline polymorphs cristobalite and quartz. By comparing multiple atomistic models of amorphous silica that equally reproduce neutron-scattering data, we show that different microscopic descriptions can imply different topological interpretations of glass stability. To characterize the network beyond conventional geometric descriptors, we introduce the linking valence, which quantifies the average number of topological links per network loop. This topological descriptor separates silica into two distinct classes: the mechanically harder quartz exhibit values more than an order of magnitude larger than those of amorphous silica and cristobalite, despite their common tetrahedral building blocks. Spectral analysis of the loop-linking networks provides a complementary distinction, separating amorphous from crystalline phases and revealing differences in the long-range organization of topological constraints. These results establish topological linking as a new framework for connecting the structure and physical properties of network-forming materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“atomistic models”（原子模型）、“topological descriptor”（拓扑描述符）、“spectral analysis”（谱分析），未涉及实验测量手段。；研究对象：网络形成材料（network-forming materials）的拓扑结构与物理性质关系，具体体系包括非晶二氧化硅（amorphous silica）的多种原子模型，以及晶体多形体方石英（cristobalite）和石英（quartz）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 引入“连接价”（linking valence）这一拓扑描述符，可区分二氧化硅的不同相：机械上更硬的石英其连接价数值比非晶二氧化硅和方石英高出一个数量级以上，尽管三者具有相同的四面体结构单元。此外，环连接网络的谱分析可区分非晶与晶相，揭示拓扑约束的长程组织差异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：引入“连接价”（linking valence）这一拓扑描述符，可区分二氧化硅的不同相：机械上更硬的石英其连接价数值比非晶二氧化硅和方石英高出一个数量级以上，尽管三者具有相同的四面体结构单元。此外，环连接网络的谱分析可区分非晶与晶相，揭示拓扑约束的长程组织差异。；创新点：首次将拓扑链接（topological linking）作为连接网络形成材料结构与物理性质的新框架，超越了传统几何描述符（如键角、环分布等），并揭示了不同微观模型对玻璃稳定性的拓扑解释可能不同。
papers.method_zh: 对实验兼容的非晶二氧化硅原子模型（能复现中子散射数据）与晶体多形体进行拓扑分析；引入“连接价”量化每个网络环的平均拓扑连接数；对环连接网络进行谱分析（spectral analysis）。

papers.title: Crystal-phase quantum dots in AlGaAs nanowires
papers.abstract: Crystal-phase quantum dots (CPQDs)$\unicode{x2014}$quantum dots in nanowires defined by crystal structure rather than material composition$\unicode{x2014}$constitute the only platform capable of fabricating quantum-dot arrays with the ultimate precision of a single atomic layer. This intrinsic control yields perfectly aligned quantum dots with atomically sharp interfaces, providing a unique pathway toward scalable quantum-dot-based photonic quantum technologies. To date, CPQDs have been studied primarily in binary semiconductors, such as InP and GaAs, where their emission linewidths are typically in the meV range, thereby limiting their technological potential. Here, we report, for the first time, CPQDs in AlGaAs nanowires and show bright single-photon emission with linewidths as narrow as 61 $μeV$ and low background emission, demonstrating optical quality well beyond typical CPQDs. We attribute this performance to a type-I band alignment, as suggested by an exciton lifetime of 1 ns, significantly shorter than that typically observed in type-II CPQDs. Additionally, we observe an exciton fine-structure splitting and a Zeeman splitting, as commonly observed in standard type-I self-assembled quantum dots.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了实际观测到的单光子发射、线宽、激子寿命、精细结构劈裂和塞曼劈裂等实验数据。；研究对象：AlGaAs纳米线中的晶相量子点（CPQDs），即由晶体结构而非材料组分定义的量子点，属于III-V族半导体纳米线体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次在AlGaAs纳米线中实现晶相量子点，展现出窄至61 μeV的线宽和低背景发射的明亮单光子发射，光学质量远超典型的二元半导体CPQDs；其激子寿命约1 ns，表明为I型能带对齐。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次在AlGaAs纳米线中实现晶相量子点，展现出窄至61 μeV的线宽和低背景发射的明亮单光子发射，光学质量远超典型的二元半导体CPQDs；其激子寿命约1 ns，表明为I型能带对齐。；创新点：首次将晶相量子点平台从二元半导体（如InP、GaAs）拓展至三元合金AlGaAs，并实现远超传统CPQDs的光学质量（线宽61 μeV），且通过I型能带对齐和激子精细结构/塞曼劈裂的观测，证明其行为接近标准I型自组装量子点，为可扩展光子量子技术提供了新路径。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体生长和表征手段，但结合内容可推断涉及纳米线外延生长（如分子束外延或VLS机制）、微区光致发光光谱（用于测量线宽和单光子发射）、时间分辨荧光（用于测量激子寿命）、以及磁场下的偏振分辨光谱（用于观测塞曼劈裂）。摘要未明确说明具体仪器名称。

papers.title: Work Function and High-Coverage Adsorption Energy as Hydrogen-Evolution Descriptors on Ag-Au-Pd-Pt Alloys
papers.abstract: Hydrogen-evolution activity is commonly rationalized through hydrogen adsorption energies and the Sabatier principle, yet this descriptor picture becomes ambiguous on multimetallic surfaces, where each composition exposes a distribution of local adsorption environments. Here we investigate whether the bare-surface work function, previously shown to add predictive information for monometallic surfaces, remains an activity descriptor for compositionally complex surfaces. We test this on three combinatorial Ag-Au-Pd-Pt thin-film materials libraries screened for acidic hydrogen evolution by scanning electrochemical cell microscopy. Graph neural networks provide adsorption-energy distributions and work functions for each measured composition. A work-function-only model explained most of the activity variation (mean $R^2_\mathrm{log}$ = 0.903), as did a coverage-corrected adsorption model (mean $R^2_\mathrm{log}$ = 0.955), outperforming dilute adsorption (mean $R^2_\mathrm{log}$ = 0.758). Combining work function and coverage-corrected adsorption yielded the highest fit quality (mean $R^2_\mathrm{log}$ = 0.969), but only a small gain over coverage-corrected adsorption alone. For these four metals the coverage-corrected adsorption energy and work function follow a similar trend, producing similar activity rankings, hence including both adds little beyond either one individually, although both are strong predictors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要提及“combinatorial thin-film materials libraries screened by scanning electrochemical cell microscopy”（实验筛选）以及“Graph neural networks provide adsorption-energy distributions and work functions”（图神经网络计算）。；研究对象：Ag-Au-Pd-Pt 四元合金薄膜表面，具体研究其酸性析氢反应（hydrogen evolution reaction, HER）活性与表面功函数、氢吸附能之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 裸表面功函数和覆盖度修正的氢吸附能均可作为复杂合金表面析氢活性的强描述符（单独使用平均 R²_log 分别为 0.903 和 0.955），两者结合时拟合质量最高（平均 R²_log = 0.969），但相比仅用覆盖度修正吸附能提升很小，因为这两种描述符在四种金属中趋势相似。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：裸表面功函数和覆盖度修正的氢吸附能均可作为复杂合金表面析氢活性的强描述符（单独使用平均 R²_log 分别为 0.903 和 0.955），两者结合时拟合质量最高（平均 R²_log = 0.969），但相比仅用覆盖度修正吸附能提升很小，因为这两种描述符在四种金属中趋势相似。；创新点：首次系统检验了裸表面功函数作为成分复杂（多组分）合金表面的析氢活性描述符的有效性，并定量比较了功函数与覆盖度修正吸附能的预测能力，发现两者在Ag-Au-Pd-Pt体系中高度相关，可互为替代。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用扫描电化学池显微镜（SECCM）对组合材料库进行酸性析氢活性筛选；计算上使用图神经网络（GNN）预测各成分的吸附能分布和功函数，并比较了三种描述符模型：仅功函数、稀释吸附能、覆盖度修正吸附能，以及功函数与覆盖度修正吸附能的组合。

papers.title: Evidence for Three-component Interlayer Coherent Exciton Condensation
papers.abstract: Increasing the number of internal components in a quantum many-body system can host collective orders inaccessible to simpler settings. Quantum Hall bilayers provide a canonical realization of interlayer exciton condensation, yet extending such coherence across three independently addressable electronic fluids has remained elusive. Here we report evidence for three-component interlayer coherent exciton condensation in triple-layer graphene system. Using Rydberg excitons in an adjacent WSe2 monolayer as a layer-sensitive optical probe, we resolve interaction-induced incompressibility at zeroth-Landau-level crossings for all three pairwise layer combinations, establishing top-middle, middle-bottom and top-bottom exciton condensate channels within the same device. Independent control of displacement field and interlayer bias continuously tunes these pairwise states towards a regime where Landau levels from all three layers approach simultaneous degeneracy. At their convergence, incompressibility persists while the exciton energy and spectral weight evolve smoothly between the pairwise limits, suggesting coherent participation of all three layers in a single three-component state. More broadly, the ability to independently control layer potentials and engineer interlayer interactions establishes multilayer graphene as a programmable synthetic dimension for exploring higher-component quantum Hall order and simulating strongly correlated quantum matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“Here we report evidence for...”（报告证据）、“Using Rydberg excitons... as a layer-sensitive optical probe”（使用光学探针）以及“we resolve...”（我们分辨出）等表述，均为实验观测语言。；研究对象：三层石墨烯体系中的三组分层间相干激子凝聚（three-component interlayer coherent exciton condensation）。具体体系为三层石墨烯（triple-layer graphene）与相邻的单层WSe2构成的异质结，物理现象为量子霍尔双层体系中激子凝聚向三组分（三层）体系的扩展。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三层石墨烯体系中观测到了三组分层间相干激子凝聚的证据：在零朗道能级交叉处，所有三对层组合（顶-中、中-底、顶-底）均表现出相互作用诱导的不可压缩性，且当三层朗道能级接近同时简并时，不可压缩性持续存在，激子能量和谱权重在成对极限之间平滑演化，表明三个层共同参与形成单一的三组分相干态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三层石墨烯体系中观测到了三组分层间相干激子凝聚的证据：在零朗道能级交叉处，所有三对层组合（顶-中、中-底、顶-底）均表现出相互作用诱导的不可压缩性，且当三层朗道能级接近同时简并时，不可压缩性持续存在，激子能量和谱权重在成对极限之间平滑演化，表明三个层共同参与形成单一的三组分相干态。；创新点：首次将层间激子凝聚从双组分（双层）体系扩展至三组分（三层）体系，在同一个器件中同时建立了三对成对激子凝聚通道，并展示了通过独立调控层电势将三层引导至同时简并、形成单一三组分相干态的能力。摘要未突出说明与理论预测的定量对比或具体凝聚序参量的直接测量。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段为光学探测：利用相邻WSe2单层中的里德堡激子（Rydberg excitons）作为层敏感的光学探针，通过测量激子能量和谱权重来分辨各层组合的相互作用诱导不可压缩性。通过独立控制位移场（displacement field）和层间偏压（interlayer bias）来连续调谐层间耦合条件。

papers.title: Nucleation and propagation of brittle fracture as a constrained energy minimization problem
papers.abstract: This paper presents a macroscopic, or continuum, theory aimed at describing when, where, and why cracks nucleate and propagate in nominally elastic brittle materials under monotonic, quasi-static, but otherwise arbitrary mechanical loads. Motivated by recent insights, the proposed sharp theory posits that: \emph{cracks nucleate and propagate exclusively in regions where the strength surface of the material is exceeded, with their evolution dictated by the minimization of the sum of the potential --- the elastic energy minus the work done by the externally applied forces --- and surface energies.} While the theory applies to materials with any elasticity (linear or nonlinear) and any material symmetry (isotropic or anisotropic), attention is restricted here to the most basic case of isotropic elastic brittle materials. For demonstration purposes, the theory is confronted with a set of nine tests that span the entire range of well-settled experimental knowledge on fracture nucleation and propagation --- the so-called ``Nine Circles of Elastic Brittle Fracture'' --- on both a hard material (a silicate glass) and a soft material (a synthetic rubber).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：macroscopic/continuum theory、sharp theory、constrained energy minimization problem。；研究对象：名义弹性脆性材料（elastic brittle materials）中裂纹的成核与扩展行为，具体涵盖硬材料（硅酸盐玻璃）和软材料（合成橡胶）两类体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 裂纹仅在材料强度面（strength surface）被超过的区域成核和扩展，其演化由势能（弹性能减去外力功）与表面能之和的最小化所决定。该理论在九个覆盖断裂成核与扩展实验知识的基准测试（“弹性脆性断裂的九个圆环”）中均与实验吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：裂纹仅在材料强度面（strength surface）被超过的区域成核和扩展，其演化由势能（弹性能减去外力功）与表面能之和的最小化所决定。该理论在九个覆盖断裂成核与扩展实验知识的基准测试（“弹性脆性断裂的九个圆环”）中均与实验吻合。；创新点：将裂纹成核与扩展统一纳入“强度面超限 + 能量最小化”的约束变分框架，形成尖锐（sharp）的连续介质理论，而非传统的相场或内聚区模型；且同时适用于硬材料和软材料。摘要未突出说明与具体数值实现方法的对比。
papers.method_zh: 提出一个宏观连续介质理论框架，适用于任意弹性（线性或非线性）和任意材料对称性（各向同性或各向异性），但本文具体限制在各向同性弹性脆性材料情形。通过九个基准测试与已有实验知识进行对比验证。

papers.title: A Generalized Model for Disordered Random Sequential Adsorption with Charge-Dependent Deposition
papers.abstract: We generalize a one-dimensional random sequential adsorption model (RSA) of charged unit segments in which the deposition position follows a beta kernel determined by the charges bounding the available gap and those of the incoming particle. The interaction parameter \(0\leqλ<1\) interpolates between uniform car parking and strongly localized deposition. We derive a four component generating function equation that provides exact recursions for the complete occupation statistics, although only the mean and variance are analyzed in detail here. Exact finite-shell solutions serve as benchmarks for the Gauss--Jacobi quadrature and Monte Carlo simulations. We prove that, although boundary charges affect finite size behavior, the four boundary states have the same asymptotic mean and variance densities, consequently, we prove that the jammed density is self-averaging. Numerical results show that charge selectivity increases the coverage, especially for mixtures dominated by opposite endpoint charges, which also exhibit strongly reduced fluctuations near \(λ=1\). The model provides a tractable connection between uniform RSA, dynamically generated disorder, and interaction-driven deposition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“generating function equation”“exact recursions”“Gauss–Jacobi quadrature”“Monte Carlo simulations”等理论推导与数值模拟方法，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：一维带电单元段的随机顺序吸附（RSA）模型，其中沉积位置由间隙两端电荷与入射粒子电荷共同决定的beta核控制，属于无序与相互作用驱动的沉积物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电荷选择性可提高沉积覆盖率，尤其在由相反端点电荷主导的混合物中，且在λ接近1时涨落显著降低；同时证明了四种边界态具有相同的渐近平均与方差密度，即堵塞密度是自平均的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电荷选择性可提高沉积覆盖率，尤其在由相反端点电荷主导的混合物中，且在λ接近1时涨落显著降低；同时证明了四种边界态具有相同的渐近平均与方差密度，即堵塞密度是自平均的。；创新点：将均匀停车问题、动态生成的无序与相互作用驱动的沉积统一在一个可解模型中，并严格证明了堵塞密度的自平均性质（摘要未突出说明其他创新点）。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：四组分生成函数方程，给出完整占据统计的精确递推关系；数值方法：Gauss–Jacobi求积与蒙特卡洛模拟；并利用精确有限壳层解作为基准验证。

papers.title: Phenomenological Growth Regimes in Liquid-Precursor CVD of MoS$_2$ on Functional Substrates
papers.abstract: The integration of two-dimensional transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) onto functional substrates remains constrained by stochastic vapor-phase growth dynamics. Here, we show that liquid-phase precursor chemical vapor deposition (CVD) of MoS$_2$ introduces growth conditions that are consistent with a substrate-influenced reaction-diffusion process. By utilizing pre-growth spin-coated MoO$_3$ intermediates across a diverse crystalline library (sapphire, SrTiO$_3$, rutile TiO$_2$, MgO, and 6H-SiC), we find that substrate-dependent variations in precursor wetting, surface chemistry, and inferred mass-transport constraints correlate with distinct growth morphologies. These substrate-dependent growth regimes are interpreted in terms of reduced effective lateral growth length on SrTiO$_3$, possible precursor anchoring on TiO$_2$, likely chemical surface restructuring on MgO, and possible step-edge growth on SiC. Raman and photoluminescence spectroscopy reveal substrate-dependent variations in vibrational and optical response that correlate with differences in strain, charge environment, and dielectric screening. Ultimately, this work highlights a substrate-dependent reaction-diffusion framework as a potentially useful route for tuning the structural and optical properties of large-area 2D materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“利用预生长旋涂MoO₃中间体”“Raman和光致发光光谱”等实验手段。；研究对象：在多种功能衬底（蓝宝石、SrTiO₃、金红石TiO₂、MgO、6H-SiC）上通过液相前驱体化学气相沉积生长的MoS₂二维过渡金属硫化物薄膜，重点研究衬底依赖的生长动力学与结构/光学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MoS₂的液相前驱体CVD生长可被描述为衬底影响的反应-扩散过程，不同衬底上的前驱体润湿性、表面化学和质量输运约束差异导致截然不同的生长形貌，并伴随应变、电荷环境和介电屏蔽相关的光谱响应变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MoS₂的液相前驱体CVD生长可被描述为衬底影响的反应-扩散过程，不同衬底上的前驱体润湿性、表面化学和质量输运约束差异导致截然不同的生长形貌，并伴随应变、电荷环境和介电屏蔽相关的光谱响应变化。；创新点：提出并验证了“衬底依赖的反应-扩散”统一框架，将不同功能衬底上的MoS₂生长形貌差异系统归因于前驱体润湿、锚定、表面重构和台阶边缘效应等具体物理化学机制，为通过衬底选择调控大面积二维材料的结构与光学性质提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 液相前驱体CVD（预生长旋涂MoO₃中间体）；跨衬底晶体库对比实验；Raman光谱和光致发光光谱表征；基于形貌观察推断生长机制（反应-扩散框架分析）。

papers.title: Nanolamellar Hybrid High-Entropy Alloys with Superior Micromechanical Properties
papers.abstract: Metallic materials with nanolamellar structures, such as pearlitic steels, exhibit high strength with appropriate ductility. Considering the potential ability of such nanolamellar structures to break the traditional strength-ductility trade-off in metallic alloys, this study aims at developing a unique nanolamellar structure with superior micromechanical properties by combining two different high-entropy alloys (HEAs). Al0.1CoCrFeNi with the face-centered cubic (FCC) structure is combined with TiZrHfNbTa with the body-centered cubic (BCC) structure using high-pressure torsion (HPT) of half discs of each alloy. That way, a layered hybrid structure was formed, with layer thickness down to about 61 nm. The BCC/FCC nanolamellar hybrid structure exhibits an exceptional combination of properties with an ultimate tensile strength of 2.4 GPa, a maximum bending strength of 4.0 GPa, and a hardness of 740 Hv, while retaining some ductility/plasticity under both tensile and bending loads. Detailed analyses by synchrotron diffraction, electron microscopy and atom probe tomography suggests that these high strength and hardness, which are superior to those of nanostructured HEAs, result from: (i) extreme grain boundary strengthening from nanograins with a mean size of 22 nm, (ii) presence of defects such as dislocations in FCC and BCC, stacking faults in FCC and twins in FCC, and (iii) interphase hardening from BCC/FCC nanolamellar boundaries with about 30% contribution to the total hardness. This work demonstrates that combining two HEAs using HPT into a defect-rich hybrid nanolamellar composite forms a promising synergy of ultrahigh strength and reasonable ductility/plasticity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到使用高圧扭转（HPT）实验制备、同步辐射衍射、电子显微镜、原子探针层析等实验表征手段。；研究对象：由FCC结构Al₀.₁CoCrFeNi高熵合金与BCC结构TiZrHfNbTa高熵合金经高压扭转复合而成的BCC/FCC纳米层状混合高熵合金。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该BCC/FCC纳米层状混合结构实现了超高强度与一定塑性的优异组合：极限拉伸强度2.4 GPa、最大弯曲强度4.0 GPa、硬度740 Hv，同时保持一定的拉伸和弯曲塑性，性能优于纳米结构高熵合金。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该BCC/FCC纳米层状混合结构实现了超高强度与一定塑性的优异组合：极限拉伸强度2.4 GPa、最大弯曲强度4.0 GPa、硬度740 Hv，同时保持一定的拉伸和弯曲塑性，性能优于纳米结构高熵合金。；创新点：首次将两种不同晶体结构（FCC与BCC）的高熵合金通过HPT复合，构建缺陷丰富的纳米层状混合复合材料，利用多种强化机制（晶界强化、缺陷强化、相界强化）协同突破传统强度-塑性权衡。摘要未突出说明与已有纳米层状材料（如珠光体钢）的系统对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用高压扭转（HPT）将两种高熵合金的半圆片复合，形成层厚低至约61 nm的纳米层状混合结构；使用同步辐射衍射、电子显微镜和原子探针层析进行微观结构表征与机理分析。

papers.title: Rapid Charge Stability Diagram Generation from Device-level Modeling of Semiconductor Quantum Dots
papers.abstract: Self-consistent Schrödinger-Poisson calculations are a powerful tool for predicting the behavior of layered semiconductor quantum dot devices. However, characterization of charge stability diagrams through fully simulated gate-voltage sweeps is computationally expensive. Combining a Multi-Domain Multi-Model (MDMM) approach with an automated tuning routine, we identify gate voltages associated with selected charge configurations. This small set of self-consistent simulations can be augmented with Full Configuration Interaction (FCI) energy calculations to extract charging energies, lever arms, and interdot Coulomb interactions to directly parameterize a Hubbard model for rapid charge stability diagram generation. For an Intel Tunnel Falls Si/SiGe device, we demonstrate the Hubbard model's ability to reproduce charge stability diagrams at a fraction of the computational cost in comparison to voltage bias sweeps. We further compare the simulated diagrams to experimental data and demonstrate qualitative agreement. Our result represents a step towards predictive digital twin models for semiconductor quantum dot devices. Finally, we apply this workflow towards lever arm engineering in a second device, demonstrating that the method extends to multiple architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Self-consistent Schrödinger-Poisson calculations”“Full Configuration Interaction (FCI) energy calculations”“Hubbard model”等计算与建模方法，未涉及实验测量手段。；研究对象：半导体量子点器件，具体为Intel Tunnel Falls Si/SiGe器件，以及另一用于杠杆臂工程（lever arm engineering）的第二类器件架构。物理现象为量子点电荷稳定性图（charge stability diagram）的生成与预测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将多域多模型（MDMM）自洽模拟与自动调谐例程结合，并辅以FCI能量计算来参数化Hubbard模型，可以在远低于全电压扫描模拟的计算成本下，快速生成与实验定性一致的电荷稳定性图，展示了面向半导体量子点器件的数字孪生建模可行性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将多域多模型（MDMM）自洽模拟与自动调谐例程结合，并辅以FCI能量计算来参数化Hubbard模型，可以在远低于全电压扫描模拟的计算成本下，快速生成与实验定性一致的电荷稳定性图，展示了面向半导体量子点器件的数字孪生建模可行性。；创新点：将器件级自洽模拟与Hubbard模型参数化相结合，避免了全栅极电压扫描的高计算成本，实现了电荷稳定性图的快速生成；并展示了该方法可推广至不同器件架构（如杠杆臂工程），向预测性数字孪生模型迈出一步。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用多域多模型（MDMM）方法进行器件级自洽薛定谔-泊松（Schrödinger-Poisson）计算；结合自动调谐例程（automated tuning routine）定位特定电荷构型对应的栅极电压；使用全组态相互作用（FCI）计算提取充电能量、杠杆臂和量子点间库仑相互作用，用于参数化Hubbard模型；最终通过Hubbard模型快速生成电荷稳定性图，并与实验数据对比。

papers.title: QUBO-Compatible Active Learning for Inverse Design of High-Entropy Alloys
papers.abstract: Machine-learned forward models can rapidly predict alloy properties, but their use for inverse design remains challenging when the search should also retain compatibility with quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO). Here, we develop a QUBO-compatible active-learning framework for inverse design of high-entropy alloys using a pretrained graph-neural-network predictor as a fixed property oracle. A property-guided binary variational autoencoder provides a binary latent representation, while an ensemble of quadratic factorization machines guides candidate selection. We systematically benchmark the framework through controlled latent-space ablations and comparison with direct composition-space optimization. The results show that candidate generation is a major determinant of search performance: local perturbations around previously high-performing latent codes provide the largest workflow-specific improvement, while surrogate-based selection further prioritizes candidates within the enriched search pool. The resulting QUBO-compatible workflow remains competitive with strong classical optimization strategies, although a composition-space genetic algorithm achieves the highest mean score. Finally, the learned quadratic surrogate can be exported directly as a QUBO. These results show that effective data acquisition can be separated from the final QUBO optimization endpoint, providing a benchmarked route for QUBO-compatible data-driven materials inverse design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/算法研究文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“machine-learned forward models”“graph-neural-network predictor”“binary variational autoencoder”“quadratic factorization machines”等机器学习与优化算法关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：高熵合金（high-entropy alloys）的逆向设计，具体关注在满足QUBO（二次无约束二元优化）约束条件下的合金成分搜索与优化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 候选生成策略是QUBO兼容逆向设计搜索性能的主要决定因素：对先前高表现潜码的局部扰动带来最大工作流改进，而基于代理模型的筛选可进一步优先化候选；该QUBO兼容工作流与强经典优化策略竞争力相当，但成分空间遗传算法获得最高平均得分。
