We explore the organizational division of labor, inspired by the NK model of rugged landscapes, which is widely applied in evolutionary biology, and incorporate interdependencies among the attributes of technical experts within an organization. Our model considers two types of employees characterized by their task allocation strategies: specialists, who are permanently assigned to a single task, and generalists, who stochastically select a task at each time step. We investigate how the ruggedness of the productivity landscape, shaped by task interdependency, affects the organization's capacity to optimize labor division and meet market demands. Using group selection algorithms, we reveal the emergence of nonlinear adaptive dynamics, providing insights into how companies can adapt their strategies to meet market demands and foster innovation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要提及“NK model of rugged landscapes”“group selection algorithms”，属于理论建模与计算模拟研究。；研究对象：组织内部的劳动力分工与任务分配体系，具体为“专家型”（固定单一任务）与“通才型”（随机选择任务）两类员工在复杂生产率景观中的适应行为。该体系受生物进化中“崎岖景观”思想启发，但研究对象是社会经济组织而非传统凝聚态材料或量子体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 任务间的相互依赖程度（即生产率景观的崎岖性）显著影响组织优化劳动力分工和满足市场需求的能力；通过群体选择算法，揭示了非线性的自适应动力学行为，表明组织可据此调整策略以促进创新。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：任务间的相互依赖程度（即生产率景观的崎岖性）显著影响组织优化劳动力分工和满足市场需求的能力；通过群体选择算法，揭示了非线性的自适应动力学行为，表明组织可据此调整策略以促进创新。；创新点：将进化生物学中的NK崎岖景观模型引入组织劳动力分工研究，并明确区分“专家”与“通才”两类策略，考察任务依赖性与自适应策略之间的耦合对组织生产率的影响。摘要未突出说明与既有组织理论模型的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用NK模型（崎岖景观模型）构建生产率景观，引入任务依赖关系；使用群体选择算法（group selection algorithms）进行演化模拟，分析不同任务分配策略（专家型 vs. 通才型）下的组织适应性与产出优化。

papers.title: First-Principles DFT Study of Ferroelectric-to-Antiferroelectric Phase Transitions in LiTaO$_3$ under Electric Boundary Conditions
papers.abstract: Ferroelectric and antiferroelectric phases of LiTaO$_3$ compete under different electric boundary conditions. First-principles density-functional calculations show that the high-symmetry reference structure supports two relevant unstable $Γ$ modes: a polar $A_{2u}$ mode at $181i$ cm$^{-1}$ that condenses into the ferroelectric (FE) phase, and an antipolar $A_{2g}$ mode at $103i$ cm$^{-1}$ that condenses into the antiferroelectric (AFE) phase. Under short-circuit conditions the FE phase is the global minimum, with a well depth of $\approx 144$ meV. Under open-circuit conditions the FE phase is destabilized by the unscreened depolarization field and the AFE phase becomes the ground state, with a well depth of $\approx 19$ meV. A weakly unstable longitudinal-optic mode at $48.3i$ cm$^{-1}$ yields a well of only $\approx 0.24$ meV and is thermodynamically irrelevant. Mapping the free energy versus electric displacement $D$ locates a second-order FE$\leftrightarrow$AFE transition at $D_c=0.051$ C/m$^2$, lower than the corresponding $0.07$ C/m$^2$ in LiNbO$_3$ and therefore more accessible experimentally.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“First-principles density-functional calculations”（第一性原理密度泛函计算）。；研究对象：LiTaO₃（钽酸锂）在铁电（FE）与反铁电（AFE）相之间的竞争与相变，特别关注不同电学边界条件（短路与开路）对相稳定性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在短路条件下，LiTaO₃的铁电相为全局能量最低态（势阱深度约144 meV）；在开路条件下，未屏蔽的退极化场使铁电相失稳，反铁电相成为基态（势阱深度约19 meV）。自由能对电位移D的映射显示，FE↔AFE相变为二级相变，临界电位移D_c=0.051 C/m²，低于LiNbO₃的0.07 C/m²，实验上更易实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在短路条件下，LiTaO₃的铁电相为全局能量最低态（势阱深度约144 meV）；在开路条件下，未屏蔽的退极化场使铁电相失稳，反铁电相成为基态（势阱深度约19 meV）。自由能对电位移D的映射显示，FE↔AFE相变为二级相变，临界电位移D_c=0.051 C/m²，低于LiNbO₃的0.07 C/m²，实验上更易实现。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，分析高对称参考结构中Γ点不稳定声子模（极性A₂ᵤ模与反极性A₂ᵍ模），并计算自由能随电位移D的变化以定位相变点。

papers.title: LDA-1/2 for Molecular Systems: A Real-Space Finite-Element Benchmark on the GW100 Set
papers.abstract: The LDA-1/2 method provides an efficient correction to semilocal density functional theory for improving ionization energies and band gaps, yet its application to molecular systems has remained limited. In this work, we present an all-electron finite-element implementation of LDA-1/2 within the NESSIE electronic-structure framework and apply it to the GW100 molecular benchmark set with systematically controllable numerical accuracy. The self-energy correction is constructed explicitly from neutral and half-ionized calculations for each molecule, avoiding the use of precomputed atomic correction potentials. The real-space finite-element formulation enables systematic convergence with respect to the discretization and provides a controlled assessment of LDA-1/2 performance. For the GW100 set, the present implementation yields a mean absolute error of 0.472 eV and a root-mean-square error of 0.645 eV relative to CCSD(T) reference ionization energies, substantially improving upon conventional LDA and the previously reported LAPW implementation of LDA-1/2, while achieving accuracy comparable to G0W0@PBE. Convergence tests show that third-order finite elements are sufficient to reach or approach chemical accuracy relative to higher-order calculations for the representative systems considered. The resulting corrected Hamiltonian also improves several lower lying valence states relative to LDA, although the improvement becomes less systematic away from the HOMO. This work provides accurate LDA-1/2 benchmark data for molecular systems and establishes a rigorous finite-element foundation for future molecular GW calculations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：finite-element implementation、electronic-structure framework、benchmark。；研究对象：分子体系，具体为GW100分子基准测试集，关注其电离能等电子结构性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: LDA-1/2方法在GW100分子集上相对CCSD(T)参考电离能的平均绝对误差为0.472 eV，均方根误差为0.645 eV，显著优于传统LDA和此前LAPW实现，精度与G0W0@PBE相当。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：LDA-1/2方法在GW100分子集上相对CCSD(T)参考电离能的平均绝对误差为0.472 eV，均方根误差为0.645 eV，显著优于传统LDA和此前LAPW实现，精度与G0W0@PBE相当。；创新点：首次在实空间有限元框架下实现LDA-1/2并系统应用于分子基准集，避免了预计算原子势的依赖，提供了可控的数值精度评估；同时为未来分子GW计算建立了严格的有限元基础。
papers.method_zh: 基于NESSIE电子结构框架的全电子有限元实现LDA-1/2方法；自能修正由每个分子的中性和半电离计算显式构造，而非使用预计算的原子修正势；通过有限元离散阶数系统控制数值收敛性。

papers.title: Turning Zeeman splitting into switchable charge polarization in a double quantum dot
papers.abstract: A magnetic field that acts identically on two quantum dots is not expected to move charge between them. Nevertheless, we show that a uniform Zeeman field can strongly reconfigure and even reverse the single-electron charge polarization of an asymmetric open double quantum dot. Using a symmetry-preserving Green's-function equation-of-motion approach, we identify regimes where the preferred dot occupation reverses while the system remains in the single-electron charge sector. Two distinct mechanisms produce this behavior. Unequal gate levels produce different occupation responses because the Zeeman-shifted resonances lie at different positions relative to the reservoir chemical potential, whereas unequal onsite interactions distinguish the dots through their many-body addition spectra. Coulomb blockade stabilizes the single-electron sector, causing the reservoir-mediated response to appear as spatial charge redistribution rather than a change in total occupation. Our results establish a mechanism for magnetic control of charge polarization at fixed electrostatic detuning.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“symmetry-preserving Green's-function equation-of-motion approach”（对称性保持的格林函数运动方程方法），属于解析/数值理论计算研究，无实验手段描述。；研究对象：非对称开放双量子点（asymmetric open double quantum dot）中的单电子电荷极化（charge polarization）行为，具体关注均匀塞曼磁场（uniform Zeeman field）对电荷空间分布的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 均匀塞曼场（对两个量子点作用相同）可以强烈重构甚至反转非对称开放双量子点的单电子电荷极化，且系统始终保持在单电子电荷扇区内。该效应源于两种机制：门电压不等导致的塞曼位移共振相对库电极化学势位置不同，以及非均匀在位相互作用通过多体加成谱区分两个量子点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：均匀塞曼场（对两个量子点作用相同）可以强烈重构甚至反转非对称开放双量子点的单电子电荷极化，且系统始终保持在单电子电荷扇区内。该效应源于两种机制：门电压不等导致的塞曼位移共振相对库电极化学势位置不同，以及非均匀在位相互作用通过多体加成谱区分两个量子点。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有工作的对比，但核心新意在于：证明均匀磁场（而非梯度场）也能在固定静电失谐（fixed electrostatic detuning）下实现电荷极化的磁控开关效应，且通过库仑阻塞稳定单电子扇区，将库区介导的响应表现为空间电荷重分布而非总占据数变化。
papers.method_zh: 对称性保持的格林函数运动方程方法（symmetry-preserving Green's-function equation-of-motion approach）。摘要未明确说明具体数值参数或计算细节（如是否结合数值重整化群等），但明确使用了该理论框架分析电荷占据与输运响应。

papers.title: Physics-informed learning for the inverse problem in resonant ultrasound spectroscopy
papers.abstract: Inferring elastic constants from resonant ultrasound spectra is a nonlinear and typically overdetermined inverse problem based on finite spectral data. We formulate the Rayleigh-Ritz inverse problem as a constrained inverse-isospectral problem on the set of physically admissible elasticity tensors. This induces effective low-dimensional variables for the inverse map on the admissible elasticity manifold: length and elastic scales, aspect-ratio coordinates, scale-free spectral features, and stability-respecting elastic ratios. We use these variables to construct a physics-informed learning pipeline in which a regression model acts only on reduced spectral and geometric features, while scale recovery and final elastic-constant reconstruction are imposed analytically. For the full cubic benchmark, the reconstructed constants have MAE values of $20.37(35.15)$, $24.30(41.33)$, and $2.13(3.66)~\mathrm{GPa}$ for $C_{11}$, $C_{12}$, and $C_{44}$. In the fixed-geometry benchmark, the corresponding cubic MAPE values are $4.14(3.87)\%$, $8.31(8.50)\%$, and $2.44(2.86)\%$, while the isotropic values are $4.0(3.6)\%$ and $0.4(0.3)\%$ for the bulk and shear moduli. The inverse problem then becomes a constrained regression problem in variables adapted to the geometry, scaling, crystal symmetry, and thermodynamic stability of Hookean elasticity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：physics-informed learning、constrained inverse-isospectral problem、regression model、analytically imposed。；研究对象：谐振超声谱（Resonant Ultrasound Spectroscopy, RUS）的逆问题——即从有限频谱数据中反演材料的弹性常数张量。摘要未明确指定具体材料，而是以立方晶系（cubic）和各向同性（isotropic）弹性体系为基准测试对象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将RUS逆问题重新表述为物理可行弹性张量集合上的约束逆等谱问题，并引入适应几何、尺度、晶体对称性和热力学稳定性的低维变量，构建的物理信息学习管线能够以较低误差重建弹性常数（如立方晶系C11、C12、C44的MAE分别为20.37、24.30、2.13 GPa；固定几何下各向同性体模量和剪切模量MAPE分别为4.0%和0.4%）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将RUS逆问题重新表述为物理可行弹性张量集合上的约束逆等谱问题，并引入适应几何、尺度、晶体对称性和热力学稳定性的低维变量，构建的物理信息学习管线能够以较低误差重建弹性常数（如立方晶系C11、C12、C44的MAE分别为20.37、24.30、2.13 GPa；固定几何下各向同性体模量和剪切模量MAPE分别为4.0%和0.4%）。；创新点：将RUS逆问题转化为约束回归问题，并利用弹性张量流形上的有效低维变量（长度/弹性尺度、长宽比坐标、无标度谱特征、稳定性弹性比）来解耦尺度与形状信息，使回归模型只处理降维特征，尺度恢复和最终重建由解析约束完成——这避免了纯黑箱回归对高维谱数据的直接拟合。摘要未突出说明与其他机器学习方法的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为Rayleigh-Ritz变分法结合逆等谱问题表述；具体方法为物理信息机器学习管线：回归模型仅作用于降维的谱特征和几何特征，而尺度恢复和最终弹性常数重建通过解析方式施加。基准测试包括完整立方晶系和固定几何（立方及各向同性）两种情形。

papers.title: Atomistic Indicators of the Ductile-to-Brittle Transition in Polycrystalline Tungsten: Temperature and Rhenium Effects on Crack-Tip Plasticity
papers.abstract: The fracture response of body-centered-cubic tungsten is governed by competition between crack-tip instability and dislocation-mediated plastic accommodation. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations are used to examine edge-cracked polycrystalline W and W-Re under displacement-controlled Mode-I tension from 300-1800 K at a strain rate of 5 x 10^8 s^-1. Heating pure W reduces the instability stress, effective specimen stiffness, and pre-instability volumetric work density, while the instability strain remains comparatively scattered. A normalized work-loss metric derived from the pre-instability work gives a broad sigmoid crossover marker, T*_MD ~ 870 K, characteristic of the simulated geometry and high-rate loading conditions. Among the available W-Re compositions, W-10Re shows greater pre-instability deformation and work accumulation than pure W across most temperatures, while the maximum-stress response remains strongly temperature- and composition-dependent. Changes in retained dislocation character and near-tip activity indicate that Re modifies the crack-tip plastic-accommodation pathway rather than producing a simple strength increase. Common-state analysis further shows that Re alters the retained 1/2<111> line character and the temporal distribution of near-tip dislocation activity without uniformly increasing the local dislocation population. These coupled mechanical and defect-structure changes provide atomistic indicators of a high-rate ductile-to-brittle transition (DBT), but not a direct prediction of experimental DBTT. A separate OpenDiS/pydis calculation demonstrates source-like bow-out and heterogeneous dislocation-network development in crack-free polycrystalline W, providing mesoscale context without implying direct quantitative MD-DDD coupling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：分子动力学（MD）模拟、OpenDiS/pydis 计算。；研究对象：多晶钨（W）及钨-铼（W-Re）合金中，裂纹尖端的塑性行为与韧脆转变（DBT）现象，重点关注温度和 Re 掺杂的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 加热纯 W 会降低失稳应力、有效刚度和失稳前体积功密度，并给出一个归一化功损失指标所标记的宽缓 S 形转变特征温度 T*_MD ≈ 870 K；Re 掺杂并非简单增强强度，而是改变裂纹尖端的塑性容纳路径（如保留位错特征和近尖端位错活动的时间分布），从而提供高应变率下韧脆转变的原子级指标。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：加热纯 W 会降低失稳应力、有效刚度和失稳前体积功密度，并给出一个归一化功损失指标所标记的宽缓 S 形转变特征温度 T*_MD ≈ 870 K；Re 掺杂并非简单增强强度，而是改变裂纹尖端的塑性容纳路径（如保留位错特征和近尖端位错活动的时间分布），从而提供高应变率下韧脆转变的原子级指标。；创新点：通过耦合力学响应（失稳应力、功密度）与缺陷结构演化（保留位错类型、近尖端位错活动时间分布）的“共同态分析”，提出高应变率韧脆转变的原子级指标；并指出 Re 的作用是改变塑性容纳路径而非单纯强化。摘要未突出说明与实验 DBTT 的直接关联预测。
papers.method_zh: 采用分子动力学（MD）模拟，对含边裂纹的多晶 W 和 W-Re 在 300–1800 K、应变率 5×10^8 s⁻¹ 下进行位移控制的 Mode-I 拉伸；另用 OpenDiS/pydis 进行位错动力学计算，模拟无裂纹多晶 W 中的位错源弓出和异质位错网络演化。

papers.title: Topological signatures in the quench dynamics of periodically driven quantum systems
papers.abstract: We study the quench dynamics of graphene, without and with a staggered mass, following the sudden switch-on of circularly polarized light where coupling to a fermionic bath is also considered. Using an armchair nanoribbon, we compute the period-averaged bond current near the edge at successive stroboscopic times. For the isolated system, the current oscillates around a dc value which, we analytically show, equals the Floquet band currents weighted by their projected occupations; a nonzero dc current signals an induced topological phase. When coupled to a bath with a finite coupling, the current and conductance initially increase and then saturate, indicating a nonequilibrium steady state. In the limit of vanishingly small coupling, the period-averaged conductance becomes quantized after summing over bath chemical potentials shifted by integer multiples of the driving frequency, revealing the number of edge modes crossing the zero-quasienergy gap and the Floquet zone boundary gap. We support these results by computing the two-terminal conductance of a finite-size tight-binding model under a three-step driving protocol; the bond conductance after applying the sum rule corroborates our findings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“we analytically show”“computing the two-terminal conductance of a finite-size tight-binding model”等理论分析与数值计算表述。；研究对象：周期性驱动（圆偏振光）的石墨烯体系（有无交错质量两种情况），并考虑与费米子热库的耦合；具体采用armchair纳米带几何结构，研究其淬火动力学中的拓扑性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在孤立体系中，周期平均键电流围绕一个直流值振荡，该直流值等于Floquet能带电流按投影占据数加权之和，非零直流电流标志着诱导拓扑相的出现；在耦合热库且耦合强度趋于零的极限下，周期平均电导在按驱动频率整数倍平移的化学势求和后呈现量子化，揭示穿过零准能隙和Floquet区边界隙的边模数目。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在孤立体系中，周期平均键电流围绕一个直流值振荡，该直流值等于Floquet能带电流按投影占据数加权之和，非零直流电流标志着诱导拓扑相的出现；在耦合热库且耦合强度趋于零的极限下，周期平均电导在按驱动频率整数倍平移的化学势求和后呈现量子化，揭示穿过零准能隙和Floquet区边界隙的边模数目。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合数值计算：对armchair纳米带在圆偏振光突然开启后的淬火动力学，计算连续stroboscopic时刻的周期平均边缘键电流；解析推导了孤立系统直流电流与Floquet带电流的关系；对有限尺寸紧束缚模型采用三步驱动协议，计算两端电导并应用求和规则验证。

papers.title: Compiling Chemical Knowledge into Executable Descriptors for Materials Prediction
papers.abstract: Materials prediction depends critically on how scientific knowledge is represented, yet many governing considerations exist only as natural-language heuristics that conventional learners cannot use. We introduce CRISP, a large language model-assisted framework that treats representation construction as a rule-space exploration and compilation problem: it repeatedly samples target-relevant chemical rules without access to structures, labels or data splits, consolidates related concepts, and compiles each into an executable scalar descriptor supplied to a conventional learner. For positive-unlabeled inorganic-crystal synthesizability, CRISP outperformed expert-curated and generic structural representations under a shared learner and surpassed purpose-built synthesizability models, with its advantage most pronounced under structural-size and chemical-family shifts. Infrequently generated rules contributed complementary predictive information, showing that generation frequency does not determine utility. The same workflow yielded competitive representations for formation energy and ionic conductivity while revealing task-dependent limits for shear modulus, establishing a dataset-blind, auditable route from broad chemical knowledge to transferable computational representations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法类文章。判断依据关键词：large language model-assisted framework、rule-space exploration、compilation problem、executable scalar descriptor、conventional learner。；研究对象：无机晶体材料的可合成性（positive-unlabeled inorganic-crystal synthesizability），以及形成能（formation energy）、离子电导率（ionic conductivity）和剪切模量（shear modulus）等材料性质预测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出CRISP框架，将化学知识以自然语言启发式规则的形式编译为可执行的标量描述符，供传统机器学习模型使用。在无机晶体可合成性预测中，CRISP优于专家筛选和通用结构描述符，并超越专门设计的可合成性模型；其优势在结构尺寸和化学族偏移（外推）场景下最为显著。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出CRISP框架，将化学知识以自然语言启发式规则的形式编译为可执行的标量描述符，供传统机器学习模型使用。在无机晶体可合成性预测中，CRISP优于专家筛选和通用结构描述符，并超越专门设计的可合成性模型；其优势在结构尺寸和化学族偏移（外推）场景下最为显著。；创新点：将描述符构建视为“规则空间探索与编译”问题，实现数据集不可见（dataset-blind）的、可审计的从化学知识到可迁移计算描述符的自动化流程；并发现生成频率低的规则仍可提供互补的预测信息，表明规则生成频率不等于其效用。摘要未突出说明与传统描述符工程相比的具体计算成本或可解释性细节。
papers.method_zh: 利用大语言模型（LLM）辅助，在无结构、无标签、无数据划分的条件下反复采样与目标相关的化学规则，合并相关概念，并将每条规则编译为可执行的标量描述符，输入传统机器学习模型（shared learner）进行训练与预测。评估任务包括正-未标记（positive-unlabeled）可合成性分类、形成能回归、离子电导率回归和剪切模量回归。

papers.title: Scale-free correlations in extremely persistent active matter
papers.abstract: Scale-free correlations are believed to be generic in out of equilibrium systems but their explicit derivations are rare and often involve approximations. Here we analyze a system of infinitely persistent active Brownian particles in the low density and small-swim-velocity limit. We show that both the density and swim velocity correlations decay algebraically as r^{-(d+1)} (with logarithmic corrections in d=2). In reciprocal space these correlations manifest themselves as cusps at k=0. The analytical predictions are confirmed by numerical simulations. The results were obtained through interaction with Claude (Opus 4.8 and 5, and Fable 5) and verified by the author.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟验证）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“analytical predictions”（解析预测）和“confirmed by numerical simulations”（数值模拟验证），属于理论推导结合数值模拟的混合类型。；研究对象：极强持续性的活性物质（extremely persistent active matter），具体为无限持续活性布朗粒子（infinitely persistent active Brownian particles）在低密度、小游动速度极限下的体系。研究的是该非平衡体系中密度和游动速度关联函数的标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低密度和小游动速度极限下，无限持续活性布朗粒子的密度关联和游动速度关联均呈代数衰减，衰减形式为 r^{-(d+1)}（在二维 d=2 时存在对数修正）；在倒空间中，这些关联表现为 k=0 处的尖点（cusps）。这为“无标度关联在非平衡体系中具有普适性”提供了具体解析例证。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低密度和小游动速度极限下，无限持续活性布朗粒子的密度关联和游动速度关联均呈代数衰减，衰减形式为 r^{-(d+1)}（在二维 d=2 时存在对数修正）；在倒空间中，这些关联表现为 k=0 处的尖点（cusps）。这为“无标度关联在非平衡体系中具有普适性”提供了具体解析例证。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断：该工作首次在极强持续活性物质体系中显式推导出无标度关联的代数衰减形式（含维度相关的对数修正），避免了以往推导中常见的近似处理，并给出了倒空间尖点的明确对应。此外，摘要末尾提及结果通过与Claude（AI模型）交互获得并经作者验证，这属于方法论上的特殊说明，但物理创新点本身摘要未详细展开。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析推导：在低密度和小游动速度极限下对无限持续活性布朗粒子体系进行解析分析，推导密度和游动速度关联函数的实空间衰减形式及倒空间行为；数值模拟验证：通过数值模拟确认解析预测的正确性。摘要未明确说明具体模拟算法（如布朗动力学模拟等）。

papers.title: Collinear altermagnetism for 3D chiral higher-order topological insulators
papers.abstract: Despite significant progress in the study of higher-order topological insulators (HOTIs), the chiral $C_4\mathcal{T}$-protected HOTI has remained elusive in electronic materials, where $C_4\mathcal{T}$ denotes the product of a four-fold rotation and time-reversal symmetry. We show that altermagnetism, a recently discovered form of collinear magnetism, provides a new route to realize this elusive phase. Specifically, we construct a microscopic model that combines a three-dimensional topological insulator with a collinear $d$-wave altermagnet on a Lieb lattice. Through analytical and numerical calculations, we show that the magnetism shifts and gaps the surface Dirac cones to produce the desired chiral hinge channels. Finally, we identify promising material classes to realise our proposal. Our results establish collinear altermagnetism as a route to intrinsic chiral higher-order topology and open a new path toward the discovery of $C_4\mathcal{T}$-protected HOTIs in real materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“construct a microscopic model”“analytical and numerical calculations”等关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：三维手性高阶拓扑绝缘体（HOTI），具体为受C₄𝒯（四重旋转与时间反演对称性的乘积）保护的手性高阶拓扑相；体系为三维拓扑绝缘体与Lieb晶格上共线d波交错磁体（altermagnet）的复合模型，并探讨了可实现该相的实际材料类别。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 共线d波交错磁（altermagnetism）可作为一种新机制，通过使表面狄拉克锥发生位移并打开能隙，从而产生所需的手性铰链通道，实现此前在电子材料中难以实现的C₄𝒯保护手性高阶拓扑绝缘体相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：共线d波交错磁（altermagnetism）可作为一种新机制，通过使表面狄拉克锥发生位移并打开能隙，从而产生所需的手性铰链通道，实现此前在电子材料中难以实现的C₄𝒯保护手性高阶拓扑绝缘体相。；创新点：首次提出将共线交错磁（altermagnetism）作为实现内禀手性高阶拓扑绝缘体的新途径，为在真实材料中寻找C₄𝒯保护的高阶拓扑相开辟了新方向。摘要未突出说明其他具体创新点。
papers.method_zh: 构建微观模型（三维拓扑绝缘体与Lieb晶格上共线d波交错磁体的组合），结合解析计算与数值计算（摘要未明确说明具体数值方法，如紧束缚模型或第一性原理等），并基于材料类别分析提出可实现该提议的候选材料体系。

papers.title: Ab initio Modeling of MoS2/Oxide Device Interfaces with Machine Learned Electronic Structures
papers.abstract: We introduce a new ab initio approach to simulate semiconductor devices that integrates scalable machine-learned (ML) electronic structure models with an advanced quantum transport (QT) solver. The developed framework enables 10,000X speedups over density functional theory to produce the Hamiltonian matrix of devices made of >20,000 atoms, while offering high prediction accuracy. We use its unique features to investigate MoS2/oxide samples and single-layer MoS2 field-effect transistors, where the surrounding oxide layers, here, HfO2 or Al2O3, are explicitly included into the QT domain. In particular, we reveal that the presence of undercoordinated metal atoms (Hf or Al) close to the semiconductor-oxide interface significantly affects the magnitude of the electronic current and its propagation through MoS2.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提及“ab initio approach”“machine-learned electronic structure models”“quantum transport solver”，属于第一性原理计算与机器学习结合的方法。；研究对象：MoS₂/氧化物（HfO₂或Al₂O₃）器件界面，以及单层MoS₂场效应晶体管，重点关注半导体-氧化物界面附近欠配位金属原子（Hf或Al）对电子输运的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 半导体-氧化物界面附近存在的欠配位金属原子（Hf或Al）会显著影响通过MoS₂的电子电流大小及其传播特性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：半导体-氧化物界面附近存在的欠配位金属原子（Hf或Al）会显著影响通过MoS₂的电子电流大小及其传播特性。；创新点：首次将机器学习电子结构模型与量子输运求解器集成，实现对包含明确氧化物界面的大规模（>20,000原子）器件的第一性原理级模拟，并利用该能力揭示了界面欠配位金属原子对电流的调控作用。
papers.method_zh: 将可扩展的机器学习电子结构模型与先进量子输运求解器相结合，构建器件哈密顿量，实现对超过20,000个原子器件的模拟，速度较密度泛函理论（DFT）提升约10,000倍。氧化物层（HfO₂或Al₂O₃）被显式包含在量子输运计算域中。

papers.title: Asphericity Lifts the Degeneracy Among Ordering Mechanisms on Curved Surfaces
papers.abstract: Spherical surfaces conceal the one-body signature of particle organization: area-uniform, conductor, and curvature-weighted measures coincide there, so the ordering mechanism leaves no trace in the density. Aspherical deformation lifts this degeneracy. On an ellipsoid, these ordering mechanisms separate into distinct powers of the distance from the shell center to its tangent plane. To leading order in deformation, the characteristic exponent can be read from both the structure factor quadrupole and the radius of gyration. Two interaction families realize the exponent in complementary ways: the Riesz $s$-energy, whose limiting measure switches sharply at the marginal power, and screened Coulomb potential, where the exponent is tuned continuously by the salt concentration. Ionic strength thereby becomes an experimental dial that transforms the particle ordering across the conductor-to-packing crossover on a fixed aspherical surface, turning a macroscopic shape parameter into a probe of the microscopic interaction law.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要讨论“limiting measure”“leading order in deformation”“characteristic exponent”等理论推导，以及“structure factor quadrupole”“radius of gyration”等可计算量，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：弯曲表面（球面、椭球面）上粒子有序化（ordering）的机制，具体涉及三种排序机制（面积均匀、导体型、曲率加权）在非球面形变下的区分，以及Riesz s-能量和屏蔽库仑势两类相互作用体系中的粒子排列行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 球面上三种粒子排序机制因密度不可区分而简并；椭球面（非球面形变）可解除该简并，使各机制表现为壳心到切平面距离的不同幂次。该幂次可通过结构因子四极矩和回转半径直接读出，且离子强度可连续调控屏蔽库仑势中的指数，从而在固定非球面上实现导体型到堆积型排序的连续转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：球面上三种粒子排序机制因密度不可区分而简并；椭球面（非球面形变）可解除该简并，使各机制表现为壳心到切平面距离的不同幂次。该幂次可通过结构因子四极矩和回转半径直接读出，且离子强度可连续调控屏蔽库仑势中的指数，从而在固定非球面上实现导体型到堆积型排序的连续转变。；创新点：首次指出非球面形变（椭球）可解除球面上排序机制的简并，并将宏观形状参数（椭球离心率）转化为探测微观相互作用规律的实验旋钮（离子强度），实现从导体型到堆积型排序的连续调控。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与解析推导：对椭球面形变做微扰展开至一阶，分析不同排序机制对应的密度标度幂次；结合结构因子四极矩与回转半径作为可观测诊断量；对比Riesz s-能量（极限测度在临界幂次处发生突变）与屏蔽库仑势（指数随盐浓度连续变化）两类相互作用模型。

papers.title: Exact branch-transfer criterion for common-mode Thomson heat cancellation in thermoelectric couples
papers.abstract: Thermoelectric p- and n-type legs are commonly paired by matching their Seebeck magnitudes, although a cooler responds to heat transported through its complete electrical and thermal network. We decompose the leg coefficients into differential thermopower $α=S_p-S_n$ and common thermopower $M=(S_p+S_n)/2$. In a connected steady-state scalar thermoelectric network, a temperature-independent co-shift applied to every electrically active segment is an exact terminal null. A temperature-dependent perturbation of the legs relative to fixed leads is instead physical. At fixed current and shared isothermal endpoints, its first-order cold-port response is the action of $Γ_m=T\,dm/dT$ on the difference between the p- and n-branch oriented collection measures. We prove that every continuous $Γ_m$ cancels if and only if these measures are equal. In the constant-property, linear-common-mode limit, matching $R_i/K_i^{\rm leg}$ is sufficient and does not require identical legs. One- and two-dimensional calculations confirm the analytic reductions within their stated domains. For split thermal pads, the analysis gives the exact array law $ΔQ_{c,Σ}=\sum_j C_jI_jΔT_{c,j}$ and, for series elements with isothermal hot pairs, $IΔV_Σ=-ΔQ_{c,Σ}$. A representative seven-pair model gives corresponding increments of 7.87 mW and $-2.80$ mV. Branch transfer and endpoint topology therefore provide distinct material-pairing and device-test criteria for common-mode Thomson heat.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“decompose”“prove”“analytic reductions”“calculations”等理论推导与解析计算关键词。；研究对象：热电偶（thermoelectric couples）中p型和n型腿的共模汤姆逊热（common-mode Thomson heat）消除问题，属于热电输运理论范畴。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在恒定电流和共享等温端点的条件下，若p支与n支的有向集合测度相等，则任意连续的共模热电系数Γ_m对冷端响应的贡献精确为零；在常物性线性共模极限下，匹配R_i/K_i^leg（电阻与热导之比）即可实现共模汤姆逊热消除，无需两腿完全相同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在恒定电流和共享等温端点的条件下，若p支与n支的有向集合测度相等，则任意连续的共模热电系数Γ_m对冷端响应的贡献精确为零；在常物性线性共模极限下，匹配R_i/K_i^leg（电阻与热导之比）即可实现共模汤姆逊热消除，无需两腿完全相同。；创新点：提出了精确的分支传递判据（exact branch-transfer criterion），将共模汤姆逊热消除条件从传统的塞贝克系数匹配推广到分支测度相等，并给出了分体热垫阵列的精确定律ΔQ_{c,Σ}=Σ_j C_j I_j ΔT_{c,j}及串联元件的对偶关系IΔV_Σ=−ΔQ_{c,Σ}，为材料配对和器件测试提供了新的判据。
papers.method_zh: 采用标量热电网络的稳态理论框架，将腿系数分解为差分热电势α=S_p−S_n和共模热电势M=(S_p+S_n)/2，通过分支传递（branch transfer）与端点拓扑分析进行解析推导，并辅以一维和二维数值计算验证，以及七对模型的具体数值模拟。

papers.title: How Long-Range Tails Reshape Non-Hermitian Spectra
papers.abstract: Exponentially decaying long-range hoppings are ubiquitous in realistic tight-binding models and are often truncated to obtain a finite-range description. We show that this approximation can fail dramatically in non-Hermitian systems under open boundary conditions: an infinitesimal long-range hopping can nonperturbatively reconstruct the spectrum and eigenstates of a short-range non-Hermitian system. The mechanism is controlled by a competition between the decay length of infinitesimal long-range hoppings and the localization length of non-Hermitian skin modes, leading to a sharp transition as the decay rate is tuned. In one dimension, we show that a squeezed generalized Brillouin zone (GBZ) replaces the original GBZ of the short-ranged Hamiltonian, yielding the reconstructed open-boundary spectrum. In two or higher dimensions, we formulate a squeezed amoeba formulation describing the reconstructed spectral density. We further show that long-range hoppings can qualitatively reshape Green's function, which can be readily detected in experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及理论模型分析（tight-binding models）、解析/数值框架（GBZ、amoeba formulation），未提及实验手段。；研究对象：非厄米紧束缚模型中的长程跳跃（指数衰减的长程hopping）对开边界条件下能谱与本征态的影响，特别关注非厄米趋肤效应与广义布里渊区（GBZ）的形变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非厄米开边界系统中，即使无穷小的指数衰减长程跳跃也能非微扰地重构短程哈密顿量的能谱与本征态；该重构由长程跳跃的衰减长度与趋肤模的局域长度之间的竞争控制，存在一个尖锐的转变。在一维中，压缩的GBZ取代原始GBZ；在二维及以上，压缩的amoeba公式描述重构后的谱密度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非厄米开边界系统中，即使无穷小的指数衰减长程跳跃也能非微扰地重构短程哈密顿量的能谱与本征态；该重构由长程跳跃的衰减长度与趋肤模的局域长度之间的竞争控制，存在一个尖锐的转变。在一维中，压缩的GBZ取代原始GBZ；在二维及以上，压缩的amoeba公式描述重构后的谱密度。；创新点：揭示了在非厄米系统中，将指数衰减长程跳跃截断为有限范围描述会失效——即使无穷小的长程项也能非微扰地改变开边界能谱，并给出了相应的GBZ/amoeba重构框架。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：一维采用广义布里渊区（GBZ）方法，高维采用amoeba公式（squeezed amoeba formulation）；通过比较衰减长度与趋肤模局域长度来刻画转变；还分析了长程跳跃对Green函数的影响。

papers.title: Exact quantification of nonlocal magic
papers.abstract: Magic, or nonstabilizerness, is the resource that lifts Clifford circuits to universal quantum computation and has become a standard diagnostic of many-body states. For a state shared between two parties, however, a basic question has remained open: how much of the magic resides in the correlations between the parties rather than in their local bases? Isolating this nonlocal magic requires minimizing over all local bases, an optimization that has so far resisted exact solution. Here we solve it for the stabilizer fidelity: the nonlocal magic of every pure multiqubit state is the distance of its entanglement spectrum from the closest spectrum of Bell pairs. The same quantity governs an apparently unrelated task: a family of states universally embezzles entanglement under local operations and classical communication if and only if its nonlocal magic diverges. The deciding property is not the amount of entanglement but the way the entanglement spectrum spreads its weight across factor-of-two windows of rank, so that critical chains and random-singlet states, with identical logarithmic entanglement scaling, carry unbounded and vanishing nonlocal magic, respectively. Nonlocal magic thereby becomes an operationally meaningful property of quantum correlations, directly accessible to tensor-network simulations and, through entanglement spectroscopy, to experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact solution、optimization、theoretical framework。；研究对象：量子多体态中的“非局域魔法”（nonlocal magic），即两体纯多比特态中存在于两体关联而非局域基中的非稳定化资源（nonstabilizerness），以及其与纠缠谱、纠缠窃取（embezzlement）的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纯多比特态的非局域魔法可由其纠缠谱与贝尔对谱的“距离”精确量化；该量是否发散决定了该态族能否在局域操作与经典通信下普适地窃取纠缠。关键判据不是纠缠量，而是纠缠谱在秩的因子二窗口中的权重分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纯多比特态的非局域魔法可由其纠缠谱与贝尔对谱的“距离”精确量化；该量是否发散决定了该态族能否在局域操作与经典通信下普适地窃取纠缠。关键判据不是纠缠量，而是纠缠谱在秩的因子二窗口中的权重分布。；创新点：首次精确求解了非局域魔法的优化问题，建立了非局域魔法与纠缠谱距离的严格等价关系，并揭示了其与纠缠窃取任务之间的操作意义联系；区分了具有相同对数纠缠标度的临界链与随机单重态态的非局域魔法行为（分别为无界和趋零）。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与精确求解：通过在所有局域基上最小化稳定化保真度（stabilizer fidelity）来定义并计算非局域魔法，将其等价转化为纠缠谱距离问题；结合纠缠谱分析、张量网络模拟和纠缠谱学实验方案进行验证与观测。

papers.title: Positivity constraints on the dynamics of cusped impurities in CFTs
papers.abstract: The cusp anomalous dimension is the universal logarithmic contribution to the free energy of a line defect with a cusp, and provides a useful observable characterizing defect dynamics. We generalize this notion to cusped line defects in the presence of a planar conformal boundary or interface. The geometry is characterized by three angles, and the distance of the cusp from the boundary or interface which separates short-distance and long-distance regimes. The resulting free energy contains two large logarithmic terms: a short-distance contribution governed by the usual vacuum cusp anomalous dimension, and a new long-distance contribution sensitive to the boundary or interface. Using reflection positivity for transverse deformations of the defect rays, we derive several constraints on the coefficients of these logarithmic terms, which can be packaged into negative semi-definiteness of their angular Hessians. We also derive constraints on the continuation of these coefficients to Lorentzian kinematics. We compute these coefficients and verify the constraints explicitly in free scalar and Maxwell theories and in planar $\mathcal N=4$ super-Yang-Mills theory at weak coupling for various choices of boundary conditions. At strong coupling, we compute the logarithmic coefficients in the holographic D3-D5 defect CFT and find a Gross-Ooguri-like phase transition between competing string worldsheets driven by the geometry of the cusp relative to the interface. We also observe a close connection of the cusp free energy in this setup with holographic corner entanglement entropy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“反射正性”“推导约束”“弱耦合计算”“强耦合全息计算”等理论推导与计算关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：共形场论（CFT）中带尖角（cusp）的线缺陷，特别是存在平面共形边界或界面时的尖角反常维度（cusp anomalous dimension）及其动力学性质。具体体系包括自由标量场、Maxwell理论、平面N=4超Yang-Mills理论以及全息D3-D5缺陷CFT。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在存在边界或界面的情况下，尖角缺陷的自由能包含两个对数项：短距离项由通常的真空尖角反常维度主导，长距离项则敏感于边界或界面。反射正性要求这些对数系数的角Hessian矩阵为负半定，从而给出动力学约束；在强耦合全息D3-D5体系中，发现由尖角相对界面的几何驱动的Gross-Ooguri型相变，并观察到尖角自由能与全息角纠缠熵的密切联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在存在边界或界面的情况下，尖角缺陷的自由能包含两个对数项：短距离项由通常的真空尖角反常维度主导，长距离项则敏感于边界或界面。反射正性要求这些对数系数的角Hessian矩阵为负半定，从而给出动力学约束；在强耦合全息D3-D5体系中，发现由尖角相对界面的几何驱动的Gross-Ooguri型相变，并观察到尖角自由能与全息角纠缠熵的密切联系。；创新点：将尖角反常维度的概念推广到存在共形边界或界面的几何中，引入三个角度和尖角到边界距离两个标度，并首次推导出对数系数的负半定Hessian约束；在全息设置中发现由几何驱动的Gross-Ooguri型相变，并建立与全息角纠缠熵的联系。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 利用反射正性（reflection positivity）对缺陷射线的横向形变推导约束条件；在弱耦合下对自由标量、Maxwell理论和平面N=4超Yang-Mills理论进行显式微扰计算；在强耦合下利用全息AdS/CFT对应（D3-D5缺陷CFT）计算对数系数，并分析竞争弦世界面的相变行为。

papers.title: Fabrication-free assessment of microwave losses in germanium-based dielectrics and superconductors
papers.abstract: We present a flip-chip-based sensing scheme to measure effective microwave losses associated with target materials for quantum technologies, without requiring any device fabrication on the material under test. Using this approach, we quantify the microwave losses of a strain-engineered Ge/SiGe quantum well heterostructure and investigate losses arising from its Ge substrate and intermediate layers. The quality factors of the fabricated microwave resonators agree with the losses of dielectric materials independently extracted from flip-chip sensing measurements. We further study the superconductor platinum silicon germanide (PtSiGe) prepared by thermal reaction with a deposited Pt film, finding high microwave losses that limit the suitability of the films studied here as the sole superconductor for high-quality resonator applications. By coating Pt with Nb prior to the reaction, we observe a substantial reduction in microwave loss and a nearly three-fold enhancement of the transport critical temperature. The temperature dependence of the microwave loss is consistent with gap inhomogeneity in both superconducting films. These results identify constraints on material choices, provide design guidance for microwave circuits on planar Ge heterostructures, and demonstrate a fast-turnaround testing method for new materials for superconducting quantum circuits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体的测量方案（flip-chip sensing）、器件制备（微波谐振器、薄膜热反应）以及实验测量结果（品质因子、临界温度、微波损耗的温度依赖）。；研究对象：锗基介电材料（应变工程 Ge/SiGe 量子阱异质结构及其 Ge 衬底和中间层）以及超导体铂硅锗化物（PtSiGe）薄膜，关注其在超导量子电路中的微波损耗特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种无需在待测材料上制备器件的倒装芯片传感方案，可独立提取介电材料的微波损耗；研究发现纯 Pt 热反应生成的 PtSiGe 薄膜微波损耗过高，不适合单独用作高品质谐振器的超导体，而在反应前用 Nb 包覆 Pt 可显著降低微波损耗并将输运临界温度提升近三倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种无需在待测材料上制备器件的倒装芯片传感方案，可独立提取介电材料的微波损耗；研究发现纯 Pt 热反应生成的 PtSiGe 薄膜微波损耗过高，不适合单独用作高品质谐振器的超导体，而在反应前用 Nb 包覆 Pt 可显著降低微波损耗并将输运临界温度提升近三倍。；创新点：提出了一种快速、免加工的微波损耗评估方法，可独立表征目标材料的介电损耗，并首次系统研究了 PtSiGe 作为超导量子电路材料的微波损耗特性及其 Nb 包覆改性效果。
papers.method_zh: 倒装芯片（flip-chip）传感测量方案（无需对待测材料进行器件加工）；微波谐振器品质因子测量；薄膜热反应制备（Pt 与 Ge 反应生成 PtSiGe，以及 Pt 先包覆 Nb 再反应）；输运临界温度测量；微波损耗随温度变化的测量。

papers.title: Euclidean Fourier Neural Operators
papers.abstract: Fourier neural operators (FNOs) provide an efficient framework for learning mappings between function spaces as they are, by construction, independent of the grid resolution at which they are trained and evaluated. However, FNOs are not independent of the periodic domain they are applied to: their discrete spectral weights are indexed by integer Fourier mode numbers, which correspond to physical wavevectors. When applied to a different domain, the same trained weights act at different wavevectors, and the FNO silently represents a different operator. This makes FNOs unsuitable for tasks where transfer across domains is crucial. We propose Euclidean Fourier neural operators~(EFNOs) as a domain-independent alternative to FNOs. By parameterizing the spectral kernel as a continuous function of the physical wavevector, the EFNO can learn operators that act consistently across periodic domains of varying shape and size. We evaluate the EFNO on a simple heat equation and on a practically relevant materials science task of learning exchange-correlation potentials across different crystal structures, and demonstrate that the EFNO is able to generalize to unseen grid sizes and domains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：提出新的神经网络架构（EFNO），并在热方程和材料科学任务上进行数值评估。；研究对象：函数空间之间的映射学习，具体应用于晶体结构中的交换关联势预测（材料科学任务），以及热方程求解。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出欧几里得傅里叶神经算子（EFNO），通过将谱核参数化为物理波矢的连续函数，使算子学习不受周期性域的形状和大小限制，能够泛化到未见过的网格尺寸和域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出欧几里得傅里叶神经算子（EFNO），通过将谱核参数化为物理波矢的连续函数，使算子学习不受周期性域的形状和大小限制，能够泛化到未见过的网格尺寸和域。；创新点：解决了标准FNO对周期性域形状和大小的依赖性问题——标准FNO的离散谱权重对应特定物理波矢，迁移到不同域时会静默地表示不同算子；EFNO通过连续化谱核实现跨域一致性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于傅里叶神经算子（FNO）的架构改进：将离散的整数傅里叶模式权重替换为物理波矢的连续函数参数化。在简单热方程和不同晶体结构的交换关联势学习任务上进行评估。

papers.title: Full-field fluorescence computed tomography (F3CT) using a calibrated virtual cone-beam pinhole geometry
papers.abstract: We present F3CT, a synchrotron-based hyperspectral full-field fluorescence computed tomography technique that avoids raster scanning by combining a pinhole aperture with an energy-resolving 2D detector. A virtual cone-beam model and two-stage calibration-reconstruction workflow enable 3D elemental mapping under full-field illumination. The method is demonstrated on biological and geological specimens, resolving silver-stain distributions in zebrafish tissue and high-energy fluorescence signatures in rock cores. Phase-contrast tomograms acquired sequentially under the same experimental geometry provide co-registered structural context. F3CT provides a high-throughput route to 3D XRF imaging and establishes a foundation for correlated structural and chemical tomography, with potential for future in-situ and operando implementations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了一种新的实验技术（F3CT），并在生物和地质样品上进行了演示，属于实验方法学工作。；研究对象：研究对象是三维元素分布成像技术，具体应用于生物样品（斑马鱼组织中的银染色分布）和地质样品（岩心中的高能荧光特征）。物理现象涉及X射线荧光（XRF）成像和相位衬度成像。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: F3CT技术能够在全场照明条件下实现三维元素分布成像，无需光栅扫描，并在同一实验几何下依次获取相位衬度断层图像，提供共配准的结构背景，从而建立结构-化学联合断层成像的框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：F3CT技术能够在全场照明条件下实现三维元素分布成像，无需光栅扫描，并在同一实验几何下依次获取相位衬度断层图像，提供共配准的结构背景，从而建立结构-化学联合断层成像的框架。；创新点：避免了光栅扫描，通过全场照明和虚拟锥束针孔几何实现高通量三维XRF成像，并实现了同一几何下结构（相位衬度）与化学（荧光）断层图像的天然共配准，为未来原位和操作条件（in-situ/operando）下的关联成像奠定基础。
papers.method_zh: 同步辐射光源下的高光谱全场荧光计算机断层扫描（F3CT），结合针孔孔径与能量分辨二维探测器；采用虚拟锥束模型和两阶段标定-重建工作流；同时使用相位衬度断层成像获取结构信息。

papers.title: Inclination-Induced Crossover in the Velocity Scaling of Lubrication-Mediated Droplet Motion
papers.abstract: We experimentally investigate the creeping motion of water droplets sliding along an inclined surface immersed in a viscous oil. The droplet velocity, width, and height are measured over a broad range of droplet sizes and inclination angles. The velocity increases with droplet radius according to a power law, but the corresponding exponent depends strongly on the inclination angle. At small inclinations, the exponent is close to 3/2, whereas at larger inclinations it progressively approaches 9/4. The results therefore reveal a continuous inclination-induced crossover in the velocity-size scaling of lubrication-mediated droplet motion. A scaling analysis based on Landau-Levich-Derjaguin film formation and viscous dissipation in the dynamic meniscus reproduces these limiting behaviors, which correspond to the quasi-spherical and pancake scaling regimes, respectively. Remarkably, the evolution of the velocity scaling is substantially more pronounced than the corresponding evolution of the macroscopic droplet shape. While the velocity data progressively approach the pancake scaling law at large inclinations, the global droplet dimensions evolve in a more complex manner than expected from a simple pancake-shape picture. In particular, the approach to pancake-like velocity scaling occurs even when the measured droplet dimensions remain far from the corresponding pancake-limit geometry. These observations suggest a crossover in the dominant lubrication-dissipation mechanism beneath the droplet that is not directly reflected in the global droplet morphology. The results identify inclination angle as a key control parameter governing lubrication-mediated droplet motion and highlight the distinction between global shape evolution and local dissipation dynamics in liquid-liquid systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“experimentally investigate”，并包含对液滴速度、宽度、高度等物理量的直接测量。；研究对象：浸没在粘性油中的倾斜固体表面上，水液滴沿斜面爬行的运动体系。具体物理现象为润滑介导的液滴运动（lubrication-mediated droplet motion），重点关注液滴速度随尺寸的标度行为及其随倾斜角度的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 液滴速度随半径呈幂律增长，但幂指数随倾斜角度发生连续交叉：小倾角时指数接近3/2，大倾角时逐渐趋近9/4。该标度交叉源于液滴下方主导润滑耗散机制的转变，且这一转变并不直接反映在液滴宏观形状的演化中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：液滴速度随半径呈幂律增长，但幂指数随倾斜角度发生连续交叉：小倾角时指数接近3/2，大倾角时逐渐趋近9/4。该标度交叉源于液滴下方主导润滑耗散机制的转变，且这一转变并不直接反映在液滴宏观形状的演化中。；创新点：首次揭示倾斜角度作为控制参数可连续调节润滑介导液滴运动的速度-尺寸标度指数（从3/2到9/4的交叉），并发现速度标度的演化与宏观液滴形状的演化显著脱耦——即使液滴几何远未达到薄饼极限，速度标度已趋近薄饼规律，表明局部耗散动力学与全局形态演化存在本质区别。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量：在不同液滴尺寸和倾斜角度范围内，系统测量液滴的速度、宽度和高度。理论分析：基于Landau-Levich-Derjaguin（LLD）薄膜形成和动态弯月面中的粘性耗散进行标度分析，用以解释准球形（quasi-spherical）和薄饼状（pancake）两种极限标度行为。

papers.title: Three-dimensional optical vortices in nonlinear Bessel waveguides
papers.abstract: We explore the formation, stability, and propagation dynamics of light bullets carrying orbital angular momentum (vorticity) in Bessel-structured nonlinear graded-index waveguides. While these waves are prone to the collapse in uniform three-dimensional media, we demonstrate that their stabilization is provided by a squared-Bessel index profile in the plane orthogonal to the propagation direction, which may play the role of the waveguiding or antiwaveguiding potential. Different solution families are obtained, revealing a variety of power-vs.-propagation-constant diagrams, characterizing the coexistence of multiple families. We analyze the propagation dynamics in a wide experimentally accessible parameter range. Our results contribute to the understanding of nonlinear light localization in multidimensional settings and suggest new possibilities for using structured light in advanced photonic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中关键词为“explore”“demonstrate”“obtained”“analyze”，未提及实验手段，属于理论建模与数值分析。；研究对象：三维非线性介质中携带轨道角动量（涡旋）的光子弹（light bullets），具体体系为具有Bessel结构（平方Bessel折射率分布）的非线性梯度折射率波导。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在均匀三维介质中易发生塌缩的涡旋光子弹，可通过在传播方向正交平面上引入平方Bessel折射率分布（可充当波导或反波导势）实现稳定化；该体系中存在多种解族，其功率-传播常数图呈现丰富结构，表明多个解族可共存。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在均匀三维介质中易发生塌缩的涡旋光子弹，可通过在传播方向正交平面上引入平方Bessel折射率分布（可充当波导或反波导势）实现稳定化；该体系中存在多种解族，其功率-传播常数图呈现丰富结构，表明多个解族可共存。；创新点：首次在Bessel结构非线性波导中系统研究三维涡旋光子弹的稳定化机制，揭示了平方Bessel势（兼具波导与反波导功能）对多维非线性光局域的调控作用，并展示了多解族共存的新奇相图。摘要未突出说明与具体实验平台的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值模拟：基于非线性波动方程（推测为非线性薛定谔方程或类似模型），引入平方Bessel型折射率势，求解涡旋光子弹的定态解族，并分析其功率-传播常数关系及在实验可达参数范围内的传播动力学稳定性。

papers.title: Lattice Green's function of the hyperkagome lattice: modular uniformization at level 30 from an orthogonal differential Galois group
papers.abstract: The lattice Green's functions of the cubic lattices are classical: each is a symmetric square of a second-order operator, with a closed form in complete elliptic integrals. The hyperkagome lattice, realized by the iridium sublattice of the spin-liquid candidate Na4Ir3O8, has resisted such a treatment: Varma and Monien reduced its density of states to a threefold integral they found no way to solve exactly. From exact lattice moments we obtain an irreducible third-order linear differential (Picard-Fuchs) operator annihilating the Green's function. It is not a literal symmetric square, yet its symmetric square carries a rational solution: the differential Galois group is orthogonal, and an order-two differential intertwiner makes the operator projectively a symmetric square. Our main result is that the underlying second-order operator is the uniformizing equation of the genus-zero modular curve of Gamma_0(30)+, the level-thirty group generated by Gamma_0(30) and all its Atkin-Lehner involutions, an explicit eta quotient parametrizing the natural variable. That uniformizing equation is itself not new - it is a row of the Lian-Yau table of genus-zero groups - so what is new here is the identification of a lattice Green's function with it, together with a proof: the Schwarzian identity is established by an a priori pole-degree bound rather than checked numerically, which also proves the tabulated entry. The hyperkagome Green's function is therefore modular at level thirty, supplying the closed form Varma and Monien sought. Its weight-two period is obtained explicitly: a depth-one quasimodular form which we prove is not a modular form times an algebraic function at any weight.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要涉及微分算子、微分伽罗瓦群、模曲线等纯数学物理理论推导，无实验数据或数值模拟关键词。；研究对象：hyperkagome 晶格（具体为自旋液体候选材料 Na₄Ir₃O₈ 的铱子晶格）的格点格林函数及其态密度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: hyperkagome 晶格的格林函数满足一个三阶 Picard-Fuchs 微分方程，其对应的二阶算子正是 Γ₀(30)+ 模曲线的均匀化方程，因此该格林函数具有 level-30 模性，从而提供了 Varma 和 Monien 所求的闭式解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：hyperkagome 晶格的格林函数满足一个三阶 Picard-Fuchs 微分方程，其对应的二阶算子正是 Γ₀(30)+ 模曲线的均匀化方程，因此该格林函数具有 level-30 模性，从而提供了 Varma 和 Monien 所求的闭式解。；创新点：首次将具体晶格（hyperkagome）的格林函数与 level-30 模曲线均匀化方程建立严格对应，并给出了 Schwarzian 恒等式的解析证明（同时证明了 Lian-Yau 表中该条目的正确性）；此外证明了该权重二周期在任何权重下都不是模形式乘以代数函数。
papers.method_zh: 利用精确格点矩（lattice moments）构造不可约三阶线性微分算子；通过对称平方与二阶微分交织算子分析微分伽罗瓦群的正交性；利用 Schwarzian 恒等式（以先验极点阶数界而非数值验证）证明与 Lian-Yau 表中 Γ₀(30)+ 均匀化方程的同一性；显式给出权重二周期（深度一拟模形式）。

papers.title: Self-partitioned Interfacial Time Crystals
papers.abstract: Nonequilibrium many-body systems can spontaneously break symmetry in time, as in time crystals, or in space, through self-organized domains and interfaces. Whether these two forms of symmetry breaking can intertwine so that an emergent interface alone hosts time-crystalline order remains unknown. In this work, by introducing the Rabi-Hatano-Nelson model, we unveil the existence and mechanism of a self-partitioned interfacial time crystal (SPITC), where a homogeneous system generates its own internal and tunable interface, at which the time-translation symmetry is also spontaneously broken. Such a SPITC phase is intrinsically induced by nonreciprocity and open boundary conditions, without external pumping or long-range interaction. The periodic and open boundary phase diagrams of the system are both mapped out; vacuum and Dicke-like superradiance with static or active orders are identified, with analytical phase boundaries in the weak coupling limit. The frequency of the SPITC is found to scale quadratically with the spin-photon coupling strength, as we derive analytically for the slow dynamics of the spins. The position of the SPITC boundary scales with a critical exponent of $-1$ as a function of the degree of nonreciprocity, in stark contrast to $-1/2$ for an otherwise stationary boundary. Our construction of SPITC establishes a route to spatiotemporal order in non-Hermitian many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：理论模型（Rabi-Hatano-Nelson模型）、解析推导（analytically）、相图分析。；研究对象：非厄米多体系统中的时间晶体与空间自组织界面，具体为自旋-光子耦合的Rabi-Hatano-Nelson模型，研究其非互易性驱动的界面时间晶体相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种自分割界面时间晶体（SPITC）相：均匀系统在非互易性和开放边界条件下自发产生内部可调界面，并在该界面上同时自发破缺时间平移对称性，无需外部泵浦或长程相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种自分割界面时间晶体（SPITC）相：均匀系统在非互易性和开放边界条件下自发产生内部可调界面，并在该界面上同时自发破缺时间平移对称性，无需外部泵浦或长程相互作用。；创新点：首次证明时间平移对称性破缺可以仅局域在系统自发产生的内部界面上（而非整个体积），建立了非厄米多体系统中时空序的新实现途径；揭示了SPITC界面位置临界指数（-1）与静态边界（-1/2）的显著差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与解析分析：构建Rabi-Hatano-Nelson模型，绘制周期与开放边界条件下的相图，识别真空态和Dicke型超辐射相（静态或活性序），并在弱耦合极限下解析推导相边界；对自旋慢动力学进行解析求解，得到SPITC频率与自旋-光子耦合强度的二次方标度关系，以及界面位置随非互易度的临界指数-1标度。

papers.title: Projected q-Shells for Nested Gausslet Bases
papers.abstract: Electronic-structure calculations require a finite representation of both the electronic wave functions and their Coulomb interaction. Conventional compact basis sets lead to a four-index interaction. Gausslet basis sets are one of a very small number of approaches that allow a much smaller two-index interaction, similar to a real-space grid, but with far fewer points. The continuing challenge in their development is reducing further the number of functions needed while maintaining high accuracy. Here we introduce projected q-shells (PQS), an improvement to the nested Cartesian gausslets of White and Lindsey. Their standard nesting construction divides a joining shell into disjoint faces, edges, and corners, reducing its polynomial completeness from order q to order q-2. PQS approximately restores the two lost orders. In terms of completeness, we prove that for an ideal, undistorted parent, the span of the PQS basis is equivalent to an overcomplete basis of overlapping patches. Coordinate distortions, which are always used in practice, harm this equivalence only slightly. The moment properties that allow two-index interactions also become inexact, even without distortion, but we show that the improvement in order more than makes up for this loss. For similar basis sizes, PQS gives smaller one-electron and interaction errors on small molecules, such as H2+, H2, and C2, than standard nesting. The improvement is largest for more compact bases with smaller q.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算方法文章。判断依据：摘要涉及基组构造、多项式完备性证明、误差分析等理论推导，以及小分子上的数值测试。；研究对象：电子结构计算中的基组表示方法，具体为嵌套笛卡尔Gausslet基组的改进方案，研究对象是H₂⁺、H₂、C₂等小分子体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了投影q壳层（PQS）方法，可近似恢复标准嵌套构造中丢失的两个多项式完备阶数，在相近基组规模下比标准嵌套方案给出更小的一电子和相互作用误差，且对更紧凑的小q基组改进最大。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了投影q壳层（PQS）方法，可近似恢复标准嵌套构造中丢失的两个多项式完备阶数，在相近基组规模下比标准嵌套方案给出更小的一电子和相互作用误差，且对更紧凑的小q基组改进最大。；创新点：针对White和Lindsey嵌套笛卡尔Gausslet基组中连接壳层被分割为不相交面、边、角而导致多项式完备性从q阶降至q-2阶的问题，提出PQS方案以近似恢复丢失的两个阶数，同时保持双指标相互作用的优势。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论证明与数值测试相结合。通过证明理想无畸变父基下PQS基组的张成空间等价于重叠块的过完备基，分析坐标畸变对该等价性的影响；并在H₂⁺、H₂、C₂小分子上对比PQS与标准嵌套基组的一电子和相互作用误差。

papers.title: Compact Variational Neural Networks for Spectral Inference from a Single Nonlinear 2D Perovskite Photodetector
papers.abstract: Spectroscopy conventionally separates optical frequencies before detection, imposing persistent constraints on footprint, complexity and scalability. Here we establish an alternative paradigm in which the nonlinear optoelectronic dynamics of a single two-dimensional perovskite photodetector physically encode the incident optical field and machine learning performs the inverse spectral reconstruction. Using a planar fluorinated phenethylammonium lead iodide (F-PEAI) photodetector, we exploit wavelength- and irradiance-dependent current-voltage signatures arising from the coupled effects of photocarrier generation, trapping, interfacial transport and field-dependent carrier dynamics. A compact variational encoder-decoder preserves the functional and history-dependent structure of these responses by independently projecting forward and reverse voltage sweeps onto a truncated Legendre-polynomial basis before mapping them through a probabilistic latent representation to continuous spectral parameters. Trained on fewer than 400 experimental voltage sweeps, the model generalises to excitation wavelengths excluded from training, reconstructing wavelength with $R^2=0.958$ and a mean absolute error of 8.1 nm, while recovering log-normalised irradiance with $R^2=0.987$. Voltage-resolved analysis further reveals that wavelength and irradiance are encoded differently across the nonlinear device response, with distinct bias regions carrying complementary optical information. These results establish nonlinear material and interface dynamics as a computational resource for spectroscopy and point towards hardware-algorithm co-design in which materials, interfaces and inference architectures are engineered jointly to maximise information content, enabling compact spectroscopic systems without dispersive optics or detector arrays.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+机器学习算法）。判断依据：摘要中描述了实际制备的二维钙钛矿光电探测器并进行电压扫描实验，同时构建了变分编码器-解码器神经网络进行光谱重建，属于实验与算法协同工作。；研究对象：二维氟化苯乙胺铅碘（F-PEAI）钙钛矿光电探测器，以及其非线性光电子动力学（光生载流子产生、俘获、界面输运、场依赖载流子动力学）对入射光场（波长与辐照度）的编码效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单个二维钙钛矿光电探测器的非线性电流-电压响应可物理编码入射光谱信息，结合紧凑变分神经网络，无需色散光学元件或探测器阵列即可实现单探测器光谱重建，波长重建R²=0.958（MAE=8.1 nm），辐照度重建R²=0.987。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单个二维钙钛矿光电探测器的非线性电流-电压响应可物理编码入射光谱信息，结合紧凑变分神经网络，无需色散光学元件或探测器阵列即可实现单探测器光谱重建，波长重建R²=0.958（MAE=8.1 nm），辐照度重建R²=0.987。；创新点：将非线性材料与界面动力学本身作为光谱计算资源，提出硬件-算法协同设计范式——材料、界面与推理架构联合优化以最大化信息含量，实现无分散光学元件、无探测器阵列的紧凑光谱系统。摘要未突出说明与传统计算光谱方法（如压缩感知）的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用平面F-PEAI光电探测器，测量波长和辐照度依赖的电流-电压特性（正反向电压扫描）；算法上采用紧凑变分编码器-解码器，将正反向电压扫描独立投影到截断Legendre多项式基上，再通过概率潜变量映射到连续光谱参数。训练数据少于400条实验电压扫描曲线。

papers.title: A different kind of continuum limit for the three-dimensional U(1) gauge theory
papers.abstract: In three-dimensional compact U(1) lattice gauge theory color confinement can be understood analytically through the dynamics of magnetic monopoles. However, its continuum limit is pathological, since the ratio of the glueball masses to the square root of the string tension vanishes as the continuum limit is approached. We investigate a simple extension of the Wilson action in which the total number of lattice monopoles is coupled to an additional parameter $μ$. By tuning $β$ and $μ$ simultaneously, we identify a line of constant physics along which the ratio of the lightest glueball mass to the square root of the string tension remains constant. We further show that the same scaling is satisfied, within numerical uncertainties, by the other low-lying glueball masses considered in this work. Along this trajectory, the string tension in lattice units decreases with increasing $β$, thus suggesting that the modified lattice action may provide a regularization of three-dimensional compact U(1) gauge theory with a physically well-behaved continuum limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。依据：摘要涉及解析论证（“can be understood analytically”）与数值模拟（“within numerical uncertainties”），属于格点规范理论的计算研究。；研究对象：三维紧致 U(1) 格点规范理论，即三维紧致 QED，重点关注其磁单极子动力学、色禁闭以及连续极限行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过同时调节 Wilson 作用量中的 β 和额外参数 μ，找到一条恒定物理线，沿此线最轻胶球质量与弦张力平方根之比保持不变，且其他低 lying 胶球质量也满足相同标度；沿该轨迹弦张力在格点单位下随 β 增大而减小，暗示该修正作用量可能提供具有良好连续极限的三维紧致 U(1) 规范理论的正则化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过同时调节 Wilson 作用量中的 β 和额外参数 μ，找到一条恒定物理线，沿此线最轻胶球质量与弦张力平方根之比保持不变，且其他低 lying 胶球质量也满足相同标度；沿该轨迹弦张力在格点单位下随 β 增大而减小，暗示该修正作用量可能提供具有良好连续极限的三维紧致 U(1) 规范理论的正则化。；创新点：提出一种不同于标准 Wilson 作用量的连续极限方案，通过引入磁单极子数耦合参数 μ 并沿恒定物理线调参，规避了标准三维紧致 U(1) 理论中胶球质量与弦张力平方根之比趋于零的病态连续极限。
papers.method_zh: 格点规范理论方法：在 Wilson 作用量基础上引入与格点磁单极子总数耦合的额外参数 μ，通过同时调节 β 和 μ 进行数值模拟，测量胶球质量与弦张力并检验其标度行为。

papers.title: Vectorized Symmetric and Fermionic Tensor Network Implementations for GPU-Accelerated Variational Monte Carlo
papers.abstract: Variational Monte Carlo (VMC) calculations based on tensor networks (TN) have recently achieved competitive accuracy in ground-state calculations of strongly correlated spin and fermionic systems. However, existing tensor network VMC (TN-VMC) algorithms have not been formulated in a manner that can fully utilize GPU acceleration. We tackle the key missing ingredient, namely, the vectorized evaluation of tensor network amplitudes and tensor network operations. This ensures high GPU utilization by batching over computations with identical structure. In particular, we show how to achieve vectorization for the practically relevant case of abelian symmetric tensor networks (which includes fermionic tensor networks) by developing a ``flat'' tensor network formalism for block-sparse tensor representation and contraction. Using this, we construct a GPU-adapted symmetric TN-VMC workflow with batched tensor network computation. In the two-dimensional Fermi--Hubbard model, we demonstrate a GPU speedup of up to $300 \times$ over single core CPU implementations, for fermionic TN variational wavefunctions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要聚焦于算法实现与数值方法（Variational Monte Carlo、tensor network、GPU加速），并给出计算性能数据（GPU speedup）。；研究对象：强关联自旋和费米子体系，具体以二维Fermi–Hubbard模型为测试平台，研究其基态性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入“扁平”张量网络形式化，实现了阿贝尔对称（含费米子）张量网络的矢量化计算，使张量网络变分蒙特卡洛（TN-VMC）方法能充分利用GPU并行加速，在二维Fermi–Hubbard模型中获得高达300倍的GPU加速比（相对于单核CPU）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入“扁平”张量网络形式化，实现了阿贝尔对称（含费米子）张量网络的矢量化计算，使张量网络变分蒙特卡洛（TN-VMC）方法能充分利用GPU并行加速，在二维Fermi–Hubbard模型中获得高达300倍的GPU加速比（相对于单核CPU）。；创新点：首次将TN-VMC算法系统性地矢量化，使其能高效利用GPU加速；针对阿贝尔对称（含费米子）张量网络开发了“扁平”块稀疏表示与收缩方案，解决了此前TN-VMC无法充分利用GPU的关键缺失环节。
papers.method_zh: 张量网络变分蒙特卡洛（TN-VMC），结合块稀疏张量表示与收缩的“扁平”张量网络形式化，并采用批量（batched）张量网络计算以适配GPU架构。具体张量网络类型（如PEPS、MPS等）摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Mode-Specific Dynamics of $\text{CO}_2$ Hydrogenation on Copper: The Hidden Role of Molecular Rotation
papers.abstract: Catalytic hydrogenation of $\text{CO}_2$ to formate on copper is a key elementary step for $\text{CO}_2$ utilization. Previous experimental and theoretical studies suggested an Eley-Rideal mechanism for this reaction, promoted by bending vibrational excitation, yet direct state resolved evidence remains lacking. Here, we present first-principles dynamical predictions for $\text{CO}_2$ hydrogenation on Cu(111) based on an accurate full-dimensional neural network potential energy surface. Our calculations near-quantitatively reproduce the measured reaction probabilities, including their nozzle-temperature and incidence-energy dependence. Our state-resolved results indicate that while vibrational excitation of the bending mode enhances reactivity, it alone cannot account for the observed reactivity increase with nozzle temperature. Instead, rotational excitation plays a dominant role, mainly attributable to the significant change in anisotropy of the molecular polar orientation as $\text{CO}_2$ accesses the transition state. This mode-specific insight reinforces the hidden role of rotation in surface reactivity, opening new avenues for state-selective control of $\text{CO}_2$ hydrogenation on heterogenous catalysts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“first-principles dynamical predictions”“full-dimensional neural network potential energy surface”，属于第一性原理动力学计算。；研究对象：CO₂在Cu(111)表面的催化加氢生成甲酸盐（formate）反应，重点关注该反应中分子振动与转动激发对反应概率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CO₂弯曲振动激发确实能增强反应活性，但仅凭振动激发无法解释实验中随喷嘴温度升高的反应概率增加；分子转动激发才是主导因素，其作用源于CO₂接近过渡态时分子极性取向的各向异性发生显著变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CO₂弯曲振动激发确实能增强反应活性，但仅凭振动激发无法解释实验中随喷嘴温度升高的反应概率增加；分子转动激发才是主导因素，其作用源于CO₂接近过渡态时分子极性取向的各向异性发生显著变化。；创新点：首次从态分辨（state-resolved）角度揭示转动激发在CO₂加氢表面反应中的主导作用，修正了此前仅强调弯曲振动促进的Eley-Rideal机制图像，为异质催化中CO₂加氢的态选择性控制提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 基于全维神经网络势能面（full-dimensional neural network potential energy surface）的第一性原理动力学计算，并与实验测得的反应概率（包括喷嘴温度和入射能量依赖关系）进行近定量对比。

papers.title: Fractional Hall Conductance of Laughlin States from a Topological Index
papers.abstract: We provide a rigorous Laughlin-pump argument that establishes the fractional quantization of the Hall conductance directly from the Laughlin state as a topological index. Our proof uses a recently defined index of a pair of pure states together with an infinite matrix product state analysis that is rigorous on a sufficiently thin cylinder. By virtue of the connection to an index, our result implies, in particular, that Laughlin states are representatives of topologically stable fractional quantum Hall phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“rigorous Laughlin-pump argument”“topological index”“infinite matrix product state analysis”等纯理论推导与数学严格性表述，无实验或数值计算关键词。；研究对象：Laughlin态（分数量子霍尔态）的霍尔电导量子化问题，具体关注薄圆柱几何下的Laughlin态及其拓扑稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过严格的Laughlin泵浦论证，直接从Laughlin态出发证明了霍尔电导的分数量子化，并将其确立为一个拓扑指标；该结果意味着Laughlin态是拓扑稳定的分数量子霍尔相的典型代表。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过严格的Laughlin泵浦论证，直接从Laughlin态出发证明了霍尔电导的分数量子化，并将其确立为一个拓扑指标；该结果意味着Laughlin态是拓扑稳定的分数量子霍尔相的典型代表。；创新点：首次从Laughlin态本身（而非仅从模型哈密顿量或线性响应理论）出发，通过拓扑指标给出霍尔电导分数量子化的严格证明，并直接建立了Laughlin态与拓扑稳定相之间的形式化联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：结合最近定义的“一对纯态指标”（index of a pair of pure states）与无限矩阵乘积态（infinite MPS）分析；论证在足够薄的圆柱几何下严格成立，属于数学物理严格证明方法。

papers.title: Noise-robust navigation from an adaptive run-and-tumble policy
papers.abstract: How do organisms navigate when the signals guiding them are noisy? Variance adaptation, the rescaling of sensitivity to noise, is common in sensory systems, but its role in navigation is unexplored. We introduce a minimal active Brownian particle whose run-and-tumble policy follows from an optimality principle. Variance adaptation emerges as part of this policy. Adaptation keeps chemotactic drift finite as noise grows, while a non-adaptive particle's collapses exponentially. Adaptation also carries a cost, degrading performance in quiet environments and requiring a tuned adaptation sensitivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“minimal active Brownian particle”“optimality principle”“policy”等理论建模与最优性原理关键词。；研究对象：活性布朗粒子在噪声环境中的趋化导航行为，具体为run-and-tumble（跑停/游动-翻滚）运动策略下的化学趋向性导航。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 方差自适应（variance adaptation）作为最优run-and-tumble策略的涌现性质，能使趋化漂移在噪声增大时保持有限，而非自适应粒子的趋化漂移则呈指数衰减；但自适应在安静环境中会降低导航性能，且需要调节自适应灵敏度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：方差自适应（variance adaptation）作为最优run-and-tumble策略的涌现性质，能使趋化漂移在噪声增大时保持有限，而非自适应粒子的趋化漂移则呈指数衰减；但自适应在安静环境中会降低导航性能，且需要调节自适应灵敏度。；创新点：首次将方差自适应（感官系统中常见的噪声重定标机制）引入导航策略研究，并证明其作为最优策略的涌现性质而非预设机制，同时揭示了自适应在噪声环境中的收益与在安静环境中的代价之间的权衡。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与最优性原理分析：引入最小活性布朗粒子模型，通过最优性原理推导run-and-tumble策略，并对比自适应与非自适应粒子的趋化漂移行为。

papers.title: Error-Adaptive Quasi-local Decoding of the Toric Code
papers.abstract: Topological quantum memories need decoders that are both reliable and scalable, but these goals compete: globally informed decoders are accurate near threshold yet expensive, while strictly local rules are fast but can miss long-range structure. Motivated by recent recoverability and mixed-state viewpoints, we make this tradeoff operational for the dephased toric code through a decoder-level local recoverability diagnostic. We compare global MWPM corrections to quasi-local corrections inside a target region and define a matching ratio $R_{\mathrm{match}}$, with mismatch $ε_{\mathrm{match}}=1-R_{\mathrm{match}}$. Across geometry families, $ε_{\mathrm{match}}$ shows strong buffer-controlled suppression and is well organized by a two-geometry scaling form. For scaled families, especially $a=b=d/8$, $R_{\mathrm{match}}$ exhibits a clear crossing and finite-size collapse near $p\!\sim\!0.09$, consistent with a growing recoverability scale near the decoding transition. We use this scaling to formulate an adaptive buffer-selection rule and to identify a distance-scaled initialization for a composite quasi-local RG decoder on the full torus. In the tuned family $a_0=b_0=d/8$, the resulting logical-failure curves show an apparent finite-size crossing at $p\simeq0.09$--$0.10$, below the conventional MWPM threshold scale. We focus on dephasing noise with perfect syndrome measurements to cleanly isolate the underlying behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：decoder-level diagnostic、scaling form、finite-size collapse、数值模拟（逻辑失效率曲线）。；研究对象：退相位噪声下的环面码（toric code）拓扑量子存储，具体研究其纠错解码器在局部与全局信息权衡下的性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过定义局部可恢复性诊断量（匹配率 R_match 及其失配率 ε_match），发现准局部解码的失配率受缓冲区大小强烈抑制，并满足双几何标度律；在调优几何族 a₀=b₀=d/8 下，逻辑失效率曲线在 p≃0.09–0.10 处出现有限尺寸交叉，低于传统 MWPM 阈值标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过定义局部可恢复性诊断量（匹配率 R_match 及其失配率 ε_match），发现准局部解码的失配率受缓冲区大小强烈抑制，并满足双几何标度律；在调优几何族 a₀=b₀=d/8 下，逻辑失效率曲线在 p≃0.09–0.10 处出现有限尺寸交叉，低于传统 MWPM 阈值标度。；创新点：将“局部可恢复性”诊断提升到解码器层面，使全局与局部解码的权衡变得可操作；提出基于标度行为的自适应缓冲区选择规则，并发现调优几何下准局部解码的有限尺寸交叉行为。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值模拟结合：对比全局最小权重完美匹配（MWPM）与目标区域内的准局部修正，定义匹配率 R_match；采用两几何标度形式分析失配率；基于标度行为设计自适应缓冲区选择规则，并构造距离标度初始化的复合准局部重整化群（RG）解码器；在完整环面上模拟逻辑失效率曲线。噪声模型为退相位噪声，且假设综合征测量完美。

papers.title: Deterministic control over launching efficiency of higher-order hyperbolic phonon polaritons
papers.abstract: Hyperbolic materials, which exhibit an extreme form of birefringence enabling the volume confinement and frequency-dependent propagation of deeply sub-diffractional optical modes, offer the opportunity for extreme confinement via the stimulation polaritonic modes, with substantially higher confinement obtained through the efficient excitation of of the higher-order (shorter wavelength) hyperbolic polaritonic modes, which they can support. However, while these higher-order hyperbolic polaritons (HO-HPhPs) form high-momentum ray-like propagation within the bulk, efficient excitation of these modes, especially in contrast to the long-wavelength lower-momentum surface polariton propagating modes, has remained a challenge. Critically, the large momentum mismatch between these modes and free-space light, alongside the spatial mismatch between the sub-diffractional scatterer and the distinct modal distribution of HO-HPhPs, lead to a suppressed launching efficiency of these higher-order modes, limiting their use in nanophotonic applications. Here, we report the experimental observation of a 10-fold enhancement in the excitation efficiency of HO-HPhPs through the use of subsurface scatterers over traditional surface scattering (e.g. a flake edge or gold launcher) within single-crystalline α-MoO3 slabs. We employ full-wave numerical simulations to investigate the role of the spatial overlap between HO-HPhP modal distributions and the scatterer placement upon excitation efficiency. Furthermore, we develop a generalized process using transfer matrix method to selectively design modal HO-HPhP excitation, which advances the capabilities of HPhP multiplexing for on-chip applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+数值模拟+理论建模）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experimental observation”（实验观察）、“full-wave numerical simulations”（全波数值模拟）以及“transfer matrix method”（传输矩阵方法）。；研究对象：单晶α-MoO3（α相三氧化钼）薄片中的高阶双曲声子极化激元（HO-HPhPs），具体关注其激发效率的调控机制，以及亚表面散射体（subsurface scatterers）与模态空间分布之间的耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在单晶α-MoO3中使用亚表面散射体替代传统表面散射体（如薄片边缘或金天线），实验上实现了高阶双曲声子极化激元激发效率的10倍增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在单晶α-MoO3中使用亚表面散射体替代传统表面散射体（如薄片边缘或金天线），实验上实现了高阶双曲声子极化激元激发效率的10倍增强。；创新点：首次实验证明通过将散射体置于亚表面位置可显著提升高阶双曲声子极化激元的激发效率（10倍增强），并建立了基于传输矩阵的通用设计框架，实现对高阶模态激发的选择性调控，为片上HPhP复用技术提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用亚表面散射体激发HO-HPhPs并与表面散射体对比；数值上使用全波电磁模拟（full-wave numerical simulations）分析HO-HPhP模态分布与散射体位置之间的空间重叠对激发效率的影响；理论上发展了一种基于传输矩阵方法（transfer matrix method）的通用流程，用于选择性设计特定模态的HO-HPhP激发。

papers.title: Criticality and universality in network dismantling
papers.abstract: Identifying the smallest set of elements whose removal dismantle a complex network, known as the network dismantling problem, is a fundamental task with many practical applications. Whereas network dismantling has been extensively studied over the past decade, most work has focused on developing efficient algorithms for large but finite networks. By contrast, the physics of the network dismantling process, namely how the network structural connectivity is affected by the removal of nodes or edges, remains largely unexplored in the thermodynamic limit. Here, we shed light on this understudied aspect of network dismantling by introducing an adaptive biased percolation process able to optimally dismantle a network. Through a systematic analysis of synthetic network models, we find that the proposed percolation process displays a universal phase transition, characterized by the abrupt and simultaneous disappearance of both the giant connected component and the largest 2-core, across networks with markedly different degree distributions. Simulations on real networks further support this universality, indicating that the physics of network dismantling is insensitive to a broad range of topological properties. Together, these results suggest that a topology-agnostic theory could be developed to explain the critical behavior of network dismantling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“引入自适应偏置渗流过程”“系统分析合成网络模型”“模拟真实网络”，属于理论建模与数值模拟结合的研究。；研究对象：复杂网络的拆解（network dismantling）问题，具体研究在热力学极限下，节点或边移除如何影响网络的结构连通性，以及该过程是否呈现临界现象与普适性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出的一种自适应偏置渗流过程在拆解网络时表现出普适的相变行为：巨连通分量与最大2-核同时且突然消失，且该行为在不同度分布的网络中一致，表明网络拆解的物理对拓扑细节不敏感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出的一种自适应偏置渗流过程在拆解网络时表现出普适的相变行为：巨连通分量与最大2-核同时且突然消失，且该行为在不同度分布的网络中一致，表明网络拆解的物理对拓扑细节不敏感。；创新点：以往研究主要关注有限大网络的高效拆解算法，本文首次在热力学极限下系统研究网络拆解过程的物理（临界性与普适性），并提出可能建立与拓扑无关的普适理论。
papers.method_zh: 引入一种自适应偏置渗流过程（adaptive biased percolation）用于最优拆解网络；对合成网络模型进行系统分析，并在真实网络上进行数值模拟验证。

papers.title: Pulling strings in real time: flux tube dynamics in (2+1)-d $\mathbb{Z}_2$-Higgs Gauge Theories
papers.abstract: Understanding real-time flux-tube dynamics in more than one spatial dimension is key to unlocking the non-perturbative physics of confinement, and is now actively pursued by quantum computing and simulation experiments. However, describing such dynamics has proven to be extremely challenging with both experiments and state-of-the-art numerical simulations limited to small volumes and short timescales. Here we investigate flux tube statics and real-time evolution in a genuine two-dimensional $\mathbb{Z}_2$ Higgs gauge theory at system sizes and timescales order of magnitude beyond present experiments and numerics. The key enabling element is the recently introduced Clifford-augmented matrix product states (CAMPS) framework, which we demonstrate to parametrically reduce the entanglement that must be represented in the matrix product state; both in the pure-gauge limit and in the presence of dynamical matter. We benchmark this capability through stringent tests of effective string theory, including universal spectral features and flux tube roughening properties in presence of matter. We then introduce a string-pull protocol that selectively excites transverse modes and reconstructs their finite-size spectrum in real time. In the rough regime, the response is collective, and our simulations show that this is also well captured by universal effective string theory predictions. Strong confinement instead produces long-lived, lattice-locked local dynamics persisting to times $tJ \gtrsim 100$. These results provide ab initio evidence that effective string theory captures nonequilibrium string dynamics and reveal a hitherto unexplored long-lived prethermal regime of strongly confined flux tubes, providing a novel angle on how confinement dictates dynamics in more than one spatial dimension.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“Clifford-augmented matrix product states (CAMPS) framework”、“simulations”、“effective string theory predictions”，属于数值模拟与理论分析结合的研究。；研究对象：二维（2+1维）$\mathbb{Z}_2$ Higgs 规范理论中的通量管（flux tube）静力学与实时动力学，重点关注禁闭（confinement）物理、通量管粗糙化（roughening）以及非平衡弦动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用 CAMPS 方法，作者在远超现有实验和数值模拟的体系尺寸与时间尺度上模拟了二维 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ Higgs 规范理论，发现有效弦理论能准确描述粗糙相中的集体非平衡响应；而在强禁闭区，通量管表现出持续至 $tJ \gtrsim 100$ 的长寿命、晶格锁定的局域动力学，揭示了一个此前未知的预热（prethermal） regime。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用 CAMPS 方法，作者在远超现有实验和数值模拟的体系尺寸与时间尺度上模拟了二维 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ Higgs 规范理论，发现有效弦理论能准确描述粗糙相中的集体非平衡响应；而在强禁闭区，通量管表现出持续至 $tJ \gtrsim 100$ 的长寿命、晶格锁定的局域动力学，揭示了一个此前未知的预热（prethermal） regime。；创新点：首次将 CAMPS 方法应用于含动态物质的二维 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ Higgs 规范理论，实现了比现有实验和数值模拟大一个数量级的体系尺寸与时间尺度；通过实时模拟提供了有效弦理论描述非平衡弦动力学的从头（ab initio）证据，并发现了强禁闭通量管的长寿命预热动力学。
papers.method_zh: 采用 Clifford-augmented matrix product states (CAMPS) 框架，该方法可参数化地降低矩阵乘积态（MPS）中需表示的纠缠；结合有效弦理论（effective string theory）进行基准测试，包括普适谱特征和通量管粗糙化性质；并引入“string-pull”协议以选择性激发横模并实时重构有限尺寸谱。

papers.title: Euler Topological Metals in 1D
papers.abstract: We give a rigorous one-dimensional formulation of Kane's transport proposal for probing the Euler characteristic of a Fermi sea. For a clean, translation-invariant continuum Hamiltonian with real-analytic dispersion, a Fermi sea confined to a finite momentum range, and nonzero Fermi velocity at every Fermi point, we analyze a particular Abel-regularized transport response (obtained by tracing over the Fermi sea) and prove that its large-time limit equals the Euler characteristic. We derive an explicit finite-time formula, show that quantization requires the large-time limit, and obtain a convergence rate under additional nonstationarity assumptions. We also prove the lattice analog, where the sharp commutator is trace-class and a completely filled band contributes zero. Finite-volume calculations illustrate the prescribed order of the thermodynamic and large-time limits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“rigorous formulation”“prove”“derive”等数学证明性表述，属于严格的理论分析。；研究对象：一维（1D）拓扑金属中费米海的欧拉示性数（Euler characteristic）输运探测量。具体体系为具有实解析色散关系的干净平移不变连续哈密顿量，以及对应的晶格模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了在特定Abel正则化输运响应下，其大时间极限严格等于费米海的欧拉示性数；该量子化要求必须取大时间极限，而非有限时间响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了在特定Abel正则化输运响应下，其大时间极限严格等于费米海的欧拉示性数；该量子化要求必须取大时间极限，而非有限时间响应。；创新点：将Kane关于费米海欧拉示性数的输运探测方案首次严格化到一维，给出了完整的数学证明框架，包括有限时间公式、收敛速率以及晶格版本的严格表述。摘要未突出说明与已有严格化工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与证明：采用Abel正则化输运响应（对费米海求迹），分析其大时间极限；推导了显式的有限时间公式；在非平稳性附加假设下给出收敛速率；并证明了晶格类比（sharp commutator为迹类算子，满带贡献为零）。辅以有限体积数值计算说明热力学极限与大时间极限的先后顺序。

papers.title: Compact Modeling of Oxide-Semiconductor, 2D Material, Carbon Nanotube, and Cryogenic Transistors with Experiment Verification
papers.abstract: This paper presents a unified compact model for emerging transistor technologies, including oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors (OSFETs), 2D material FETs (2DFETs), carbon nanotube FETs (CNFETs), and cryogenic MOSFETs. A unified charge-density formulation is developed to account for quantum confinement, trap charges, and band-tail states in channel charge calculations. A physics-based transport model is introduced to seamlessly capture carrier transport from the long-channel diffusive regime to the short-channel ballistic limit. Scaling models are incorporated to accurately describe 2D electrostatic effects. Cryogenic operation is modeled through the inclusion of band-tail states and temperature-dependent mobility and threshold voltage. The proposed model is validated against experimental data from the fabricated OSFETs with multiple channel lengths and published measurements of 2DFETs, CNFETs, and cryogenic MOSFETs. Excellent agreement is demonstrated across diverse device architectures, operating conditions, and material systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论建模 + 实验验证）。判断依据：摘要中同时出现“compact model”（紧凑模型/理论建模）、“validated against experimental data”（实验验证）以及“fabricated OSFETs”（制备的器件）等关键词。；研究对象：新兴晶体管技术，具体包括：氧化物半导体场效应晶体管（OSFETs）、二维材料场效应晶体管（2DFETs）、碳纳米管场效应晶体管（CNFETs）以及低温（cryogenic）MOSFETs。研究涉及的物理现象包括量子限域、陷阱电荷、带尾态、载流子输运（从扩散到弹道）、二维静电效应以及低温输运特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种统一的紧凑模型，能够在一个框架内准确描述多种新兴晶体管（OSFET、2DFET、CNFET、低温MOSFET）的电学特性，并与实验数据（包括自制的多沟道长度OSFET及已发表的2DFET、CNFET和低温MOSFET数据）取得了良好的一致性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种统一的紧凑模型，能够在一个框架内准确描述多种新兴晶体管（OSFET、2DFET、CNFET、低温MOSFET）的电学特性，并与实验数据（包括自制的多沟道长度OSFET及已发表的2DFET、CNFET和低温MOSFET数据）取得了良好的一致性。；创新点：提出了一个统一的紧凑建模框架，首次将氧化物半导体、二维材料、碳纳米管和低温MOSFET这四类差异显著的器件纳入同一套电荷密度公式和输运模型中，并通过多类型实验数据验证了其普适性。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架方面：采用统一的电荷密度公式（考虑量子限域、陷阱电荷和带尾态）；基于物理的输运模型（无缝衔接长沟道扩散输运与短沟道弹道极限）；缩放模型（描述二维静电效应）；低温模型（引入带尾态、温度依赖的迁移率和阈值电压）。实验验证方面：使用自制的不同沟道长度OSFET器件进行实测，并引用已发表的2DFET、CNFET和低温MOSFET实验数据。

papers.title: Metallogenic quantum criticality: Fermi surface nucleation at transitions between gapped phases
papers.abstract: Continuous quantum phase transitions in interacting many-body systems exhibit universal phenomena that are largely independent of microscopic details. An organizing principle distilled from canonical examples such as the magnetic transition in Ising models is that the low-energy physics of transitions between gapped phases is governed by scale-invariant quantum field theories with gapless degrees of freedom at isolated points in momentum space. In this paper, we show that this principle can fail in a radical way: an entire gapless Fermi surface can emerge at a quantum critical point separating two fully gapped insulators. These exotic phase transitions are dubbed \textit{metallogenic quantum critical points} (MGQCP). We construct a controlled family of effective field theories for MGQCPs between distinct fractional Chern insulators and propose a periodically modulated quantum Hall bilayer as a minimal microscopic setting. The critical theory exhibits an unusual mixture of physical signatures: while transport and compressibility follow scaling laws compatible with a conformal field theory, the electron spectral function develops a power-law non-analyticity at the Fermi momentum, characteristic of non-Fermi-liquid metals. We discuss how the concept of MGQCP may shed new light on critical phenomena in moire materials with tunable Chern bands. More generally, our results point to a broader class of quantum critical phenomena in which extended manifolds of gapless excitations emerge in momentum space despite being absent in both neighboring phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“construct a controlled family of effective field theories”“propose a minimal microscopic setting”，属于理论构建与模型分析。；研究对象：量子临界现象，具体为两个全有能隙的分数陈绝缘体之间的连续量子相变，以及在该临界点处涌现的费米面。微观载体为周期性调制的量子霍尔双层体系，并讨论其在moire材料（可调陈带）中的潜在应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现一种全新的量子临界点类型——“成金属量子临界点”（MGQCP），在该临界点处，尽管两侧均为全有能隙绝缘体，但临界理论中会涌现出完整的无能隙费米面，打破了“有能隙相之间转变的低能物理由动量空间孤立点处的无标度量子场论支配”这一传统组织原则。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现一种全新的量子临界点类型——“成金属量子临界点”（MGQCP），在该临界点处，尽管两侧均为全有能隙绝缘体，但临界理论中会涌现出完整的无能隙费米面，打破了“有能隙相之间转变的低能物理由动量空间孤立点处的无标度量子场论支配”这一传统组织原则。；创新点：首次提出“整个费米面可以在量子临界点处从两个全有能隙相之间涌现”这一概念，突破了传统量子临界点仅在动量空间孤立点产生无能隙激发的范式，并指出这类临界现象可能存在于具有可调陈带的moire材料中。摘要未突出说明与具体实验测量的直接对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：构建了一族受控的有效场论（controlled family of effective field theories）来描述MGQCP；提出了周期性调制的量子霍尔双层作为最小微观模型。分析手段包括：计算输运与压缩率标度行为（与共形场论兼容），以及电子谱函数在费米动量处的幂律非解析行为（非费米液体金属特征）。

papers.title: Distinguishing Quantum Capacitance Signatures of a Topological Majorana Wire from a Normal Wire Segment
papers.abstract: Majorana zero modes (MZMs) are spatially separated, near-zero-energy excitations expected at the ends of a topological superconducting (TS) wire. A quantum-dot interferometer can be used to probe the quantum capacitance of the TS wire, and the location and magnitude of the capacitance resonances provide information about the MZMs, while their magnetic flux dependence probes coherent coupling to the two Majorana modes. It has been recently shown that, a gapless (i.e., $Δ=0$) wire segment can also exhibit flux-dependent quantum capacitance oscillations through Aharonov-Bohm interference and, with suitable tuning, can reproduce a Majorana-like response. Here we show that the two mechanisms can be distinguished experimentally. In the gapless normal wire segment, the two parity-dependent signals originate from separate energy resonances corresponding to the lack of generic zero-energy states. By contrast, in the topological wire, the pair of low energy levels with even and odd parity are nearly degenerate in energy, and therefore, the two parity branches remain within the same broader resonance region in the quantum-dot potential, and persist under independent variations of the dot potential and wire chemical potential.
