papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“We investigate the mean-field ground states”（平均场基态研究）以及“We find numerically”（数值发现），属于理论计算研究。；研究对象：耦合一维玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（Bose-Einstein condensates）在合成磁场作用下的涡旋晶格（vortex lattices）行为，具体涉及耦合导线模型（coupled-wire model）从少腿梯子（few-leg ladders）到扩展涡旋晶格的过渡。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在离散方向采用周期性边界条件时，系统倾向于形成类似Abrikosov晶格的交错排列同号涡旋阵列；而在小尺寸有限系统中采用开放边界时，涡旋被限制在合成方向中心附近的排状结构中。有限尺寸效应和边界条件共同决定了涡旋的空间组织方式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在离散方向采用周期性边界条件时，系统倾向于形成类似Abrikosov晶格的交错排列同号涡旋阵列；而在小尺寸有限系统中采用开放边界时，涡旋被限制在合成方向中心附近的排状结构中。有限尺寸效应和边界条件共同决定了涡旋的空间组织方式。；创新点：该工作系统地研究了连续-离散量子流体中有限尺寸效应和边界条件对涡旋涌现及空间组织的调控作用，为未来隧道耦合原子导线或合成维度实验提供了理论参考。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 平均场方法（mean-field）求解基态，数值计算耦合导线模型。系统具有一个连续空间方向和一个离散空间方向，通过改变导线数目实现从少腿梯子到扩展涡旋晶格的插值研究。具体数值技术（如是否使用DMRG等）摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Decoupled domain-texture switching from magnetic easy axis in kagome ferromagnet EuTi3Bi4
papers.abstract: Magnetic anisotropy defines the easy axis of a magnetic material and governs the spatial arrangement of its domains. To date, anisotropy engineering has focused on reorienting the easy axis or tuning the anisotropy energy, both of which demand substantial energy input. Here, we demonstrate that magnetic domain textures can be switched without reorienting the easy axis, as observed in a kagome ferromagnet EuTi3Bi4 crystal. Using low-temperature magnetic force microscopy, we observe that the preferred orientation of magnetic domains switches from the a-axis to the b-axis upon temperature variation, and that this switching can also be triggered by an out-of-plane magnetic-field reset. Magnetization measurements and density functional theory calculations confirm a robust c-axis easy magnetization, ruling out a conventional spin-reorientation transition. Instead, the texture switching is governed by the temperature dependence of the in-plane variation of the Magnetic anisotropy energy landscape, which arises from two competing interactions with different decay rates: single-ion anisotropy favors a-oriented spin components, while nearest-neighbor anisotropic exchange favors b-oriented ones. Furthermore, the critical switching temperature is substantially elevated in a mechanically exfoliated EuTi3Bi4 flake. Our findings establish that macroscopic magnetic textures can be effectively manipulated by tuning the competition between in-plane anisotropic interactions, without the energy cost of reorienting the easy axis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“低温柔性磁力显微镜”实验观测、“磁化测量”实验，以及“密度泛函理论计算”。；研究对象：kagome晶格铁磁材料EuTi₃Bi₄单晶及其机械剥离薄片。具体物理现象为磁畴织构（domain texture）的切换行为，以及其与磁各向异性能（MAE）景观的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在EuTi₃Bi₄中，磁畴的择优取向可在不改变c轴易磁化轴的前提下，随温度变化或外加垂直磁场重置而在a轴与b轴之间切换。该切换源于面内各向异性相互作用（单离子各向异性与最近邻各向异性交换）的竞争，而非传统的自旋重取向相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在EuTi₃Bi₄中，磁畴的择优取向可在不改变c轴易磁化轴的前提下，随温度变化或外加垂直磁场重置而在a轴与b轴之间切换。该切换源于面内各向异性相互作用（单离子各向异性与最近邻各向异性交换）的竞争，而非传统的自旋重取向相变。；创新点：首次证明宏观磁畴织构可以通过调控面内各向异性相互作用的竞争来实现切换，而无需重新定向易磁化轴，从而避免了传统各向异性工程中所需的巨大能量开销。这一机制区别于传统的自旋重取向相变。
papers.method_zh: - 实验手段：低温柔性磁力显微镜（MFM）用于直接观测磁畴织构；磁化测量用于确认宏观磁各向异性。

papers.title: Low-temperature magnetism and spin dynamics in the disordered triangular-lattice Yb$^{3+}$ compound LiCaYb$_5$(BO$_3$)$_6$
papers.abstract: The interplay between geometric frustration, spin--orbit coupling, and structural disorder can give rise to unconventional magnetic ground states in rare-earth triangular-lattice magnets. We report low-temperature magnetic and $^7$Li NMR investigations of the disordered triangular-lattice compound LiCaYb$_5$(BO$_3$)$_6$ (LCYBO). Rietveld refinement confirms a hexagonal $P6_522$ structure with partial Ca/Yb antisite disorder and fractional Li occupancy. Magnetic susceptibility and magnetization measurements indicate a well-isolated effective $J_{\mathrm{eff}}=1/2$ Kramers doublet with weak antiferromagnetic interactions ($θ_{\mathrm{CW}} \approx -0.54$~K). The specific heat reveals a weak anomaly near 0.43 K, suggesting the development of short-range correlated magnetism rather than conventional long-range order. $^7$Li NMR spectra broaden strongly upon cooling, consistent with increasingly inhomogeneous internal magnetic fields. The spin-lattice relaxation exhibits two relaxation components consistent with disorder-induced distributions of local magnetic environments arising from antisite disorder and competing exchange pathways. Our results establish LCYBO as a structurally disordered frustrated triangular-lattice magnet with correlated low-energy spin dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“低温磁性和⁷Li NMR研究”“磁化率与磁化强度测量”“比热”“NMR谱”等实验手段。；研究对象：无序三角晶格稀土化合物 LiCaYb₅(BO₃)₆（LCYBO），具体关注其低温磁性、自旋动力学以及几何阻挫、自旋-轨道耦合与结构无序的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: LCYBO 是一种结构无序的阻挫三角晶格磁体，具有良好隔离的 J_eff=1/2 Kramers 双重态和弱反铁磁相互作用（θ_CW ≈ −0.54 K），在 0.43 K 附近仅出现短程关联磁性的弱比热异常，而非常规长程磁有序；⁷Li NMR 显示低温下内场高度不均匀，自旋-晶格弛豫呈双分量行为，反映无序诱导的局域磁环境分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：LCYBO 是一种结构无序的阻挫三角晶格磁体，具有良好隔离的 J_eff=1/2 Kramers 双重态和弱反铁磁相互作用（θ_CW ≈ −0.54 K），在 0.43 K 附近仅出现短程关联磁性的弱比热异常，而非常规长程磁有序；⁷Li NMR 显示低温下内场高度不均匀，自旋-晶格弛豫呈双分量行为，反映无序诱导的局域磁环境分布。；创新点：首次系统研究了 LCYBO 这一具有 Ca/Yb 反位无序和 Li 部分占据的无序三角晶格 Yb³⁺ 化合物的低温磁性与自旋动力学，揭示了结构无序与几何阻挫共同作用下形成的短程关联磁态及双分量自旋弛豫行为。
papers.method_zh: Rietveld 结构精修（确定 P6₅22 六方结构及 Ca/Yb 反位无序和 Li 部分占据）；磁化率与磁化强度测量；低温比热测量；⁷Li 核磁共振（NMR）谱及自旋-晶格弛豫测量。

papers.title: Four-phonon scattering and coherent heat transport in ultrawide-bandgap SrSnO3
papers.abstract: SrSnO3 is a promising ultrawide-bandgap perovskite oxide whose thermal transport is governed by structural distortions and anharmonic lattice dynamics. Here, we investigate the lattice thermal conductivity (kL) of orthorhombic and cubic SrSnO3 within a unified first-principles framework combining self-consistent phonon renormalization, three- and four-phonon scattering, and coherent heat transport. Bonding analysis reveals a rigid Sn-O octahedral framework embedded in a weakly bonded Sr sublattice, giving rise to low-frequency vibrational modes susceptible to strong anharmonic effects. Four-phonon scattering is identified as a key mechanism limiting particle-like heat conduction, reducing the Peierls thermal conductivity by 19.4% at 300 K in the orthorhombic phase and by 52.1% at 1300 K in the cubic phase, while the coherent contribution provides a finite channel that partially compensates this reduction. We further show that the apparent agreement between three-phonon calculations and experimental thermal conductivity at room temperature is not indicative of a complete physical description. Instead, it arises from a near cancellation between four-phonon suppression of the particle-like channel and the neglected coherent contribution. This cancellation breaks down when the full temperature dependence is considered, where only the combined treatment improves agreement with the experimentally observed scaling behavior. A physically consistent description of kL therefore requires phonon renormalization, four-phonon scattering, and coherent transport to be treated on equal footing rather than inferred from three-phonon agreement at a single temperature. These results provide microscopic insight into thermal transport in ultrawide-bandgap stannate perovskites and establish a benchmark for anharmonic transport in strongly distorted oxides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“first-principles framework”“self-consistent phonon renormalization”“calculations”等关键词，属于第一性原理计算研究。；研究对象：超宽禁带钙钛矿氧化物 SrSnO₃ 的晶格热导率（kL），具体涵盖正交相与立方相中的声子非谐输运、四声子散射及相干热输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 四声子散射是限制粒子型热传导的关键机制（300 K 下正交相降低 Peierls 热导率 19.4%，1300 K 下立方相降低 52.1%），而相干输运贡献可部分补偿该降低；室温下三声子计算与实验的表观吻合源于四声子抑制与相干贡献的近似抵消，并非物理描述的完备性，只有同时考虑声子重正化、四声子散射与相干输运才能在全温度范围内与实验标度行为一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：四声子散射是限制粒子型热传导的关键机制（300 K 下正交相降低 Peierls 热导率 19.4%，1300 K 下立方相降低 52.1%），而相干输运贡献可部分补偿该降低；室温下三声子计算与实验的表观吻合源于四声子抑制与相干贡献的近似抵消，并非物理描述的完备性，只有同时考虑声子重正化、四声子散射与相干输运才能在全温度范围内与实验标度行为一致。；创新点：首次在统一框架内将声子重正化、四声子散射与相干输运置于同等地位处理 SrSnO₃ 的热输运，并揭示了三声子计算在单一温度下与实验吻合的“假象”源于两种效应的近似抵消，为强畸变氧化物中的非谐输运建立了基准。
papers.method_zh: 统一的第一性原理框架，具体包括：自洽声子重正化（self-consistent phonon renormalization）、三声子与四声子散射计算、相干热输运（coherent heat transport）建模，以及键合分析（bonding analysis）用于揭示晶格结构特征。

papers.title: Quenched activity induces nonuniversal scaling in nonreciprocal XY Models and surfaces
papers.abstract: Active XY models and active surfaces are two paradigmatic nonequilibrium systems with distinct microscopic origins. We show that the hydrodynamic theories for a quenched-disordered nonreciprocal random bond two-dimensional XY model and an inversion-symmetric active surface tangentially advected by quenched velocities are identical. This theory predicts sub-logarithmic phase order in the XY model and sub- or super-logarithmic positional order in the surface for short-range disorder with nonuniversal exponents, which vary continuously with the degree of transversality of the disorder variance. We argue that the nonreciprocal random bond XY model can disorder through vortex proliferation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。依据：摘要中明确提到“hydrodynamic theories”（流体力学理论）、“predicts”（理论预言）等关键词，属于理论建模与分析。；研究对象：非互易XY模型（nonreciprocal XY model）与活性表面（active surfaces）这两类非平衡系统，具体研究其淬火无序（quenched disorder）下的序与标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 淬火无序的非互易随机键二维XY模型与由淬火速度切向平流的反演对称活性表面具有相同的流体力学理论；该理论预言短程无序下XY模型呈现亚对数相序，表面呈现亚对数或超对数位置序，且标度指数非普适，随无序方差横向度连续变化。此外，非互易随机键XY模型可能通过涡旋增殖发生失序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：淬火无序的非互易随机键二维XY模型与由淬火速度切向平流的反演对称活性表面具有相同的流体力学理论；该理论预言短程无序下XY模型呈现亚对数相序，表面呈现亚对数或超对数位置序，且标度指数非普适，随无序方差横向度连续变化。此外，非互易随机键XY模型可能通过涡旋增殖发生失序。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其新意在于建立了非互易XY模型与活性表面两类不同微观起源的非平衡系统在淬火无序下的统一流体力学描述，并预言了非普适标度指数。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为流体力学/水动力学理论（hydrodynamic theory），结合淬火无序（quenched-disordered）的随机键模型分析，并讨论涡旋增殖机制（vortex proliferation）对失序的贡献。

papers.title: Band offsets and electronic structure at $α$/$β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ and $κ$/$β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ phase heterojunctions
papers.abstract: Ga$_2$O$_3$ phase heterojunction materials are emerging as promising candidates for deep-ultraviolet optoelectronics. Here, the band offsets at the $α$/$β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ and $κ$/$β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ phase heterojunctions are investigated through hybrid functional calculations. Explicit, realistic slab models that satisfy electron counting rules are constructed for the heterojunctions. Our calculations demonstrate that a type-II staggered band alignment forms at the $α$/$β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ and $κ$/$β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ phase heterojunctions, where both the valence and conduction band edges of $α$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ and $κ$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ are higher than those of $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$. Strain effects on the band alignment are also discussed. Spatially resolved local density of states maps are presented, clearly revealing the interfacial electronic structures. These results provide valuable insights into the physical properties of Ga$_2$O$_3$ phase heterojunctions, offering guidance for future device design efforts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“hybrid functional calculations”（杂化泛函计算），属于第一性原理计算研究。；研究对象：Ga₂O₃ 相异质结，具体为 α/β-Ga₂O₃ 和 κ/β-Ga₂O₃ 两种相界面的能带偏移与电子结构，面向深紫外光电器件应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: α/β-Ga₂O₃ 和 κ/β-Ga₂O₃ 相异质结均形成 type-II 交错能带排列，其中 α-Ga₂O₃ 和 κ-Ga₂O₃ 的价带顶与导带底均高于 β-Ga₂O₃ 的对应能带边。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：α/β-Ga₂O₃ 和 κ/β-Ga₂O₃ 相异质结均形成 type-II 交错能带排列，其中 α-Ga₂O₃ 和 κ-Ga₂O₃ 的价带顶与导带底均高于 β-Ga₂O₃ 的对应能带边。；创新点：首次对 α/β-Ga₂O₃ 和 κ/β-Ga₂O₃ 相异质结采用满足电子计数规则的显式 slab 模型进行杂化泛函计算，并系统给出应变效应与空间分辨的界面态密度信息，为 Ga₂O₃ 相异质结器件设计提供定量能带对齐数据。
papers.method_zh: 采用杂化泛函（hybrid functional）第一性原理计算；构建满足电子计数规则的显式、真实 slab 模型来模拟异质结界面；计算了应变对能带排列的影响；通过空间分辨的局域态密度（LDOS）图揭示界面电子结构。

papers.title: A novel Grand-Potential Phase-Field Lattice-Boltzmann model for multi-phase solidification with convection
papers.abstract: Melt convection plays a critical role in microstructure evolution during alloy solidification, yet accurately capturing its interaction with moving solid-liquid interfaces remains a significant computational challenge, particularly in multi-phase, multi-component systems. In this work, we develop a computational framework that couples a Grand-Potential phase-field model with the Lattice Boltzmann method (LBM) to simulate convection-driven solidification within a unified and thermodynamically consistent formulation. The proposed approach rigorously enforces no-slip conditions at evolving solid-liquid interfaces, while fluid transport is solved using the standard single-relaxation-time Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook collision operator. The framework provides an efficient and robust methodology for resolving the coupled evolution of interfaces, solute transport, and fluid flow. The versatility of the proposed framework is demonstrated through simulations of dendritic and eutectic solidification under natural convection. The results show that convection significantly modifies solute segregation, destabilizes growth fronts, and induces oscillatory growth modes in both systems. These examples illustrate the capability of the proposed method to capture complex flow-induced morphological instabilities and provide new insights into the mechanisms governing convection-driven microstructure evolution in alloy solidification.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/模拟文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a computational framework”“simulations of dendritic and eutectic solidification”，属于数值模拟研究。；研究对象：合金凝固过程中的多相、多组分体系，具体涉及枝晶和共晶凝固，以及熔体对流与移动固液界面的耦合作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该框架成功模拟了自然对流下的枝晶和共晶凝固，结果表明对流显著改变溶质偏析、使生长前沿失稳，并在两类体系中诱导出振荡生长模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该框架成功模拟了自然对流下的枝晶和共晶凝固，结果表明对流显著改变溶质偏析、使生长前沿失稳，并在两类体系中诱导出振荡生长模式。；创新点：在统一的热力学自洽框架内，将巨势相场模型与LBM耦合，用于多相、多组分凝固中的对流驱动微观组织演化模拟，并严格处理移动界面上的无滑移条件。摘要未突出说明与以往模型相比的具体性能优势或适用范围扩展。
papers.method_zh: 将巨势相场模型（Grand-Potential phase-field model）与格子玻尔兹曼方法（LBM）耦合，采用标准单松弛时间 Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook（BGK）碰撞算子求解流体输运，并在演化的固液界面处严格施加无滑移边界条件。

papers.title: Exceptional point induced by hyperbolicity in an electrostatic spherical shell
papers.abstract: Exceptional points (EPs) are non--Hermitian degeneracies at which both eigenvalues and eigenvectors coalesce, usually engineered through balanced gain and loss or non--reciprocity. In this work, we show that the radial electrostatic problem of an anisotropic core--shell nanoparticle realizes an EP without any of the alluded conditons. Written in the logarithmic radial coordinate, the problem is a Cauchy--Euler equation that maps onto a damped oscillator and, equivalently, onto a two-site Hatano--Nelson Hamiltonian, so that the non-Hermiticity is emulated in space rather than in time and the sole control parameter is the degree of dielectric anisotropy, $\varepsilon_t/\varepsilon_r$. The shell is passive, reciprocal, and lossless, yet it hosts an EP and a non--Hermitian phase transition governed by hyperbolicity alone. Beyond a hyperbolicity threshold the electric field inside the shell turns from monotonic decay into spatial oscillation, producing hotspots at intermediate radii which can be exploited to tailor fluorescence, strong coupling, sensing, or cloaking. More broadly, this establishes hyperbolic media as a platform to simulate non--Hermitian physics without gain, loss, or non--reciprocity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：realizes、maps onto、emulated in space、theoretical framework（Cauchy–Euler方程、Hatano–Nelson哈密顿量映射）。；研究对象：各向异性核壳纳米颗粒的径向静电问题，具体为介电各向异性（ε_t/ε_r）调控下的静电势分布与电场行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无增益、无损耗、无非互易性的无源无耗散壳层中，仅凭介电各向异性（双曲性）即可实现例外点（EP）及非厄米相变；超过双曲性阈值后，壳内电场从单调衰减转变为空间振荡，并在中间半径处产生热点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无增益、无损耗、无非互易性的无源无耗散壳层中，仅凭介电各向异性（双曲性）即可实现例外点（EP）及非厄米相变；超过双曲性阈值后，壳内电场从单调衰减转变为空间振荡，并在中间半径处产生热点。；创新点：首次证明无需增益/损耗或非互易性，仅通过空间各向异性（双曲性）即可在无源无耗散体系中实现例外点，将双曲介质确立为模拟非厄米物理的新平台。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析方法：采用对数径向坐标将静电问题转化为Cauchy–Euler方程，进一步映射为阻尼谐振子及两格点Hatano–Nelson哈密顿量，以介电各向异性比ε_t/ε_r作为唯一控制参数。

papers.title: The Effect of Geometry on Thermodynamic Response
papers.abstract: At the nano- and microscale, various patterns influence and shape thermal and optical response, making them essential for the survival of various biological species. In addition, controlling thermal radiation is vital for a broad range of applications, such as thermal management, spectroscopy, optoelectronics, and energy conversion technologies. For this reason, there is strong pressure to elucidate the physics of thermal radiation at the nanoscale. In this article, we provide evidence that complex nanoscale geometries affect thermal management, leading to an unusual thermal response in heat-capacity measurements as a function of temperature. Beyond identifying the structural constraints associated with this unusual thermodynamic response, the current study introduces the possibility of shaping the apparent heat-capacity response through geometry without necessarily altering the system's chemistry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要强调“provide evidence”“identifying structural constraints”，未提及具体实验手段，偏向理论分析与数值模拟。；研究对象：纳米与微米尺度下复杂几何结构对热辐射及热力学响应（特别是热容随温度变化）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 复杂纳米几何结构可改变热管理行为，导致热容测量随温度出现异常响应；通过几何设计即可调控表观热容响应，无需改变材料化学组成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：复杂纳米几何结构可改变热管理行为，导致热容测量随温度出现异常响应；通过几何设计即可调控表观热容响应，无需改变材料化学组成。；创新点：提出“几何本身可作为调控热力学响应的独立自由度”，即在不改变体系化学性质的前提下，通过结构形貌塑造表观热容行为，为纳米尺度热管理提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体计算方法或理论框架（如有限元模拟、密度泛函理论等），仅提及对几何结构约束的分析与热容响应的理论论证。

papers.title: Repeated Growth and Hot Delamination of Single-Crystal Graphene: A Two-Kilometer Process-Design Assessment with hBN as a Separate Case
papers.abstract: Large single crystals of graphene and hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) remain difficult to manufacture because batch growth and transfer limit area, throughput, and quality. This Perspective asks whether an atomically thin film could instead be grown, hot-delaminated, and regrown repeatedly on a long, reusable single-crystal metal surface. No integrated process is demonstrated. Once rapid full-area growth is available, hot film removal is likely to become the rate-limiting step, whereas usable single-crystal growth area sets the material produced per cycle. Two experiments determine whether the concept merits further development: rapid, damage-free delamination at or near the growth temperature, and acceptable film growth through repeated complete growth-dwell-peel-regrowth cycles. The analysis then examines the crystalline growth surface, layer control, interface and gas chemistries, product capture, quality criteria, energy, and scale. These provisional analyses expose known requirements, define early stop criteria, and guide experiments; they cannot anticipate every coupled constraint or failure mode. Graphene is the quantitative baseline. hBN requires its own M(111), product thickness, apparatus, and scaling strategy. Pilot-scale development is justified only if the two central experiments succeed and the remaining gates can then be refined experimentally.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：Perspective（观点/前瞻性分析文章），非实验、计算或理论原始研究。判断依据：摘要明确说明“No integrated process is demonstrated”，且全文为“provisional analyses”和“guide experiments”的过程设计评估。；研究对象：单晶石墨烯（graphene）和六方氮化硼（hBN）在可重复使用的单晶金属表面上进行反复生长、热剥离（hot delamination）和再生长的工艺概念。具体物理现象涉及薄膜生长动力学、界面化学、层数控制及热剥离速率限制步骤。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未给出实验性物理结论，核心观点为：一旦实现快速全覆盖生长，热膜剥离将成为速率限制步骤；该概念是否值得发展取决于两个关键实验——生长温度附近的无损伤快速剥离，以及多次完整生长-保温-剥离-再生长循环后的可接受薄膜质量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未给出实验性物理结论，核心观点为：一旦实现快速全覆盖生长，热膜剥离将成为速率限制步骤；该概念是否值得发展取决于两个关键实验——生长温度附近的无损伤快速剥离，以及多次完整生长-保温-剥离-再生长循环后的可接受薄膜质量。；创新点：提出“在长尺寸可重复使用的单晶金属表面上反复生长-热剥离-再生长”的连续化工艺概念，以替代传统批量生长与转移路线，并明确给出早期终止判据和两个决定性实验作为可行性门槛。摘要未突出说明与现有连续化方法（如卷对卷）的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未涉及具体实验手段或计算方法，属于工艺设计评估（process-design assessment），采用分阶段门控分析（early stop criteria），对晶体生长表面、层数控制、界面/气体化学、产物收集、质量判据、能量和规模进行逐项推演。未使用DFT、DMRG、ARPES等具体工具。

papers.title: Switchable giant room-temperature nonlinear Hall effect in Bilayer Graphene
papers.abstract: Utilizing quantum second-order nonlinear transport for practical junction-free devices require materials with large and tunable nonlinearites at room temperature -- a current materials platform challenge. Here, we report the nonlinear Hall effect (NLHE) in double-ionic gated bilayer graphene devices that enable unusually strong inversion breaking. We observe NLHE that are readily switchable (on, off, and sign reversed) with second order nonlinear susceptibilities $χ^{(2)}_{yxx}$ that reaches giant room-temperature values of $3\,10^{-3}\,μ\mathrm{m}\,\mathrm{S/V}$, comparable to values commonly observed at low temperature in WTe$_2$ or in graphene-based moiré superlattices, and three-to-four orders of magnitude larger than values reported in material systems recently employed in search of a room-temperature NLHE. Our devices produce corresponding THz voltage responsivities $\simeq 4\,10^{4}\,\mathrm{V/W}$, comparable to commercially available Schottky diodes. These are orders of magnitude better than for previously reported room-temperature NLHE devices rendering double-ionic gated bilayer graphene a choice platform for junction-free nonlinear technology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述“我们报道”“我们观察到”“我们的器件”等实验性表述，涉及器件制备与测量。；研究对象：双离子栅控的双层石墨烯（bilayer graphene）器件中的非线性霍尔效应（NLHE），重点研究其在室温下的可开关非线性输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在双离子栅控双层石墨烯中实现了室温下巨大的、可开关（开、关及符号反转）的非线性霍尔效应，其二阶非线性磁化率χ⁽²⁾_{yxx}达到3×10⁻³ μm·S/V，与低温下WTe₂或石墨烯莫尔超晶格中的典型值相当，比此前室温NLHE材料体系高3–4个数量级；对应的太赫兹电压响应度约4×10⁴ V/W，可与商用肖特基二极管媲美。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在双离子栅控双层石墨烯中实现了室温下巨大的、可开关（开、关及符号反转）的非线性霍尔效应，其二阶非线性磁化率χ⁽²⁾_{yxx}达到3×10⁻³ μm·S/V，与低温下WTe₂或石墨烯莫尔超晶格中的典型值相当，比此前室温NLHE材料体系高3–4个数量级；对应的太赫兹电压响应度约4×10⁴ V/W，可与商用肖特基二极管媲美。；创新点：首次在双层石墨烯中利用双离子栅控实现室温下可开关的巨非线性霍尔效应，其性能远超此前室温NLHE器件，为无结非线性电子学提供了实用平台。摘要未突出说明与理论计算的对比或微观机制分析。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：双离子栅控（double-ionic gating）技术实现强反演对称性破缺，测量二阶非线性输运响应（NLHE），并提取二阶非线性磁化率χ⁽²⁾及太赫兹电压响应度。

papers.title: Observation of dodecagonal replica bands in 30$^{\circ}$-twisted bilayer WSe$_2$
papers.abstract: Twisted bilayers of two-dimensional (2D) transition metal dichalcogenides are promising systems for achieving tunable quasicrystalline orders with emergent properties. The underpinning electronic structure and scattering processes in 2D quasicrystals with multiorbital dodecagonal replica bands have so far not been determined. Here, we utilize angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) with micrometer spatial resolution to directly observe replica bands in 30$^{\circ}$-twisted bilayer WSe$_2$. The symmetry and intensity distribution of the observed replicas are explained by interlayer Umklapp scattering from bottom to top WSe$_2$ layers. Our spectral function measurements are consistent with the presence of a van Hove singularity adjacent to the $\mathrm{K}$-valleys, which underlines the possibility of inducing electronic reconstructions in bilayers with a large interlayer twist angle.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) with micrometer spatial resolution”进行直接观测。；研究对象：30°扭转的双层WSe₂（transition metal dichalcogenide，过渡金属二硫化物）体系中的准晶有序电子结构，具体为多轨道十二重（dodecagonal）复制能带及其散射过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在30°扭转双层WSe₂中直接观测到复制能带，其对称性和强度分布可由层间Umklapp散射（从底层到顶层）解释；谱函数测量表明K谷附近存在van Hove奇点，暗示大扭转角双层中可能诱导电子重构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在30°扭转双层WSe₂中直接观测到复制能带，其对称性和强度分布可由层间Umklapp散射（从底层到顶层）解释；谱函数测量表明K谷附近存在van Hove奇点，暗示大扭转角双层中可能诱导电子重构。；创新点：首次通过ARPES直接观测到二维准晶中多轨道十二重复制能带的电子结构和散射过程（此前尚未被确定）。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 微米空间分辨的角分辨光电子能谱（micro-ARPES），结合谱函数测量分析能带对称性与强度分布。

papers.title: Self-selective growth of GaAs1-xBix on GaAs zinc blende/wurtzite nanowire heterostructures
papers.abstract: Site-selective nanostructure growth and material incorporation at the atomic scale offer a promising pathway for engineering quantum materials and nanodevices. Here, GaAs nanowires (NWs) with an axial heterostructure of alternating zinc blende (Zb) and wurtzite (Wz) crystal phases are employed as templates for site-selective Ga and Bi overgrowth. Using X-ray photoemission electron microscopy (XPEEM) with nanoscale spatial resolution, we map elemental distribution and local chemical bonding to reveal the incorporation behavior of Bi atoms in {110} Zb and {11-20} Wz facets. Bi incorporation proceeds through an anion-exchange process, where Bi atoms replace As, forming local Ga-Bi bonds and producing a thin GaAs1-xBix shell. We observe crystal-phase-dependent Bi incorporation, with higher Bi concentration in the Zb segments than in the neighboring Wz segments within the same NW. Furthermore, the Zb segment with higher Bi content exhibits reduced susceptibility to oxidation compared with the Wz segment, resulting in increased Ga-oxide in the Wz surfaces. This study highlights GaAs NW Zb/Wz heterostructures as a template for controlled growth of GaBi and GaAs1-xBix nanostructures with tailored functionalities for quantum applications
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到使用X射线光电子发射显微镜（XPEEM）进行实验表征，并描述了对纳米线的生长和元素分布观测。；研究对象：GaAs纳米线中闪锌矿（Zb）与纤锌矿（Wz）轴向异质结构上，Ga和Bi的选择性过生长行为，具体为GaAs₁₋ₓBiₓ薄壳层的形成及其晶相依赖的Bi掺入特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Bi原子在GaAs纳米线的{110} Zb和{11-20} Wz晶面上通过阴离子交换过程取代As，形成局部Ga-Bi键并生成薄GaAs₁₋ₓBiₓ壳层；Bi掺入浓度具有晶相依赖性，Zb段中的Bi含量高于同一纳米线中相邻的Wz段，且高Bi含量的Zb段比Wz段更不易被氧化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Bi原子在GaAs纳米线的{110} Zb和{11-20} Wz晶面上通过阴离子交换过程取代As，形成局部Ga-Bi键并生成薄GaAs₁₋ₓBiₓ壳层；Bi掺入浓度具有晶相依赖性，Zb段中的Bi含量高于同一纳米线中相邻的Wz段，且高Bi含量的Zb段比Wz段更不易被氧化。；创新点：首次展示了利用GaAs纳米线Zb/Wz晶相异质结构作为模板，实现晶相选择性（自选择性）的Bi掺入和GaAs₁₋ₓBiₓ纳米结构的受控生长，并揭示了晶相对Bi掺入浓度及氧化行为的影响。
papers.method_zh: 以具有交替Zb/Wz轴向异质结构的GaAs纳米线为模板进行Ga和Bi过生长；使用具有纳米级空间分辨率的X射线光电子发射显微镜（XPEEM）进行元素分布和局域化学键合的表征。

papers.title: A review of simulation, measurement techniques, and development in chip thermal design
papers.abstract: As integrated circuits advance toward higher power densities, three-dimensional integration, and heterogeneous packaging, chip thermal management has become a key bottleneck limiting device performance, reliability, and lifetime. This article systematically reviews numerical simulation methods and experimental measurement techniques for chip thermal design, with particular emphasis on the technical challenges associated with multiscale and multiphysics coupling, thermal boundary resistance measurement, and high-heat-flux cooling. We first introduce macro- and device-scale thermal simulation methods, including equivalent thermal-circuit models, the finite element method, and computational fluid dynamics, and discuss the application of phonon transport theory and molecular dynamics at microscopic scales. We then examine the advantages and limitations of infrared thermography, thermoreflectance, Raman thermometry, and embedded sensors. Current limitations include the enormous computational cost, inaccurate multiscale coupling, expensive experimental facilities, and the physical limits of conventional cooling technologies. Finally, we discuss emerging directions, including AI-accelerated thermal simulation, embedded microchannel liquid cooling, two-phase cooling, advanced high-thermal-conductivity materials, and multiphysics co-design, with the aim of advancing chip thermal management toward greater efficiency and intelligence.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（综述文章）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“systematically reviews numerical simulation methods and experimental measurement techniques”，涵盖数值模拟与实验测量两方面。；研究对象：芯片热设计（chip thermal design），具体涉及集成电路中的多尺度热输运现象、热边界电阻、高热量流密度冷却等物理问题，以及相关材料与冷却技术。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 芯片热管理已成为限制器件性能、可靠性与寿命的关键瓶颈；当前主要挑战包括多尺度多物理场耦合的计算成本巨大、热边界电阻测量困难、实验设施昂贵以及传统冷却技术的物理极限。未来发展方向包括AI加速热模拟、嵌入式微通道液冷、两相冷却、高导热材料及多物理场协同设计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：芯片热管理已成为限制器件性能、可靠性与寿命的关键瓶颈；当前主要挑战包括多尺度多物理场耦合的计算成本巨大、热边界电阻测量困难、实验设施昂贵以及传统冷却技术的物理极限。未来发展方向包括AI加速热模拟、嵌入式微通道液冷、两相冷却、高导热材料及多物理场协同设计。；创新点：摘要未突出说明（作为综述文章，其价值在于系统整合多尺度模拟与多种实验手段，并指出当前瓶颈与未来方向，而非单一技术突破）。
papers.method_zh: 综述了以下方法：宏观与器件尺度——等效热路模型、有限元法（FEM）、计算流体动力学（CFD）；微观尺度——声子输运理论、分子动力学（MD）模拟；实验测量——红外热成像、热反射法（thermoreflectance）、拉曼测温法、嵌入式传感器。

papers.title: Stabilization of Interband Phase Solitons in Two-Band Noncentrosymmetric Superconducting Rings
papers.abstract: Two-band superconductors maintain a relative interband phase which can carry winding soliton excitations in a superconducting ring, supported by independent winding numbers in the two bands. In rings of superconductors obeying the inversion symmetry the interband phase solitons are metastable states, separated from the uniform ground state by the energy of screening currents. In this work we find that, breaking the inversion symmetry strongly enough, one can make the soliton a true ground state. In that case, a magneto-electric coupling, absent in centrosymmetric materials, contributes critically above a certain threshold, a relevant, free-energy term, odd with respect to the winding number, which biases the energy balance in favor of a particular winding sign. Once the bias outweighs the energy cost that originally made the soliton metastable, a phase soliton with a finite winding number becomes the ground state, with chirality set by the applied field. In current--flux measurements performed in equilibrium states, the effect is demonstrated by field-odd soliton branches, that replace the metastable ones existing in mesoscopic rings, built by two-component superconductors, realizing a magneto-electric analog of the Little--Parks fluxoid-branch physics in the interband relative-phase sector.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we find that”“contributes critically”“free-energy term”等理论推导与能量分析表述，未提及实验手段或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：双能带非中心对称超导环中的带间相位孤子（interband phase soliton），以及磁电耦合效应对其稳定性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当反转对称性被足够强地破坏时，带间相位孤子可以从亚稳态转变为真正的基态；磁电耦合项（对涡旋数呈奇函数）在超过某一阈值后主导自由能平衡，使具有有限涡旋数的相位孤子成为基态，其手性由外加磁场决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当反转对称性被足够强地破坏时，带间相位孤子可以从亚稳态转变为真正的基态；磁电耦合项（对涡旋数呈奇函数）在超过某一阈值后主导自由能平衡，使具有有限涡旋数的相位孤子成为基态，其手性由外加磁场决定。；创新点：首次提出在非中心对称双能带超导环中，通过磁电耦合的奇涡旋数自由能项，可将原本亚稳的带间相位孤子稳定为真正的基态，并实现带间相对相位自由度上的Little–Parks物理的磁电类比。摘要未突出说明与具体材料体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论自由能分析：基于双能带超导体的Ginzburg-Landau或微观理论框架，引入磁电耦合项，分析涡旋数相关的自由能贡献，并讨论平衡态下电流-磁通测量中的物理后果。摘要未明确说明具体计算技术（如是否使用数值求解）。

papers.title: Brownian yet non-Gaussian diffusion through equilibrium nonlinear friction
papers.abstract: In Brownian yet non-Gaussian diffusion (BnGD) the mean squared displacement grows linearly in time. However, the displacement statistics do not follow a normal distribution throughout. Typically, they are non-Gaussian at intermediate times, before they cross over to Gaussian in the long-time regime. We demonstrate that nonlinear friction under correctly applied stochastic equilibrium conditions provides an explanation of this phenomenon also for homogeneous environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中“demonstrate”“provide an explanation”等表述，以及讨论随机过程与随机平衡条件，属于理论建模与分析。；研究对象：布朗但非高斯扩散（BnGD）现象，具体为在均匀环境中，非线性摩擦与随机平衡条件如何导致位移统计在中间时间呈非高斯分布、长时间趋于高斯分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在正确施加随机平衡条件的前提下，非线性摩擦本身即可在均匀环境中产生布朗但非高斯扩散，无需依赖空间异质性或复杂环境。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在正确施加随机平衡条件的前提下，非线性摩擦本身即可在均匀环境中产生布朗但非高斯扩散，无需依赖空间异质性或复杂环境。；创新点：已有BnGD解释多依赖非均匀环境或活性介质，本工作指出均匀环境中仅由平衡非线性摩擦即可复现该现象，摘要未突出说明更具体的数学或数值手段。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：随机动力学建模，结合非线性摩擦与随机平衡条件（如涨落-耗散关系的修正形式），分析均方位移与位移概率分布的时域演化。

papers.title: Neural Renormalization Group Flow for Percolation
papers.abstract: Machine learning offers a possible route to data-driven real-space renormalization when the relevant observables are nonlocal and difficult to prescribe explicitly. We explore this idea for two-dimensional site percolation developping a supervised, scale-shared neural architecture. The model recursively applies the same learned coarse-graining rule across scales, producing a latent field from which the crossing probability is predicted, while a corresponding fine-graining decoder reconstructs the largest-cluster mask. Trained only on small lattices, the model extrapolates to substantially larger systems, recovers the spanning cluster with high fidelity, and produces observables obeying the expected finite-size scaling near the critical point. We observe that to get such performance it is key that the learned latent representation exhibits critical fluctuations and scale-dependent flows consistent with the renormalization-group structure of percolation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“machine learning”“neural architecture”“supervised”“scale-shared”，以及“renormalization-group structure”等计算与理论建模关键词。；研究对象：二维格点逾渗（two-dimensional site percolation）体系，具体关注跨越概率（crossing probability）与最大团簇（largest cluster）的粗粒化描述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过一个跨尺度共享的监督神经网络，仅在小尺寸晶格上训练，即可外推到更大系统，高保真地重建跨越团簇，并在临界点附近产生符合预期有限尺寸标度的可观测量。关键条件是学习到的隐表示必须呈现临界涨落和与逾渗重整化群结构一致的尺度依赖流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过一个跨尺度共享的监督神经网络，仅在小尺寸晶格上训练，即可外推到更大系统，高保真地重建跨越团簇，并在临界点附近产生符合预期有限尺寸标度的可观测量。关键条件是学习到的隐表示必须呈现临界涨落和与逾渗重整化群结构一致的尺度依赖流。；创新点：提出了一种数据驱动的实空间重整化方案，无需显式预设非局域可观测量，且模型具有跨尺度外推能力；并明确指出隐表示的临界涨落与重整化群流结构是实现高性能的关键。摘要未突出说明与传统数值重整化群方法的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用监督式、尺度共享（scale-shared）的神经网络架构，递归应用同一学习到的粗粒化规则（coarse-graining rule）跨尺度生成隐场（latent field），用于预测跨越概率；同时配备一个细粒化解码器（fine-graining decoder）重建最大团簇掩码。训练数据仅来自小尺寸晶格。

papers.title: Interlayer-engineering of Charge Order Wave Vector in Kagome Metals
papers.abstract: Charge orders in the kagome metals AV$_3$Sb$_5$ sit at the center of a rich phase diagram that also includes superconductivity, nematicity, and signatures of time-reversal-symmetry breaking. Yet even the basic question of which charge ordering wave vectors are intrinsic, and which are selected by dimensionality and lattice coupling, remains unsettled. Importantly, the microscopic origin of different charge orders and, in particular, the relationship between the robust bulk $2 \times 2$ charge order and the controversial $4 \times 1$ modulation, which is primarily resolved by surface probes, remains unresolved. Here, we use first-principles calculations to study the role of interlayer coupling in CsV$_3$Sb$_5$ by tuning the interlayer separation from the monolayer limit to the bulk limit. In the monolayer AV$_3$Sb$_5$ (A = Rb, Cs), the phonon spectrum exhibits no instability at the M point; instead, the dominant lattice instability occurs at q = (1/4, 0, 0), consistent with a $4 \times 1$ modulation. As interlayer coupling increases in CsV$_3$Sb$_5$, an M-point phonon progressively softens and becomes unstable already near c = 12.24 Å, evolving into the strong $2 \times 2$ instability characteristic of the bulk. These results identify interlayer coupling as a control parameter at a fixed stoichiometry that links competing $4 \times 1$ and $2 \times 2$ tendencies, providing a unified framework for understanding why multiple charge-order wave vectors coexist and compete in kagome metals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算），并涉及声子谱计算。；研究对象：笼目金属 AV₃Sb₅（A = Rb, Cs），具体以 CsV₃Sb₅ 为主，研究其电荷序波矢（2×2 与 4×1）与层间耦合的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 层间耦合是决定电荷序波矢选择的关键控制参数：单层极限下主导晶格不稳定性在 q = (1/4, 0, 0)（对应 4×1 调制），而随着层间耦合增强，M 点声子逐渐软化并在 c ≈ 12.24 Å 附近失稳，最终演化为体相中强烈的 2×2 电荷序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：层间耦合是决定电荷序波矢选择的关键控制参数：单层极限下主导晶格不稳定性在 q = (1/4, 0, 0)（对应 4×1 调制），而随着层间耦合增强，M 点声子逐渐软化并在 c ≈ 12.24 Å 附近失稳，最终演化为体相中强烈的 2×2 电荷序。；创新点：在固定化学计量比下，将层间耦合作为连续可调的控制参数，统一解释了 4×1 与 2×2 两种电荷序波矢的共存与竞争关系，为理解笼目金属中多种电荷序的微观起源提供了统一框架。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（DFT 框架下的声子谱计算），通过调节层间距从单层极限到体相极限，系统研究层间耦合对晶格不稳定性的影响。

papers.title: Instability of two-dimensional nonrelativistic altermagnets
papers.abstract: Altermagnets (AMs) are collinear compensated magnets that exhibit momentum-dependent spin splitting without requiring a net magnetization. Since local magnetic moments and exchange-driven order do not rely on relativistic effects, altermagnetism can be naturally formulated in a nonrelativistic spin-group framework. This raises a basic question: can two-dimensional altermagnetic order be stabilized by purely exchange interactions in the absence of spin-orbit-induced anisotropy? We address this question by applying Bogoliubov's inequality to a minimal $d$-wave altermagnetic spin model. We show that the anisotropic exchange pattern responsible for altermagnetism still contributes only a quadratic long-wavelength term to the Bogoliubov denominator. Consequently, short-ranged exchange interactions alone cannot stabilize long-range altermagnetic order in two dimensions when continuous spin-rotation symmetry is preserved. In contrast, the corresponding three-dimensional system has a finite small-momentum contribution and is not ruled out by the Mermin-Wagner argument.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Bogoliubov's inequality、spin model、理论论证。；研究对象：二维非相对论性交错磁体（altermagnets）的磁有序稳定性问题，具体为纯交换相互作用下二维d波交错磁自旋模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在保持连续自旋旋转对称性且无自旋轨道耦合各向异性的情况下，短程交换相互作用单独无法在二维中稳定长程交错磁有序；而对应的三维系统则不受此限制，可存在有限小动量贡献，不被Mermin-Wagner论证排除。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在保持连续自旋旋转对称性且无自旋轨道耦合各向异性的情况下，短程交换相互作用单独无法在二维中稳定长程交错磁有序；而对应的三维系统则不受此限制，可存在有限小动量贡献，不被Mermin-Wagner论证排除。；创新点：首次从严格不等式角度证明二维交错磁有序在纯交换相互作用下无法稳定，填补了交错磁体维度效应与Mermin-Wagner定理适用性的理论空白。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：对最小d波交错磁自旋模型应用Bogoliubov不等式，分析长波极限下各向异性交换作用对不等式分母的贡献。

papers.title: Non-Hermitian Skin Effect from Radiative Coupling in a Reciprocal Chiral Medium
papers.abstract: We find that long-range radiative coupling through a passive reciprocal chiral medium produces an unusual non-Hermitian skin effect in a chain of electric dipoles. Although the system is reciprocal, the chirality generates polarization-dependent phase accumulation and attenuation, leading to degenerate pairs of skin modes localized at opposite boundaries. We find that the skin mode profile consists of an exponential contribution from an isolated complex-$β$ pole and a longer-range tail proportional to $1/[n(\ln n)^2]$, where $n$ is the distance from the occupied boundary measured in lattice sites. Finite-chain calculations show that part of the OBC spectrum contracts toward the Bloch spectrum, whereas the number of boundary-localized modes remains extensive.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：We find、theoretical analysis、finite-chain calculations，属于解析与数值结合的理论研究。；研究对象：由电偶极子构成的一维链，嵌入无源、互易的手性介质中，研究其非厄米趋肤效应（non-Hermitian skin effect）及辐射耦合导致的边界局域模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在互易手性介质中，长程辐射耦合可产生非厄米趋肤效应，形成成对、分别局域于相反边界的简并趋肤模式；其模式轮廓由指数项与长程尾巴（~1/[n(ln n)^2]）组成，且开边界谱部分收缩至布洛赫谱，但边界局域模式数目仍为广延量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在互易手性介质中，长程辐射耦合可产生非厄米趋肤效应，形成成对、分别局域于相反边界的简并趋肤模式；其模式轮廓由指数项与长程尾巴（~1/[n(ln n)^2]）组成，且开边界谱部分收缩至布洛赫谱，但边界局域模式数目仍为广延量。；创新点：首次在互易（reciprocal）体系中仅通过手性介质的长程辐射耦合实现非厄米趋肤效应，打破了以往趋肤效应通常依赖非互易或短程跃迁的认知；并揭示了非指数型长程尾巴这一新的模式轮廓特征。
papers.method_zh: 解析求解孤立复β极点贡献，结合有限链数值计算，分析开边界（OBC）谱与布洛赫谱的关系，并提取趋肤模式的实空间分布函数。

papers.title: Topologically protected perfect crossed Andreev reflection in flux-engineered quantum wire junctions
papers.abstract: Generating non-locally entangled electron pairs via Cooper-pair splitting is vital for solid-state quantum information processing. However, isolating the underlying crossed Andreev reflection (CAR) is challenging due to competing transport processes like electron tunneling (ET) and local Andreev reflection (AR). Here, we propose a flux-tunable four-terminal normal metal-superconductor junction that achieves deterministic, 100\% efficient CAR. We demonstrate that at exactly half a magnetic flux quantum ($φ=π$), exact destructive Aharonov-Bohm and Peierls interferences structurally forbid ET and AR respectively. By tuning the central junction hopping, electron reflection is also suppressed to zero. Using the Cauchy argument principle, we prove that this suppression manifests as a quantized topological winding number, guaranteeing a topologically protected unit CAR probability. We establish that this regime is characterized by a strictly positive cross-correlation shot noise, providing an unambiguous experimental signature of Cooper-pair splitting. Furthermore, this perfect CAR is nearly broadband within the superconducting gap and remarkably robust against structural disorder, offering a highly resilient architecture for deterministic nonlocal entanglement generation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“propose”“demonstrate”“prove”等理论推导词汇，以及“Cauchy argument principle”等数学工具，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：通量可调的四端正常金属-超导体（N-S）结，具体为量子线结中的交叉Andreev反射（CAR）过程，以及与之竞争的电子隧穿（ET）和局域Andreev反射（AR）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在磁通量子半整数（φ=π）处，通过Aharonov-Bohm和Peierls干涉的精确相消，可结构性地完全抑制ET和AR，同时调节中心结跳跃使电子反射为零，从而实现确定性的100%效率CAR，且该完美CAR受拓扑保护。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在磁通量子半整数（φ=π）处，通过Aharonov-Bohm和Peierls干涉的精确相消，可结构性地完全抑制ET和AR，同时调节中心结跳跃使电子反射为零，从而实现确定性的100%效率CAR，且该完美CAR受拓扑保护。；创新点：首次提出在四端N-S结中通过磁通调控实现结构性的、拓扑保护的100%效率CAR，并给出严格拓扑证明；同时指出正交叉关联散粒噪声是Cooper对劈裂的明确实验特征。摘要未突出说明与以往CAR方案的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与解析证明。具体包括：利用Aharonov-Bohm干涉和Peierls相位的相消条件设计结参数；采用Cauchy参数原理（辐角原理）证明零反射对应的量子化拓扑绕数；计算交叉关联散粒噪声作为实验可测信号。

papers.title: A solid-solution approach for room-temperature bulk plasticity in KTa1-xNbxO3
papers.abstract: Dislocations are being engineered into perovskite oxides to harvest versatile functional properties. One major bottleneck, however, persists: perovskite oxides that can be engineered with dislocations, particularly via mechanical deformation at room temperature in bulk scale, have so far been limited to only three materials: SrTiO3 (2001, Brunner et al.), KNbO3 (2016, Mark et al.), and KTaO3 (2024, Fang & Zhang et al.). Here, we propose a simple and effective approach by using solid solution to significantly extend the range of materials. We showcase KTa1-xNbxO3 (0<x<1) perovskite oxides for their bulk plasticity at room temperature by constructing a closed-loop validation workflow that includes crystal growth, Brinell indentation, bulk compression, and transmission electron microscopy characterization. Our findings are expected to unlock the materials toolbox for dislocation-tuned functionality of perovskite oxides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到晶体生长、布氏压痕、块体压缩、透射电子显微镜表征等实验手段。；研究对象：KTa1-xNbxO3（0<x<1）钙钛矿氧化物固溶体，具体研究其在室温下的块体塑性变形能力。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过固溶体策略，KTa1-xNbxO3在室温下表现出块体塑性，显著扩展了可通过位错工程调控功能的钙钛矿氧化物材料范围（此前仅有SrTiO3、KNbO3、KTaO3三种材料）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过固溶体策略，KTa1-xNbxO3在室温下表现出块体塑性，显著扩展了可通过位错工程调控功能的钙钛矿氧化物材料范围（此前仅有SrTiO3、KNbO3、KTaO3三种材料）。；创新点：提出利用固溶体（solid solution）这一简单有效的方法来扩展具有室温块体塑性的钙钛矿氧化物材料种类，突破了此前仅限三种材料的瓶颈。
papers.method_zh: 闭环验证流程，包括：晶体生长、布氏压痕（Brinell indentation）、块体压缩实验、透射电子显微镜（TEM）表征。

papers.title: Strain-driven orbital-selective reconstruction and bicollinear-to-stripe evolution in FeTe
papers.abstract: FeTe, as a representative parent material among iron-based superconductors, provides an ideal platform for exploring the interplay among orbital-selective correlations, magnetism, and unconventional superconductivity. However, a unified picture of the correlated electronic structure and magnetism of FeTe under strain remains to be fully clarified. Here, combining density functional theory plus dynamical mean-field theory and Heisenberg model analysis, we uncover an orbital-selective reconstruction of the correlated electronic structure and reveal a strain-driven trajectory from bicollinear to stripe antiferromagnetism (AFM) via an intermediate competing staggered $n$-mer AFM regime in FeTe. Moderate strain gives rise to a regime where more coherent quasiparticles coexist with suppressed local moments. Further strain drives FeTe into an incoherent correlated regime with robust local moments and Fe-$3d_{z^2}$-dominated low-energy states. These results establish a strain-driven trajectory across distinct magnetic and correlated electronic states in FeTe.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：density functional theory plus dynamical mean-field theory、Heisenberg model analysis。；研究对象：铁基超导母体材料 FeTe，具体研究其在应变（strain）作用下的轨道选择性关联电子结构、磁性（双斜纹 bicollinear 到条纹 stripe 反铁磁）演化以及中间出现的交错 n-mer 反铁磁态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了 FeTe 在应变驱动下经历轨道选择性重构，并沿“双斜纹 → 交错 n-mer → 条纹”反铁磁路径演化；中等应变下准粒子更相干且局域磁矩被抑制，而更强应变则进入局域磁矩增强、低能态由 Fe-3d_z² 轨道主导的非相干关联区。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了 FeTe 在应变驱动下经历轨道选择性重构，并沿“双斜纹 → 交错 n-mer → 条纹”反铁磁路径演化；中等应变下准粒子更相干且局域磁矩被抑制，而更强应变则进入局域磁矩增强、低能态由 Fe-3d_z² 轨道主导的非相干关联区。；创新点：首次在 FeTe 中建立应变驱动的从双斜纹到条纹反铁磁的完整演化轨迹，并识别出中间的交错 n-mer 反铁磁竞争态，同时将轨道选择性重构（特别是 Fe-3d_z² 主导的低能态）与磁性转变和相干性变化联系起来。摘要未突出说明与实验对比或预测可观测量的细节。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论 + 动力学平均场理论（DFT+DMFT），并结合海森堡模型分析。

papers.title: Emptiness formation in the Lieb-Liniger gas: hydrodynamic instantons and a conjectured rate function
papers.abstract: We study the emptiness formation probability (EFP) in the ground state of the repulsive one-dimensional Lieb-Liniger Bose gas. For a macroscopic empty interval of length $2R$, its leading asymptotic behavior is described by a rate function $f(γ_0)$, defined by $-\log P(R)\sim(ρ_0R)^2f(γ_0)$, where $ρ_0$ is the mean density and $γ_0$ is the dimensionless interaction strength. We propose a parameter-free integral equation for $f(γ_0)$. Starting from the exact dual-field Fredholm-determinant representation of the EFP, we show how the conjectured kernel arises formally and identify the uniform asymptotic statement that remains to be proven for a rigorous derivation. The conjecture reproduces the Tonks-Girardeau and weak-coupling limits, as well as the first correction obtained independently in both limits. It also agrees at the few-percent level with numerical minimization of the Lieb-Liniger hydrodynamic action over more than four orders of magnitude in coupling. The numerical calculation yields the corresponding emptiness instantons and their astroid-like vacuum regions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“提出积分方程”“形式推导”“猜想”“数值最小化”等理论推导与数值计算关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：一维排斥型Lieb-Liniger玻色气体的基态，具体研究其“空区间形成概率”（EFP），即长度为2R的宏观空区间在基态中出现的概率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了空区间形成概率的速率函数f(γ₀)的无参数积分方程猜想，该猜想在Tonks-Girardeau极限和弱耦合极限下均正确，并与数值计算在四个数量级耦合强度范围内以百分之几的精度吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了空区间形成概率的速率函数f(γ₀)的无参数积分方程猜想，该猜想在Tonks-Girardeau极限和弱耦合极限下均正确，并与数值计算在四个数量级耦合强度范围内以百分之几的精度吻合。；创新点：首次提出一个无参数的积分方程来统一描述Lieb-Liniger气体EFP的速率函数，并给出了其形式来源及待证的渐近严格表述；数值上揭示了空穴瞬子及其星形（astroid-like）真空区域结构。摘要未突出说明与已有速率函数猜想的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 从EFP的精确对偶场Fredholm行列式表示出发，形式推导出猜想核；利用Lieb-Liniger流体动力学作用量的数值最小化计算空穴瞬子（emptiness instantons）及速率函数；并与已知极限（Tonks-Girardeau、弱耦合）的解析结果进行对比验证。

papers.title: When dissipative steady states admit thermodynamic occupation laws
papers.abstract: Non-equilibrium steady states (NESSs) generally lack thermodynamic occupation laws because finite stationary circulation and a globally exact rate-ratio field cannot coexist for the same Markov generator. Here we construct a sector-separated geometry that overcomes this incompatibility without arresting dissipation. Entropy-production exposure-and-separation excludes the entropy-producing state~$0$ from the conditional occupation manifold while retaining it in the dissipative full graph; physical returns $i\to0\to0^\ast$ become effectively Markovian in the strong-bias/rapid-reset (SR) limit. For a thermodynamically complete conditional manifold, autonomous redistribution (AR) eliminates residual futile circulation, making the rate-ratio one-form exact. Thermodynamic calibration gives $X_i=β(Δμ- \mathcal F_i^{\mathrm{cost}})$ and $p_i=e^{X_i}/Z_\mathcal{C}$, with $Z_\mathcal{C}=1+\sum_i e^{X_i}$. Full-graph probabilities factorize exactly as $P_α=(1-P_0)p_α$. In the SR limit, the kinetic factor tends to unity while $p_α\to e^{X_α}/Z_\mathcal C$, yielding $P_α\to p_α$ while finite dissipation persists. Near AR, integrability is lost linearly in residual cycle current whereas dissipation begins quadratically. In the binary zero-cycle-rank limit, occupation redistributes autonomously under maintained $Δμ$ bias, yielding the inverted Fermi--Dirac law, which is applied to thermal smearing in quantum-dot lasers. The framework provides constructive acquisition conditions and failure diagnostics for thermodynamic occupation laws in dissipative NESSs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：construct（构造）、framework（框架）、theoretical/thermodynamic calibration（热力学标定）、Markov generator（马尔可夫生成元）。；研究对象：非平衡稳态（NESS）系统，具体为具有扇区分离几何结构的马尔可夫生成元体系，以及其热力学占据律（thermodynamic occupation laws）的存在条件；应用对象为量子点激光器中的热展宽。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过构造扇区分离几何，并引入熵产生暴露-分离与自主再分布机制，可以在保持有限耗散的同时，使非平衡稳态的占据概率严格满足热力学占据律（如玻尔兹曼型或倒费米-狄拉克型分布），从而克服了有限稳态环流与全局精确速率比场不能共存的矛盾。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过构造扇区分离几何，并引入熵产生暴露-分离与自主再分布机制，可以在保持有限耗散的同时，使非平衡稳态的占据概率严格满足热力学占据律（如玻尔兹曼型或倒费米-狄拉克型分布），从而克服了有限稳态环流与全局精确速率比场不能共存的矛盾。；创新点：提出了一种无需抑制耗散即可恢复热力学占据律的构造性方案（扇区分离+SR/AR机制），并给出了占据律成立的构造条件与失效诊断；摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造与解析分析：基于马尔可夫生成元框架，构造扇区分离几何；引入强偏置/快速重置（SR）极限与自主再分布（AR）机制；通过热力学标定得到占据概率表达式 \(p_i=e^{X_i}/Z_\mathcal{C}\)；分析近AR极限下可积性的线性损失与耗散的二次行为；在二元零环秩极限下推导倒费米-狄拉克分布。

papers.title: Influence of twist direction and large deformation on soft material torsional contact
papers.abstract: Shear-induced contact area reduction is widely observed in soft contacts, yet recent torsional experiments have revealed a more complex non-monotonic evolution in which the contact area first increases and then decreases with twist angle. The mechanism responsible for this initial area increase and the role of large deformation in the overall area evolution remain unclear. In this study, we experimentally investigate the torsional contact response of soft Polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) spheres by combining forward-backward twist tests with a systematic variation of the curing-agent-to-base ratio to tune material softness and deformation level. The loading-unloading tests show that the torsional interface is strongly irreversible: during unloading, the contact area follows a decrease-increase-decrease path rather than retracing the loading branch, and repeatable petal-like edges appear, indicating a wrinkle-induced surface instability. By decreasing the mixing ratio, we find that larger deformation strengthens the area-reduction contribution and eventually suppresses the initial area increase, leading to a monotonic area decrease during loading for sufficiently soft PDMS. Softer PDMS also exhibits lower shear strength, weaker torque oscillations, and improved repeatability. The results provide experimental evidence that large deformation can drive shear-induced contact area reduction, while the origin of the initial area increase remains unresolved. These findings narrow the possible mechanisms (e.g., triboelectrification) responsible for the initial area increase and provide a stringent benchmark for frictional contact models of soft interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“experimentally investigate”“loading-unloading tests”“experimental evidence”。；研究对象：软材料（PDMS，聚二甲基硅氧烷）球体在扭转接触中的接触面积演化行为，具体涉及扭转方向、大变形效应以及表面失稳（褶皱）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 大变形会增强剪切诱导的接触面积缩减效应，并最终抑制初始面积增加，使足够软的PDMS在加载过程中呈现单调面积减小；而初始面积增加的机制仍未解决，但实验结果缩小了可能机制（如摩擦起电）的范围。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：大变形会增强剪切诱导的接触面积缩减效应，并最终抑制初始面积增加，使足够软的PDMS在加载过程中呈现单调面积减小；而初始面积增加的机制仍未解决，但实验结果缩小了可能机制（如摩擦起电）的范围。；创新点：首次通过系统改变材料软硬度并结合正反向扭转实验，揭示大变形对扭转接触面积非单调演化的调控作用，并排除了部分初始面积增加的候选机制，为软界面摩擦接触模型提供了严格的实验基准。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用正向-反向扭转测试（forward-backward twist tests），并通过系统改变固化剂与基体比例（curing-agent-to-base ratio）来调节材料软硬度和变形程度，观测加载-卸载过程中的接触面积变化、扭矩振荡及表面形貌。

papers.title: Thermally quenched metastability in metal-insulator transitions via elemental substitution
papers.abstract: Thermal quenching inhibits equilibration toward the thermodynamic ground state during phase transitions, revealing metastable phases such as structural glasses and quenched alloys. Whether such thermally quenched metastability can be realized in metal-insulator transitions has remained an open question because these transformations are governed by collective electronic reorganization rather than atomic diffusion. We demonstrate that rapid cooling exceeding 10$^9$ K s$^{-1}$ kinetically avoids the metal-insulator transition, stabilizing a long-lived metastable metallic phase in tungsten-substituted VO$_2$. Temperature-dependent relaxation reveals nucleation-dominated kinetics with a thermal activation barrier introduced by tungsten substitution. Our results establish elemental substitution as a route to thermally quenched metastability in metal-insulator transitions, expanding metastable phase control to electronic phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“demonstrate”“rapid cooling”“temperature-dependent relaxation”等实验性关键词。；研究对象：钨取代二氧化钒（W-substituted VO₂）中的金属-绝缘体相变，以及通过热淬火实现亚稳金属相的可能性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过超过10⁹ K s⁻¹的快速冷却，可以动力学地避开金属-绝缘体相变，稳定一种长寿命的亚稳金属相；钨取代引入的热激活势垒导致成核主导的弛豫动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过超过10⁹ K s⁻¹的快速冷却，可以动力学地避开金属-绝缘体相变，稳定一种长寿命的亚稳金属相；钨取代引入的热激活势垒导致成核主导的弛豫动力学。；创新点：首次在金属-绝缘体相变中实现热淬火诱导的亚稳性，将元素取代作为调控电子相亚稳态的通用途径，扩展了亚稳相控制从结构相到电子相的范畴。
papers.method_zh: 快速热淬火实验（冷却速率>10⁹ K s⁻¹）、温度依赖的弛豫测量，用于表征亚稳相的稳定性与转变动力学。

papers.title: Atomic investigations on the mechanical properties of CoCrNi medium-entropy alloy nanowires
papers.abstract: This work investigated the mechanical properties of CoCrNi medium-entropy alloy (MEA) nanowires under uniaxial tensile loading along three crystallographic orientations [100], [110] and [111].The CoCrNi single crystal nanowires with face-centered cubic (FCC) structure exhibits a strong anisotropic behavior.Molecular dynamics simulations were employed to give atomic-level insight into the plastic deformation.The surface effect causes dislocations emitted from the free surface and slip into the internal. The temperature effect was also considered. Under identical geometric configurations, crystal orientations and temperature, interatomic interactions dominate key mechanical properties such as Young's modulus and yield strength.Simulation results reveal a promounced linear correlation between the average atomic force and mechanical performance across eight representative FCC metallic nanowires (Al, Au, Ag, Cu, Ni, Al19Mg alloy, FeCoCrCuNi high-entropy alloy and CoCrNi MEA). This study delivers novel insights into the mechanical behavior of metallic nanowires, and offers guidance for the rational design of alloy nanowires.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Molecular dynamics simulations were employed”（采用分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：CoCrNi中熵合金（MEA）纳米线，具体为面心立方（FCC）单晶结构，沿[100]、[110]和[111]三个晶体学方向进行单轴拉伸加载。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CoCrNi中熵合金纳米线在拉伸下表现出强烈的各向异性行为；表面效应导致位错从自由表面发射并向内部滑移；在相同几何构型、晶体取向和温度下，原子间相互作用主导杨氏模量和屈服强度等关键力学性能。此外，在八种代表性FCC金属纳米线中，平均原子力与力学性能之间存在显著的线性关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CoCrNi中熵合金纳米线在拉伸下表现出强烈的各向异性行为；表面效应导致位错从自由表面发射并向内部滑移；在相同几何构型、晶体取向和温度下，原子间相互作用主导杨氏模量和屈服强度等关键力学性能。此外，在八种代表性FCC金属纳米线中，平均原子力与力学性能之间存在显著的线性关联。；创新点：揭示了平均原子力与金属纳米线力学性能之间的普适线性关联，为合金纳米线的理性设计提供了新指导。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新点。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学（MD）模拟，用于原子级洞察塑性变形过程；考虑了温度效应；对比了八种FCC金属纳米线（Al、Au、Ag、Cu、Ni、Al19Mg合金、FeCoCrCuNi高熵合金和CoCrNi MEA）的力学性能。

papers.title: Dynamical phase selection controls compute scaling in looped transformers
papers.abstract: A looped transformer performs inference by iterating a weight-tied map, making its computation a dynamical process whose cost is set by the resulting inference dynamics. Here we show that networks with identical architecture and objective, trained to identical accuracy, nevertheless realize distinct dynamical phases depending strongly on initialization, and that the bifurcation defining each phase determines how test-time compute scales. The phases are distinguished by their bifurcation mechanisms, including a saddle-node fold and a Neimark-Sacker-type transition to bounded nonstationary motion. In the fold phase, a one-dimensional normal-form reduction predicts both the relaxation-time and spectral-gap amplitudes from local derivatives of the trained map, yielding the parameter-free relation $τ(\varepsilon)[1-λ_{\max}(-\varepsilon)]\toπ$. Composed with a regular distribution of problem difficulty, the same critical slowing down produces the workload-level tail $P(τ>N)\sim N^{-2}$. In the Neimark--Sacker phase, the fold scaling law disappears rather than merely changing its prefactor. Thus, test-time compute is not determined by architecture alone. It is governed by the dynamical phase of the solution found by training.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要涉及“dynamical process”“normal-form reduction”“scaling law”等理论分析，以及“trained map”“test-time compute”等计算/机器学习建模内容，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：循环变压器（looped transformer）在推理（inference）过程中的动力学行为，具体关注其计算成本（test-time compute）如何由训练后映射的动力学相（dynamical phase）决定。属于神经网络动力学与统计物理交叉的体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 具有相同架构、目标和训练精度的网络，会因初始化不同而落入不同的动力学相（由分岔机制区分，如鞍结分岔和Neimark-Sacker型分岔），且各相决定测试时计算量的标度行为：鞍结相中临界慢化给出参数无关关系 τ(ε)[1−λ_max(−ε)]→π，并导致工作量尾部 P(τ>N)∼N^(−2)；而在Neimark-Sacker相中该标度律完全消失。因此测试时计算量不由架构单独决定，而由训练所找到解的动力学相控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：具有相同架构、目标和训练精度的网络，会因初始化不同而落入不同的动力学相（由分岔机制区分，如鞍结分岔和Neimark-Sacker型分岔），且各相决定测试时计算量的标度行为：鞍结相中临界慢化给出参数无关关系 τ(ε)[1−λ_max(−ε)]→π，并导致工作量尾部 P(τ>N)∼N^(−2)；而在Neimark-Sacker相中该标度律完全消失。因此测试时计算量不由架构单独决定，而由训练所找到解的动力学相控制。；创新点：首次将循环变压器的测试时计算标度与训练后动力学相（由分岔类型刻画）联系起来，揭示初始化通过选择分岔机制（而非仅影响精度）决定计算标度，并给出参数无关的普适关系及尾部指数。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体数值方法或理论工具，但提及：权重共享映射的迭代动力学分析、分岔理论（鞍结分岔、Neimark-Sacker型转变）、一维正规形约化（normal-form reduction）、谱隙与弛豫时间分析、以及问题难度分布与临界慢化组合推导尾部标度。未提及具体计算框架（如PyTorch、TensorFlow等）。

papers.title: Field-amplified readouts of weak altermagnetic exchange in MnF$_2$
papers.abstract: MnF$_2$, the textbook two-sublattice antiferromagnet, has reemerged as a prototypical altermagnet, yet the sublattice-odd exchange that defines this identity remains under active debate: it enters the magnon splitting only in quadrature with the dipole--dipole interaction, its magnitude suppressed and its sign erased. An overdetermined first-principles total-energy mapping resolves this scale as a seventh-neighbor imbalance $δ{J_7}\simeq+8~μ$eV. The resulting Hamiltonian, with the dipole--dipole interaction included explicitly, reproduces the low-energy gap and the visible finite-momentum splitting. A longitudinal field $B\parallel c$ then acts as a linear amplifier of the hidden scale, opening two signed, field-linear readouts. The first is the compensation field $B^\ast(\mathbf Q)$, the position of minimum splitting, which is equal and opposite at the rotation-related partner momenta: a shift from zero field is itself evidence of a finite imbalance, its side gives the sign, and its magnitude, $|B^\ast|\simeq0.34$~T here, gives the scale. The second is the fixed-field contrast of the partner splittings, $\simeq0.14$~meV at $1$~T, six times the zero-field excess: a sign check from just two spectra. Both readouts survive a $0.12$~meV energy resolution, and the construction carries over to any easy-axis collinear altermagnet, bringing $μ$eV altermagnetic exchange within present instrumental reach.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“first-principles total-energy mapping”（第一性原理总能映射）、“Hamiltonian”（哈密顿量）等关键词，未提及实验测量手段。；研究对象：MnF₂（氟化锰），一种典型的双亚晶格反铁磁体，近期被重新认定为交错磁体（altermagnet）。研究聚焦于其亚晶格奇宇称交换相互作用（即交错磁交换）的尺度与符号，以及该隐藏能标在外加磁场下的可读性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MnF₂ 中第七近邻交换不平衡 δJ₇ ≃ +8 μeV 是决定交错磁交换的关键尺度；沿 c 轴施加纵向磁场可将这一隐藏能标线性放大，产生两个带符号的场线性读出信号：补偿场 B*(Q) 和固定场下伙伴劈裂对比度，二者均可用于确定该交换不平衡的符号与大小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MnF₂ 中第七近邻交换不平衡 δJ₇ ≃ +8 μeV 是决定交错磁交换的关键尺度；沿 c 轴施加纵向磁场可将这一隐藏能标线性放大，产生两个带符号的场线性读出信号：补偿场 B*(Q) 和固定场下伙伴劈裂对比度，二者均可用于确定该交换不平衡的符号与大小。；创新点：提出利用纵向磁场作为“线性放大器”来读取被偶极相互作用掩盖的微弱交错磁交换能标，并给出两个可直接实验验证的读出方案（补偿场位置与固定场劈裂对比度），使 μeV 量级的交错磁交换进入现有仪器可探测范围。摘要未突出说明与以往理论工作的其他差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用超定（overdetermined）第一性原理总能映射方法提取交换参数，显式包含偶极-偶极相互作用构建自旋哈密顿量，并通过数值求解得到磁振子谱与场依赖行为。摘要未明确说明具体泛函形式（如 DFT+U 或杂化泛函）。

papers.title: Competition between Geometrical Frustration and the Kondo Effect in CePdAl Revealed by High-Resolution Magnetization
papers.abstract: CePdAl is a heavy-fermion compound with a quasi-kagome structure, where geometrical frustration competes with the Kondo effect. Using a high-sensitivity magnetometer, we observe clear first-order metamagnetic transitions without magnetization plateaus in CePdAl at 80 mK, indicating a lifting of frustration through the suppression of the Kondo effect and spin flips of ordered moments under fields. An anomaly in the nonlinear magnetic susceptibility at 4.3 T suggests nondipolar correlations in the polarized paramagnetic state. Furthermore, we found no evidence of non-Fermi-liquid behavior in the high-field region, where the antiferromagnetic order is completely suppressed. These findings establish the essential thermodynamic constraints for understanding the field-induced spin-liquid state in CePdAl.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到使用高灵敏度磁强计（high-sensitivity magnetometer）进行测量，并报道了实验观测结果（如80 mK下的磁化行为）。；研究对象：重费米子化合物CePdAl，其具有准kagome结构，核心物理现象是几何阻挫与Kondo效应之间的竞争，以及磁场诱导的自旋液体态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在80 mK下，CePdAl中观察到清晰的一级亚磁跃迁但无磁化平台，表明磁场通过抑制Kondo效应并翻转有序磁矩来解除几何阻挫；同时在高场区未发现非费米液体行为的证据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在80 mK下，CePdAl中观察到清晰的一级亚磁跃迁但无磁化平台，表明磁场通过抑制Kondo效应并翻转有序磁矩来解除几何阻挫；同时在高场区未发现非费米液体行为的证据。；创新点：首次在CePdAl中通过高分辨率磁化测量明确观测到无平台的一级亚磁跃迁，并在4.3 T处发现非线性磁化率异常，暗示极化顺磁态中存在非偶极关联；同时排除了高场区的非费米液体行为，为理解该材料中场致自旋液体态提供了关键热力学约束。
papers.method_zh: 高灵敏度磁强计测量（high-sensitivity magnetometer），包括高分辨率磁化强度测量以及非线性磁化率的测量。

papers.title: Optical spectroscopy of composite fermion edge states in the fractional quantum Hall effect
papers.abstract: We show that edge states in fractional quantum Hall effect samples can be selectively probed and excited with sub-terahertz optical spectroscopy. Using the composite fermion (CF) mean-field framework, which maps the strongly correlated fractional quantum Hall problem onto an effective integer quantum Hall problem, we calculate the absorbance spectrum for the Jain sequence of filling fractions including both bulk and edge states. The CF edge-state absorption peaks appear in the millimeter-wave to sub-terahertz range, e.g., 60-500 GHz at B = 10 T in GaAs, i.e. they are blueshifted with respect to the bulk CF cyclotron frequency but are well below the integer quantum Hall cyclotron frequency scale at the same magnetic fields. The number of resolved peaks in each series of the absorption spectrum counts the filled Lambda-levels and fingerprints the fraction. Inversion symmetry breaking near the edge activates optical transitions forbidden in the bulk and enables second-order nonlinear processes in electric-dipole approximation. The absolute frequency scale of the spectrum is set by the CF effective mass, which is generated entirely by electron-electron interactions, so the absorption spectrum provides a direct optical probe of this interaction-induced mass.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“composite fermion (CF) mean-field framework”进行计算，并“calculate the absorbance spectrum”，未提及实验测量。；研究对象：分数量子霍尔效应（FQHE）中的边缘态，具体为Jain序列填充因子下的复合费米子边缘态，体系为GaAs二维电子气。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 复合费米子边缘态的吸收峰出现在毫米波至亚太赫兹频段（如B=10 T时约60–500 GHz），相对于体态CF回旋频率发生蓝移，但远低于同磁场下整数量子霍尔回旋频率；吸收谱中每个系列的峰数目对应填充的Lambda能级数，可直接指纹化填充因子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：复合费米子边缘态的吸收峰出现在毫米波至亚太赫兹频段（如B=10 T时约60–500 GHz），相对于体态CF回旋频率发生蓝移，但远低于同磁场下整数量子霍尔回旋频率；吸收谱中每个系列的峰数目对应填充的Lambda能级数，可直接指纹化填充因子。；创新点：首次提出用亚太赫兹光学光谱选择性探测和激发FQHE边缘态，并揭示吸收谱可直接测量由电子-电子相互作用产生的复合费米子有效质量——这是对相互作用诱导质量的直接光学探针。摘要未突出说明与以往边缘态输运或光学研究的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用复合费米子平均场理论框架，将强关联FQHE问题映射为有效整数量子霍尔问题，计算包含体态和边缘态的吸收光谱；同时分析了电偶极近似下由边缘反演对称性破缺激活的非线性光学过程。

papers.title: Phase transitions and microphases in elastomers. II. Anisotropy-driven morphologies
papers.abstract: In swollen elastomers, elasticity can arrest macroscopic demixing between the polymer network and the solvent, producing stable domains of finite size. While previous theories have focused on isotropically swollen elastomers, anisotropy strongly influences the phase behavior of many related systems, such as gels and crosslinked polymer blends. Building on the approach developed in Part I of this two-part paper, we investigate the effects of two experimentally induced sources of anisotropy: uniaxial swelling and stiffness gradients. We show that uniaxial swelling can lead to the formation of stable lamellar microphases and modify phase behavior, while stiffness gradients can cause spatial variations in the characteristic microphase size.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“previous theories”“Building on the approach developed in Part I”，且讨论的是理论框架对相行为的预测，未涉及实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：弹性体（elastomers）中的相分离与微相（microphases）形成，具体关注各向异性（单轴溶胀和刚度梯度）对聚合物网络与溶剂之间宏观去混溶（macroscopic demixing）被弹性抑制后形成的有限尺寸稳定畴结构的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单轴溶胀可诱导稳定层状微相（lamellar microphases）并改变相行为；刚度梯度会导致特征微相尺寸在空间上发生变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单轴溶胀可诱导稳定层状微相（lamellar microphases）并改变相行为；刚度梯度会导致特征微相尺寸在空间上发生变化。；创新点：将各向异性效应引入弹性体微相形成的理论框架，此前理论多聚焦于各向同性溶胀；本研究系统探讨了单轴溶胀和刚度梯度这两种实验可实现的各向异性对相图及微相形貌的影响。
papers.method_zh: 基于该两篇论文第一部分（Part I）所发展的理论方法，对两种各向异性来源（单轴溶胀与刚度梯度）进行解析或半解析的理论分析。摘要未明确说明具体数学形式（如自由能泛函、自洽场理论等）。

papers.title: Beyond Allen-Heine-Cardona: non-perturbative electron-phonon interactions in the linewidths and lineshifts of diamond
papers.abstract: The temperature-dependent band gap of solids is usually computed from the perturbative Allen-Heine-Cardona (AHC) electron-phonon self-energy evaluated on-shell. Extending AHC to arbitrary frequency $ω$ to determine the full spectral function via the Dyson equation is known to fail, misplacing satellites and yielding no broadening at band extrema, while non-perturbative supercell (SC) methods have focused on eigenvalue averages rather than lineshapes, and approaches based on special displacements cannot describe the full lineshape, or the lineshift at degenerate bands. Here we use a non-perturbative Green's function method (NPG), stochastically sampling distorted SC configurations, from which the spectral function, including lineshift, linewidth, and asymmetry, follows directly, and we recover finite spectral weight at the renormalized band extrema. We prove that the perturbative self-energy, computed to any order with the bare propagator and introduced into the Dyson equation, has an imaginary part that vanishes within the bare gap, giving incorrect spectral functions: self-consistency of the propagator is essential to broaden the band edges. NPG satisfies this property by construction, and contains all non-bubble diagrams. We also give a simple explanation of why SC methods converge with much smaller SCs than the corresponding $\mathbf{q}$-grids required by perturbation theory. For the band gap shift itself, the NPG and on-shell AHC results are found to be comparable, demonstrating that higher-order terms do not significantly alter the resulting renormalization in diamond. When it comes to the spectral function though, our results show that going beyond bare perturbation theory is not merely more accurate, but necessary, and NPG provides a robust framework to capture spectral broadening and higher-order effects from first principles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“非微扰Green's function方法（NPG）”“随机采样”“超胞（SC）方法”“微扰自能”等理论计算关键词，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：金刚石（diamond）中的电子-声子相互作用，具体关注其温度依赖的带隙重整化、谱函数（spectral function）中的线宽（linewidth）、线移（lineshift）及不对称性（asymmetry），以及带边（band extrema）处的谱权重行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非微扰Green's function方法（NPG）能够正确给出金刚石重整化带边处的有限谱权重和完整谱函数（含线宽、线移、不对称性），而任意阶的微扰自能（基于裸传播子）代入Dyson方程后，其虚部在裸带隙内为零，导致谱函数错误；自洽性是展宽带边的必要条件。对于带隙移动本身，NPG与on-shell AHC结果相当，表明高阶项对金刚石重整化影响不大，但谱函数必须超越裸微扰理论。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非微扰Green's function方法（NPG）能够正确给出金刚石重整化带边处的有限谱权重和完整谱函数（含线宽、线移、不对称性），而任意阶的微扰自能（基于裸传播子）代入Dyson方程后，其虚部在裸带隙内为零，导致谱函数错误；自洽性是展宽带边的必要条件。对于带隙移动本身，NPG与on-shell AHC结果相当，表明高阶项对金刚石重整化影响不大，但谱函数必须超越裸微扰理论。；创新点：首次用非微扰随机采样Green's function方法直接计算完整谱函数（而非仅本征值平均），证明自洽传播子对带边展宽的必要性，并解释了SC方法为何比微扰论所需q网格收敛更快（SC方法天然满足自洽性并包含所有非气泡图）。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 非微扰Green's function方法（NPG）：随机采样畸变超胞（SC）构型，直接计算谱函数（含线移、线宽、不对称性）。与on-shell Allen-Heine-Cardona（AHC）微扰自能结果对比，并分析微扰自能（任意阶，基于裸传播子）代入Dyson方程的行为。摘要未明确说明具体基函数或泛函（如DFT具体实现），但属于第一性原理框架。

papers.title: Fluctuation--response relations from an emergent $\mathbb{Z}_2$ symmetry in the rotating stochastic Landau model
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate the extent to which fluctuation--response relations emerge from coarse-grained stochastic dynamics alone, and which aspects instead depend on additional information about the system. To address this question, we study the rotating stochastic Landau model, an exactly solvable system describing an overdamped charged Brownian particle in a constant magnetic field, coupled dissipatively to a rotating environment, whose steady state supports circulating probability currents. Using the Martin--Siggia--Rose path integral, we show that there is an emergent $\mathbb{Z}_2$ symmetry transformation that implements the time-reversed dynamics and changes the action by a boundary term. Comparison with the Crooks fluctuation theorem identifies this term with the entropy associated with transitions between steady-state configurations. After coupling the theory to external sources, the same symmetry yields Ward identities relating fluctuations and response. These identities follow entirely from the coarse-grained stochastic theory and do not fix the noise strength. Finally, upon imposing the Einstein relation, we show that they coincide with the high-temperature fluctuation--dissipation relations implied by the rotating Kubo--Martin--Schwinger condition for a microscopic Gibbs ensemble.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“Martin–Siggia–Rose path integral”“Ward identities”“对称性变换”等理论物理工具，且无实验或数值计算描述。；研究对象：旋转随机朗道模型（rotating stochastic Landau model），即一个过阻尼带电布朗粒子在恒定磁场中与旋转环境耗散耦合的体系，其稳态支持循环概率流。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该粗粒化随机动力学中存在一个涌现的 \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) 对称性变换，可实现时间反演动力学并使作用量仅改变一个边界项；由此导出的 Ward 恒等式给出了涨落与响应之间的关系，且这些关系完全由粗粒化随机理论决定，不依赖于噪声强度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该粗粒化随机动力学中存在一个涌现的 \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) 对称性变换，可实现时间反演动力学并使作用量仅改变一个边界项；由此导出的 Ward 恒等式给出了涨落与响应之间的关系，且这些关系完全由粗粒化随机理论决定，不依赖于噪声强度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: Martin–Siggia–Rose（MSR）路径积分形式；通过耦合外部源导出 Ward 恒等式；与 Crooks 涨落定理对比识别边界项的熵含义；在施加爱因斯坦关系后，与旋转 Kubo–Martin–Schwinger（KMS）条件给出的高温涨落耗散关系进行比较。

papers.title: Comparing non-local granular fluid continuum models for silo discharge: Toward clogging prediction
papers.abstract: Non-local constitutive theories have received increasing attention in continuum descriptions of granular flows. However, these models have not been systematically compared for silo discharge within a unified numerical framework. We address this gap with two-dimensional finite-volume method (FVM) simulations of silo discharge using the Basilisk platform. We first validate our FVM implementation of the dynamic non-local granular fluidity (NGF) model against the material point method results of Dunatunga & Kamrin (J. Fluid Mech., 2022, 940, A14), obtaining quantitative agreement. Second, we relate the discharge rate $Q$ to the outlet-to-particle size ratio $D/d$ and the non-local amplitude $A$. From the simulated $Q$, we then evaluate the clogging probability $J(D/d, A)$ within the probabilistic framework of Janda et al. (Europhys. Lett. 84 (4), 44002). The predicted $J$ decays exponentially with $D/d$, consistent with the experimental trend of Janda et al. (Europhys. Lett. 84 (4), 44002). Rather than directly predicting flow arrest, our approach captures the continuous probabilistic transition. Finally, within the same numerical framework and using identical values of $A$, we compare several non-local constitutive models, including several linearised variants that we derive. Almost all models predict a reduction in the discharge rate with increasing $A$, yet significant quantitative differences are observed among the models. The results are further classified into groups according to their predicted flow behaviour, revealing close correspondences among certain formulations. Notably, using the non-local amplitudes reported in the literature [Bouzid et al. (Phys. Rev. Lett. 111, 238301), Henann & Kamrin (Proc. Natl Acad. Sci. USA 110(17))] yields near-zero discharge rates. Ill-posed issues are discussed. The implementation of all models is open-sourced and computationally efficient.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“two-dimensional finite-volume method (FVM) simulations”“material point method results”“numerical framework”等计算模拟关键词。；研究对象：颗粒物质从料仓（silo）排出的非局域颗粒流变学问题，具体关注颗粒流连续介质模型、堵塞（clogging）概率以及出口尺寸与颗粒尺寸比 D/d 对排出速率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于模拟得到的排出速率 Q，在 Janda 等人的概率框架下预测的堵塞概率 J(D/d, A) 随 D/d 呈指数衰减，与实验趋势一致；几乎所有非局域模型都预测排出速率随非局域振幅 A 增大而减小，但各模型间存在显著定量差异，且使用文献报道的非局域振幅值会导致排出速率接近零。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于模拟得到的排出速率 Q，在 Janda 等人的概率框架下预测的堵塞概率 J(D/d, A) 随 D/d 呈指数衰减，与实验趋势一致；几乎所有非局域模型都预测排出速率随非局域振幅 A 增大而减小，但各模型间存在显著定量差异，且使用文献报道的非局域振幅值会导致排出速率接近零。；创新点：首次在统一数值框架内系统比较多种非局域连续介质模型在料仓排出问题中的表现，并推导了若干线性化变体；所有模型实现开源且计算高效。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用 Basilisk 平台上的二维有限体积法（FVM）求解动态非局域颗粒流动性（NGF）模型，并与 Dunatunga & Kamrin 的质点法（MPM）结果进行定量验证；随后在统一数值框架下，用相同 A 值对比多种非局域本构模型（包括若干线性化变体），并基于 Janda 等人的概率框架评估堵塞概率。

papers.title: Statistical Disorder in MBE-Grown AlGaAs/GaAs Superlattices for Quantum Bragg Mirrors using Synchrotron X-ray Diffraction
papers.abstract: AlGaAs/GaAs superlattices grown by Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE) are foundational for advanced optoelectronic devices, including Quantum Bragg Mirror (QBM) infrared detectors. The performance of these devices critically depends on achieving near-perfect periodicity and abrupt interfaces, however, intrinsic statistical fluctuations during MBE growth introduce nanoscale structural disorder that can degrade device efficiency. In this study, we present a comprehensive methodology for quantifying this disorder in a 203-layer QBM device. High-resolution structural characterization was performed using high-energy (25 keV) synchrotron X-ray diffraction. By coupling a recursive dynamical diffraction formalism with an ensemble simulated annealing refinement, we extracted statistically robust, layer-by-layer thickness profiles. Our analysis reveals highly systematic, material-specific deviations from the nominal design: all AlGaAs barrier layers were consistently thinner than nominal by 0.3-0.6 nm. Furthermore, the sequential thickness profile successfully identified a significant 35 nm deficit in the final macroscopic top contact layer and a 40 nm deficit in the first GaAs layer. Achieving a statistical precision of about 0.2 to 0.6 nm (approximately 1-2 atomic monolayers), this non-destructive diagnostic approach provides directly actionable feedback for MBE flux calibration protocols.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“synchrotron X-ray diffraction”（同步辐射X射线衍射）进行高分辨结构表征，属于实验手段。；研究对象：分子束外延（MBE）生长的AlGaAs/GaAs超晶格，具体为一个203层的量子布拉格反射镜（QBM）红外探测器器件，关注其纳米尺度的统计结构无序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 所有AlGaAs势垒层均系统性比名义设计薄0.3–0.6 nm；同时识别出顶层接触层存在35 nm的厚度亏损，以及第一层GaAs层存在40 nm的厚度亏损。该非破坏性方法可实现约0.2–0.6 nm（约1–2个原子单层）的统计精度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：所有AlGaAs势垒层均系统性比名义设计薄0.3–0.6 nm；同时识别出顶层接触层存在35 nm的厚度亏损，以及第一层GaAs层存在40 nm的厚度亏损。该非破坏性方法可实现约0.2–0.6 nm（约1–2个原子单层）的统计精度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可看出其新意在于：对203层实际器件实现逐层厚度统计提取，并达到原子单层级别的统计精度，且能直接反馈给MBE束流校准工艺。
papers.method_zh: 高能（25 keV）同步辐射X射线衍射进行高分辨结构表征；将递归动力学衍射理论（recursive dynamical diffraction formalism）与系综模拟退火精修（ensemble simulated annealing refinement）相结合，提取逐层厚度分布。

papers.title: Magnetic permeability and zone-folded phonons in layered NiPS$_3$
papers.abstract: Nickel phosphorus trisulfide (NiPS$_3$) stands out as a Mott insulator exhibiting XY-type antiferromagnetic order. In this work, we investigate the electrodynamic response of single-crystalline NiPS$_3$ using Terahertz Time-Domain Spectroscopy (THz-TDS) as a function of temperature. In cases where the magnetic permeability cannot be approximated to unity, conventional THz transmission analysis is often restricted to the complex refractive index, hindering the distinction between magnetic and dielectric contributions. To overcome this limitation, we demonstrate an extraction methodology capable of decoupling the magnetic permeability from the electric permittivity. Assuming that the dielectric contribution remains invariant below the N'eel temperature (TN), we used data from the paramagnetic phase to isolate the intrinsic magnetic component at 13 K. The angular and thermal dependence of the spectra revealed a magnon mode near 1 THz (for 0$^\circ$ orientation) and, distinctively, a zone-folded phonon activated by symmetry breaking (at 90$^\circ$). The isolated magnetic permeability was successfully modeled using Drude-Lorentz oscillators, enabling the extraction of fundamental spin dynamics parameters in this material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Terahertz Time-Domain Spectroscopy (THz-TDS)”进行测量，并描述温度依赖的电磁响应实验。；研究对象：层状Mott绝缘体NiPS₃，具体研究其XY型反铁磁有序下的电磁动力学响应，包括磁振子（magnon）和声子模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在NiPS₃中观测到约1 THz的磁振子模式（0°取向）以及由对称性破缺激活的折叠声子模式（90°取向）；通过新方法成功将磁导率与介电常数解耦，并提取了低温下的本征磁响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在NiPS₃中观测到约1 THz的磁振子模式（0°取向）以及由对称性破缺激活的折叠声子模式（90°取向）；通过新方法成功将磁导率与介电常数解耦，并提取了低温下的本征磁响应。；创新点：提出并演示了一种在磁导率不可近似为1时，从THz透射数据中解耦磁导率与介电常数的方法，从而能够独立提取磁性贡献，并据此获得自旋动力学参数。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 太赫兹时域光谱（THz-TDS），变温测量；提出一种从复折射率中解耦磁导率与介电常数的提取方法，利用顺磁相数据（假设介电贡献在Néel温度以下不变）分离出13 K下的本征磁贡献；用Drude-Lorentz振子模型拟合隔离后的磁导率。

papers.title: Above Room-Temperature Phase Transition in Helicoidal 2D Halide Perovskite Enables Pyro-Phototronic Control
papers.abstract: Bridging pyro-phototronic and ferroelectric properties in a single material not only gives rise to exotic physical phenomena but also provides strategy to build-up next-generation multi-functional energy harvesting devices. The layered halide perovskites are emerging class of synergetic 2D-materials of exceptional light-induced functionalities. Here, we report synthesis of a lead-free perovskite (3-fluorobenzylamine)2CuCl4 of partially fluorinated aromatic rings. Molecular chains are chiral in helicoids so to render flexibility, energy-transfer, and freedom to tailor tunable pyro-phototronics on light illumination. The fluorinated framework promotes ferroelectric-to-paraelectric transition point (TC), as high as \textasciitilde 412 K of wide range of workably. A giant pyro-photronic response is distinctly evident even upon UV-visible light-illuminations. A significantly high pyro-photronic current of 60 nA was achieved under an illumination of λex\textasciitilde 365 nm (27 mW) in a self-powered configuration. Consequently, an intricate coupling of the spontaneous polarization to the optical properties is visualized from the piezo response force microscopy (PFM) responses. In particular, the polar domains get diminished reversibly in on-off steps of the light irradiations. It indicates, the light provides another degree of the freedom to control the features for the applications of optoelectronic devices, optical memories, photo/thermo-chromic systems, and energy-harvesters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“synthesis”（合成）、“piezo response force microscopy (PFM) responses”（压电力显微镜响应）等实验手段。；研究对象：无铅二维卤化物钙钛矿（3-氟苄胺）₂CuCl₄，具有部分氟化芳香环、螺旋状手性分子链结构，以及铁电-顺电相变和热释电-光电子（pyro-phototronic）耦合效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该材料在室温以上（~412 K）发生铁电-顺电相变，并在紫外-可见光照射下表现出显著的热释电-光电子响应，自供电模式下在365 nm（27 mW）光照下产生高达60 nA的光热释电电流；光照可逆地调控极化畴，表明光可作为控制铁电极化的额外自由度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该材料在室温以上（~412 K）发生铁电-顺电相变，并在紫外-可见光照射下表现出显著的热释电-光电子响应，自供电模式下在365 nm（27 mW）光照下产生高达60 nA的光热释电电流；光照可逆地调控极化畴，表明光可作为控制铁电极化的额外自由度。；创新点：首次在无铅二维卤化物钙钛矿中实现室温以上（~412 K）的铁电-顺电相变，并通过部分氟化芳香环设计赋予螺旋手性分子链，从而同时实现高热释电-光电子响应和光控极化畴可逆调控，为多功能能量收集和光电器件提供新策略。
papers.method_zh: 化学合成（制备部分氟化芳香环的层状钙钛矿单晶/薄膜）；压电力响应显微镜（PFM）用于观测极化畴及其在光照开关下的可逆变化；光电流测量（自供电配置，λ_ex ~ 365 nm，27 mW）用于表征热释电-光电子响应；相变温度通过（推测为介电或热学测量，摘要未明确说明具体手段）确定。

papers.title: Magnetic Communication with an Acoustically Actuated Magnetoelectric Resonator and a Quantum Diamond Magnetometer
papers.abstract: Wireless communication via propagating magnetic fields is a communication modality that has recently garnered significant interest for short-to-medium range communication in conductive mediums, such as underwater and underground, where existing approaches utilizing electric fields are highly inefficient. Typical implementations of magnetic communication make use of loop antennas as both the transmitter and receiver, with the sensitivity and frequency response scaling with and inversely with the loop cross-sectional area, respectively.
