papers.abstract_summary_zh: 暗物质晕的本动速度分布可以用基于非广延统计力学的双参数 Tsallis 模型精确描述（在速度<1000 km/s 时精度达5%），且该分布随时间演化越来越偏离高斯分布和热平衡态。理论上，该分布可展开为一系列 Tsallis 分布函数的叠加，而零阶近似（单一 Tsallis 函数）已足够精确。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：暗物质晕的本动速度分布可以用基于非广延统计力学的双参数 Tsallis 模型精确描述（在速度<1000 km/s 时精度达5%），且该分布随时间演化越来越偏离高斯分布和热平衡态。理论上，该分布可展开为一系列 Tsallis 分布函数的叠加，而零阶近似（单一 Tsallis 函数）已足够精确。；创新点：首次将暗物质晕的本动速度分布与非广延统计力学（Tsallis 统计）建立直接联系，并证明其在宽速度范围内的高精度适用性。同时，理论推导表明该分布可表示为 Tsallis 分布函数的级数叠加，为理解宇宙网引力演化的非平衡统计提供了新视角。摘要还指出拟合参数（尤其是速度弥散）有望作为宇宙学参数的有效探针。
papers.method_zh: 1) 从大型 N 体模拟中提取暗物质晕样本；2) 使用最大似然估计对速度分布进行双参数 Tsallis 模型拟合；3) 在超统计（superstatistics）框架下，利用基于伽马分布的广义 Gram-Charlier 展开进行理论重构。

papers.title: Beyond geometric symmetry: Broadband linear relations in wave scattering
papers.abstract: The design and control of wave scattering, that is, of the reflection and transmission parameters of a device, is of ubiquitous importance. These parameters generally change with varying frequency, though certain \emph{frequency-independent} linear relations may exist between them. Reciprocity and geometric symmetry (reflections, rotations, etc.) are classic and well-known examples that are present in many devices and significantly ease their design. In this work, we go beyond these and introduce a new class of relations that cannot be induced by reciprocity or geometric symmetry. Choosing networks of waveguides as our workhorse, we discuss the conditions and consequences of such novel behaviour and showcase suitable example setups. We further experimentally test our predictions using coaxial cables and find excellent agreement in the broad frequency range between 0 and 1 GHz. Our work not only deepens the theoretical understanding of waveguide network dynamics, but also opens new avenues for applications in broadband signal processing, quantum information, and integrated photonics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论分析 + 实验验证）。判断依据：摘要中同时出现“introduce a new class of relations”“discuss the conditions”等理论推导表述，以及“experimentally test our predictions using coaxial cables”等实验验证表述。；研究对象：波导网络（waveguide networks）中的波散射现象，具体关注反射与透射参数之间存在的频率无关线性关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一类新的频率无关线性关系，这类关系无法由互易性或几何对称性（反射、旋转等）诱导产生，并在0–1 GHz宽频范围内通过同轴电缆实验得到验证。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一类新的频率无关线性关系，这类关系无法由互易性或几何对称性（反射、旋转等）诱导产生，并在0–1 GHz宽频范围内通过同轴电缆实验得到验证。；创新点：超越了传统由互易性和几何对称性所决定的散射关系，首次提出并实验验证了一类全新的、非对称性起源的频率无关线性关系。摘要未突出说明其与具体已有工作的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为波导网络的散射矩阵分析；实验手段为同轴电缆搭建的波导网络，在0–1 GHz频率范围内测量散射参数。

papers.title: Random Recursive Simplicial Complexes
papers.abstract: We investigate random recursive simplicial complexes growing by adding, at each step, a vertex together with a simplex formed by joining the new vertex with a randomly chosen existing simplex. We also add all faces of the new simplex to ensure that the resulting object remains a simplicial complex. If the choice of an existing simplex is uniform among simplices of dimension $<m$, the number $S_d$ of simplices of any admissible dimension $d\leq m$ is an asymptotically self-averaging random variable. This feature allows us to determine the asymptotic growth law of the average of $S_d$ when the number of vertices diverges. We also probe the degree distribution, examine the probabilities of various extreme outcomes, and analyze the characteristics of the first vertex.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要涉及随机递归单纯复形的数学定义、概率分析与渐近增长规律，属于统计物理与随机图论交叉的理论研究。；研究对象：随机递归单纯复形（Random Recursive Simplicial Complexes），即一种随时间逐步生长的高维网络/几何结构，其生长规则为每一步新增一个顶点，并将该顶点与一个随机选取的已有单纯形相连，同时补齐所有面以保持单纯复形性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于任意允许维度 d ≤ m，单纯形数目 S_d 是渐近自平均（self-averaging）的随机变量；基于此，可确定当顶点数趋于无穷时 S_d 平均值的渐近增长律。此外，研究还给出了度分布、极端事件概率以及第一个顶点的特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于任意允许维度 d ≤ m，单纯形数目 S_d 是渐近自平均（self-averaging）的随机变量；基于此，可确定当顶点数趋于无穷时 S_d 平均值的渐近增长律。此外，研究还给出了度分布、极端事件概率以及第一个顶点的特征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其创新在于将经典随机递归图（如随机递归树）推广到高维单纯复形，并利用自平均性严格求解各维度单纯形数的增长律。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：利用随机递归过程的概率方法，研究均匀随机选择维度 < m 的单纯形时的统计性质；通过自平均性推导平均单纯形数的渐近行为，并分析度分布与极端概率。

papers.title: Quantum cellular automata and invertible phases of matter
papers.abstract: We introduce and study (fermionic and bosonic) invertible quasi-local algebras over uniformly locally finite metric spaces $X$ with infinite-dimensional local von Neumann algebras. We show that the group of Brauer equivalence classes of such algebras is isomorphic to both the group of phases of invertible states and the group of stable equivalence classes of quantum cellular automata over $X\times \mathbb{Z}$. Using K-theory of the symmetric monoidal category of invertible quasi-local algebras and bounded spread isomorphisms, we propose a definition of an $Ω$-spectrum of invertible phases as conjectured by Kitaev. We then show that the $c=\frac{1}{2}$ chiral Majorana fermion net and the $(E_{8})_{1}$ conformal net provide Brauer non-trivial invertible quasi-local algebras, thus providing explicit constructions of non-trivial invertible states and quantum cellular automata on $\mathbb{Z}^{2}$. In addition, we show that the time-slice nets of rational diagonal conformal field theories admit lattice degrees of freedom, which implies the discretization of any holomorphic conformal net is invertible.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“引入并研究”“提出定义”“证明同构”等数学物理理论推导关键词，无实验或数值计算内容。；研究对象：量子格点系统与拓扑物态，具体包括：费米子和玻色子的可逆准局域代数、可逆物相（invertible phases）、量子元胞自动机（QCA），以及手性马约拉纳费米子网和 (E₈)₁ 共形网等一维/二维量子场论体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了可逆准局域代数的 Brauer 等价类群与可逆态相群、以及 X×ℤ 上量子元胞自动机的稳定等价类群三者同构；并给出 c=1/2 手性马约拉纳网和 (E₈)₁ 共形网作为 Brauer 非平凡的可逆准局域代数的显式构造，从而在 ℤ² 上提供了非平凡可逆态和量子元胞自动机的具体例子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了可逆准局域代数的 Brauer 等价类群与可逆态相群、以及 X×ℤ 上量子元胞自动机的稳定等价类群三者同构；并给出 c=1/2 手性马约拉纳网和 (E₈)₁ 共形网作为 Brauer 非平凡的可逆准局域代数的显式构造，从而在 ℤ² 上提供了非平凡可逆态和量子元胞自动机的具体例子。；创新点：首次将可逆准局域代数的 Brauer 等价类、可逆态相群和量子元胞自动机稳定等价类三者统一在同构框架下，并给出 Kitaev Ω-谱的严格定义；同时通过共形网显式构造了二维非平凡可逆态与 QCA。摘要还指出有理对角共形场论的时间片网具有格点自由度，从而任何全纯共形网的离散化都是可逆的。
papers.method_zh: 采用算子代数与张量范畴方法：引入可逆准局域代数及其 Brauer 等价类，利用对称幺半范畴的 K-理论定义 Kitaev 猜测的 Ω-谱；结合共形场论中的时间片网（time-slice nets）与格点化分析。

papers.title: Optically Induced Thermal Runaway in Phase-Change VO2 Nanostructures
papers.abstract: While thermal runaway occurs across diverse physical disciplines, its presence in subwavelength phase-change photonics remains unexplored because existing thermo-optical models break down near sharp optical transitions. Here, we introduce an iterative multiphysics framework coupling full-wave electrodynamics with heat transfer, and we discover optically induced thermal runaway in vanadium dioxide (VO2) nanostructures. The runaway switching threshold depends on the illumination wavelength, ambient temperature, and underlying substrate, with external thermal biasing significantly reducing the optical intensity required for runaway ignition. Our results push forward the modeling of sharp photothermal transitions and provide essential design principles for active metasurfaces, neuromorphic photonic devices, and nanoscale thermal management.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提到“引入迭代多物理场框架”“耦合全波电动力学与热传递”，属于建模与数值模拟研究。；研究对象：二氧化钒（VO2）纳米结构中的光致热失控现象，涉及亚波长相变光子学、光-热耦合非线性效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在VO2纳米结构中发现了光致热失控现象，其开关阈值依赖于光照波长、环境温度和衬底类型，且外部热偏置可显著降低触发热失控所需的光强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在VO2纳米结构中发现了光致热失控现象，其开关阈值依赖于光照波长、环境温度和衬底类型，且外部热偏置可显著降低触发热失控所需的光强。；创新点：首次在亚波长相变光子学体系中揭示光致热失控现象，并建立了能够处理尖锐光热相变过渡的迭代多物理场建模方法，为有源超表面和神经形态光子器件提供设计原则。
papers.method_zh: 迭代多物理场仿真框架，将全波电动力学（求解麦克斯韦方程）与热传导方程耦合求解，用于处理尖锐光学跃迁附近传统热-光模型失效的问题。

papers.title: Large Deviations for the Bose--Einstein Condensate of the Ideal Gas in the Canonical Ensemble
papers.abstract: We consider a non-interacting Bose gas governed by a general one-particle Hamiltonian in the canonical ensemble. Our main results are large-deviation estimates for the number of particles in the Bose--Einstein condensate. We show that the left- and right-tail probabilities decay at different exponential rates as the number of particles tends to infinity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确讨论“large-deviation estimates”（大偏差估计）与“exponential rates”（指数速率），属于数学物理/严格分析的理论研究。；研究对象：理想玻色气体（non-interacting Bose gas）在正则系综（canonical ensemble）下的玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚（BEC）现象，体系由一般单粒子哈密顿量（general one-particle Hamiltonian）描述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在粒子数趋于无穷时，凝聚体粒子数的左尾（低于均值）与右尾（高于均值）概率衰减具有不同的指数速率，即大偏差函数左右不对称。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在粒子数趋于无穷时，凝聚体粒子数的左尾（低于均值）与右尾（高于均值）概率衰减具有不同的指数速率，即大偏差函数左右不对称。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异，但明确指出“左尾与右尾以不同指数速率衰减”这一非对称性结果，可能区别于以往对称高斯涨落或仅关注平均行为的处理。
papers.method_zh: 采用大偏差理论（large deviation theory）进行严格数学分析，针对正则系综中凝聚体粒子数的统计涨落给出指数级衰减估计。

papers.title: Lieb-Schultz-Mattis Constraints for Quantum Channels: A Spacetime-Duality View
papers.abstract: Quantum anomalies strongly constrain the possible behavior of many-body systems. A prime example is the Lieb-Schultz-Mattis (LSM) theorem, which relates UV symmetry and filling constraints to IR features of the energy spectrum and ground-state structure. Here, we ask how LSM constraints shape dynamical signatures and temporal correlations in open quantum systems. Using a spacetime duality, we show that the Liouvillian of a $d$-dimensional repeated quantum channel with a mixed anomaly between strong $S$ and weak $G$ symmetry can be mapped to a $(d{+}1)$-dimensional mixed-state symmetry-protected topological (mSPT) phase. Under this correspondence, the initial and steady states of the channel are identified with boundary states of the higher-dimensional mSPT in the presence of bulk projection. We further introduce the twisted Renyi-$N$ correlator (TRNC) as a probe of temporal correlations in the channel and demonstrate that it is dual to the mSPT strange correlator, providing a direct bulk-boundary route to diagnose long-range temporal order implied by the LSM anomaly. Finally, we identify the \textit{Liouvillian singular spectrum}, rather than the Liouvillian spectrum itself, as a more fundamental diagnostic of quantum anomalies, and show that it is dual to the operator entanglement spectrum of the mSPT.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：spacetime duality、mapped to、theoretical framework。；研究对象：开放量子系统中重复量子通道（repeated quantum channel）的动力学，特别是具有混合量子反常（mixed anomaly）的对称性约束下的时间关联与李雅普诺夫谱。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过时空对偶，d维重复量子通道的刘维尔算符可映射为(d+1)维混合态对称性保护拓扑（mSPT）相；LSM反常导致的长时间有序可通过扭曲Renyi-N关联函数（TRNC）与mSPT的strange correlator的对偶关系来诊断，且刘维尔奇异谱（而非刘维尔谱本身）是量子反常的更基本诊断量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过时空对偶，d维重复量子通道的刘维尔算符可映射为(d+1)维混合态对称性保护拓扑（mSPT）相；LSM反常导致的长时间有序可通过扭曲Renyi-N关联函数（TRNC）与mSPT的strange correlator的对偶关系来诊断，且刘维尔奇异谱（而非刘维尔谱本身）是量子反常的更基本诊断量。；创新点：首次将LSM定理的约束从平衡态基态性质推广到开放量子通道的动力学时间关联，提出刘维尔奇异谱作为反常诊断的新概念，并建立了TRNC与mSPT strange correlator的直接对偶关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：时空对偶（spacetime duality）、混合态对称性保护拓扑（mSPT）相、边界-体对应（bulk-boundary correspondence）、扭曲Renyi-N关联函数（TRNC）、strange correlator、算子纠缠谱（operator entanglement spectrum）分析。

papers.title: Why Cooper pairs live in AdS2: a spectral analysis of the Yukawa-SYK model
papers.abstract: We establish the spectral foundation of the geometric formulation of Cooper pairing in the Yukawa--Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev model. Starting from the large-$N$ bilocal effective action, we derive the Gaussian fluctuation kernel in the even-frequency spin-singlet Cooper channel. Following the construction of Maldacena and Stanford, we determine the kernel eigenvalue $k\left(h\right)$ analytically for arbitrary conformal weight $h$ and resolve the pairing fluctuations into the continuous and discrete sectors of the associated de-Sitter space Laplacian. We show that the superconducting instability and the universal low-energy fluctuations near it reside entirely in the continuous scattering sector, while the discrete modes remain non-critical. Expanding the kernel about the lowest continuum mode yields a Klein--Gordon action on ${\rm dS}_2$, restricted to the continuous spectral subspace. This is precisely the subspace on which the inverse Radon transform to ${\rm AdS}_2$ is well defined. The projected bilocal Cooper-pair field can therefore be mapped onto a scalar matter field propagating in ${\rm AdS}_2$, without requiring any further spectral restriction on the bulk theory. Our results provide the missing microscopic justification for the projection implicit in earlier holographic formulations and clarify how a local bulk field emerges from the bilocal pairing theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要涉及“large-N bilocal effective action”“kernel eigenvalue”“Klein–Gordon action”等解析理论推导，无实验或数值计算关键词。；研究对象：Yukawa–SYK（Yukawa–Sachdev–Ye–Kitaev）模型中的Cooper配对问题，具体关注配对涨落的谱结构及其与AdS₂几何（de Sitter空间）的对应关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Cooper配对的不稳定性及其附近的普适低能涨落完全位于连续散射谱中，离散模不临界；将核在最低连续模附近展开可得到限制在连续谱子空间上的dS₂上的Klein–Gordon作用，该子空间恰好是Radon逆变换到AdS₂有良好定义的子空间，从而无需额外谱限制即可将双局域Cooper对场映射为AdS₂中的标量物质场。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Cooper配对的不稳定性及其附近的普适低能涨落完全位于连续散射谱中，离散模不临界；将核在最低连续模附近展开可得到限制在连续谱子空间上的dS₂上的Klein–Gordon作用，该子空间恰好是Radon逆变换到AdS₂有良好定义的子空间，从而无需额外谱限制即可将双局域Cooper对场映射为AdS₂中的标量物质场。；创新点：为早期全息表述中隐含的投影提供了微观证明，澄清了双局域配对理论如何涌现出局域体场，无需对体理论施加额外谱限制。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 从大N双局域有效作用出发，推导偶数频自旋单态Cooper道的高斯涨落核；沿用Maldacena–Stanford构造，解析求解任意共形权重h下的核本征值k(h)，将配对涨落分解为dS₂拉普拉斯算子的连续谱与离散谱部分，并利用Radon逆变换建立到AdS₂的映射。

papers.title: Least Variable Quantum Counting Processes
papers.abstract: Counting processes provide a fundamental description of stochastic events ranging from photon detection to clock ticks. A central question is how accurately such events can be timed when only finite memory resources are available. Here, we investigate this problem within a general framework of finite-dimensional classical and quantum counting processes. We derive a rigorous finite-memory variance bound obeyed by every classical $d$-state counting process, which is tight and saturated by a discrete Erlang-type ladder process. Through numerical optimization, we identify quantum counting processes that violate this classical bound, achieving smaller first-tick fluctuations than any classical process with the same memory size and mean tick time. For the qubit case, we further derive an analytical large-mean bound within a single-Kraus no-tick family, showing that the quantum advantage persists asymptotically within this class. The optimized quantum processes exhibit coherent conditioned dynamics and approach a continuous-time quantum-jump description as the mean increases. Our results establish a finite-memory quantum advantage in temporal precision and connect discrete-time counting processes with continuous-time quantum timekeeping.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：general framework、derive a rigorous bound、numerical optimization、analytical derivation。；研究对象：有限维经典与量子计数过程（counting processes），即描述随机事件（如光子探测、时钟滴答）发生时间序列的随机过程，重点关注有限记忆资源下的计时精度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在相同记忆维度（d态）和平均首次滴答时间下，存在量子计数过程能突破所有经典d态计数过程所满足的有限记忆方差下界，实现更小的首次滴答时间涨落，即有限记忆下的量子计时精度优势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在相同记忆维度（d态）和平均首次滴答时间下，存在量子计数过程能突破所有经典d态计数过程所满足的有限记忆方差下界，实现更小的首次滴答时间涨落，即有限记忆下的量子计时精度优势。；创新点：首次在有限记忆（有限维）框架下严格证明并数值展示量子计数过程相对于经典过程的计时精度优势，并建立了离散时间计数过程与连续时间量子守时（quantum timekeeping）之间的联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导（严格证明经典d态计数过程的方差下界，并构造饱和该下界的离散Erlang型阶梯过程）；数值优化（搜索量子计数过程以最小化首次滴答方差）；解析分析（在单Kraus无滴答族内推导大平均时间下的方差界，证明量子优势的渐近保持）。

papers.title: Intrinsic temporal and spectral mixing in time-resolved terahertz spectroscopy
papers.abstract: In an ultrafast optical-pump terahertz-probe measurement, the photoinduced material response can be modulated on a timescale shorter than the extent of the THz pulse. In this situation, the measured time-frequency response deviates from a simple time-dependent linear response. When full two-dimensional time-frequency maps are measured, this yields complex features that can be incorrectly assigned to a photoexcited coherent response. We investigate this experimentally via the measured response of photoexcited SnSe, whereby photoinduced phase change dynamics lead to ultrafast changes of the charge carrier and lattice optical conductivity response. Two-dimensional time-frequency THz transmission maps subsequently show unexpected time-frequency features at early pump-probe delay times. These features are reproduced in both finite-difference time-domain simulations of the THz experiment and in an extension of non-equilibrium response function theory, demonstrating their systematic origin. This work improves the understanding of systematic effects in high time resolution optical-pump THz-probe spectroscopy, and explores the conditions in which they are likely to appear.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验 + 模拟 + 理论）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experimentally via the measured response”、“finite-difference time-domain simulations”以及“extension of non-equilibrium response function theory”。；研究对象：光激发SnSe（硒化锡）材料在超快光泵浦-太赫兹探测实验中的瞬态光电导响应，特别是光致相变导致的载流子与晶格光学电导率的超快变化，以及由此产生的二维时间-频率太赫兹透射图谱中的伪特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超快光泵浦-太赫兹探测中，当光致材料响应在比太赫兹脉冲宽度更短的时间尺度上调制时，测量到的时间-频率响应会偏离简单的含时线性响应，产生可被错误归因于光激发相干响应的复杂特征。这些特征在SnSe中被实验观测到，并通过模拟和理论扩展证明其具有系统性起源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超快光泵浦-太赫兹探测中，当光致材料响应在比太赫兹脉冲宽度更短的时间尺度上调制时，测量到的时间-频率响应会偏离简单的含时线性响应，产生可被错误归因于光激发相干响应的复杂特征。这些特征在SnSe中被实验观测到，并通过模拟和理论扩展证明其具有系统性起源。；创新点：系统揭示了高时间分辨光泵浦-太赫兹探测光谱中因“时间-频谱混合”效应产生的伪特征，并给出了其出现的条件，从而提高了对该类实验中系统性效应的理解。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用超快光泵浦-太赫兹探测光谱（optical-pump THz-probe spectroscopy），测量二维时间-频率太赫兹透射图谱；数值上使用时域有限差分（FDTD）模拟太赫兹实验；理论上扩展了非平衡响应函数理论（non-equilibrium response function theory）以复现实验特征。

papers.title: Front-induced transitions control THz waves
papers.abstract: Relativistically moving dielectric perturbations can be used to manipulate light in new and exciting ways beyond the capabilities of traditional nonlinear optics. Adiabatic interaction with the moving front modulates the wave simultaneously in both space and time, and manifests a front-induced transition in both wave vector and frequency yielding exotic effects including non-reciprocity and time-reversal. Here, we introduce a technique called SLIPSTREAM, Spacetime Light-Induced Photonic STRucturEs for Advanced Manipulation. The technique is based on the creation of relativistic fronts in a semiconductor-filled planar waveguide by photoexcitation of mobile charge carriers. Here we demonstrate the capabilities of SLIPSTREAM for novel manipulation of THz light pulses through relativistic front-induced transitions. In the sub-luminal front velocity regime, we generate temporally stretched THz waveforms, with a quasi-static field lasting for several picoseconds tunable with the front interaction distance. In the super-luminal regime, the carrier front outpaces the THz pulse and a time-reversal operation is performed via a front-induced intra-band transition. We anticipate our platform will be a versatile tool for future applications in the THz spectral band requiring direct and advanced control of light at the sub-cycle level.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/实验混合类型。判断依据：摘要中既有理论机制描述（“Adiabatic interaction with the moving front modulates the wave…”），也包含实验演示（“we demonstrate the capabilities of SLIPSTREAM…”）。；研究对象：半导体填充平面波导中的太赫兹（THz）光脉冲，具体物理现象为相对论运动介电扰动（移动载流子前沿）诱导的光波波矢与频率的跃迁，包括亚光速与超光速两种前沿速度区间的THz波形操控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过光激发移动载流子前沿（SLIPSTREAM技术），在亚光速区间可产生准静态、持续数皮秒且可调谐的拉伸THz波形；在超光速区间可实现THz脉冲的时间反演操作（通过前沿诱导的带内跃迁）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过光激发移动载流子前沿（SLIPSTREAM技术），在亚光速区间可产生准静态、持续数皮秒且可调谐的拉伸THz波形；在超光速区间可实现THz脉冲的时间反演操作（通过前沿诱导的带内跃迁）。；创新点：提出并实验验证了SLIPSTREAM（Spacetime Light-Induced Photonic STRucturEs for Advanced Manipulation）技术，利用相对论移动前沿实现对THz光脉冲的亚周期级直接操控，包括非互易性、时间反演和准静态场生成，超越了传统非线性光学的调控能力。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用半导体填充平面波导，通过光激发移动电荷载流子产生相对论移动介电前沿；理论上基于移动前沿与光波的绝热相互作用，分析波矢与频率的同时调制（时空耦合跃迁）。

papers.abstract: We employ a generalized approach to the master equation for driven open N-level (N>2) quantum systems using Lewis–Riesenfeld invariants, which avoids the driving-strength restrictions inherent to conventional approaches. We show that the invariant-based master equation provides a unifying general…

papers.title: Magnetoelasticity in Fe/GaAs(110) films: Depth profile of magnetic anisotropy
papers.abstract: The authors report here the coexistence of cubic and uniaxial magnetic anisotropies in thick epitaxial bcc Fe(110)/GaAs(110) films, with the latter having a magnitude comparable to that of the former. Their interplay stabilizes an in-plane easy axis along the ⟨001⟩ directions that persists throughout the film volume for thicknesses up to 100 nm. This unconventional behavior gives rise to a depth-dependent magnetic response, with perpendicular standing spin-wave modes exhibiting distinct sensitivities to different regions of the film thickness. The study further identifies anisotropic strain as the microscopic origin of the observed in-plane uniaxial anisotropy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中“The authors report”“The study further identifies”等表述，以及涉及磁性测量和自旋波模式，属于实验研究。；研究对象：外延生长的体心立方（bcc）Fe(110)/GaAs(110) 薄膜，具体研究其磁弹性和磁各向异性的深度分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在厚度达100 nm的Fe(110)/GaAs(110)薄膜中，立方磁各向异性与单轴磁各向异性共存且强度相当，二者相互作用使面内易轴沿⟨001⟩方向稳定存在；各向异性应变是面内单轴各向异性的微观起源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在厚度达100 nm的Fe(110)/GaAs(110)薄膜中，立方磁各向异性与单轴磁各向异性共存且强度相当，二者相互作用使面内易轴沿⟨001⟩方向稳定存在；各向异性应变是面内单轴各向异性的微观起源。；创新点：发现厚膜（高达100 nm）中单轴各向异性与立方各向异性强度相当且贯穿整个膜厚，导致磁响应具有深度依赖性，并将单轴各向异性归因于各向异性应变。摘要未突出说明与以往薄层研究的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如磁光克尔效应、铁磁共振、布里渊光散射等），仅提及通过垂直驻留自旋波模式（perpendicular standing spin-wave modes）探测不同厚度区域的磁响应，并进行了应变分析。

papers.method_zh: 理论形式化分类与推导。摘要中未提及具体的数值实现、基准测试或软件代码，仅涉及对泛函数学结构的分类定义。

papers.title: Topological gyromorphs
papers.abstract: Author(s): Laura Gómez Paz, Justin Schirmann, Adam Yanis Chaou, Isidora Araya Day, and Adolfo G. Grushin Gyromorphs are disordered structures that retain quasi-long-range rotational order. They support unusually large, isotropic photonic band gaps, making them promising for technological applications. Here, the authors show that gyromorphs host higher-order topological insulating phases protected by rotational symmetry realized only on average, precisely where standard real-space diagnostics become ambiguous. They develop a diagnostic toolbox for average rotational symmetries that yields a consistent phase diagram, establishing gyromorphs as a new platform for statistical-symmetry-protected topology beyond crystals and quasicrystals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“develop a diagnostic toolbox”（发展诊断工具）、“yield a consistent phase diagram”（得到相图），属于理论分析与数值计算结合的研究。；研究对象：Gyromorphs——一种无序但保留准长程旋转有序的结构，论文研究其高阶拓扑绝缘体相，以及由“平均旋转对称性”保护的拓扑态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Gyromorphs 可以承载由平均旋转对称性保护的高阶拓扑绝缘体相，且这种对称性仅在统计意义上成立；作者建立了适用于平均旋转对称性的诊断工具，得到一致的相图，确立了 gyromorphs 作为超越晶体和准晶的统计对称性保护拓扑新平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Gyromorphs 可以承载由平均旋转对称性保护的高阶拓扑绝缘体相，且这种对称性仅在统计意义上成立；作者建立了适用于平均旋转对称性的诊断工具，得到一致的相图，确立了 gyromorphs 作为超越晶体和准晶的统计对称性保护拓扑新平台。；创新点：首次在 gyromorphs（无序但具有准长程旋转有序的结构）中实现高阶拓扑绝缘体相，并解决了标准实空间拓扑诊断在平均对称性下失效的问题，提出新的诊断框架，将拓扑保护的范畴从晶体和准晶扩展到统计对称性体系。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如紧束缚模型、第一性原理计算等），但明确提到开发了针对平均旋转对称性的“诊断工具箱”（diagnostic toolbox），用于识别拓扑相并绘制相图。具体计算手段摘要未详细交代。
